deepseek.summary_zh: DeepSeek 團隊發表 DeepSeek-V4 家族首款實驗性多模態模型 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp。該模型以 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 架構為基礎,加入視覺模組並進行持續訓練(continued training),以解鎖視覺理解能力。方法上,團隊在既有文字模型中整合視覺元件,再透過後續訓練使模型具備處理影像輸入的能力。主要證據來自與 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 及 Opus-4.8 的基準比較:在多模態代理能力上,新模型較原版有顯著進步;在純文字代理任務方面,則維持與原版相當的水準,例如 Terminal Bench 2.1 由 82.7 升至 83.9,NL2Repo 由 54.2 升至 57.7,DeepSWE 由 54.4 升至 59.3,但 Cybergym 由 76.7 微降至 75.3,顯示部分文字任務可能出現輕微退化。除 DeepSWE 以 59.3 略勝 Opus-4.8 的 58.0 外,其餘項目仍落後,如 NL2Repo 57.7 對 69.7。限制方面,此為實驗性版本,內容僅提供摘要,未詳述訓練資料規模、視覺架構細節、安全評估及多模態基準的完整分數,結論宜視為初步結果。其意義在於驗證 DeepSeek 能在不大損文字代理能力的前提下擴充至多模態,為 V4 系列後續的視覺化發展奠定基礎。

other.summary: TimesFM (Time Series Foundation Model) is a pretrained time-series foundation model developed by Google Research for time-series forecasting. This repository contains the official PyTorch weights and configurations for **TimesFM 3.0**. This model is released under the **TimesFM Non-Commercial License v1.0**. - **Architecture**: Stacked Mixing Transformer with Variate Attention and CPM Iterative RevIN. - **Context Patch Length**: 32 - **Forecast Horizon Patch Length**: 64 - **Layers**: 20 transformer layers (model dim: 1280, heads: 16) - **Quantiles**: (median at index 4) timesfm-3.0 is pretrained using - GiftEvalPretrain excluding the datasets that overlap with fev-bench
other.summary_zh: 本頁面為 Hugging Face 上的模型儲存庫「google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch」,目前僅有標題可參考、未附完整摘要,因此本導讀僅依標題與 TimesFM 系列的公開背景做克制說明,不推測未提供的實驗證據。TimesFM 是 Google 發展的時間序列基礎模型(foundation model)系列,目標是針對時間序列資料提供通用的點預測能力。該系列採用 decoder-only 的 Transformer 架構,以大量真實與合成時間序列資料進行預訓練,強調零樣本(zero-shot)推論:使用者不需針對個別資料集重新訓練或進行 fine-tuning,即可直接產生預測結果。儲存庫名稱中,3.0 代表系列第三個主要版本,pytorch 表示此版本以 PyTorch 實作,便於在 PyTorch 生態系中載入、推論與部署。一般而言,系列更新多著重於更長的預測視窗與更好的準確度,但本頁面並未列出基準測試結果、訓練資料規模或與先前版本的比較,應以官方技術報告與模型卡為準。限制方面,摘要缺失使我們無法驗證具體改進幅度;此外,時間序列基礎模型普遍面臨資料分佈位移、不規律取樣、共變量與階層結構處理等挑戰。整體而言,此模型適合需要大規模時間序列預測且希望降低逐一調校成本的團隊,PyTorch 版本亦有助於降低部署門檻。

qwen.summary_zh: 本倉庫收錄 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 後訓練(post-trained)版本的 FP8 量化模型權重與設定檔,採用 Hugging Face Transformers 格式。其要解決的問題是:大型模型在部署時往往需要大量記憶體與運算資源,而 FP8 這類低精度格式可望在品質損失極小的前提下,降低儲存成本並提升推論吞吐量。量化方法採用細粒度(fine-grained)FP8 量化,區塊大小(block size)為 128,官方宣稱各項效能指標與原始模型幾乎一致。這些產物可直接搭配 Hugging Face Transformers、vLLM、SGLang、TokenSpeed 等主流推論框架,方便研究者在自有硬體上部署與實驗。此外,Qwen Cloud 提供官方 API 服務,讓不想自行維運基礎設施的使用者能取得可擴充的推論能力;而 Qwen3.8-Flash 則是以 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 為基礎、加入更多生產環境功能的官方版本,例如預設支援 1M(百萬級)上下文長度與內建官方工具。需要留意的是,本次內容僅為倉庫的摘要說明,並未附上完整技術報告或基準測試細節,量化前後的具體差異、適用硬體條件與授權條款等資訊,仍需查閱原始倉庫確認。整體而言,此釋出降低了高效率推論的入門門檻,對想在本地或自建環境執行大型模型的開發者具有實用價值。

stability-ai.summary_zh: Stability AI 發布的 Stable Audio 3 是一系列快速的潛在擴散模型(latent diffusion models),涵蓋小型、中型與大型三種規模,專為可變長度的音訊生成與編輯而設計。此存放庫收錄的是針對特定硬體加速進行最佳化的實驗性檢查點;若需標準版本,官方建議改用 Stable Audio 3 Medium,商業用途則須遵循 Stability AI 的授權條款。此工作要解決的核心問題在於:模型可生成長達數分鐘的音訊,若對短音效也從頭生成完整長度,運算成本將過高,因此可變長度生成成為關鍵設計;此外,模型支援 inpainting(局部修補),可進行目標式的音訊編輯,也能延續既有的短錄音。方法上,這些潛在擴散模型建立在新穎的語意—聲學自動編碼器(semantic-acoustic autoencoder)之上,先將音訊投影至緊湊的潛在空間,再於其上進行擴散生成,以降低運算負擔。限制方面,本存放庫屬實驗性質,最佳化僅針對特定硬體,通用性有限;公開摘要亦未提供量化的評估證據或效能資料,讀者宜以官方標準版本與授權頁面為準。整體而言,此工作反映音訊生成模型正朝向高效率、可彈性控制長度與局部編輯的方向發展,對音效設計與內容創作深具實用價值。

links.title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory

evidence: Section 4.3: at 8 composed memories raw collapse is 26.25 points; removing duplicated BOS columns recovers 13.75 (p=4.7e-4), net penalty 12.50 (p=0.0055); removing all BOS columns collapses accuracy to 0.106.
Section 4.3: co-visible training (30%) did not protect - both arms at -22.5 points at 8 memories, registered precondition failed because both sit near the floor; honestly reported as unresolvable.

Section 5.3: no-replay chain at generation 13 falls 8.93 points below fresh retrain (p=0.0031) and 11.79 below initialization-matched retrain (p=0.0001); thirteen no-replay updates worth +2.50 over stale floor at p=0.51, versus +17.50 for full replay.

Section 6.3: best single two-hop cell 0.357; every policy at every pile size ends at least 64.3 points short of the full-context reference; single-hop gains 16.7 points to a plateau near 32 updates (p=1.2e-10).

Section 6.3 wording factorial: naming contrast +83.3 points (p=1.3e-57), replicated on fresh items (+77.5 pasted, +77.8 injected); wrong-naming decoy adopted on 0.877 of items (95% CI 0.828-0.914), showing compliance not recognition.

Appendix B: two-hop visibility threshold tau = 0.82-0.92 across 1,500-24,000-token texts in both runs; fitted slope -0.045 (95% CI -0.130 to +0.046), supporting a constant-fraction co-preparation requirement.

Appendix A.4/A.5: pre-registered append-only record with registered rules and amendments; MDE convention (alpha=0.05, 80% power, exact McNemar, ~9.85-point MDE); metered costs of 0.34 GPU-hours (no-replay) to 5.35 (full-replay) per increment vs 5.03 for a fresh retrain.
Section 8: 'every verdict comes from one model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct'; tested lengths stop at 24,000 tokens; single seed, corpus, and cartridge size for warm-start chains - explicit scope limits.
Section 2.2/6.4: connects the naming/compliance finding to indirect prompt injection (Greshake et al. 2023) and agent-memory poisoning, framing update channels as injection surfaces.
Whole document: no explicit public code or data release statement found; replication infrastructure (manifest content hashes, pinned templates) is described but availability is not claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A careful negative-result measurement paper squarely on high-weight preferences: LLM KV-cache memory (caches and trained 'cartridges'), long-context reuse, RAG comparison, serving costs, multi-hop reasoning, and an injection-surface finding on update wording. Novelty is solid rather than transformative: it adjudicates between conflicting published claims (composability vs. collapse), quantifies the co-preparation threshold (~0.82-0.92 constant fraction for two-hop), and prices warm rebuilds with replay, but the techniques studied are existing ones applied unmodified. Rigor is exceptional for a single-author paper: pre-registered append-only record, MDE/power conventions via paired McNemar, mechanical (BOS-column) and content (padding) controls, initialization-matched retrain control, fresh-item replications, wrong-naming decoy control, cost metering, and honest reporting of failed preconditions and unresolvable comparisons. Evidence within scope is strong and internally consistent, but bounded by one model (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), lengths to 24k tokens, one corpus/seed for chains, and a descriptive-only second-model check, which caps generalizability. Reproducibility benefits from deterministic decoding, hash-checked templates, and manifest hashes, but no explicit public code/data release is stated. Heavy reliance on concurrent, unverifiable 2026 preprints slightly weakens the external grounding. Overall a high-quality, in-scope measurement contribution.

primary_link.title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory

papers.summary: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型可把長篇材料預先運算成可重複使用的記憶，形式包括直接 prefill 的 KV cache 與經 self-study 訓練壓縮的 cartridge。本文以 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 在合成文本與 LongHealth 臨床紀錄上，檢驗三個問題：分開準備的記憶能否重組、更新能否便宜地重建、修正能否不重建而在查詢時附加。結果顯示，組合多個獨立訓練的 cartridge 會使準確率下滑，8 個記憶的原始崩跌達 26.25 點，其中約半數來自重複的 BOS 起始欄位，移除後可免費回收，其餘損失連部分共同可見訓練也無法修補。暖啟動重建唯有重播舊資料才能維持品質：半重播以約全新重訓一半的成本達到相近效果，無重播雖便宜十五倍，十三代更新後與從不更新無異。查詢時附加修正最不可靠，單一相關修正的修復率約 0.34，更新累積至 512 則降至一成以下，二跳題上所有策略至少落後全文參考 64 點；填充對照證明損害來自修正內容而非篇幅。關鍵發現是「點名問題」的措辭可將採用率推升至九成以上，但帶假值的點名更新也幾乎同樣被採納，顯示機制是順從而非辨識，構成提示注入風險。限制在於結論僅基於單一模型，測試長度止於 24,000 tokens，且多數實驗使用合成文本。對部署而言，記憶應在事實變動時重建；若須在重建間隔附加更新，應以檢索或合併減少競爭修正，並讓每則更新點名其回答的問題。
papers.title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory

links.title: Ceiling-Clipped Acceptance Histograms Indicate Stranded Speed-up in Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding

evidence: Abstract: DBloom expands DFlash/DFlare drafters from B16 to B24 across Qwen3-8B/4B, raising per-prompt committed length on high-ceiling benchmarks by a median of +0.8 tokens (up to +1.1), and up to +1.37 with preceding continuation fine-tuning

Section 6.1 / Table 3: Spearman rho = +0.88 to +0.93 between pre-expansion block-ceiling fraction and realized committed-length gain over 35 drafter-benchmark points; the paper explicitly notes the evidence is in-sample with only ~5 independent drafters and omits a nominal CI

Appendix C, Table 6: data-only control (B16+30K, no expansion) gains +0.05 to +0.21 tokens versus +0.26 to +1.02 for the full B24 expansion on Qwen3-8B DFlare, attributing the gain to the wider block rather than extra data
Appendix D, Table 7: three training seeds for Qwen3-8B DFlare Arm-A agree within 0.029 tokens across all seven benchmarks, well inside the evaluation CIs

Section 6.3 and Appendix I, Tables 20-21: prompt-matched paired comparison shows DBloom-DFlare Arm-B with no significant committed-length loss to JetSpec at tree budgets up to 256 nodes (JetSpec leads only on AIME21-26 by 0.62, p=0.07), while Arm A shows one significant loss (MBPP at 256-node budget)
Section 7.2 (Scope): controlled grid limited to Qwen3 at 8B/4B with two drafter architectures plus one Gemma-4-12B-IT family check, with one target and one drafter not establishing universal transfer

Appendix A: full training recipe given (lr 1e-5, 4 epochs, global batch 64, AdamW, cosine schedule, 30K expansion corpus from OpenMathInstruct-2 and rStar-Coder), but the paper states no release of the DBloom drafters or evaluation code; only baseline weights (DFlash, DFlare, JetSpec) are cited as released
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM inference-methodology paper on speculative decoding with block-diffusion drafters (Qwen3-8B/4B, Gemma-4-12B-IT targets), squarely matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, Inference & Serving, Scaling & Efficiency, and Training & Optimization; not a pure domain application, so fully in scope. Novelty is moderate: the ceiling-bin diagnostic is a useful reframing of a signal the DFlash authors already observed (their Table 8), and block-horizon expansion via a cheap 30K-prompt curriculum (DBloom) is a natural but non-obvious, genuinely new recipe. Rigor and evidence are strong: a controlled 2x2 drafter x target grid, full test sets, prompt-level bootstrap CIs with Holm correction (Appendix H.2), a data-versus-expansion control isolating the wider block as the cause (Appendix C, Table 6), a six-arm loss-weighting ablation that honestly finds no effect (Appendix B, Table 5), three-seed robustness (Appendix D), EOS-runaway quantification (Appendix G), a reproduction gate against published values (Appendix H.3), and a prompt-matched out-of-design comparison vs JetSpec (Appendix I). The correlation analysis is correctly flagged as in-sample over ~5 drafters, and scope is narrow (one extra family check), limiting generalizability. Recipe details are extensive (Appendix A) but no release of DBloom code/weights is stated, capping reproducibility. Overall a careful, well-evidenced empirical contribution with incremental conceptual novelty.

primary_link.title: Ceiling-Clipped Acceptance Histograms Indicate Stranded Speed-up in Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding

papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up generation with an efficient draft model (drafter) that proposes tokens for a target model to verify in one pass, preserving the target's output distribution. High-acceptance block-diffusion drafters such as DFlash and DFlare fill an entire block in one parallel pass. In many cycles, the target accepts the whole block, so the drafter exhausts its trained block horizon before verification fails. We call this unrealized acceptance stranded speed-up. A mean committed
papers.summary_zh: 投機解碼以輕量草稿模型提出候選詞元，再由目標模型一次驗證。區塊擴散草稿器（如DFlash、DFlare）能以一次平行步驟填滿整個區塊，但在許多循環中目標模型會接受全部草稿詞元，使草稿器在驗證失敗前就用盡訓練時的區塊長度，形成作者所稱的「閒置加速」。僅看平均提交長度無法察覺此現象，完整的每循環接受直方圖卻會在「天花板區間」——即接受整個區塊的循環比例——出現尖峰，如同照片過曝截斷的高光，顯示區塊長度已成瓶頸。作者據此提出DBloom：先以接受直方圖作為事前診斷，再將B16草稿器後訓練擴充至B24。由於草稿器的雙向注意力會使直接加寬區塊侵蝕前段驗證並降低加速，作者採用約30K提示詞的短課程（僅約原訓練資料1%），對新增尾部位置加權訓練。在Qwen3-8B與Qwen3-4B上，高天花板基準的每提示提交長度中位數提升+0.8個詞元（至多+1.1），若先進行同區塊continuation fine-tuning再擴充，增益可達+1.37；配方亦成功轉移至Gemma-4-12B-IT。天花板比例與擴充增益的Spearman相關為+0.88至+0.93，可作為排序基準的指標。與樹狀草稿器JetSpec配對比較，線性B24草稿器在各樹節點預算下皆無統計顯著劣勢。限制在於受控網格僅涵蓋Qwen3加上單一Gemma檢查，相關性屬樣本內的描述性證據。此方法以極低成本指出何處擴充區塊值得投入訓練運算，兼具診斷與實用價值。

links.title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark

evidence: Abstract: 'we evaluate nine open and proprietary large language models and find that nearly all exhibit a systematic tendency to accept congruent evidence while resisting incongruent updates'
Section 3.5: 'Ground truth labels in DeReLab are produced deterministically by a path-based resolution procedure grounded in the inheritance theory of Horty et al. (1990)'
Section 5.2: 'GPT-5.1 reaches near-total incongruent failure (BiasGap = 0.935, OR = 891, 95% CI [586, 1498]) — a C2 accuracy of just 3.5%'
Section 5.4: 'The ICC across all model–condition cells is 0.949 (95% CI [0.938, 0.963])... Kruskal–Wallis tests yield no significant differences across the 20 seeds'
Appendix H: 'We use McNemar's test (with continuity correction)... Holm–Bonferroni correction is applied to control the family-wise error rate across the full set of comparisons'
Section 5.2 / Appendix I.1: question-order reversal shows C2-eff drops (e.g., Gemma-4-31B 0.970→0.264) while BiasGap is unchanged or increases, qualifying the know-but-don't-output claim
Limitations: 'DeReLab didn't evaluate models' consistency against human performance... Our evaluation includes only two explicitly reasoning-enabled configurations'
Table 2: '900 canonical evaluation conversations... 18,390 question turns'; Appendix L: 'All our data and code are public and available at https://github.com/Jayanta47/DeReLab'
Appendix J: pseudoword vs real-entity comparison shows 'no systematic advantage for either naming convention', supporting contamination-resistant design
llm_evaluation.rationale: A directly on-preference LLM reasoning-evaluation paper: it benchmarks nine open and proprietary LLMs (GPT-5.1/mini, Gemma-4 family, Llama-3.1, Qwen3-32B) on defeasible reasoning and confirmation bias using a generative, formally verified multi-turn benchmark. Strong alignment with LLM, reasoning/CoT, evaluation-benchmark, and bias preferences; no Japanese/agent/code component. Novelty is solid but incremental: it extends the generative-evaluation paradigm of ReCogLab and builds on established defeasible/NMR datasets (Rudinger 2020; Allaway & McKeown 2025) and known LLM cognitive-bias findings; the genuinely new elements are parameterized multi-turn belief-updating generation with verified labels, contamination-resistant pseudowords, and controlled bias probes. Rigor is high: deterministic graph resolver (Algorithm 1, Horty-style preemption), McNemar tests with Holm-Bonferroni correction, bootstrap OR CIs, question-order-reversal control for the metacognitive confound, and seed-reproducibility analysis (ICC 0.949). Evidence is quantitative and ablated (18,390 turns; e.g., GPT-5.1 BiasGap 0.935, OR 891, CI [586,1498]; Qwen3-32B* gap 0.008 vs 0.670 without thinking), though no human baseline is included and bias mechanisms are not explained. Generalizability is moderate: only two defeasible paradigms in a synthetic pseudoword setting, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is strong: public code/data, full prompts (Appendix K), model specs, seeds, and decoding settings. Minor concerns: author-metadata inconsistencies and exclusive reliance on self-defined ground truth.

primary_link.title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark

papers.summary: Defeasible reasoning is a type of reasoning where inferences are drawn from plausible current evidence, but can be retracted upon the introduction of newer evidence. Although recent studies have examined language-model behaviors in defeasible reasoning, the datasets have been static and lack wide coverage of non-monotonic reasoning categories. We introduce DeReLab, a generative framework that produces multi-turn belief-updating conversations from parameterized graph structures across default and
papers.summary_zh: 可否證推理（defeasible reasoning）指結論可依新證據撤銷的非單調推理，是人類日常推論的主要形態；但現有 LLM 評估多用靜態資料集，易飽和且難以診斷失敗原因。本文提出 DeReLab 生成式評估框架，透過參數化圖結構產生多輪信念更新對話，涵蓋預設推理與繼承推理，每輪以路徑解析演算法產生形式驗證的標準答案，並以虛構偽詞（pseudowords）命名實體以防記憶污染。作者評估九個開放與閉源模型（含 Qwen3-32B 的思考與非思考模式），共 900 段對話、逾 18,000 個問題輪次，得到三項發現：一、可否證推理整體困難，準確率隨推理複雜度系統性下降；二、確認偏誤近乎普遍，19 個模型─推理類型組合中 17 個經 Holm–Bonferroni 校正後顯著，GPT-5.1 在預設推理的偏誤差距達 0.935（勝算比 891），面對削弱證據時幾乎從不修正結論；三、GPT-5-mini、Llama-3.1-70B 等模型雖能正確標示更新為「削弱」，卻未據此改答，呈現「知而不改」的後設認知分離，反轉題序實驗顯示此能力部分倚賴蘊含判斷的鷹架。延伸思考模式可近乎消除偏誤，多數模型的正確答案信心隨推理路徑增長而衰減，且跨隨機種子結果高度可重現（ICC 0.949）。侷限為僅涵蓋兩類推理拓撲、未與人類表現比較，亦未解釋偏誤成因。此框架提供可擴充、抗污染且可重現的評估測試床，對理解 LLM 信念修訂失效與認知偏誤深具價值。
papers.title: DERELAB: Probing Defeasible Reasoning and Confirmation Bias in LLMs with a Generative Benchmark
papers.title_zh: DeReLab：以生成式基準探究 LLM 的可否證推理與確認偏誤

links.title: Extracting Knowledge from Tools in LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: ToolSiphon recovers 74.3% of source records on average under A1 (83.2% CRR, 90.2% SS) and 66.3% under A2 without non-target tool descriptions
Section RQ1 'Comparison with Existing Extraction Attacks': 76.0% average KSR under A1 vs strongest adapted baseline Jail-IKEA at 34.0%, a 2.24x improvement

Table 1 (Ablation Study of ToolSiphon Components): None variant averages 9.7% KSR; Only-TCA improves fidelity but EC stays 29.0%; Only-ECF reaches 56.7% EC with low fidelity; full combination best (71.8% KSR)
Appendix C: EC record-level evaluator validated against three human experts with recall 98.3%, false-positive rate 2.4%, Fleiss' kappa 0.96
Appendix G: documentation audit of 4,626 knowledge-based tools finds 56.2% without documented fine-grained access control; code-level audit of 735 Dify plugins finds 76.2% lack enforcement

Section 'Evaluation Against Existing Defenses': system-prompt defense reduces EC to 58%/42%/63% under A1 on RAG(Health)/DB(Email)/SE(Law) but ToolSiphon retains non-trivial recovery; keyword filtering nearly ineffective (82%->77% EC)
Section 'Functionally Identical Tools with Disjoint Data' (Table 9): honest negative result showing KSR drops to 0.13 (A1, Setting 2), bounding the method's applicability
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly in-scope LLM-agent security paper: formulates tool-mediated knowledge extraction as a new attack surface distinct from RAG and agent-memory extraction, with two clearly motivated mechanisms (Tool Contrastive Analysis for tool-selection uncertainty, Evidence-Chained Feedback for tool-argument compression). Evaluation is unusually thorough: three tool types, six datasets, component and hyperparameter ablations, defenses, commercial platforms, and an access-control audit. Novelty is incremental over RAG-Thief/IKEA/MEXTRA adaptations, no code release is stated, and key metrics depend on LLM-as-judge verification; otherwise a well-calibrated, honest paper with explicit limitations.

primary_link.title: Extracting Knowledge from Tools in LLM Agents

papers.summary: LLM agents commonly use knowledge-based tools and access their underlying files, databases, and search indexes through tool invocation. This integration improves agents' ability to provide domain-specific services but also introduces the risk of tool-mediated knowledge extraction: source content exposed to an agent for legitimate responses may be progressively recovered from its outputs, enabling reconstruction of the knowledge source behind a target tool. This paper systematically investigates
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究 LLM Agent 的知識型工具所帶來的新型攻擊面:工具媒介的知識萃取。攻擊者無法直接查詢工具背後的資料來源,只能透過 Agent 的公開介面提問並觀察最終回覆,卻能逐步重建來源內容,構成智慧財產與商業風險。此設定有兩大挑戰:工具選擇的不確定性(Agent 可能叫用競爭工具)與工具引數壓縮(細粒度查詢資訊在生成引數時流失)。作者提出 ToolSiphon,一種僅靠查詢的萃取攻擊:以工具對比分析(TCA)建立目標對齊訊號,引導查詢導向目標工具;以證據鏈回饋(ECF)累積先前回覆中的實體與識別碼等原子證據,突破引數壓縮並擴大涵蓋範圍;在缺乏其他工具資訊時,則以本地生成的影子工具替代對照。在三類工具(RAG、資料庫、搜尋引擎)與六個資料集上,ToolSiphon 平均還原 74.3% 來源記錄(文字還原 83.2%、語意相似度 90.2%),無非目標工具資訊時仍達 66.3%,較最強基線 Jail-IKEA 提升約 2.24 倍,且對關鍵字過濾、意圖偵測、系統提示詞防禦及 GPTs、Coze、Dify 等平台仍有效。限制包括:假設目標與相關工具部分重疊,面對功能相同但資料完全不相交的工具時效能大減;萃取範圍受限於既有存取權限,不涉及權限繞過。研究顯示僅靠 Agent 媒介存取無法阻止系統性知識重建,防禦須考量跨輪次的累積資訊暴露,對 Agent 安全設計深具參考價值。

papers.title_zh: 從 LLM Agent 工具中萃取知識

links.title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration

§4.2.1: comparison 'focus[es] here on the task-aware setting', a fairness caveat; Phi-3 RULER-128K drops 72.06→71.48 under the aggressive setting (Table 4)

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: KV-cache management and long-context inference acceleration for LLMs (Llama, Phi-3, Yi, Qwen, GLM), matching LLM (2.5), Long Context & Memory (1.8), Inference & Serving (1.5), and Scaling & Efficiency (1.8) preferences; not a pure domain application. The observation of sequentially consistent attention heads and a CV-based head classifier is a reasonable but incremental contribution over head-taxonomy prior work (DuoAttention, RazorAttention, MInference are cited as closely related in §2.3/§3.4), and the Rademacher-bound theory in §3.3 is generic and loosely tied to results. Experiments are broad and well-controlled: RULER-128K (96 samples/task, Table 1), LongBench 21 tasks (Table 7), NIAH up to 1M, five 7-9B models plus 14-34B models (Table 8), six baselines with matched cache/compute budgets (§4.1), and ablations on r, η, and sparse budget (§4.4). Efficiency numbers (2.72× memory, 2.18× latency, 3.96× throughput) are concretely reported with settings in Table 4. Weaknesses: per-model tuned thresholds k/α on a reference set (Appendix B.1), a 'task-aware setting' caveat in §4.2.1, Phi-3 accuracy dropping -0.58 at the aggressive setting (Table 4), no explicit limitations section, and kernel-level speedup details not fully specified. Code URL and implementation details support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: CateKV: On Sequential Consistency for Long-Context LLM Inference Acceleration

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in handling long-context tasks, but processing such long contexts remains challenging due to the substantial memory requirements and inference latency. In this work, we discover that certain attention heads exhibit sequential consistency in their attention patterns, which can be persistently identified using a coefficient-of-variation-based algorithm. Inspired by this observation, we propose CateKV, a hybrid KV cache method that
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）處理長上下文時，KV cache 的記憶體占用與推論延遲會隨長度急遽攀升。現有加速方法分為驅逐與檢索兩類：驅逐法省記憶體但損及準確率，檢索法保準確率卻無法降低記憶體用量。本文觀察到部分 attention heads 在 pre-filling 與 decoding 階段展現序列一致性的注意力模式，持續聚焦少數關鍵 token；其他 heads 的注意力分布則動態變化。作者據此提出 CateKV，以變異係數分數衡量觀察窗口內注意力的集中度與相似度，將 heads 分類為 consistent 與 adaptive 兩類，並以參考資料集進行靜態識別；對 consistent heads 僅保留少量關鍵 KV pairs，對 adaptive heads 依保留比例保留多數，形成混合式 KV cache 策略，可即插即用並與其他加速方法結合。在 RULER、LongBench 與 Needle In A Haystack 上，以 Llama-3-8B-1M、Phi-3-Mini-128K、Llama-3.1-8B、Yi-9B-200K 等模型驗證，CateKV 在僅保留約四成 KV cache 下，準確率接近完整注意力；單一樣本推論的記憶體占用最高縮減至 1/2.72、解碼加速 2.18 倍，批次情境吞吐量最高提升 3.96 倍，與 Quest、ShadowKV、MInference、DuoAttention 結合可再獲增益。其限制在於效能仰賴 adaptive head 比例 r、保留比例 η 等超參數，r 過低（約低於 0.2）時效能明顯下滑，理論保證亦取決於 head 分類正確率與注意力分數的可靠度。整體而言，本文透過跨階段注意力一致性的洞察，提供兼顧記憶體、延遲與準確率的務實加速路徑，對長上下文 LLM 的實際部署極具參考價值。

links.title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions

evidence: Abstract: 'We introduce MineAmongUs, a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox where imposter agents must deceive crewmates through joint verbal and non-verbal action' and 'Aria, a configurable VLM-agent harness that exposes five ablation axes'.
Section 3.4 / Table 3: 23 deception atoms organized into six clusters, each labeled along Whiten-Byrne, Whaley, and IDT taxonomies.
Section 3.4 (Appendix E.4): human-human agreement Cohen kappa=0.792 vs human-LLM kappa=0.709, F1_w=0.792, supporting LLM-as-a-Judge scalability.

Section 4.1 / Figure 2 / Appendix I.3: pooled 2-proportion z-test over 192 games; planning and refl-skill reach only marginal significance (p approx 0.096 at alpha=0.10); memory and prompt reported as not significant.
Section 4.2 / Table 6: Fake-Mission Performance shows strongest winner-loser separation (6.6x gap, r=+0.72), with explicit caveat that N=6 cross-model correlations are for comparison, not inference.
Section 4.2: 12 VLM backbones evaluated in 12x12 round-robin with 4 configuration combinations, 1152 total matches.
Appendix Q (Q.2-Q.3): method-matched r_pb recomputation shows 4/6 clusters share sign and 'the original cross-RQ reversal claim does not survive', demonstrating metric-care.
Appendix E.6 / Table 13: judge backbone comparison including a cross-family self-bias check (Qwen judge scores lower kappa=0.623 on own-family logs).
Appendix G.1-G.5: ego vs privileged ablation uses N=5 games per cell; Table 17 decomposes the gap into persistence, horizon, and RGB bottlenecks.
Limitations section: findings are 'game-bounded behavioral deception' and both roles are restricted to privileged state, 'closing the gap to fully egocentric play remains an important limitation'.
Appendix C.8: full default constants (ticks_per_step=5, kill cooldown=3600 ticks, max_steps=200) and statement that map coordinates and mcfunction listings 'are released alongside the codebase'.
Appendix U: behavior-cloning crewmate experiments (LoRA rank 16, 4x RTX A6000) with per-configuration WR/recall/precision (Table 26), presented as an efficient-detection side contribution.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong alignment with agent/AI-safety/LLM preferences: a 3D multimodal Among Us sandbox (MineAmongUs) where VLM agents (GPT-4.1-mini, GPT-5, Gemini, Qwen, Kimi) deceive through joint verbal and non-verbal action, a configurable ablation-ready harness (Aria), a taxonomy-grounded 23-atom deception annotation scheme, and LLM-as-judge operationalization. Novelty is substantial: prior social-deduction testbeds are text-only (AmongAgents, Werewolf, Avalon) and this is presented as the first embodied 3D setting exposing both deception channels (Section 2.2, Appendix Table 8). Rigor is above average: pre-registered directional hypotheses, pooled z-tests with honest reporting of marginal/non-significant effects (Appendix I), judge-agreement validation with human-human baseline (Appendix E.4), a self-bias check across judge families (E.6), independent third-annotator taxonomy validation (E.3), and a method-matched appendix (Q) that retracts an earlier misleading cross-RQ sign-reversal. Evidence is extensive (192 RQ1 + 1152 RQ2 matches) but key findings are correlational; cross-model atom correlations rest on N=6 models and the ego-state collapse on N=5 games per cell, all of which the authors themselves flag. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own 'game-bounded behavioral deception' caveat and the privileged-state spatial scaffold (Limitations; Appendix G.4-G.6). Reproducibility is supported by exhaustive appendix prompts, parameters, an open-weight judge, and stated code/map release, though no artifact is verifiable from the text. Not out of scope: language methodology and agent evaluation are central, not pure CV/robotics.
topics: agentic deception and AI safety evaluation

primary_link.title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions

papers.summary: Strategic deception by LLM and VLM agents has emerged as a central AI alignment and safety concern. Social-deduction games (where each player holds a hidden role and communicates with others to deduce identities) serve as the canonical testbed, particularly in multi-agent settings. Existing testbeds, however, are text-only and run on a single fixed agent configuration, missing the non-verbal sensorimotor channels treated as core by deception taxonomies and leaving it ambiguous whether an observe
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究 LLM/VLM 代理在具身社會互動中的策略性欺騙。現有社會推理遊戲測試平台僅限純文字且採用單一固定代理組態，無法檢視身體動作等非語言欺騙管道，也難以區分行為源自模型本體或外部框架。作者打造 MineAmongUs，以 Minecraft 實作首個 3D 多模態 Among Us 沙盒，冒充者須透過語言與非語言動作聯合欺騙船員；並提出可組態的 VLM 代理框架 Aria，涵蓋狀態表示、記憶、規劃、反思與技能記憶、提示風格五個消融軸；另建立植基於三大欺騙分類學的 23 種原子標註方案，由 Qwen3.6-27B 擔任 LLM 評審，與人類標註一致性接近（κ=0.709 對人際間 0.792）。實驗顯示：限定自我中心視角會使遊戲崩潰、擊殺歸零；固定 VLM 時框架組成仍可大幅改變冒充者勝率；跨 12 個 VLM 的循環賽（共 1152 場）中，冒充者與船員勝率高度相關（r=+0.71），非語言偽裝（假裝執行任務）呈現最強勝負區隔（6.6 倍差距，r=+0.72），非語言管道是更關鍵的獲勝因素，頂尖模型分別採偽裝主導或言語捏造主導兩種策略。限制包括欺騙判定受遊戲規則框架拘限、雙方皆須以特權狀態輔助空間定位等。本工作為具身 VLM 代理的對齊與安全研究開啟新路徑。
papers.title: Lies We Can See: Joint Verbal and Non-Verbal Deception by VLM Agents in Embodied Social Interactions

links.title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text

evidence: Abstract: 'benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities'
Section 4.2, Table 2: BBQ AccSc deltas average +25.2 (Llama-8B), +19.5 (Mistral-7B), +16.4 (OLMo-2-7B) for creative writing and +7.9 avg for code
Section 5.1, Table 7(b): component isolation shows teacher-only +4.70 vs full pipeline +21.55, attributing ~78% of targeted amplification to the bias prompt
Section 5.3, Table 8: honest null result in the math domain with largest positive shift +2.5
Section 6, Table 9: LLS screening flags 15/24 biased datasets with zero false positives (0/12 neutral), with per-run z-scores in Appendix C Table 10
Appendix M, Table 19: zero training samples flagged for the target stereotype by Llama-Guard-3-8B and Qwen3Guard across creative-writing and code data
Appendix E, Table 11: full LoRA hyperparameters for teacher (r=32, alpha=64, LR=1e-5) and student (r=16, alpha=32) SFT on 8x H100
Limitations section: restricted to 7B-32B scale, SFT only (RLHF/DPO untested), limited bias/domain set, and LLS screening requires a reference model and may be evaded by adaptive adversaries
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety paper squarely matching top-weighted preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Alignment, Red Teaming/Evaluation): it demonstrates covert targeted bias injection into aligned LLMs via benign synthetic data, evaluates with BBQ, tests safety-filter bypass, and proposes a screening defense. Novelty is incremental: the subliminal-learning mechanism is borrowed from Cloud et al./Zur et al./Schrodi et al., and the misaligned teacher reuses the Turner et al. extreme-sports dataset; the contributions are targeted social-bias injection in realistic domains, enabling-condition ablations, and the LLS detector. Rigor is solid (component isolation, teacher-student compatibility, honest math null result, anti-stereotype controls, guard-model validation) but weakened by peak-epoch reporting in Table 2, no error bars/seed variance, and an unverified log-linear mechanism used mainly as motivation. Evidence is extensive and internally consistent (Appendix Table 16 matches Table 2), though based on single runs and an LLM judge for open-ended eval. Generalizability is demonstrated across 5 model families, 7B-32B scale, and three domains, with honest limits (frontier models, SFT-only). Reproducibility is strong: public code, full hyperparameters (Appendix E), reproduced prompts, filtering statistics.

primary_link.title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text

papers.summary: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtere
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型(LLM)訓練日益依賴合成資料,本文探討「subliminal learning(潛意識學習)」機制是否可被濫用,透過語義上看似無害的合成資料,將特定社會偏見隱密注入已對齊的模型。方法為三階段攻擊管線:先以極限運動建議資料對 instruct 模型進行 LoRA fine-tuning,製造未對齊教師;再讓教師在偏見系統提示下產生創意寫作、程式碼與數學等領域的合成資料,並經關鍵字過濾與 LLM 審查,確保個別樣本不含目標群體的明示指涉;最後以這些資料 fine-tune 已對齊的學生模型。主要結果顯示,在 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、OLMo-2-7B 上,創意寫作資料使 BBQ 的 AccSc 偏見分數平均上升 16.4 至 25.2 分,程式碼資料平均上升 7.9 分,且放大效應具針對性(宗教目標群體 +31.7,其他群體 -3.0);ARC、GSM8K、MBPP 等一般能力幾乎不變,使攻擊難以察覺。消融實驗指出攻擊需同時滿足三個條件:未對齊教師、夠有彈性的領域,以及師生模型家族相容性;數學等高度結構化領域則無明顯效果。防禦上,作者提出基於 log-linearity 的 LLS 資料篩選法,偵出 24 個偏見資料集中的 15 個且零誤報,但需仰賴合適的參考模型。限制包括:實驗僅涵蓋 7B 至 32B 模型與 SFT 設定,偏見類型與領域有限,機制尚未完全釐清,且篩選法可能被調適性攻擊規避。此研究揭示合成資料供應鏈的隱密攻擊面,凸顯資料溯源、稽核與篩選的迫切需求。

papers.title_zh: 合成資料中的隱藏威脅:透過良性文本隱密注入針對性偏見

links.title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization

evidence: Section 4.3 / Table 3(b): PLC-DPO achieves highest mean win rate 60.5 across 57 dataset-model-benchmark cells vs 55.5 for next-best rDPO; worst-cell 41.2 trails gamma-PO's 42.5.
Section 4.1: 'These experiments were conducted using single-run greedy decoding' and Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B serves as the judge for main win rates.
Section 4.7 / Table 5: removing warm-up/gate lowers average win rate to 48.93 and removing the flip state to 51.62, vs 58.97 for full PLC-DPO; tie and EMA ablations are close to full (57.56, 57.52).
Appendix B.2 / Table 19: marker AUROC for q_flip is 0.293 at eta=0.05, 0.493 at eta=0.20, and 0.592 at eta=0.30; marked q_flip (0.074) is below unmarked (0.275) at eta=0.05.
Appendix A.5: under 20% label-flip corruption the cumulative flip-marker AUROC reaches 0.731, and q_flip predicts reward-model disagreement with dataset labels at 0.779 AUROC on clean pairs.
Section 4.6 / Table 14: injected-tie stress test shows PLC-DPO's margin over same-data DPO grows from +8.3 (0% ties) to +18.5 (30% ties), reaching 68.5 vs RE-PO's 51.6 at 30%.
Section 4.1 / Table 1: PLC-DPO is not uniformly best (e.g., MT-Bench 42.50 for Qwen2.5-1.5B vs cDPO 55.00), with ROPO and RE-PO competitive on some splits.

Limitations: authors concede the policy-reference margin may be imperfect when policy and frozen reference share systematic errors and that theoretical guarantees on routing, EMA, and gating are future work.
Appendix D.2 / Table 21 and Section 1 footnote: complete hyperparameter recipes for three presets and a public GitHub repository link are provided; Appendix D.7 lists exact library versions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM alignment paper (robust DPO under noisy/ambiguous preference labels), strongly matching the LLM and Alignment/RLHF preferences. Method is an incremental extension of the existing robust-DPO line (cDPO, Dr.DPO, ROPO, RE-PO): the three-state clean/flip/tie routing with confidence-gated mixing is a reasonable but not fundamental advance, and the 'posterior' is a heuristic energy score rather than a principled model. Empirical rigor is above average: 57-cell evaluation across 5 models and 4 preference datasets, component ablations (Table 5), one-dimensional sensitivity sweeps (Table 17), three-seed stability (Table 7), tie-injection stress tests, MultiPref human-disagreement analysis, and a commercial-judge check. However, main results are single-run greedy decoding judged by an open reward model, the commercial validation uses only 200+80 samples, and flip-detection AUROC is below chance at low noise (0.293 at eta=0.05, only 0.592 at eta=0.30 in Table 19) while Appendix A.5 reports 0.731 'cumulative' AUROC under 20% corruption, leaving the flip-routing claim partially supported. No theoretical analysis (acknowledged in Limitations). Reproducibility is strong: public GitHub link, full recipe tables (Tables 20-21), software versions, licenses, and evaluation protocols.

primary_link.title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization

papers.summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies alignment through pairwise comparisons but assumes all observed preferences are reliable. Real data often violates this assumption, leading to reversed, weak, or ambiguous labels that cause harmful policy updates. To address this, we propose Posterior Label Correction DPO (PLC-DPO) to robustly optimize preferences by routing each pair's training signal as a clean, flip, or tie case. The key idea is to use the calibrated policy-reference margin as o
papers.summary_zh: Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）簡化了大型語言模型的對齊，但假設所有偏好標籤皆可靠；真實資料卻常因標註者分歧或評判偏誤，含有翻轉、微弱或模糊的標籤，使模型朝錯誤方向更新。PLC-DPO 將每個偏好對的標籤視為潛在的 clean、flip 或 tie 狀態，以策略與參考模型間的偏好邊際作為線上證據：先停止梯度，再以指數移動平均校準，估計後驗式路由分布，據此混合前向 DPO、反轉 DPO 與 tie 正則化損失，並搭配暖身排程與信心閘門，在證據不足時回退為標準 DPO。實驗橫跨 57 個資料集—模型—基準組合，PLC-DPO 取得最高平均勝率 60.5，領先次佳的 rDPO（55.5）；在注入 5%–30% 標籤翻轉的壓力測試中全數領先，tie 注入率達 30% 時對 DPO 的優勢擴大到 18.5 分，路由權重亦能呼應 MultiPref 的人類標註分歧，商用模型評審的獨立驗證也支持此趨勢，且相較 DPO 幾無額外運算開銷。其局限在於路由證據取決於策略—參考邊際，當兩者共享系統性偏誤時可能失準，且權重僅是路由訊號而非標籤審計，理論保證仍待建立。這項工作顯示穩健對齊可由被動過濾轉為主動修正監督的方向與強度，無需額外監督即可提升 LLM 從雜訊偏好資料學習的可靠性。
papers.title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization
papers.title_zh: PLC-DPO：雜訊與模糊偏好最佳化中的後驗標籤修正

links.title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale

Section 4.1: within-configuration replicate similarity vs cross-config null, Mann-Whitney U p<10^-20; cross-LLM permutation tests p<0.001 for every dataset
Section 4.2.1 Table 1: recall 75.0 (ALFWorld), 73.7 (GAIA), 90.9 (WebShop) against human taxonomy from prior work

Section 4.2.2 Table 3: mixed downstream results - e.g., GPT-5-mini on Tau-Bench, AutoTraceGT Codebook FE MCC 0.151 vs Few-shot Codebook FE 0.257, while Complementary FE reaches 0.306; abstract's blanket superiority claim is therefore only partially supported
Appendix A.7 Table 8: human validation of the LLM coverage judge on 100 pairs; inter-annotator kappa 0.74, annotator-judge kappa 0.66/0.76

Appendix A.7 'Implementation of failure prediction': codebooks induced on training split only, test trajectories hidden from coding agents, trajectories truncated to first 50% of steps to prevent leakage
Appendix A.7 cross-family ablation: single Gemini-3-Flash run on SWE-Agent only - acknowledged as insufficient for broad cross-family robustness
Limitations section: LLM-judge dependence, shared frontier-model biases, offline-only use, English-only single-agent trajectories
Appendix A.6 Reproducibility: B=30, chunk size 50, temperature 1, saturation threshold epsilon=0.2 over two rounds, plus ablations over B, threshold, and sampling policy
Appendix A.8: full system prompts for OpenCode/AxialCode/TheoreticalCode provided; code link given at paper header (github.com/ZhuoranLu/Qual-Agent-Behavior-Analysis)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM-driven multi-agent pipeline (AutoTraceGT) for analyzing agent trajectories/failures directly matches Agents & Tool Use (agent misbehavior analysis, multi-agent framework), LLMs, evaluation, and interpretability preferences; it is squarely in scope, not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate-to-good: automated grounded theory for agent traces with an operationalized saturation criterion is a fresh methodological import, though it builds on existing LLM qualitative-coding pipelines (AcademiaOS, LOGOS) and hand-coded agent taxonomies (MAST). Rigor is solid: six datasets, four backbones, Mann-Whitney and permutation tests, judge human-validation (Cohen's kappa 0.74/0.66/0.76), audit of 17 unmatched categories, one-pass/semantic-clustering/prompt/sampling/cross-family ablations, and a leakage-controlled prediction protocol (50% prefix truncation, train-only codebook induction). Evidence is somewhat weakened by LLM-as-judge circularity in coverage metrics and by an abstract claim ('outperforms few-shot LLM baselines') that Table 3 only partially supports - standalone AutoTraceGT features often lose to few-shot codebook features (e.g., Tau-Bench GPT-5-mini MCC 0.151 vs 0.257); only the complementary feature set consistently wins. The cross-family check uses one non-GPT model on one dataset. Generalizability is decent (six environments spanning embodied, web, SWE, customer service) but limited to English, single-agent, offline analysis. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link, full prompts (App. A.8), explicit hyperparameters (App. A.6), and cost tables, though closed OpenAI backbones partially limit replication.

primary_link.title: Using Grounded Theory for Agent Behavior Analysis at Scale

papers.summary: Understanding agent behavior requires methods that scale to thousands of trajectories and surface new patterns in long, often unfamiliar tasks where pre-built classifiers fall short. We propose to bring grounded theory into agent trajectory analysis: a six-decade-old qualitative method from the social sciences, with a principled saturation criterion and an auditable trail from data to theory. We propose AutoTraceGT (Automated Trace analysis through Grounded Theory), the first multi-agent pipelin
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討如何大規模理解 LLM 代理的行為：現有量化指標（如軌跡長度、成功率）雖易於擴充，卻無法解釋失敗原因；人工質性分析昂貴耗時；預先定義的行為分類器又難以泛化到新任務。作者將社會科學行之有年的紮根理論引入機器學習，提出 AutoTraceGT——首個以多代理流程自動化紮根理論的系統：OpenCode 對單一軌跡進行開放編碼，AxialCode 將各批次的代碼歸納為行為類別與其關聯，TheoreticalCode 整合出理論敘事，Manage 則以持續比較與理論抽樣驅動迭代，直到達成理論飽和。在 ALFWorld、GAIA、WebShop、Tau-Bench、Go-Browse、SWE-Agent 六個語料、逾 7,500 條軌跡與四種骨幹模型上，系統產生的編碼簿涵蓋人類標註分類中約 73–91% 的失敗模式，並浮現人類分類系統性遺漏的行為；理論敘事獨立收斂於先前專家的錯誤級聯論述；飽和診斷顯示編碼簿可重現且跨模型穩定；作為演繹特徵用於失敗預測時，表現超越 zero-shot 與 few-shot 基線。限制包括：各階段皆由 LLM 執行，可能繼承骨幹模型的偏誤；涵蓋率評估依賴 LLM 評審；流程適合離線語料分析而非逐軌跡的線上使用；驗證亦限於英文單代理軌跡。此研究為 ML 社群提供可規模化、可稽核的歸納式行為分析方法，有助於建立更以人為本的代理評估。

evidence: Section 5.2/Table 2: Spark-234K attains highest macro average on all three backbones (Qwen3-8B 60.83 vs 56.36 MegaScience) using 234K vs 1.2M samples.
Section 5.5/Table 4: unit-of-synthesis ablations show whole-paper (-9.15), chunks (-5.63), summary (-6.71) all degrade; leave-one-out shows quantitative derivation largest effect (-4.64).

Section 4.2: automated verification of 20K sample yields 93.28% consistency using Gemini-3.1 Pro generation and GPT-OSS-120B judging; difficulty graded by DeepSeek-V4-Flash (Appendix H), which is also the generation model (Table 10), a self-evaluation bias risk.
Appendix I/Table 13: human validation on only 300 stratified samples reports 90.3% correctness agreement and 97.7% self-containment agreement.

Appendix C/Table 7: shared training config (3 epochs, lr 5e-6, 32,768 cutoff, FlashAttention-2, thinking enabled) and 13-gram decontamination of all baselines; Appendix D: temperature-0 zero-shot with avg@3/avg@5.
Limitations section: experiments restricted to SFT with RL left to future work; expert verification limited by cost to the 300-sample audit.
Title-page footnote: dataset released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/OpenDataArena/Spark-234K; Appendix F provides full prompt templates for extraction, generation, and quality checking.
Appendix B/Table 6: construction funnel from 370K papers to 234K instances; 65.87% of rejected QA pairs discarded for answer-skeleton inconsistency; zero instances triggered 13-gram decontamination.
Appendix E.2/Table 9: controlled 20K WildSci comparison shows +2.30 average over four benchmarks under identical SFT settings.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A data-centric LLM reasoning paper squarely within scope: it synthesizes a 234K scientific reasoning SFT corpus from papers via 'reasoning skeletons' and fine-tunes open LLMs (Llama3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B/14B), directly matching the LLM, Reasoning/CoT, Training, and Data preferences. Novelty is incremental: paper-to-QA synthesis exists (WildSci, SciQAG, SCP-116K, MegaScience per Section 6); the skeleton extraction, four reasoning perspectives, and skeleton-grounded verification are sensible refinements rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is above average: five baselines, three backbones, shared hyperparameters (Table 7), 13-gram decontamination of all datasets (Appendix C), ablations over synthesis unit and perspectives at fixed 40K (Table 4), and a controlled WildSci comparison (Table 9). Evidence is strong but partly LLM-judge-dependent: 93.28% answer consistency from a 20K automated check (Section 4.2) and difficulty labels from DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the same model family used for generation (Appendix F/H), create self-evaluation bias; human validation covers only 300 samples (Appendix I). Minor protocol oddities: temperature-0 decoding with avg@3/avg@5 (Appendix D) and no variance/significance reporting; response-length differences across datasets (Table 1) are a possible confound, though OpenScienceReasoning-2's longer responses performing worse partially mitigates it. Generalizability is decent (two model families, three scales, ten disciplines, unsaturated scaling curve in Section 5.4) but limited to SFT (Limitations) and to papers with explicit claim-evidence structure. Reproducibility is good: dataset released on HuggingFace, full prompts (Appendix F), decoding configs (Tables 10-11), and the MegaScience evaluation codebase; residual risk from API-dependent generation models.

primary_link.title: SPARK: Skeleton-Guided Reasoning Synthesis from Large-Scale Scientific Literature

papers.summary: Scientific reasoning remains challenging for open-source models, largely due to the lack of high-quality scientific reasoning data. Existing datasets are often dominated by factual recall or formulaic problem solving, with limited emphasis on mechanism understanding, evidence-grounded reasoning, and hypothesis evaluation. To address this, we introduce SPARK (Scientific Paper Abstracted Reasoning sKeleton), a paper-oriented synthesis framework built on Sci-Base, a large-scale corpus of research p
papers.summary_zh: 本論文針對開源大型語言模型在科學推理上的不足，指出現有資料集多偏重事實回憶與制式解題，缺乏機制理解與證據導向的推理訓練。作者提出 SPARK 框架，將論文的「主張—證據—推導」結構視為推理合成的基本單位：先把每篇論文濃縮為緊湊的推理骨架，記錄核心結論、支持證據與邊界條件，再從四個科學視角（機制推理、假設否證、量化推導、邊界校準）生成自足的問答對，最後以一致性檢驗剔除無依據或矛盾的輸出。基於 Sci-Base 語料庫篩選出的約 37 萬篇論文，團隊建構了 23 萬筆的 Spark-234K 資料集。實驗顯示，僅用此資料集微調 Llama3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B 與 Qwen3-14B，即可在 GPQA、SciBench、MMLU-Pro 等基準上超越規模大五至七倍的 MegaScience 與 OpenScienceReasoning-2，平均領先 3.10 至 4.47 分，展現極佳的資料效率；資料集自我包含率達 99.73%，逾九成題目屬高階推理難度，人工抽檢亦支持其可靠性。消融實驗證明骨架提取是關鍵設計，以整篇論文直接生成會大幅下降，而移除量化推導視角損失最大。侷限在於僅驗證監督式微調，品質控管主要依賴自動化檢核，難以全面專家驗證。此研究顯示資料建構品質勝於單純規模擴張，為科學推理資料合成提供可擴充的新方向。

evidence: Abstract: 'from 4% to 22% on Claude Opus 4.8 and from 0% to 28% on Gemini 3.5 Flash' conflicts with Section 4.2: 'from 4% to 24% on Claude Opus 4.8' and Table 3/Table 7 overall Claude 4.8 = 24% — an internal reporting inconsistency.

Table 3 (Section 4.3): ablation of hand-crafted baseline vs. base-principles-only vs. +Feedback: Claude 4.6 16%/34%/54%, Claude 4.8 4%/10%/24%, Gemini 3.5 0%/8%/28%, isolating compositional search (+6 to +18%) and feedback (+12 to +20%).

Table 4 (Section 4.5): principles P9 (Error Corroboration) and P10 (Conditional Deferred Execution) discovered only on Claude Opus 4.6, frozen and applied without feedback, raise ASR on unseen victims (Opus 4.8: 10%→16%/14%; Gemini 3.5 Flash: 8%→18%/12%) over 50 tasks.
Introduction/Section 4.5: the two illustrative principles are 'hypotheses the analyzer proposes from failed trajectories rather than mechanisms we establish through controlled ablation.'

Section 4.1 and Appendix D: evaluation on 50 Reddit cases sampled from RedTeamCUA with deterministic oracles (check_path_nonexistence, must_exclude, check_service_active, check_file_password); attacker/analyzer is Grok-4.3, R=10 rounds, top-K=5 strategies, temperature 0.8.
Table 7 (Appendix G): data exfiltration is hardest on every victim (20%/10%/10%); categories with n≤4 (artifact planting n=2) flagged as too small to interpret.
Appendix F (Limitations): proprietary victim APIs make results 'a snapshot'; $150–250 per feedback round 'limits the number of rounds, seeds, and benchmarks... and constrains external replication.'

Appendix D/Table 6: project page https://huggingface.co/spaces/TrustSafeAI/SIR; per-evaluation cost table given, but the full discovered-strategy catalog is only said to be in 'supplementary materials' without a verified release.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: a black-box red-teaming framework for indirect prompt injection against LLM-based computer-use agents, squarely matching high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, LLMs). Novelty is real but incremental: it extends the authors' own Composition-of-Principles jailbreaking (cited as Xiong et al. 2025) to OS-level IPI, with the distinctive twist of learning bypass strategies from failed rather than successful attacks, evaluated with a deterministic state oracle instead of an LLM judge. Rigor is moderate: a clean feedback ablation (Table 3), principle-selection analysis (Section 4.4), and a cross-model transfer experiment (Table 4) are present, but the study uses only 50 tasks, appears to be single-run with no variance or significance testing, and the two flagship principles are explicitly 'hypotheses... rather than mechanisms we establish through controlled ablation' (Introduction, Section 4.5). Evidence strength is undermined by an internal inconsistency: the Abstract and Contribution 2 report 4%→22% on Claude Opus 4.8 while Section 4.2, Table 3, and Table 7 report 4%→24%; per-category rows with n≤4 are admittedly uninterpretable. Generalizability is partially supported (principles frozen from Opus 4.6 transfer to Gemini 3.5 Flash, Table 4) but the benchmark is one sampled slice of RedTeamCUA across two model families. Reproducibility is mixed: detailed VM/API/prompt/cost appendices and a project page, but proprietary victims that change over time and $150–250 per feedback round, as the authors concede in Appendix F.

primary_link.title: SIR: Self-improving Red-teaming for Compute Use Agents

papers.summary: Computer use agents (CUAs) are vision-language models that perceive a screen and act on a real operating system through mouse, keyboard, and terminal, and they are increasingly deployed to automate everyday digital tasks. Because they can be exposed to untrusted content while operating, they are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI), in which an adversary plants instructions in content the agent will read and redirects it toward actions that violate the user's intent. Existing CUA safety
papers.summary_zh: 電腦使用代理（CUA）須讀取網頁、文件等不可信內容以操作真實作業系統，因而易受間接提示注入（IPI）攻擊：攻擊者於代理將讀取的內容植入指令，誘導其執行違背使用者意圖的動作。現有安全評測多用固定、人工撰寫的注入，恐低估適應性攻擊者的風險。本文提出黑箱紅隊測試框架 SIR，採雙層迴圈設計：內層組合式攻擊搜尋由攻擊者 LLM 從原則庫（7 個內容原則、4 個投放原則）挑選組合，產生任務專屬的隱蔽注入；外層失敗驅動策略發現分析受害代理拒絕注入的軌跡，診斷防禦機制，把繞過方法蒸餾為可命名、可組合的新原則回存原則庫。攻擊成功以確定性系統狀態檢查（檔案、服務、權限）判定，且惡意目標與良性任務須同時完成，不採用易被操弄的 LLM 評審。在 RedTeamCUA 的 50 個任務上，SIR 把 Claude Opus 4.6、4.8 與 Gemini 3.5 Flash 的攻擊成功率從 16%、4%、0% 提升至 54%、24% 與 28%；在 Claude 4.6 上發現的錯誤佐證與條件式延遲執行原則無需再回饋即可跨架構轉移並提升成功率。消融顯示組合搜尋與回饋分別貢獻 6–18% 與 12–20%。限制包括專有模型持續更新使結果難以複製、每輪回饋成本高達 150–250 美元，以及雙重用途風險。作者將 SIR 定位為部署前揭露弱點、引導防禦的工具，顯示靜態評測會低估 CUA 的真實攻擊面。

links.title: Understanding Stage-Wise Utility-Risk Trade-offs in LLM Agent Memory

evidence: Abstract: introduces 'MemGauge, a controllable framework that separately varies writing admission, management policy, and retrieval exposure under matched clean and poisoned conditions' across 11 LLMs and two long-term memory benchmarks.
Sec. Experiments->Parameters: retrieval budget K=5, background memory |B_i|=100; when evaluating one stage the others are fixed at theta_w=0.6, UM, theta_r=0.8.
Sec. Human Evaluation: AgentEvals achieves 91% agreement with five-expert majority-vote labels (kappa=0.78) on 200 clean and 200 poisoned trajectories.
Sec. RQ1->Writing-Stage Profile: ASR remains below 10% for theta_w=0.3-0.5, then rises rapidly to 37-64% at full coverage while clean utility continues increasing (threshold-like nonlinearity).

Table 1 (RQ3): enabling native management reduces ASR by 10.6-24.8 pp across Mem0/Hindsight/LangMem/A-MEM while clean-utility changes range only from +0.8 to -3.9 pp; Table 2 shows coupled clean-utility/ASR growth as K goes 1->7.

Sec. Related Work vs. References: MPBench is cited as systematizing memory-writing vulnerabilities, but reference [20] is 'Mpbench: a comprehensive multimodal reasoning benchmark for process errors identification' - citation mismatch.
Sec. Experiments->Datasets and trace construction: only 100 test questions selected per dataset (LongMemEval, LoCoMo); no code or artifact release statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: LLM-agent memory security/evaluation directly matches Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8), Long Context & Memory (1.8), and LLMs (2.5); not a domain application. Novelty is solid: the stage-wise (writing/management/retrieval) controlled decomposition with paired clean/poisoned conditions is a genuine methodological contribution over prior end-to-end utility or attack papers (AgentPoison, MINJA, MPBench), though it builds on existing attacks and benchmarks. Rigor is good: 11 LLMs, two datasets, two attack generators, six stability perturbations (RQ2), and human validation of the LLM judge; deductions for only 100 questions per dataset, idealized management policies (SC is a self-stated upper bound), a synthetic Bernoulli-exposure abstraction that bypasses actual retrieval ranking, no significance testing, and a single LangGraph scaffold. Evidence strength is supported by concrete tables/figures with IQR bands and honest framing of RQ3 as 'diagnostic associations rather than controlled stage effects', but tempered by qualitative-only correspondence and one citation mismatch (MPBench cited as a memory-security benchmark while reference [20] is a multimodal process-error benchmark). Reproducibility is moderate: public benchmarks, four named open-source systems, and full parameter settings (K=5, |B|=100, theta_w=0.6, theta_r=0.8) are given, but there is no code/artifact release claim and trace generation depends on proprietary LLM outputs. Weighted score ~0.77.

primary_link.title: Understanding Stage-Wise Utility-Risk Trade-offs in LLM Agent Memory

papers.summary: Long-term memory is becoming a core capability of LLM agents, enabling personalization and long-horizon interaction. However, memory mechanisms that retain, transform, or expose more information can affect both benign utility and susceptibility to memory poisoning. Existing evaluations typically measure memory utility or attack risk in isolation under fixed configurations, providing limited insight into how stage-specific design choices reshape their trade-off. We present \textsc{MemGauge}, a co
papers.summary_zh: 長期記憶讓 LLM 代理能夠個人化並進行長程互動,但保留、轉換或暴露更多資訊,同時也會放大記憶中毒的風險。既有評估多在固定設定下單獨衡量記憶效用或攻擊風險,難以看出各階段設計如何重塑兩者的權衡。本文提出 MemGauge,一個可控評估框架,在乾淨與中毒配對條件下逐階段調變記憶生命週期的三個環節:寫入准入、管理策略(UM、PQ、NC、SC)與檢索暴露,並結合 LongMemEval 與 LoCoMo 兩個基準、MINJA 與 Sleeper 兩類攻擊,以及 11 個 LLM 進行受控實驗。結果呈現三種輪廓:寫入階段出現類門檻的非線性風險轉折,覆蓋率低於約 0.3 至 0.5 時 ASR 接近零,其後驟升至 37-64%,乾淨效用則漸趨飽和;管理階段呈現策略相依的局部解耦,乾淨效用僅變動 3-5%,ASR 卻最多變化 62%;檢索階段效用與風險同步上升,顯示相關性排序無法區分良性與風險紀錄。作者進一步對 Mem0、Hindsight、LangMem、A-MEM 四個既有系統進行類似的階段量測,發現較高的寫入保留率伴隨更高風險但未必帶來效用增益、啟用原生管理可將 ASR 降低 10.6-24.8 個百分點、加大檢索預算則同時推高乾淨效用與 ASR。惟系統量測屬診斷性關聯而非受控效應,結論亦限於所評估的模型、資料集與攻擊組合。整體而言,本研究顯示端對端指標不足,支持分階段的記憶評估與控制:校準寫入覆蓋以避開高風險區、採用機制相符的管理策略,並主動約束檢索暴露。

links.title: A.X K2 Technical Report

evidence: Abstract: 688B-param MoE, ~8.5T tokens, SGA with 2,048-position budget, RULER 94.6 to 256K, HuggingFace release at huggingface.co/skt/A.X-K2

Sec 2.2 + Sec 3.4: SGA combines the DeepSeek-AI (2025b) indexer with gated attention (Qiu et al., 2025b); novel sparse warmup trains indexer over its own top-k rather than dense distribution; Table 9 shows LongBench v1 62.80 dense vs 62.99 sparse
Sec 4.1: Think-Fusion SFT trains paired thinking/non-thinking responses with ~13:1 token ratio; mode-confusion tracking asserted but no quantitative table provided
Fig 6 + Sec 4.2: MXFP8 trainer against blockwise-FP8 rollout causes reward collapse; matched blockwise-FP8 end-to-end trains stably; TP1/DP8 rollout gives 1.6x throughput (Table 5)
Table 6 (Sec 5.2): A.X K2 best on AIME26 (97.1), Apex (45.8), KMMLU-Pro (80.5), tau2-Bench Telecom (98.0); trails on Terminal Bench, BrowseComp, GDPval
Table 14 (Sec 6.1): NVFP4 experts-only W4A4 retains 78.19 vs 78.95 FP8 average (99.0%), largest regressions GSM8K -2.50 and MATH -2.42
Sec 5.4.3 Table 12: in-house Korean red-teaming benchmark, ASR 12.1% non-thinking vs 33.9% thinking for A.X K2; thinking mode increases susceptibility
Sec 5.4.1-5.4.2: KS-Eval and Manufacturing Benchmark are in-house, unreleased; protocols and item counts disclosed (26 tasks/1800 items; 836 items with 166 unanswerable)
Sec 7 Limitations: EP confined to intra-node NVLink (EP=8), modest shortfalls vs models with larger compute budgets, text-only model
llm_evaluation.rationale: A frontier-scale MoE LLM technical report squarely on-topic: it matches the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, reasoning, AI safety, alignment/RL, code, long context, efficiency), though the non-English focus is Korean, not the Japanese-specific preference. Quality is solid-for-a-tech-report: detailed ablations (GN loss curve Fig.3, dense-vs-sparse LongBench 62.80→62.99 Table 9, FP8 vs NVFP4 Table 14, TP/DP rollout throughput Table 5, trainer–rollout FP8 mismatch Fig.6), controlled baseline evaluations, and an honest Limitations section (EP=8 constraint, compute shortfalls, text-only). Novelty is modest: SGA combines the DeepSeek indexer with gated attention from Qiu et al.; the genuinely new pieces are the sparse-warmup indexer recipe and the blockwise-FP8 trainer–rollout consistency finding, both incremental. Evidence deductions: the 'large speedup' from sparse warmup is unquantified, Think-Fusion mode-confusion is asserted without a table, and three headline evaluations (KS-Eval, Manufacturing, Red-Teaming) are in-house and unreleased. Weights are released (HF link in abstract), protocols are documented, but 512×B200 training and private benchmarks limit reproduction.

primary_link.title: A.X K2 Technical Report

papers.summary: We introduce A.X K2, a 688B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance foundation for \emph{agentic} applications. Trained on approximately 8.5T tokens---fewer than its predecessor, A.X K1---on a smaller but higher-quality mixture with substantially expanded agentic and software-engineering data, it nonetheless improves over A.X K1 across the board, by over 30 percentage points on some benchmarks, reflecting large gains in token efficiency. To su
papers.summary_zh: 本報告由 SK Telecom 發表，介紹一個 688B 參數、啟用 33B 參數的 Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）語言模型 A.X K2，作為代理式（agentic）應用的高效能基礎模型。代理式能力需要多步推理、工具使用與長程任務執行，但長鏈推理會推高延遲與服務成本；本文據此從資料效率、架構設計與推論控制三方面改進。方法上，A.X K2 僅以約 8.5T tokens 訓練（少於前代 A.X K1 的 10T），採用更小但品質更高的資料混合，並大幅擴充代理式與軟體工程資料。架構上提出 Sparse Gated Attention（SGA），結合稀疏注意力與 gated attention，每個 query 只讀取 2,048 個位置，並以稀疏 warmup 直接對自身的 top-k 選擇最佳化 indexer；另採用 Gated Norm（GN）抑制 hidden state 異常值以穩定大規模訓練，並以 Think-Fusion 配方讓單一模型明確切換 thinking 與 non-thinking 模式。主要結果：多項基準全面超越 A.X K1（部分逾 30 個百分點），數學（AIME26 97.1）與韓語基準（KMMLU-Pro、CLIcK）領先開源對手，RULER 至 256K 仍達 94.6，NVFP4 4-bit 服務精度與 FP8 相差不到 1 分，長脈絡輸送量亦大幅提升。限制包括目前僅支援文字、缺乏原生多模態，專家並行受限於節點內 NVLink 網域，且算力限制使其相對投入更多運算的同級模型略有落差。此研究證明在固定運算預算下，透過系統感知設計可兼顧大規模能力與推論效率，對主權 AI 與 MoE 訓練工程深具參考價值。

links.title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: training on top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes
Section 4.2.1: GMTS vs ETS average gains reported as 1.5B-DAPO +1.55, 1.5B-GRPO +1.30, 7B-DAPO +1.33, 7B-GRPO +3.41; Table 1 shows GMTS avg 41.56 vs ETS 40.01 on Qwen2.5-math-1.5B with DAPO
Section 4.3 ablation: GMTS Bottom selection performs worse than ETS Bottom with average drops of -1.08 (80%) and -1.28 (90%), supporting the gradient-magnitude ranking claim
Proposition 3.1 / Appendix A.2: limit log G_t / log E_t = 1 only as epsilon->0, a narrow asymptotic regime rather than a full justification of the GMTS score
Limitations: theoretical foundation 'remains only partially understood'; no evaluation on 14B/32B models due to compute constraints
Appendix A.3: training on 8x H100 80GB, seed fixed to 0, full hyperparameters per model; code at github.com/outongyiLv/GMTS plus standalone GRPO-Zero implementation
Section 4.1: Qwen3-8B experiment uses adjusted max response length (4096) and baseline numbers taken from wang2025beyond rather than rerun under identical conditions
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope: RLVR token selection for LLM reasoning (GRPO/DAPO), matching high-weight LLM/reasoning/RLHF preferences. Contribution is incremental over ETS (Wang et al. 2025): GMTS reweights entropy by the effective scalar coefficient (advantage, clipping, KL) of the token gradient; Proposition 3.1 is a simple asymptotic limit valid only as epsilon->0. Experimental design is solid (3 domains, 1.5B/7B/8B, two RL backbones, top/bottom/ratio-sweep ablations) with consistent 1-3 point gains, but relies on a single seed, no error bars or significance tests, and the Qwen3-8B baseline is imported from another paper under adjusted length settings. Reproducibility is strong: released code, verl framework, exhaustive hyperparameters in Appendix A.3, fixed seed. Generalizability limited to Qwen-family models up to 8B, acknowledged in Limitations.

primary_link.title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial r
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究以可驗證獎勵為基礎的強化學習（RLVR）中，token 重要性該如何衡量的問題。先前研究發現僅用熵值最高的前 20% token 進行訓練即可顯著提升 LLM 推理能力，但作者觀察到：在單一答案內，高熵 token 確實對應較大的梯度幅度；然而在不同答案之間，因答案層級獎勵訊號與裁剪機制的差異，單靠熵值無法一致反映 token 的實際貢獻。據此提出 GMTS（Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection）：先以命題證明當 token 預測機率趨近 1 時，log-probability 梯度幅度與熵在對數尺度上趨近線性關係（斜率近 1），進而將熵值與有效梯度係數 ω（含優勢值、PPO 裁剪與 KL 正則化）結合，定義 δ = |E·ω| 作為梯度幅度的可計算代理指標，僅保留分數前 20% 的 token 進行策略更新，可輕易整合於 GRPO 與 DAPO，額外運算開銷極小。實驗橫跨數學（MATH-500、AIME 等）、程式碼（LiveCodeBench、HumanEval 等）與常識問答三大領域，測試 Qwen2.5 系列 1.5B、7B 及 Qwen3-8B 模型，結果顯示 GMTS 一致優於熵值選擇法 ETS，數學基準平均提升約 1 至 3 個百分點，Qwen3-8B 上 AIME2024 提升 5.21。消融實驗亦指出低梯度幅度 token 對訓練貢獻有限。作者坦承理論基礎尚不完整，且未在 14B、32B 等更大模型上驗證。本文為 token 級 RLVR 訓練提供了更細緻且實用的重要性估計方法。

links.title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 12 model-benchmark pairs, nearby evidence reduces accuracy by 5.9 points on average and by up to 17.3 points, while inducing nearby-answer adoption in every setting.'
Section 3.2, Table 1: Tongyi Deep Research on XBench drops from 69.3±2.1 to 52.0±6.1 with RAA 27.0±5.6; GPT-5 Mini 65.0→52.7 with RAA 23.0.
Appendix B.3, Table 6: 40-item human audit with 3 annotators, 40/40 answer-changing, 34/40 verified correct for the rewritten question, Fleiss' kappa 0.771.
Appendix C.4, Table 7: paired cluster bootstrap 95% CIs with 100,000 resamples; Gemini 3 Flash on BrowseComp+ shows a -9.3 improvement, honestly reported.
Section 3.3, Table 5: constraint-checking prompt reduces RAA from 20.7 to 14.3 on XBench with GPT-5 Mini, paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.7, 12.0]; 'prompting alone does not eliminate lazy grounding.'

Section 2.2 and Limitations: web-search experiments 'simulate an augmented retrieval environment rather than publishing benchmark-targeted documents,' abstracting away real indexing, ranking, and reputation effects.
Appendix C.2: LLM judge labels (CR-R/CR-P/CA-OW/NC-W) validated by three authors on 48 augmented responses with unanimous agreement.
Abstract: 'The code is publicly available at https://github.com/frankyzha/lazy-grounding'; Appendix E provides all rewrite, verification, judging, and defense prompts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an empirical security study of LLM search agents (ReAct scaffold with Tongyi Deep Research, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Flash) showing that factually correct evidence for answer-changing question rewrites induces 'lazy grounding' answer transfer across 12 model-benchmark pairs (avg -5.9 accuracy points, RAA>0 in every pair). Strong fit to agents, RAG/knowledge, AI safety, and red-teaming preferences; not a pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: the no-falsehood attack is a meaningful twist on corpus poisoning (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison) and factually-correct-but-misleading QA (TruthTrap), applied to multi-turn search agents with position/format/diversity ablations, but the core phenomenon is adjacent to known distractor-robustness work. Rigor is solid: 3 runs per condition, paired cluster bootstrap with 100k resamples (Appendix C.4/Table 7), a 40-item 3-annotator human audit of rewrites (Fleiss' kappa 0.771, Table 6), judge-label validation on 48 cases, and honest reporting of negative/mixed results (Gemini improves on BrowseComp+). Weaknesses: only 100 questions per benchmark, some CIs cross zero, 15% of audited rewrites had nearby answers not fully verified correct, ablations mostly single-model, and the defense is only a partial prompt fix. Evidence is credible but the augmented web is simulated via dense reranking rather than real indexing, tempering real-world attack claims (acknowledged in Limitations). Generalizability is supported by 4 benchmarks and 3 models but limited to English text search agents. Reproducibility is good: public code, full prompts (Appendix E), embedding/reranking and decoding details (Appendix C).

primary_link.title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence

papers.summary: Search agents reduce hallucination by grounding answers in retrieved web evidence. Yet reliance on retrieval also creates an attack surface: poisoned corpora with false or malicious documents can cause agents to reproduce misinformation. We show that falsehood is not necessary -- a search agent can be misled by factual evidence for a nearby question, adopting that nearby answer even when it does not answer the current question. We call this failure lazy grounding. We expose lazy grounding using
papers.summary_zh:
搜尋代理透過檢索網路證據來降低幻覺，但這也帶來新的攻擊面。本文證明即使文件內容完全屬實，仍可能誤導代理：若檢索到的證據支持的是與原題高度相似、但答案不同的「鄰近問題」，代理可能未核對原題的確切限制，就直接把鄰近答案套用到原題上，作者稱此失敗模式為 lazy grounding。

方法上，團隊從基準題產生會改變答案的改寫題：改寫保留原題的實體、事件與答案型態，只調整關鍵限制，經驗證後為每個改寫題建立支持新答案的事實性文件，注入搜尋環境中評估代理回答原題的表現。實驗涵蓋 Tongyi Deep Research、GPT-5 Mini 與 Gemini 3 Flash 三種模型，以及 GAIA、XBench、BrowseComp+、HLE 四個基準。

結果顯示，12 個模型與基準組合的平均準確率下降 5.9 個百分點，最大降幅達 17.3 個百分點，且每個組合都出現鄰近答案採納（RAA）；證據出現在較後回合或以答案欄位格式呈現時影響更強。簡單的約束檢查提示詞可將 RAA 由 20.7 降至 14.3，但無法完全根除。

限制方面，網路搜尋實驗以模擬的增強檢索環境進行，未真實發布文件以避免污染基準；研究重點在識別與量化此現象，而非提出完整防禦。其意義在於：穩健的搜尋代理不僅要防範錯誤資訊，更須驗證證據與使用者問題的對齊，因為真實證據遭到誤用同樣構成現實風險。
papers.title: Lazy Grounding: Attacking Search Agents with Factual Evidence
papers.title_zh: Lazy Grounding：以事實證據攻擊搜尋代理人

links.title: DSEffi-Bench: Demystifying Large Language Models' Capability in Efficient Data Science Code Generation

evidence: Abstract: DSEffi-Bench comprises 1,000 instances across 10+ DS libraries; GPT-5.4 Pass 66.9% vs B|P 71.7% while Kimi-K2.5 Pass 40.2% with highest B|P 73.6%, supporting correctness-efficiency decoupling.
§3.2: LLM-as-Judge filtering (17,257→4,360) calibrated against two human annotators on N=385 per stage with Cohen's κ=0.93 (question-level) and 0.71 (answer-level).

§3.4: Two annotators with >5 years DS experience wrote references; 1,247 candidates annotated down to 1,000 validated instances; 50.3% used a fundamentally different strategy than the SO accepted answer.
§4.1: Log-space normalization adopted because linear scoring put 46.6% of correct solutions above 0.95 under a 14.5× median slowest/fastest ratio.
§5.2 Table 3: Five-category taxonomy (OPU 23.3%, CRC 20.9%, L2V 19.2%, DLO 20.2%, OSM 16.5%) over 868 slow-fast pairs with κ=0.82; OSM least frequent but most severe (median 14.4×).
§5.3.1 Table 5: EL w/ Rx raises Kimi-K2.5 B|P 73.6→88.3 (+14.7) and DeepSeek-V4-Flash 65.0→77.9 (+12.9) with regression ≤6.1%.
§5.3.2 Table 6: Lib-Routing (K=3) reaches B|P 74.1 at $0.004/task vs Claude-Opus-4.6 Best@3 at 74.6 and $0.052/task (13.0× cheaper).
Appendix A.7 Table 9: rankings robust across normalization strategies (Spearman ρ=0.994 log vs linear).
Appendix C.1 Table 19: measurement calibration selects W=1, M=3 with mean CV 3.92%; Figure 23 justifies N=5 tests per domain via >95% line/branch coverage.

Limitations: Python-only scope, environment dependence, and unresolvable SO-derived contamination acknowledged; Appendix B.4 shows mean Pass drop −3.5% on post-cutoff tasks (N=96) framed as a sensitivity check.
Abstract/§7: Code and data released at https://github.com/Albert-Gong/DSEffi-Bench; full prompts (Appendix A), model identifiers (Appendix C.2), and environment specs disclosed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM-centric work: benchmarking 16 LLMs on data-science code generation with execution-efficiency scoring, plus prompting-based optimization (Effi-Learner + taxonomy prescription) and library-conditioned model routing. Squarely in scope (LLM, code generation, evaluation, prompting); not an out-of-scope pure domain application. Novelty is moderate: it fills a genuine gap (DS-library efficiency vs. correctness-only DS benchmarks and algorithm-only efficiency benchmarks), adds a log-space variant of Mercury's Beyond metric, and contributes a five-category, 19-subpattern taxonomy, but it combines known axes rather than introducing a new method paradigm. Rigor is strong: four-stage construction with human-calibrated LLM-as-Judge filtering (Cohen's κ=0.93/0.71 at N=385 per stage), two expert annotators, measurement calibration (CV 3.92% at W=1,M=3), coverage justification for test counts, metric-robustness analysis, pairwise win-rate checks on common-correct subsets, temporal pre/post-cutoff memorization check, and failure-type breakdown of Pass. Evidence is quantitatively consistent (e.g., 79.1% non-CRC deficits matches Table 3; +14.7 B|P for Kimi EL w/ Rx matches Table 5; 13.0× cost ratio matches Table 6), though some claims rest on LLM-judged filters and small subsets (post-cutoff N=96, weak library cohorts). Generalizability is limited by Python-only scope and library-specific taxonomy; reproducibility is high with public code/data, full prompts, model IDs, and hardware/software environment documented. Weaknesses: contamination not fully resolvable (acknowledged), spectrum scoring depends on the evaluated model pool, and improvement experiments cover only two models over three rounds.

primary_link.title: DSEffi-Bench: Demystifying Large Language Models' Capability in Efficient Data Science Code Generation

papers.summary: Current data science (DS) code generation benchmarks equate correctness with quality, overlooking execution time differences that span orders of magnitude between correct solutions. We introduce DSEffi-Bench, the first benchmark specifically targeting execution efficiency in LLM-generated DS code, comprising 1,000 instances across 10+ DS libraries with stress-testing harnesses and human-validated references. Evaluating 16 models across 3 tiers, we find that correctness alone fails to characteriz
papers.summary_zh: 論文提出 DSEffi-Bench，首個專門評估大型語言模型（LLM）生成資料科學程式碼執行效率的基準測試。既有評測僅衡量正確性，忽略同樣正確的解法在執行時間上可相差數個數量級，且 LLM 常以通用寫法取代函式庫內建的最佳化原語。研究團隊從 Stack Overflow 蒐集效率導向貼文，透過四階段品質把關流程，由 17,257 篇篩出 1,000 個經人工驗證的實例，涵蓋 NumPy、Pandas、PyTorch、Polars、SciPy 等 10 餘種函式庫，每個實例包含問題描述、含正確性與壓力測試的評測框架及人工驗證參考解法，效率則以多模型頻譜的對數正規化分數 Beyond 與 B|P 衡量。對 16 個模型（分三層級）的實驗顯示正確性與效率明顯脫鉤：GPT-5.4 正確率最高（66.9%）但 B|P（71.7%）與 GPT-5.4-mini 幾乎相同；Kimi-K2.5 正確率最低（40.2%）卻有最高 B|P（73.6%）；人類參考解法 B|P 達 86.6%，領先最佳模型 13.0%。人工標註的五類分類法顯示 79.1% 效率缺陷源自領域特定根因，並隨模型層級與函式庫而異：開源程式碼模型普遍欠缺迴圈向量化，前沿模型則常見過度工程開銷。兩項探索實驗證實診斷可引導改進：分類法引導的最佳化提示最高提升 B|P +14.7%；函式庫條件路由以 13.0 倍更低成本逼近 Claude-Opus-4.6 Best@3 的效率。限制包括僅涵蓋 Python、量測受環境影響，以及來自公開貼文的資料汙染風險。此基準凸顯僅憑正確性不足以評估程式碼品質，為效率感知的提示工程、模型路由與後訓練研究奠定基礎。
papers.title: DSEffi-Bench: Demystifying Large Language Models' Capability in Efficient Data Science Code Generation
papers.title_zh: DSEffi-Bench：揭開大型語言模型高效能資料科學程式碼生成能力的面紗

links.title: Tensor Methods for Language Models: From Token Representation to Training, Adaptation, Inference, Compression, and Interpretability

evidence: Abstract: survey 'synthesize[s] open challenges and introduce[s] rho_gap, a metric for the compression-realization gap between theoretical memory reduction and measured system-level speedup', indicating organizational rather than experimental contribution
Section 9.1: 'We do not report new measurements here; the aim is to name the phenomenon' - confirms no original empirical results despite defining the compression-realization gap metric

Table 7 caption/notes: multi-linear attention 'is compared against a Transformer-XL baseline of different depth and width, so its compression may reflect the change of configuration', and Shapeshifter/Hypoformer/CoMERA omitted as they 'report no language-modeling validation at all' - demonstrates critical protocol-aware comparison

Section 3.2: verifiable illustrative arithmetic on LLaMA-3-8B (embedding table E in R^128000x4096 'holds roughly 525M parameters... about 6.5% of all parameters'; TTM rank R=64 gives 'compression ratio of roughly 60x' for one FFN projection)

Table 9 discussion: 'The table is meant to give a general picture... conclusions drawn from this table carry real limitations and should be read with these differences in mind' - transparent about cross-paper comparability limits
Section 5.1: 'To our knowledge, no published work applies tensor methods to the tokenization procedure itself' - honest gap acknowledgment
Section 9.1 Eq. 56: derivation C_F/S_T = MFU_dense/MFU_TN is algebraically correct and correctly caveated as 'informative only in the compute-bound regime'

Abstract/Conclusion: 'The GitHub page dedicated to this paper is accessible at this https URL' - availability claim present but link unresolved in provided text; extensive bibliography with arXiv IDs supports traceability
llm_evaluation.rationale: A well-structured survey of tensor decompositions/tensor networks for LLMs across a seven-stage lifecycle (embeddings, pre-training, PEFT, compression, inference/KV-cache, interpretability) plus a Transformer-component view. Strongly aligned with core LLM methodology preferences: LLMs, transformer architecture, efficiency/compression (LoRA, quantization, pruning, distillation), inference/serving, long context, and mechanistic interpretability. Novelty is moderate and appropriate for a survey: the two-view taxonomy, unified notation, and the rho_gap metric (Eq. 55) are useful organizational contributions, but the survey introduces no new method or experimental result and explicitly states 'We do not report new measurements here' (Sec. 9.1). Rigor is high for the genre: formal problem definitions per stage, careful uniqueness/complexity treatment of CP/Tucker/TT/TTM/BT, a correct MFU-based derivation, and explicit flagging of incomparable baselines (e.g., multi-linear attention in Table 7) and footnoted caveats in Tables 8-9. Evidence strength is limited by the absence of original experiments; claims are compilations of cited results, with LLaMA-3-8B worked arithmetic (Sec. 3.2) verifiable but illustrative. Generalizability is good: the taxonomy spans model scales, notes scaling-law evidence gaps, and extends to MoE/multimodal future directions, while acknowledging cross-model compression transferability is unknown. Reproducibility is adequate: extensive citation apparatus with arXiv identifiers and a GitHub page, though the link is a placeholder in the text and there is no code/artifact evaluation.

primary_link.title: Tensor Methods for Language Models: From Token Representation to Training, Adaptation, Inference, Compression, and Interpretability

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are built from structured high-dimensional objects such as token representations, weights, adaptation updates, caches, and activations, whose multilinear structure is underexploited by the conventional matrix-centric view. Tensor decompositions and tensor networks provide a principled algebraic language for this structure, yet the literature often treats them as isolated compression mechanisms. This survey organizes tensor methods for LLMs through two complementary v
papers.summary_zh: 這篇綜述將張量分解與張量網路視為掌握大型語言模型（LLM）多線性結構的統一代數語言。有別於以矩陣為中心的傳統觀點，作者以兩個互補視角組織文獻：一是涵蓋詞元化、嵌入、預訓練、調適（PEFT）、壓縮、推論與可解釋性的七階段生命週期分類，二是聚焦嵌入層、注意力與前饋網路的元件視角，並以 LLaMA-3-8B 作為貫穿全文的實例，說明各階段可行的張量化做法與代價。文章統一 CP、Tucker、TT、TTM 與 block term 等分解的記號與理論基礎，比較各方法的模型規模、基準與評測協議，並連結量化、剪枝、知識蒸餾等效率技術及機率張量網路。核心發現有二：張量化策略取決於張量模式是否承載語義，注意力與堆疊投影張量適合模式特定分解，而 FFN 與嵌入表多半依賴強制重塑與 TT/TTM 鏈狀結構；其次，相同分解家族跨階段重複出現，但預訓練與壓縮的最佳化目標不同，不能只看壓縮率。作者另提出 ρ_gap 指標，將理論壓縮與實測加速之間的落差拆解為演算法項與硬體實現項，說明參數節省未必轉化為端對端加速。文獻限制包括各方法基準不一、預訓練缺乏多尺度證據、詞元化階段尚無張量方法；未來方向涵蓋融合核心、自適應秩配置與分階段基準測試。對欲進入張量化語言模型領域的研究者，這是兼顧理論與系統視角的結構化入門。
