Appendix E.4: two Mem0 failures verified against raw logs with non-empty retrieval (average scores 1.5 and 1.0)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference fit: an LLM-agent memory benchmark squarely targeting Agents & Tool Use, RAG & Knowledge, Long Context & Memory, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Novelty is moderate: the four-dimension 'memory utilization' framing (dense/implicit/long-form/distractor) and the counterfactual evidence-sensitivity filter are genuine contributions in a crowded memory-benchmark space, but distractor-robustness diagnostics extend known RAG findings and all data is LLM-synthesized. Rigor is solid: dual-judge scoring with reported agreement (Appendix E.3: Pearson 0.848, QWK 0.832 on 1,717 outputs), matched 120K token budget vs LongMemEval-S, controlled interference study varying k/noise/generator size, and honest limitations. Weaknesses: evaluation is fully LLM-judge against a model-generated oracle reference (circularity risk), human verification covers only 50 development instances (45/50 passed, Appendix E.1), and the headline claim that factual-benchmark strength 'does not transfer' is argued via a selection effect rather than tested by evaluating the same systems on LongMemEval/LoCoMo. Within-benchmark evidence is strong (Mem0 17.3 NR/98.3 DR with raw-log-verified failures; recall>=0.8 instances still at RS 6.4-7.9; k75% of 1.5-2.2 distractors under strong noise). Generalizability is explicitly scoped to UtilMem-style synthetic tasks and one generator family. Reproducibility is good: code released, full prompts in Appendices F-I, model/temperature table in Appendix B, though some synthesis parameters (N, M, turn ranges) are not visible in the provided text.

primary_link.title: UTILMEM: Benchmarking Evidence Utilization in Long-Term Conversational Memory

papers.summary: Long-term memory is increasingly important for conversational agents, yet existing benchmarks primarily measure memory through pointwise factual recall: whether a system can recover isolated facts or event-level details from prior interactions. Real-world memory use, however, often requires a more demanding capability: integrating distributed, implicit, and noisy evidence across extended interaction histories into coherent, task-oriented outputs. We call this capability memory utilization. Here,
papers.summary_zh: 現有長期對話記憶基準多以逐點式事實回憶為主，測試系統能否從歷史對話找回孤立事實；但實務上更需要將分散、隱含且含雜訊的證據整合為任務導向輸出的「記憶利用」能力。本文提出 UtilMem 診斷式基準，含 1,717 個實例，橫跨學習輔助、理財指導、心理健康、健身教練與文件分析五個領域，評測四個面向：跨多輪對話的密集推理、隱含記憶擷取、長篇綜合撰寫，以及語意相似干擾對話的過濾。建構流程先合成多輪互動歷史並生成依賴證據的問題，再以反事實退化測試（逐步移除證據並要求答案品質單調下降）過濾，最後注入與證據共享詞彙但意圖不同的對抗性干擾對話。結果顯示：NaiveRAG 約得 59 NR，Mem0 等壓縮型系統僅約 17 NR；即使召回率高於 0.8，答案品質仍明顯低於乾淨參考，部分領域逾半高召回實例仍退化；在召回率固定為 1.0 時，少數強干擾即可移除約四分之一品質，且傷害集中於最初幾個干擾項。限制包括全流程依賴 LLM 建構與評分、oracle 答案僅為協議參考而非人類最佳解，證據敏感性亦僅驗證於抽樣移除路徑。此基準揭示「存取記憶」與「有效運用記憶」之間的落差，凸顯未來架構須保留原始證據並強化抗干擾能力，對對話代理與記憶系統研究極具參考價值。

evidence: Section 4.1 names four backbones (Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Mistral-7B-v0.3, Olmo-3-1025-7B) and three evidence-grounded domains (related-work sections, SEC 10-K MD&A, legal judgments)
Table 1 reports per-benchmark numbers for Initial, ForwardGen, Artifact-Only, WebGLM, WebCPM, and RetroGen across all four backbones
Section 4.2 claims RetroGen improves average evidence-grounded generation over ForwardGen by +4.8 (ALCE +4.3, ScholarQA +6.7, QASPER +3.5) and +2.7 over Artifact-Only on domain reasoning
Table 2 (Section 4.3.1) shows the four-signal weighted verifier (avg 64.98) beats single-signal filters and next-N replace under a matched token budget on Qwen3-8B
Section 4.3.2 reports AstaBench LitQA2 accuracy doubling 0.20→0.40 and search-to-read transitions rising 0.15→0.23 with read-to-end 0.20→0.55

Appendix A.3 gives optimization details: DeepSpeed ZeRO-1, AdamW peak lr 1e-5, cosine schedule, one epoch, fixed seeds; no code/data release is mentioned
Limitations section concedes dependence on recoverable evidence in expert artifacts and restriction to retrieval-oriented text tools, excluding code execution or non-textual environments
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: trajectory-level process supervision for tool-using LLMs (Section 3.2 abstract action vocabulary; AstaBench agentic evaluation in 4.3.2), evidence-grounded/RAG-style generation with citations (ALCE, ScholarQA, QASPER; Section 4.1), and SFT training methodology (Appendix A.3). Not a pure domain application; the scientific/financial/legal domains are testbeds for a general agent-training framework. The retrospective reconstruction of trajectories from expert artifacts is a genuinely fresh angle relative to forward distillation (WebGLM/WebCPM) and STaR-style bootstrapping, though it builds on established process-supervision ideas. Rigor is solid: four backbones, matched-token-budget controlled baselines (ForwardGen, Artifact-Only, Public-Baseline), a verification-dimension ablation with next-N replace (Table 2), and general-capability retention checks; however, no significance testing or seed variance is reported, and verification is performed by the same backbone (Appendix B), creating self-verification circularity the paper does not empirically address. Evidence is concrete (Table 1 gains, e.g., ScholarQA +6.7 avg over ForwardGen; AstaBench LitQA2 accuracy 0.20→0.40), but many margins are small (ALCE 88.03 vs 87.86 Artifact-Only; LegalBench 75.37 vs WebGLM 76.12 on Qwen3-8B), retention results appear only as figures without exact numbers, and single-run evaluation limits strength. Generalizability is supported by three domains and four models but the Limitations section concedes dependence on high-quality, well-grounded artifacts and retrieval-only text tools. Reproducibility benefits from unusually detailed appendices (thresholds 0.52/0.48/0.63, ~25K trajectories, AdamW lr 1e-5, ZeRO-1, fixed seeds, prompt templates), but no code or data release is stated.

papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的代理能力日益仰賴軌跡資料，但在文獻回顧、財務分析報告、法律判決等開放式、證據紮根的長文本生成任務中，因缺乏單一標準答案且驗證成本高，高品質軌跡難以規模化。本文提出回溯式過程監督框架 RetroGen，核心觀察是：專家撰寫的最終成品並非過程紀錄，卻可視為背後證據搜尋流程的壓縮軌跡，且此類成品在預訓練語料中相當豐富。RetroGen 先由成品反推任務規格並自動產生評分規準，再依成品中的引用與實體線索檢索重建證據環境，接著讓 agent 透過真實工具呼叫重構可執行的候選軌跡，最後以涵蓋規準達成、整體品質、證據紮根與軌跡一致性的加權分數過濾，僅保留達門檻的軌跡與其合成成品配對進行 SFT，全程不需更強教師模型或人工標註。實驗涵蓋科學寫作、財務分析與法律判決三領域，在 Qwen3-8B 等四個開源模型上，RetroGen 於 ALCE、ScholarQA、QASPER 與法律推理基準多數優於 ForwardGen（證據紮根生成平均提升 4.8 分）、Artifact-Only 及公開資料基線；消融顯示四個驗證訊號互補；AstaBench 動態評估顯示模型搜尋後更傾向檢視證據並適時終止，一般能力亦未退化。限制在於方法依賴品質夠高、證據線索可回復的專家成品，且目前僅驗證於檢索型工具。整體而言，此研究展示了專家成品可作為開放式 agent 可規模化、自我改進的過程監督來源。
papers.title: From Final Artifacts to Trajectories: Retrospective Process Supervision for Evidence-Grounded Long-Form Generation
papers.title_zh: 從最終成品到軌跡：以回溯式過程監督實現證據紮根的長文本生成

evidence: Abstract: CPR surpasses SFT expert by 1.4-5.5% in domain performance while recovering the general-capability drop from 3.4-14.5% to at most 0.5%, invoking the expert on ~one-third of tokens

Section 4.3 / Table 3: ablations show w/o Micro drops math average by 8.6%, w/o Macro drops general by 1.5%, alpha=0.9 causes 11.9% math drop, thresholds (0.5,0.5) drop math by 6.3%
Table 5: measured latency — CPR 1.40x (Gemma3-4B) and 1.44x (Llama3.1-8B) vs Ensemble 1.89x/2.25x relative to expert-only decoding
Table 6: external experts (OpenMath2-Llama3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B) — CPR recovers general drops of -18.20%/-23.33% to +0.73%/-0.58%
Section 3.2 Eqs. 5-9: critical-point labels from teacher-forcing greedy agreement with sqrt inverse-frequency re-weighted BCE; Section 3.3 Eqs. 10-11: momentum smoothing and 3-way threshold dispatch

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper on mitigating catastrophic forgetting in domain SFT via token-level routing between a base model and its SFT expert. Strongly aligned with LLM, fine-tuning, and inference-efficiency preferences; math/medical are evaluation domains only, not the paper's identity. Novelty is moderate: token-level LM collaboration exists (Co-LLM, Switch Generation, FusionRoute cited in Related Work); the contributions are the critical-point auto-labeling (base fails, expert succeeds), hierarchical macro/micro router, momentum smoothing, and 3-way threshold dispatch plus KV-cache catch-up. Rigor is solid: controlled comparisons sharing the same base/expert, both official and retrained routing baselines (Appendix B.1), extensive ablations (Tables 3, 9-13), data-scale robustness (Table 4), external experts (Table 6), finance and instruction-following extensions (Tables 15-16), and measured latency/memory (Tables 5, 18). Weaknesses: no seeds/variance or significance testing, small benchmarks (e.g., SVAMP/ASDiv at ~0.33% granularity), and latency on 100 samples. Claims of SOTA across settings are supported by Tables 1-2, and the single-model trade-off claim is backed by Figure 8 linear fits. Reproducibility is good: code link in Section 1, full hyperparameters (Appendix A.3), prompt templates (Appendix A.4), and named baseline checkpoints. Limitations honestly noted (dual-model memory, base always runs, needs expert advantage on some tokens).

primary_link.title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation

papers.summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the de facto standard for adapting large language models (LLMs) to target domains, but it often degrades the model's general capabilities, a phenomenon known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing approaches typically modify the SFT loss to mitigate forgetting, but they inevitably operate along a domain-generality trade-off. In this work, we step outside this trade-off by decoupling the two capabilities at the model level: we keep the original base model for general
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型（LLM）領域適應的核心難題：監督式微調（SFT）雖能提升數學、醫療等領域表現，卻常造成通用能力退化的災難性遺忘。現有方法多修改 SFT 損失，把兩種能力壓縮進同一組權重，難以擺脫兩者間的取捨。作者提出 CPR（Critical-Point Routing），改在模型層級解耦：保留 base model 負責通用能力，只在必要時呼叫 SFT 專家。做法是透過 teacher-forcing 比對兩模型的貪婪預測，自動標出「base 失敗但 expert 成功」的關鍵點，再訓練輕量的階層式路由器（macro 編碼器加 micro 路由器），推論時輔以動量平滑與門檻式三分派（hard base、soft blend、hard expert）穩定決策。在 Gemma3-4B 與 Llama3.1-8B 的數學與醫療四種組合中，CPR 皆取得最佳整體平均，領域表現超越 SFT 專家 1.4–5.5%，通用能力損失由 3.4–14.5% 收斂至最多 0.5%，且專家僅需處理約三分之一 tokens，延遲低於 Ensemble。CPR 也能直接搭配公開的外部數學專家，在 1K 小樣本、財經與開放式指令遵循情境依然有效。限制在於需同時載入兩個模型而增加 GPU 記憶體負擔，base 仍須逐步執行，且仰賴專家在部分 tokens 上確實優於 base。本文將災難性遺忘定位為架構問題，為領域專家模型提供可事後套用的通用解方。
papers.title: CPR for LLMs: Critical-Point Routing against Catastrophic Forgetting in Domain Adaptation
papers.title_zh: CPR for LLMs：以關鍵點路由對抗領域適應中的災難性遺忘

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope and well aligned: MLLM-based work (LLaVA-1.5-7B, Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL) squarely touching AI-safety/privacy (retain-free identity unlearning) and interpretability-style localization (causal tracing, weight transplant, Fisher overlap), with strong weights on LLM, Multimodal, Safety, and Interpretability preferences. Not out-of-scope CV: language methodology (NPO, decoder-MLP editing) is central. Novelty is moderate-good: ROME-style tracing, NPO, and weight grafting are adapted, but the localization-first retain-free framing and self-anchoring from forget images are fresh. Rigor is high: five baselines grouped by retain access, two benchmarks, three backbones, component/target/lambda/K ablations, stability analyses (Spearman 0.947+/-0.014), sequential unlearning, and a relearning attack; main weakness is a single seed/single run and coarse binary GPT-4o-mini judgments. Evidence is solid with concrete tables, though judged metrics and synthetic identity profiles limit auditability. Generalizability is capped by acknowledged per-model re-localization, 7-8B-only backbones, and curated synthetic profiles (Section 7). Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters (Appendix A.3) and a verbatim judge prompt (Figure 7), but no code release is stated and two dataset licenses are unspecified.

primary_link.title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.summary: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and
papers.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）會將人臉與姓名、個人背景等身分資訊編碼於參數中，當事人依 GDPR 有權要求刪除，但現有機器遺忘方法多需保留集（retain set），部署後難以取得且重建保留集反而重現隱私風險；僅用遺忘集又會破壞共享的視覺—語言運算。本文將免保留集遺忘視為定位問題，透過因果追蹤、權重移植與 Fisher 重疊分析，一致指出早期至中期的解碼器 MLP 正是身分知識的儲存處，且修改後對視覺處理干擾最小。據此提出 PAVA：僅在這些層以 LoRA 更新，以 NPO 壓制身分問答，並從遺忘圖像本身構建視覺屬性錨點（VAA），以未遺忘前模型對衣著、背景等身分無關問題的自答作為蒸餾目標，同時完成刪除與保留。在 MLLMU-Bench 與 ReMem 上，以 LLaVA-1.5-7B 與 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 為骨幹，PAVA 在免保留集方法中取得最佳的遺忘—保留權衡，例如 Qwen2.5-VL 的遺忘正確率由 84 降至 36，同時維持接近原模型的實用性；亦具序列 QA→VQA 遺忘與抗再學習能力。限制包括：基準資料為策劃的個人檔案，定位結論對真實網路身分尚待驗證；實驗僅涵蓋同類 7–8B 模型，層級需逐一重新定位；再學習攻擊也不能證明資訊已完全移除。此研究指出身分遺忘的關鍵在於「在哪裡改」，而非「如何改」。
papers.title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models

links.title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle

llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: it builds an automated testing framework for LLMs used as post hoc explainers of RL policies, matching the LLMs, Reasoning & CoT, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Interpretability, and Agents preferences strongly (no out-of-scope domain-application content). Novelty is real but incremental: model checking has previously been combined with LLMs and policies (the paper's own related work, e.g. ref [12]), so the new contribution is the oracle-for-explainer framing plus a query taxonomy and difficulty-based prioritization. Rigor is solid: exact grading against Storm-computed V(s)/Q(s,a)/D(s), a Random baseline, per-category taxonomy, and a Wilcoxon signed-rank test (p=0.035) over 220 cells; however greedy decoding with sample size 1 and only 20 states per category weaken per-cell statistics. Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1 averages check out against reported means and the abstract's 0.85/0.70/below-random claims), though the prioritization effect is admittedly 'modest in magnitude' (Section 7). Generalizability is limited by seven small, exactly model-checkable MDPs, memoryless policies, reachability properties only, and three open-weight models with handwritten templates; the authors acknowledge this. Reproducibility benefits from detailed setup (hardware, Docker, Storm 1.12.0, Ollama, budgets) but no code or artifact release is stated.

primary_link.title: Automated Testing of LLM-Based Post Hoc Explainers Using Model Checking as an Oracle

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are used as post hoc explainers of sequential decision-making policies, producing natural-language explanations of why an action was chosen. However, LLMs often generate plausible but incorrect statements, and no existing approach systematically tests whether such explanations are faithful to the underlying environment. Two classic software testing challenges stand in the way: there is no oracle for the correctness of an explanation, and the test inputs, natural lang
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）常被用來在事後解釋循序決策策略為何選擇某個動作，但其解釋可能聽來合理卻不正確，過去缺乏系統性測試方法。本文指出兩大軟體測試難題：一是缺少可判定解釋對錯的 test oracle（測試預言），二是自然語言查詢的輸入空間缺乏結構。作者以機率模型檢驗（probabilistic model checking，以 Storm 工具搭配 PCTL 性質）計算每個狀態的精確參考值 V(s)、Q(s,a) 與危險度 D(s)，作為自動評分的預言；並提出事後查詢分類法，依物件、範圍、模式三個維度組織測試案例，再以診斷難度分數（模糊性、選擇性、顯著性）優先挑選最具診斷價值的狀態。實驗涵蓋七個 MDP 環境與三個開放權重模型：推理模型 Qwen3.5 平均通過率 0.85，Gemma 4 31B 為 0.70，而 Gemma 3 1B 得 0.43，低於隨機基線的 0.51；診斷式排序顯著挖出比隨機選取更難的案例（Wilcoxon 檢定 p=0.035），各查詢類別難度亦有差異，以子集中的死端與最差動作最難。限制包括僅涵蓋七個可精確建模的環境與三個受測開放權重模型、提示範本為手工撰寫、貪婪解碼僅取樣一次，且通過最佳動作測試並不代表 LLM 能勝任策略本身。此工作量化了在無模型、無法驗證的情境下 LLM 生成解釋的可信度落差，對可信 AI 的軟體測試具重要意義。

links.title: Why Are LLM Backdoor Defenses Fragmented? A Feature-Level Explanation with Sparse Autoencoders

evidence: Abstract: claims SAE feature clamping 'reduces ASR to at most 10.8% in most dirty-label settings and at most 15.4% in the majority of clean-label settings, while preserving benign-task performance'.

Sec 4.1, Table 1: BEEAR/CRoW cut dirty-label ASR to ~17.3%/15.6% average but clean-label ASR remains ~90%; RepGuard cuts clean-label ASR to 30.6% while dirty-label stays 91.7% — establishes the fragmentation motivating the paper.

Sec 4.2.2, Table 2: factorial decomposition attributes the backdoor logit-margin shift mainly to the interaction term (e.g., rare trigger: +23.5 of +27.1 total, 86.6%), justifying feature-level attribution.
Sec 5.3, Tables 5-6: Base Clamp and CC Clamp report per-setting ASR/CACC deltas across 3 models x 3 datasets x 6 attack settings; CC Clamp ASR mostly below 6% with CACC changes within a few points.

Tables 1, 7, 8: the 'No Defense' ASR rows are numerically identical (100/100/98.8/97.9/99.9/94.6 etc.) across Gemma, Llama, and Qwen backdoored models, which is implausible for independently poisoned models and suggests copy error; Table 8 Gemma LLM-LAT dirty-rare No Defense (82.4) also conflicts with Table 5 Gemma Before ASR (93.8).

Appendix F: aggregated feature counts are inconsistent with the implied top-60 selection (e.g., Llama dirty '258 out of 530 feature instances', clean '273 out of 541'), while per-setting tables show columns summing to 50-62 instead of a uniform 60.
Appendix C: LoRA rank 16/alpha 16, lr 1e-4, batch 32, FP32, 4 epochs on 4xA800; no code or artifact release statement anywhere, and poisoning rates are not specified.

Limitations section: authors state evaluation 'focuses on controlled classification-style settings and a limited set of backdoor objectives' and Appendix G notes limited public SAE availability, bounding generalizability claims.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-topic for high-weight preferences: backdoor attacks/defenses on LLMs (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Qwen2.5-7B) analyzed via SAE mechanistic interpretability, with defense benchmarking. Claimed first SAE-based feature-level analysis of LLM backdoors is plausibly novel (prior SAE work targets jailbreaks/steering; Yu et al. 2025 does backdoor attribution), and the 2x2 factorial trigger/weight/interaction decomposition plus four-role feature taxonomy is a genuine methodological contribution. Rigor is solid in breadth (3 models, 3 datasets, 3 triggers, 2 paradigms, threshold/top-k/SAE-variant sensitivity in Appendix H) but weakened by heuristic classification thresholds, single-run results without variance, an oracle-flavored clamping feature selection that assumes a suspicious-input set, and an overstated 'first' claim. Evidence strength is undercut by internal inconsistencies: 'No Defense' ASR rows are identical across three different architectures in Tables 1/7/8, and Table 8 Gemma LLM-LAT dirty-rare (82.4) conflicts with Table 5 Gemma Before ASR (93.8); Appendix F aggregate counts (530/541/545/539/543) deviate from the implied 540-per-paradigm totals. Generalizability is acknowledged as limited to classification-style settings with finite SAE availability. Reproducibility is partial: training hyperparameters and thresholds are given, but no code/data release and poisoning rates are unstated.

primary_link.title: Why Are LLM Backdoor Defenses Fragmented? A Feature-Level Explanation with Sparse Autoencoders

papers.summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs), but existing defenses remain fragmented, failing to pro?vide unified defense against both dirty-label and clean-label attacks. To investigate why such fragmentation arises, we present the first systematic feature-level mechanistic analysis of LLM backdoors using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Starting from a 2 x 2 comparison of clean and poisoned models on clean and triggered inputs, we trace backdoor-induced logit shifts to hi
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型(LLM)的後門攻擊威脅模型安全,但現有防禦呈現碎片化:有效於 dirty-label 的 BEEAR、CRoW 在 clean-label 下失效,反之亦然。本文首度以稀疏自編碼器(SAE)對 LLM 後門進行系統性的特徵層級機制分析。作者以 2×2 因子實驗(乾淨/中毒模型 × 乾淨/觸發輸入)將後門 logit 偏移分解為觸發、權重與交互作用三效應,歸因至 SAE 特徵,按激活模式分為 interaction、suppressed、mixed、weight-modified 四類。實驗涵蓋三種主流 LLM(Gemma-2、Llama-3.1、Qwen2.5)、三個資料集與三種觸發器,交互作用效應佔後門總偏移至少 86.6%;dirty-label 攻擊由孤立的 interaction 特徵主導,clean-label 攻擊則多依賴 mixed 與 weight-modified 特徵,結構性解釋了防禦碎片化。作者以推論時期的特徵鉗制(feature clamping)驗證因果角色,多數情境 ASR 降至 10.8%(dirty-label)與 15.4%(clean-label)以下,且大致維持 CACC。限制包括實驗僅涵蓋受控分類式任務與有限後門目標,SAE 重建品質可能影響歸因,機制洞見亦可能被自適應攻擊者利用。本研究指出防禦碎片化源於攻擊典範間的特徵編碼差異,為統一且可解釋的後門緩解提供方向。
papers.title: Why Are LLM Backdoor Defenses Fragmented? A Feature-Level Explanation with Sparse Autoencoders

links.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core agents/LLM paper: a benchmark for LLMs as agent-swarm orchestrators plus an experience-replay method (SwarmExp). Topic fit is strong (agents, tool use, evaluation, in-context experience injection). Rigor is above average: formal swarm definition (Sec 2.1), accuracy/efficiency/cost metrics with formulas (Appendix C), baselines including a cost-matched single agent (Appendix D.1), component ablations (Table 4), cross-model/cross-task transfer (Tables 3, 10), 5-run variance analysis (Appendix D.2), and LLM-judge vs human agreement (Appendix D.3, r=0.684-0.801). Main deductions: 50 samples per task makes small gains like +0.25 on MTU (Table 2) within reported noise (~±1.0), only one human annotator validates the LLM judges, heavy reliance on LLM-as-judge for open-ended tasks, and results depend on unverifiable proprietary models. Novelty is moderate: process-quality scoring of decomposition/delegation/aggregation is a fresh angle, but SwarmExp (skill/trick/model-card extraction and replay) is close to cited memory/experience work (Agent Workflow Memory, G-Memory, EvoSkill). Code release and prompt appendix aid reproducibility, though API costs and model access limit it.

primary_link.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?

papers.summary: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show
papers.summary_zh: 基於大型語言模型（LLM）的多代理系統正由固定協作走向動態編排的 Agent Swarm，主代理須拆解任務、動態建立子代理並整合結果，但既有基準多沿用單代理任務、只看最終答案，難以系統檢驗這種編排能力。本文提出 SwarmBench，含 8 項任務、400 個樣本，分為任務分解（MATH、Batch Download、Multi-Text Understanding）、子代理建立與指派（Multi-Perspective Analysis、Root Cause Analysis、Treasure Hunt）與結果整合（Long-Text Generation、Wide Search）三大類，並從準確率、效率、成本與流程品質多面向評估；在統一輕量框架中，主代理不得自行呼叫工具，須依模型池描述為子代理挑選骨幹模型。實驗顯示 GPT-5.4 是最強且最均衡的編排者，八項任務中六項居首，開源模型能力則較零散；成本與效能並非線性關係，關鍵在編排結構是否有效，平行代理數量多也不保證省時，例如 Gemini-3-flash 以中等平行度取得最高增益；流程品質分析更指出結果整合是最普遍的瓶頸。作者另提出 SwarmExp，自執行軌跡萃取 skill、trick 與 model card 並重新注入主代理，於 MTU、RCA、LTG、WS 四項任務一致提升（RCA +6.42、LTG +6.46），且經驗可跨模型轉移（16 個設定中 14 個改善）。研究限制包括任務僅八項、採固定子代理模型池，以及流程評估部分依賴 LLM 評審、恐引入偏誤。本基準證明 Agent Swarm 的效益主要來自分解、指派與整合的編排結構，而非單純增加成本或平行度，為 LLM 擔任群集編排者的後續研究提供系統性評估基礎。
papers.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
papers.title_zh: SwarmBench：大型語言模型能否勝任 Agent Swarm 編排者？

links.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models

evidence: Section 5.2: 'at the highest intensity, accuracy falls by up to 10.0%p for EXAONE-7.8B and 7.0%p for Qwen3-4B relative to their clean baselines'; EXAONE-7.8B shows a larger drop than its 2.4B counterpart under Jamo Transposition, supporting the scaling-does-not-help claim.
Section 6.3, Table 2: held-out typo-type detection AUROC ranges 0.905-0.943 across four models, with probes trained on HAERAE-GK and evaluated on unseen KMMLU questions and an unseen typo type.
Section 7.4, Table 5: TACoT beats a rate-matched random router by up to 2.3 points at the highest intensity level, isolating the value of the probe's routing signal.

Section 7.3/Figure 5: selective routing reduces average output tokens by approximately 37% versus full CoT (range 26% for EXAONE-2.4B to 49% for A.X-Light) while preserving most accuracy gains per Table 3.
Appendix C, Table 6: the five-type taxonomy covers 96.2% of 729,755 annotated real Korean input error spans from the AI-Hub corpus, with jamo-fragmenting errors at 16.8% of keyboard typos.

Appendix A: HAERAE-GK (176 four-choice questions) is used for Fisher layer selection, probe training, and threshold selection; 'KMMLU is never used for layer selection, probe training, or threshold selection' - a clean leakage-prevention design.

Limitations section: authors acknowledge the probe/TACoT approach requires hidden-state access and is 'fundamentally incompatible with API-based LLM deployment', and that larger models in Appendix E are evaluated only for accuracy degradation without probe or TACoT validation.
Appendix E, Table 7: re-generating perturbations under three random seeds changes mean accuracy by at most 0.07 points, supporting robustness of the headline degradation findings.

Affiliation/footnote block lists https://github.com/SJLee0311/korean-jamo-typo and Appendix B states 'we release the full implementation so the benchmark can be regenerated exactly'; however, repository contents cannot be verified from the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper spanning several high-weight preferences: LLM robustness evaluation (AI Safety), chain-of-thought reasoning (TACoT routing), and internal-representation probing (interpretability). The jamo-level (intra-syllabic) perturbation taxonomy is a genuine but incremental extension of existing multilingual keyboard-typo work (Zhao et al., 2026 is cited as covering multilingual typos), and TACoT is a fairly straightforward selective-CoT application of a linear probe. Rigor is above average: clean calibration/test separation (HAERAE-GK for all fitting, KMMLU never used for fitting), held-out typo-type probe evaluation, a rate-matched random-router control (Table 5), seed-robustness checks (Table 7), and cross-domain transfer to HRM8K. Evidence is quantitative and mostly well-supported (AUROC 0.905-0.943, accuracy deltas, ~37% token reduction, 96.2% coverage of 729,755 real error spans in Appendix C), though no statistical significance testing or confidence intervals are reported. Generalizability is limited by the Korean-specific phenomenon and the white-box requirement for hidden states, which the Limitations section itself flags as incompatible with API deployment; probe/TACoT validation is restricted to four 2.4B-7.8B models with larger API models tested only for accuracy. Reproducibility is aided by a released GitHub implementation, full perturbation algorithms (Appendix B), prompts (Appendix D), and public datasets/models, though the repository could not be verified from the text alone.

primary_link.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Korean introduces an additional typographical perturbation level not captured by ordinary character-level edit models: because syllable blocks are internally composed of sub-character units called jamo, keyboard-level errors can occur within a syllable, either producing a valid but semantically altered character or exposing raw jamo on the surface. Both outcomes disrupt sub-word tokenization and are not reliably corrected by existing grammatical error correction pipelines, leaving LLMs directly
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）對韓文錯字的脆弱性。韓文音節方塊由子字母（jamo）組成，鍵盤輸入的錯誤可發生在音節內部，形成合法但語義改變的字或裸露 jamo，兩者皆會擾亂 sub-word tokenizer，且現有韓文文法錯誤修正（GEC）管線無法可靠修復，使 LLM 直接處理受損輸入。作者以 KMMLU 為主要 benchmark，定義五種源自鍵盤機制的擾動類型（jamo 替換、終聲刪除、jamo 重複、空格刪除、jamo 位移），各施以 5%–25% 五種強度，評測四個模型。結果顯示準確率隨強度單調下降，參數規模擴大無法帶來穩健性；空格刪除則幾乎不影響表現，顯示 tokenizer 可部分吸收此類擾動。進一步以 Fisher 分離分數選出對錯字敏感的層，於 last-token hidden state 訓練線性探針，發現錯字輸入造成有別於「答錯」的獨特表徵位移，探針對未見過的錯字類型 AUROC 達 0.905–0.943。據此提出 TACoT：僅在探針判定疑似錯字時啟用 chain-of-thought，保留 CoT 大部分準確率增益，同時平均減少約 37% 輸出 token 成本；在 HRM8K 數學 benchmark 上亦驗證通用性，並優於觸發比例相同的隨機路由。相形之下，GEC 前置修正與提示模型注意錯字幾乎無效甚至有害。限制包括：擾動為合成，未必反映真實錯字分佈；方法需存取內部 hidden states，與 API 部署不相容；探針實驗僅涵蓋 2.4B–7.8B 模型；TACoT 僅做路由，並未直接修復表徵偏移。整體而言，本研究確立韓文錯字穩健性為結構性瓶頸，並示範內部表徵訊號能支撐低成本的按需推理防禦。
papers.title: Quantifying and Mitigating Korean Jamo-Level Typographical Vulnerabilities in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 量化並緩解大型語言模型對韓文 Jamo 層級錯字的脆弱性

links.title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'We introduce a tool-driven framework for generating controlled, label-preserving edits to logical reasoning problems... operating on symbolic representations of first-order logic and constraint satisfaction problem tasks'

Section 5.1, Table 2: 'Flip Rate: Total Percentage of records that transition from correct to incorrect and from incorrect to correct as logic-forms change' with values up to 46.15 for Gemma3-12B SymbCoT 0->2 on FOLIO
Section 5.2, Table 4: 'performance consistently drops when the label changes, with large declines observed across high-performing models' - e.g., Gemma3-27B FOLIO Altered -23.33, Llama3-8B -21.33
Appendix C, Table 9: 'the annotators achieved 94.5% inter-annotator agreement, measured using Gwet's AC1'; overall validity 98.9% (89/90)
Section 5.1 Qualitative study: 'The two are highly correlated, with a Pearson's correlation coefficient of 0.9' between LLM-coded reasoning scores and final-answer accuracy
Appendix A: AR-LSAT translations obtained for approximately 88% of records using Gemini 2.5 Flash; Table 7 lists 6 manually corrected answer labels
Limitations: 'Our study makes use of proprietary language models, which are non-deterministic and subject to undisclosed version updates, limiting exact replication of results'
Footnote 1: 'The code and dataset are available at RamyaKeerthy/BeyondSurfaceForms'; Appendix I introduces the LogicEdit Python library
Appendix F: 'only 15 records in total showed a change in proof length for cumulative edits... Strong conclusions are avoided due to the limited available proofs'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A solid LLM-focused evaluation paper squarely within preferred topics: it stress-tests LLM logical reasoning (CoT, test-time scaling, SymbCoT) via a tool-driven framework that performs label-preserving and label-altering operator edits on symbolic FOL/CSP representations across FOLIO, Logical Deduction, and AR-LSAT, evaluated on Gemma3 (1B-27B), Llama3-8B, Phi-4-Mini, Qwen3-4B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Novelty is moderate: it extends the GSM-Symbolic-style perturbation paradigm (Mirzadeh et al.) and Stolfo et al.'s causal interventions from value edits to operator-level symbolic edits for logical reasoning, with a reusable LogicEdit library. Rigor is above average: significance testing with Bonferroni correction, flip-rate analysis revealing instability hidden by stable aggregate accuracy, human validation of back-translations (94.5% Gwet's AC1 agreement, 98.9% validity in Table 9), and manual correction of 6 AR-LSAT labels. Weakened by small qualitative subsets (e.g., 9-24 records per dataset in Table 12), reliance on Gemini 2.5 Flash as both translator and LLM-judge coder (mitigated by a 0.9 Pearson correlation with accuracy), only 15 records with usable proof-length variation (Appendix F), and AR-LSAT excluded from individual-edit analysis (22 records). Central findings - accuracy instability via flips (Table 2, up to ~46% flip rates), large accuracy drops under label-altering edits (Table 4, e.g., Gemma3-27B FOLIO -23.33), and original-answer retention (Table 5) - are quantitatively supported. Reproducibility is decent: code, dataset, and LogicEdit library are released with prompts and configurations in appendices, but dependence on proprietary Gemini 2.5 Flash for translation and coding limits exact replication, as acknowledged in Limitations.

primary_link.title: Beyond Surface Forms: Symbolic Edits as a Test for Logical Reasoning with LLMs

papers.summary: Logical reasoning with large language models (LLMs) is a critical capability, as it reflects a system's ability to correctly deduce hypotheses from a given context using faithful deductive processes. However, LLM reasoning has often been shown to be sensitive to small surface-level variations in problem formulation, raising questions about whether models truly follow the underlying logical structure. Studying this behavior is challenging because the symbolic components of logical problems, such
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）的邏輯推理是否真正依循問題的邏輯結構，而非僅仰賴表層模式匹配。作者提出一套工具驅動的框架，將 FOLIO、Logical Deduction 與 AR-LSAT 三個資料集轉為一階邏輯或約束滿足問題的符號表示，透過 Prover9、Z3 與 Python 約束求解器對邏輯運算子（如 or、xor、lessthan 等）進行受控編輯，再以 Gemini 2.5 Flash 回譯為自然語言，產生保留或改變最終答案的題目變體。實驗評估 Gemma3 系列（1B–27B）、Llama3-8B、Qwen3-4B 與 Phi-4-Mini，測試 Chain-of-Thought、推理期運算擴充與 SymbCoT 三種策略。主要發現：在標籤保留式編輯下，最終準確率大多穩定，但翻轉率（flip rate）分析顯示模型預測在編輯後頻繁於正確與錯誤間切換，行為不一致，且與模型大小無關；改變答案的單一編輯則使多數模型準確率顯著下滑，並常回頭輸出原始答案，顯示對既有答案模式的依賴。質性分析亦發現，隨編輯數增加，前提忠實度、推論有效性與答案對齊等指標持續下降。限制包括依賴符號翻譯的覆蓋率、回譯可能引入語意誤差，以及使用專有模型影響可重現性。此框架提供超越準確率的結構化壓力測試工具，凸顯現行 LLM 未能穩固扎根於符號結構，對建構更可靠的推理評量基準深具意義。

links.title: Frontier vision-language models have overtaken young adults at detecting AI-generated portraits -- but not their calibration

evidence: Material and methods, 'Benchmark protocol' (pp. 20-21): fixed system prompt, four labelled few-shot practice images mirroring the human practice phase, structured JSON output, temperature 0, 3,762 main judgments with zero API errors.

Results (p. 5): gpt-5.6-sol 92.8% single-pass balanced accuracy with identity-cluster CI 89.8-95.8%; claude-fable-5 detected 132/132 AI images; McNemar tests separate July from June leaders (p = .011-.026).

Material and methods, 'Robustness to few-shot examples' (p. 22): identical-prompt control bounds run-to-run noise at 1.5-2.0% for stable models vs 9.1-11.6% for OpenAI models; example effect 3.4-4.5x noise for stable models but only 1.2-1.3x for OpenAI models.

Material and methods, 'Statistics' (pp. 24-25): log-linear correction for d′/c, identity-level cluster bootstrap with a fixed, documented resampling stream, Wilson intervals, exact binomial McNemar, Brier scores; uncorrected vs corrected d′ at ceiling (5.50 vs 3.41) shown explicitly.

Results, 'Models cite human-like cues…but the cues are verdict markers' (pp. 11-13): 3,738 rationales coded into 15 categories; over-smoothness +24.4 pp within AI but −77.6 pp within real, indicating cues track verdicts rather than truth; LLM coder circularity mitigated by blinding and a rule-based cross-check (p. 23, Suppl. Fig. S5).

Discussion, limitations (p. 17): one portrait domain, two generator families frozen July 2025, single prompt family via one aggregator; FFHQ is public, stimuli publicly served since August 2025, and stimulus class is recoverable from the prior public release, so contamination 'would if anything inflate model performance'.
Material and methods, 'Age-persona prompt-sensitivity pilot' (p. 24): pre-specified stop criteria, shifts ≤3.8 pp balanced accuracy, explicitly framed as a narrow screening result.

Data accessibility (pp. 25-26): per-item judgments, cue codes, and headline-statistics script deposited (GitHub v1.0.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22148304); stimulus-code-to-filename mapping and verbatim rationales withheld with stated justification, and a bounded nine-item disclosure acknowledged.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A matched-protocol evaluation of 19 frontier VLMs against an age-stratified human reference on AI-portrait detection. It is not pure computer vision: the methodology is centered on multimodal LLM evaluation — few-shot prompting protocols, few-shot-example sensitivity with run-to-run noise decomposition, verbalized-confidence calibration (Brier, resolution), reasoning-effort and persona prompting pilots, and LLM-coded rationale analysis — mapping onto high-weight preferences (multimodal AI, prompting/ICL, evaluation/benchmarking, AI safety, interpretability). Rigor is strong: balanced accuracy matched to human session composition, identity-cluster bootstrap, exact McNemar tests, log-linear-corrected d′, an identical-prompt noise control, and unusually candid limitations (including acknowledged training-contamination risk since FFHQ stimuli and class labels are publicly recoverable). Novelty is moderate: VLM deepfake-detection evaluations exist (its own refs 18-22), but the signal-detection framing (sensitivity vs. criterion), verdict-marker vs. evidence rationale diagnosticity, and two-cohort temporal design are fresh contributions. Evidence is solid but bounded: headline claims carry CIs and paired tests, though contamination could inflate model scores, the human baseline comes from a non-peer-reviewed preprint with a self-selected sample, and some cue cells are small (62 REAL verdicts comparator). Generalizability is explicitly narrow (one portrait domain, two frozen generators, one prompt family, one aggregator). Reproducibility is high: per-item judgments, fixed-seed deterministic resampling streams, code and data on GitHub/Zenodo, with justified withholding of the stimulus-code mapping and rationale texts. Overall a careful, well-evidenced evaluation study whose main limits are domain scope and application-style (rather than language-methodology) novelty.

primary_link.title: Frontier vision-language models have overtaken young adults at detecting AI-generated portraits -- but not their calibration

papers.summary: AI image generators now create face portraits that are hard to tell from real photographs. Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly proposed to flag such images. We benchmarked 19 VLMs on the same 198 face portraits -- real photographs and identity-matched ChatGPT-4o and Imagen 3 versions -- under the same task as our earlier study of 1,667 adults (85% correct overall; accuracy fell steeply with age). The June-2026 cohort of 14 models only matched adults in their 20s-30s. Four weeks later
papers.summary_zh: 本研究以與人類實驗完全相同的流程，檢驗前沿視覺–語言模型能否偵測AI生成人像。研究者沿用先前1,667名成人研究的人類基準，分兩批測試19個模型（2026年6月14個、7月5個），判定同一批198張人像：真實FFHQ照片與以ChatGPT-4o、Imagen 3重製的同身分版本。模型在溫度0下逐一輸出REAL/AI判斷、信心與一句理由，並以平衡準確率、訊號偵測指標（d′與準則c）、更換few-shot範例後的穩定性及理由編碼進行比較。結果顯示：6月批次最佳模型僅與20–30歲成人相當；四周後gpt-5.6-sol達92.8%（多輪平均92.1%），claude-fable-5偵出全部AI影像、平均91.9%，敏感度達d′=3.4，明確超越20歲組的88.5%（d′約2.4）。但人類的校準未被超越：模型判斷準則散布於c=−1.10至+1.45，兩位新領先者皆有偏誤；更換標註範例約使四分之一答案翻轉；6月模型普遍過度自信，7月領先者則近乎校準；模型理由引用的線索多與判斷結果一致而非真實證據，僅髮型線索在兩類皆屬正向。15/19模型也重現人類覺得ChatGPT-4o影像較難辨識的排序。限制包括僅單一人像領域、兩種2025年7月的生成器與單一提示詞流程，且FFHQ為公開資料，可能造成訓練汙染。本研究顯示：機器在此任務首次勝過各年齡層平均成人，但判斷準則、穩定性與理由品質仍不像人類。

links.title: EvoSkill Injection: Red-Teaming Autonomous Skill Generation and Evolution in Self-Evolving Agents

evidence: Section 5.1: three Target Agents (AutoSkill, Voyager, ExpeL) and six LLMs; GPT-4o-mini serves as primary Orchestrator/Attacker/Judge model
Section 6.1, Table 1: attack success at pass@4 reaches 43.5% (Generation), 54.6% (Escalation), 49.9% (Reinforcement) on GPT-4o-mini AutoSkill

Section 5.2/Appendix A.6: safety labels (Explicit Refusal/Soft Safe/Unsafe-Harmful) and attack success determined by an LLM-based behavior judge; no human annotation or judge-accuracy validation reported

Section 6.2, Table 2: attacked vs clean harmful rates 19.2% vs 6.5% (AutoSkill), 32.5% vs 5.5% (Voyager), 15.2% vs 8.8% (ExpeL); ExpeL clean harm overall inconsistent with topic-level values summing to 61/800=7.6%
Section 6.4, Table 4: SARGE harmful rate 19.2% vs PAIR 33.6%, IPI 19.1%, PoisonedRAG 11.6%, Phantom 15.1%, BadRAG 15.2%; authors candidly note PAIR is stronger at direct elicitation
Section 6.5, Table 5: removing Generation Agent drops harmful rate 19.2%→9.0%; removing Reinforcement Agent drops it to 12.4%
Section 6.3/Appendix C.1: transferability varies widely, e.g., Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite ~70.9-72.0% pass@4 vs DeepSeek-V4-Pro <13%
Appendix D, Table D.1: prompt defenses cut harm (AutoSkill 19.2%→8.4%) but raise refusals (Voyager 33.1%→62.9%) and do not prevent malicious skill generation/storage
Appendix A.5/A.2: EvoSkillBench has 800 trajectories (100 per 8 categories) generated by DeepSeek-V4-Pro with an LLM-only quality-control pipeline; no human verification mentioned
Ethical Considerations: 'We plan to release the code and benchmarks' — availability is promised, not demonstrated with a repository link
Limitations: acknowledges only three self-evolving agent frameworks, GPT-4o-mini judge/attacker cost constraints, and non-exhaustive benchmark coverage
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper squarely matching high-weight preferences (agents/red-teaming/AI safety/LLMs): defines 'EvoSkill Injection' threat model targeting autonomous skill-generation pipelines, proposes the SARGE multi-agent red-teaming framework, and two benchmarks (800 trajectories + 800 post-attack queries, Appendix A.5). Novelty is a genuine but incremental shift from external skill poisoning/memory poisoning (AgentPoison) to internalization of attacker-crafted interaction trajectories. Rigor is solid in breadth (3 target agents, 6 LLMs, PAIR/IPI/PoisonedRAG/Phantom/BadRAG baselines in Table 4, agent-removal ablations in Table 5, prompt defenses in Appendix D) but weakened by exclusive reliance on an LLM judge (GPT-4o-mini) for both attack success and safety labels with no human validation, no significance/variance reporting, and an internal inconsistency in Table 2 (ExpeL clean harm overall 8.8% vs topic-level sum 61/800=7.6%). Threat model assumes the attacker can supply fabricated assistant turns within interaction histories, a strong capability assumption only partially justified by the comparison to memory poisoning. Evidence is detailed with sample counts (e.g., 154/800, Table C.1) but single-run and judge-based. Reproducibility is helped by full prompts (Appendix B) and construction procedures, but code/benchmark release is only 'planned' (Ethical Considerations), not verified.

primary_link.title: EvoSkill Injection: Red-Teaming Autonomous Skill Generation and Evolution in Self-Evolving Agents

papers.summary: LLM-based agent systems increasingly adopt skill-based architectures to reduce repetitive reasoning costs and improve stable, efficient task execution. Recent studies propose self-evolving agents that autonomously generate, refine, and reuse skills from past experiences to enable continuous capability evolution. However, autonomous skill evolution introduces a new attack surface in which malicious capabilities are generated, stored, and reused as legitimate skills. In this paper, we define EvoSk
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理系統日益採用技能導向架構，透過儲存與檢索可重複使用的行為能力來降低重複推理成本；近期研究更提出自我演化代理，可從互動軌跡中自主生成、精煉並重複使用技能。本文指出自主技能生成與演化管線本身即構成新的攻擊面，並首度定義 EvoSkill Injection 威脅模型：對抗性互動軌跡會誘使代理將惡意能力內化為看似合法的持久技能。作者提出紅隊測試框架 SARGE，以 Orchestrator、Attacker 與 Judge 代理協作，設計技能生成、技能升級與技能強化三種攻擊流程，並建構涵蓋八大高風險類別、共 800 則多輪中毒軌跡的 EvoSkillBench，及事後安全評測集 EvoSkillSafetyBench。針對 AutoSkill、Voyager、ExpeL 三種代理的實驗顯示，pass@4 攻擊成功率分別達 43.5%、54.6% 與 49.9%；注入後 AutoSkill 有害回應率由 6.5% 升至 19.2%，Voyager 更達 32.5%，且攻擊可跨模型轉移，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 有害率最高達 29.6%。與基線比較，SARGE 有害率 19.2%，優於間接提示注入、記憶投毒、後門與 RAG 投毒；消融實驗顯示移除生成攻擊代理時降幅最大。系統提示層級防禦僅能部分緩解，且會推高拒答率，無法阻止惡意技能被生成與儲存。研究限制包括僅評估三種代理架構、多代理迭代攻擊成本高昂，及類別涵蓋有限。本文凸顯持久性能力汙染是自我演化代理的關鍵安全風險，呼籲於技能生成與儲存管線層級建立根本性防禦。
papers.title: EvoSkill Injection: Red-Teaming Autonomous Skill Generation and Evolution in Self-Evolving Agents
papers.title_zh: EvoSkill Injection：對自我演化代理自主技能生成與演化的紅隊測試

Section 5.2, Table 4: utility preserved on Llama-3.1 (MATH 32.2 vs base 31.8; GSM8K 74.3 vs 74.6) while CAST collapses to 1.4/0.4
Section 5.2, Table 3: ALTSTEER's Leakage Rate on Llama-3.1 is 18.0% vs 8.6% base, yet Safe Alt. is highest at 61.1%
Appendix C.2, Table 11: GPT-4o judge matches human majority at 99.0% agreement (Refusal) and 91.3% (Alternative); leakage judge Cohen's kappa 0.943
Section 5.3, Table 5: all-layer gate precision 0.959 (Llama-3.1) and 0.989 (Qwen2.5); single-layer gate brittle on Qwen2.5 (accuracy 39.4%)
Appendix F, Table 16: Constant/Reverse/Hard-switch schedules reduce RAR; Response-aware (97.0 MI RAR) slightly outperforms the proposed staged schedule (96.0)
Appendix G, Table 18: two-stage post-refusal prompting reaches higher RAR (e.g., 89.8 AdvBench) but needs 1.614 model calls vs 1.000 for ALTSTEER
Appendix H, Table 19: Mistral-7B transfer shows marginal RAR gains and utility degradation (MATH 9.8 to 7.4; XSTest 99.2 to 95.6)
Limitations section: leakage is mitigated not eliminated; alternative vector quality depends on base model's represented safe-completion behavior
Section 5.1: implementation specifies greedy decoding, T=512, layer 13/14 intervention, lambda strengths 1.5/1.0 (Llama) and 5.0/3.0 (Qwen); no code release mentioned
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical fit: an LLM activation-steering method for safety alignment, squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Alignment, Interpretability, safety evaluation); no out-of-scope cap applies. Novelty is moderate: components (difference-in-means refusal direction, orthogonalization, conditional steering) are established (Arditi et al. 2024; CAST; AdaSteer), but the refusal-relevant all-layer zero-threshold gate, orthogonalized alternative vector from explained-vs-simple refusal pairs, and staged step-dependent schedule are a new combination, supported by useful diagnostics (Sec. 3 gating instability, template refusal rates). Rigor is solid: four steering baselines, four harmful and four utility benchmarks, gating/component/schedule/threshold/prompt ablations, human validation of the GPT-4o judge (Appendix C.2), and an honest two-stage prompting comparison; weaknesses include greedy single-run decoding without variance, per-model hyperparameters swept on the same harmful benchmarks (Table 7), and an ad hoc template-refusal metric. Evidence is quantitative and transparently reports unfavorable results (higher 18.0% leakage vs 8.6% base on Llama-3.1, Table 3; response-aware schedule slightly beats theirs, Table 16; SafeSwitch wins Safe Alt on Qwen2.5, 90.5 vs 83.1). Generalizability is limited: two main 7-8B models plus preliminary transfer where Mistral-7B shows marginal gains and utility degradation (Table 19), white-box-only applicability, English-only data, and self-acknowledged dependence on the base model's latent safe-completion behavior (Limitations). Reproducibility is decent: layers, strengths, schedules, judge prompts, and dataset construction are specified, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives

papers.summary: Safety alignment is essential for deploying large language models, requiring systems to prevent harmful compliance while preserving helpfulness on benign requests. Activation steering offers a training-free inference-time approach to safety control, but effective safety steering requires addressing two coupled questions: when to intervene and how generation should be shaped after intervention. However, existing safety steering methods remain limited along both dimensions, as their triggering mec
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的安全對齊長期以「生硬拒絕」為核心，有害請求常以簡短、樣板化的拒絕收場，削弱使用者效用。既有活化導引（activation steering）方法存在兩大缺陷：門控訊號跨領域不穩定，容易在數學推理等良性輸入上誤觸干預；即使正確觸發，拒絕導向的導引也多半停留在僵化拒絕，而非建設性的安全回應。為此，本文提出 ALTSTEER，一個在單次推論內完成的安全導引框架。它以輸入表徵與模型內部「拒絕方向」跨所有層平均的餘弦相似度為門控訊號，以零為無參數門檻決定是否介入，避免對良性輸入的不必要干預；啟動後同時施加拒絕向量與正交化後的替代向量，並採分階段強度排程——解碼前期錨定拒絕，後期逐步轉向解釋性、建設性的安全替代方案。在 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 與 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上的實驗顯示，於 BeaverTails、AdvBench、MaliciousInstruct、JailbreakBench 等有害基準中，ALTSTEER 大幅提升「拒絕且提供替代」率（RAR），Llama-3.1 的安全替代率從 22.4% 升至 61.1%；同時在 XSTest、AlpacaEval、MATH500、GSM8K 上幾乎不損良性效用，明顯優於 CAST、AdaSteer、SafeSwitch、SAFESTEER 等方法。限制包括：成效依賴參考向量的品質、無法完全消除替代內容的安全洩漏，且允許多次呼叫的後處理改寫管線可達更高的絕對回應品質。整體而言，此研究把推論時安全控制從「要不要拒絕」推進到「如何安全地提供幫助」，兼具安全性與部署實用性。
papers.title: ALTSTEER: Selective Safety Steering for Moving Beyond Hard Refusals to Constructive Alternatives
papers.title_zh: ALTSTEER：選擇性安全導引，從生硬拒絕邁向建設性替代方案

links.title: LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'On the 4–8B models, LaMoC achieves an average 2.5% reduction in perplexity and a 1% relative improvement in task accuracy over state-of-the-art modular compression methods.'

Section 4.1: 'The relative reduction in PPL compared to MoDeGPT reaches an average of 2.46% for a relative reduction range of 0.79% – 6.79%' with Tables 1-2 reporting WikiText-2 PPL across Llama-3.1-8B, Ministral-8B, Qwen3-4B/8B, Llama-3.2-1B/3B at 20-50% compression.

Section 3.3 Statistical Validation: 'we observe Pearson correlation reaches 0.91±0.28' between the fixed-reference-gradient first-order proxy and true cross-entropy change for Llama-3.2-1B layers (Figure 3).
Table 4: Win/tie/loss counts show Fixed γ=0.75 at +0.41±1.07 pp and Adaptive γ* at +0.40±1.11 pp mean task accuracy improvement over MoDeGPT, indicating marginal effect sizes.
Table 10: Repeated Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 evaluations under 3 calibration seeds show 0-shot accuracy improvement holds at +0.76±0.26 pp and PPL at 11.99±0.06 vs 12.29±0.01 baseline.
Section 4.3 Calibration Data (Table 5): with Alpaca calibration, 'Adaptive γ* wins on all 6 downstream tasks with average accuracy improvement of +0.86±0.84 pp.'
Table 11 (Sec. 4.4): end-to-end latency at 20% compression via torch.compile shows 1.1× speedup for Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen3-4B (prefill 341.1→278.9 ms).
Table 9 (Sec. 4.3 Scalability): Qwen2.5-32B at 20%/40% shows Adaptive γ* improving 0-shot average over UniQL by +1.42/+1.25 pp (avg +1.34 pp).
Appendix C.7 Table 25: LaMoC compression wall time ~3h10m vs ~2.5h for canonical MoDeGPT on Llama-3.1-8B, documenting compute overhead.

Limitations: 'Our method has been tested and evaluated for models ranging from 1B to 33B... broader experimental validation at or beyond the ≥30B parameter tier of models remains needed' and architectures like MoE/state-space models are untested; no code release is mentioned anywhere in the paper.

Appendix B Table 12: positioning against OBD, OBS, WoodFisher, LLM Surgeon, FWSVD shows the method's components (Fisher weighting, activation-aware reconstruction) build on established prior work, with the module-level blending formulation as the stated distinction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methods paper on training-free loss-aware modular compression of LLMs (Llama-3, Qwen3, Ministral, EXAONE; 1B-33B), squarely within high-weight LLM and efficiency topics; not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate: Fisher/Hessian-aware pruning and Fisher-weighted low-rank reconstruction are well established (OBD, WoodFisher, FWSVD per Appendix B, Table 12), and the contribution is a module-level blending of Fisher-weighted and activation Grams with a two-tiered objective and heuristic gamma selection (Sec. 3.1-3.3) - an incremental but genuine combination. Rigor is solid: the first-order proxy is validated statistically (Pearson 0.91±0.28, Sec. 3.3, though variance is large), and there are extensive ablations (calibration data, EF vs GGN, trace rescaling, gamma granularity, reference vs exact gradients, oracle comparison, Tables 5-8, 15, 22-24) plus 3-seed repetition (Table 10). Evidence is credible for perplexity: average 2.46% relative PPL reduction over MoDeGPT across 8 models and 20-50% rates (Sec. 4.1, Tables 1-2); task gains are small and partly within noise (Table 4: +0.41±1.07 pp fixed, +0.40±1.11 pp adaptive), honestly reported. Latency (1.1x, Table 11) and compression-time overhead (~3h10m vs ~2.5h, Table 25) are measured. Generalizability is decent within standard transformer decoders but the authors note validation gaps for MoE/SSM/hybrid architectures and >33B (Limitations). Reproducibility is helped by detailed setups (128 calibration samples, seq 2048, hardware, tensor shapes in Table 20) but no code release is stated. Overall a careful, incremental efficiency contribution with consistent but modest gains.

primary_link.title: LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs

papers.summary: Modular compression has enabled considerable parameter reduction in LLMs while preserving strong language understanding and downstream task accuracy. However, existing joint modular compression methods primarily rely on activation statistics, leaving loss-sensitivity information and its module-level characterization underexplored. We investigate addressing this gap with LaMoC, a loss-aware modular compression methodology that blends activation and Empirical Fisher statistics through gradient-err
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）的免訓練模組化壓縮。現有聯合模組化壓縮方法（如 MoDeGPT、UniQL）主要依賴激活統計量，較少利用損失敏感度資訊，作者提出 LaMoC：透過梯度誤差對齊，將激活 Gram 統計量與 Empirical Fisher 統計量混合，並表述為兩層最佳化問題，在最小化模組重構誤差的同時，為每個模組選出激活與梯度加權統計量之間的混合率 γ。方法上，以一階損失近似與參考梯度快速估計壓縮後的交叉熵變化，並以統計驗證（Pearson 相關約 0.91）支持此代理指標，另提供固定與自適應兩種 γ 選擇策略。實驗涵蓋四個模型家族共八個模型（1B 至 33B），顯示在 4–8B 模型上，LaMoC 相較最先進模組化壓縮平均降低 2.5% 困惑度，並提升約 1% 相對任務準確率；較小模型受益更大，高壓縮率下增益更明顯，20% 壓縮時仍保有約 1.1 倍推論加速，且可擴展至 Qwen2.5-32B 與 EXAONE 4.5-33B。限制方面，方法源自經驗觀察，γ 的理論最佳解仍待推導，實測規模約至 33B，對混合架構、狀態空間模型、Mixture of Experts 等新興架構及長上下文、代理式任務尚需更多評估。此研究的價值在於證明激活感知、損失曲率、非均勻截斷與模組化四項技術可以疊加，無需 fine-tuning 即可進一步改善壓縮品質，且方法具通用性，對資源受限環境下的 LLM 部署深具意義。
papers.title: LaMoC: Loss-Aware Modular Compression for LLMs
papers.title_zh: LaMoC：大型語言模型的損失感知模組化壓縮

llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM benchmarking/evaluation paper (ScienceArena) squarely matching high-weight preferences: LLMs, multi-step scientific reasoning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and prompting protocols. Strengths: expert (olympiad-medalist) calibrated judge system, controlled modality ablation with bootstrap CIs, cross-family judge study, stability repeats, and unusually honest contamination/release-date caveats. Novelty is moderate: the olympiad-benchmark space is crowded (OlympiadBench, MathArena, HiPhO) and the paper itself positions the work as a cross-science extension with rubric-faithful scoring rather than a new methodology; interleaved prompting is explicitly not claimed as new. Its open-ended, multi-step problems use process-credit rubrics, making faithful scoring difficult. We build ScienceArena through an expert-audited digitization pipeline th
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 ScienceArena,一套以奧林匹亞科學競賽為本的評測基準,回應現有基準飽和與資料汙染的困境;選擇題與簡答題格式無法檢驗長篇推導、圖表解讀、多步驟一致性與依評分標準給部分分數等真實科學解題能力。研究團隊蒐集十三項公開競賽,涵蓋物理、化學、生物(如 IPhO 與 IChO 2025–2026、IBO 2023、USAPhO 2026、USNCO 2025),以五階段數位化流程將官方試題、圖片、解答與評分規則轉為結構化 JSON,並由奧林匹亞獎牌得主逐題審核。為降低人工評分成本,他們以獎牌得分的真人評分為校準錨點建立 LLM-as-judge 系統,兩個評審模型與專家總分差距在一分以內。主實驗採用交錯式(interleaved)提示讓模型逐子題作答,十六組比較全數勝過一次性解題;評測十四個近期模型後,Gemini 3.1 Pro 整體最強,在 IPhO 2025 達 29.45/30、超越人類冠軍參考分數,生物項目接近飽和,但 IChO 仍低於人類最高分。診斷指出化學受結構與立體化學保真度拖累(立體化學僅 34.7%),物理敗在全域物理模型掌控與圖形對應,生物則敗於多敘述資料一致性。限制包括僅評理論試題、專家校準僅涵蓋 IPhO/IChO、多數模型發布晚於賽事而無法排除訓練資料汙染疑慮,子領域分類亦由模型輔助。此基準提供可重現、貼近官方評分規則的科學推理評測框架,並系統性揭露模型持續性弱點。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-preference: an LLM coding-agent benchmark (Agents 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code 2.0) with rigorous causal task construction. DepBench's four-state oracle (Definition 1, Sec III-D) that certifies upgrade-causality, repair necessity, and sufficiency is a genuine methodological increment over SWE-bench/BUMP/BeyondSWE, though it is an incremental refinement within a crowded repository-benchmark space. Evaluation is controlled (containerized Harbor, hidden tests, blocked PR pages, Sec IV-A) and failure analysis is unusually careful (dual annotation with adjudication of 172 disagreements, Sec IV-D). Main deductions: only three proprietary frontier models, no repeated-run variance or significance testing, small Python slice (10 tasks), Dependabot/Renovate selection bias and public-PR leakage acknowledged in Sec VI, and no explicit public release URL for the benchmark artifacts itself. Solid, credible benchmark paper that does not overclaim.

primary_link.title: Update from Hell: Can Coding Agents Survive Hidden Breakage in Dependency Upgrades?

papers.summary: Modern software systems rely heavily on third-party dependencies, but upgrading those dependencies remains a costly maintenance activity. Dependency upgrades do not always preserve the function signatures, type systems, APIs, or runtime semantics assumed by existing code. Consequently, developers often need to perform source code adaptations to accommodate dependency-induced changes. However, such code-level changes are often not explicitly communicated to project maintainers, posing a significa
papers.summary_zh: 現代軟體大量重用第三方依賴,但升級依賴常破壞函式簽名、型別、API 或執行期語意,需要額外的原始碼修補,而編碼代理能否勝任此類修復長期缺乏嚴謹評估。本文提出 DepBench,一個可執行的儲存庫級基準:從 Dependabot、Renovate 等依賴更新機器人的合併 pull request 出發,先以補丁分解將依賴清單變更、開發者修復與保留測試拆開,再以四態 oracle 確認因果性——基底狀態須可正常建置、僅升級加測試必須失敗、升級加修復必須成功、僅修復不加升級仍須失敗——並輔以人工與 LLM 稽核,最終釋出橫跨 npm/yarn、Maven/Java、Go、Cargo、Python 五大生態系的 203 個乾淨任務。評估顯示,最強組態 Codex 搭配 GPT-5.5 也僅解出 104/203(51.2%),成效隨模型、harness 與生態系劇烈變動:Maven 較易,npm/yarn 與 Cargo 最難;多數保留測試確實編碼升級後的具體行為。最常見的失敗根因是「不完整遷移」:代理常找對升級介面,卻未能將新契約傳播到包裝器、型別、測試夾具與行為輸出,個案研究(如 GitLab client 的 int→int64 型別傳播、Gremlin 數值溢位語意變更)具體印證此點。限制包括以測試為 oracle 的假設、僅取樣機器人 PR 的選擇偏差,以及公開 PR 可能已見於預訓練資料的解法洩漏風險。此基準清楚揭露現行編碼代理與真實軟體維護需求間的落差,對代理設計與基準建構皆具指標意義。

evidence: Appendix B.4, Table B.4: five candidate LLMs (Qwen3.5 Plus, GPT-5 Mini, Gemini 3 Pro, Kimi K2.5, DeepSeek V3.2) compared under identical prompts; Qwen3.5 Plus selected with Pearson 0.720/cosine 0.725 vs GPT-5 Mini 0.566/0.575.
Section 2.1 and Table 1: 300 reusable Household Agents, one control arm and twelve tariff-treatment arms organized into six controlled communication dimensions with within-agent counterfactual reuse.
Appendix C.1, Fig. C.1 and Table C.1: calibrated CvM medians 0.18-0.33 below the 0.451 critical value across eight months; uncalibrated 0.81-1.22; sensitivity over gamma in [0.55,0.85].
Appendix C.2, Fig. C.2: calibrated AUCs 0.50-0.70 for LR/RF/GBC/FNN vs uncalibrated gradient boosting generally above 0.90, with train/validation/test splits and training-set-only normalization.
Appendix C.3, Table C.2: Democrat coefficient 4.352-4.427 (calibrated) vs 3.459-6.508 (human) with equality p-values 0.145-0.913; persona-only 0.272-0.353 shows under-polarization.
Section 6, Table 5: explicit evidence/claim hierarchy assigning T1 direct validation, T2-T9 cautious near-generalization, and T10-T12 plus C1-C5 exploratory status.
Appendix B.3, Table B.1 and Figs. B.1-B.2: full parameter table with sensitivity checks for SMIM share alpha in {0.10,0.50,0.90} and memory windows w in {3,10,17}.

Section 5 and Fig. 7: central-bank strategies C1-C5 after T11; only C4 (look-through) yields negative DTEs while all five reduce belief dispersion, explicitly framed as hypothesis generation, not policy recommendation.

Reproducibility notes: verbatim Trump/FOMC agent prompts and all treatment texts in Appendices A.1-A.2 and F.1; full dictionaries in Table E.1; however, Qwen3.5 Plus is a proprietary endpoint (App. B.4 footnote) and Section 6 states machine-readable logs should only 'additionally' be preserved by future implementations.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM multi-agent simulation paper whose methodology (persistent persona agents, memory, recommender-mediated social information, foundation-model selection) is squarely in scope for LLM/agent preferences, though it does not touch top-weighted topics like reasoning/CoT, Japanese LLM, or alignment. Novelty is moderate: persona-based LLM respondents build on Argyle/Horton/Park, but the 18-month dynamic panel with within-agent counterfactuals, endogenous agent-generated posts, and a tiered validation hierarchy is a genuine increment. Rigor is high: formal DTE/DiD specification, repeated-subsample CvM tests with gamma sensitivity, four-classifier discrimination with proper splits, coefficient-equality heterogeneity tests, blinded dual coding with kappa thresholds, and an unusually careful Lipschitz-style transport-bias argument (App. C.4). Evidence strongly supports calibration claims (CvM 0.18-0.33 vs critical 0.451; calibrated AUC 0.50-0.70 vs uncalibrated GBC >0.90; recovered partisan/income/gender gradients) while all treatment-effect rankings and the central-bank experiment are simulation-only and correctly labeled exploratory. Generalizability is bounded by design (single model endpoint, single population, validity claimed only near T1); reproducibility benefits from verbatim prompts, full treatment texts, dictionaries, and parameter tables, but rests on a proprietary Qwen3.5 Plus endpoint with no explicit code/log release.

primary_link.title: Tariff Threats, Macroeconomic Expectations, and Policy Communication Strategies: Experiments Based on a Multi-Agent System

papers.summary: Tariff threats can move household beliefs before policy is enacted, yet their rapidly changing language is difficult to study with conventional surveys. We build a multi-agent system that turns 300 households from the Michigan Surveys of Consumers into persistent large-language-model agents exposed to social-media information over several simulated months. Calibrated agents reproduce some distributional and demographic patterns in human survey data collected after the announcement of Liberation
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對關稅威脅在政策落地前如何改變家戶信念的問題,建構一套以大型語言模型為核心的多代理人系統(MAS)。作者將密西根消費者調查(MSC)中300戶家庭的真實人口特徵與初始預期,轉化為具備滾動記憶、社群媒體資訊模組與貝氏更新機制的「家戶代理人」,並讓其彼此發文、形成內生資訊流,模擬18個月的動態問卷面板;基準情境T1(立即實施10%普遍關稅)以Cramér–von Mises檢定、機器學習判別與異質性迴歸,對齊2025年4月至11月的真人調查,校準後的分佈形狀與黨派、所得、性別差異方向大致吻合。十二組對照實驗顯示:立即實施、明確的高稅率、語義漸進升溫與極簡措辭會放大平均預期調整;時點或稅率不明、過簡或過繁措辭、漸進序列則擴大信念離散;同一訊息若歸於民主黨領袖反而引發更大反應與分歧。開放式回覆與因果框架編碼把上述排序連結到注意力、模糊性、可信度與外推等機制。第二項實驗在T11後測試五種聯準會溝通策略,僅「看穿式」(視關稅為暫時相對價格衝擊)能壓低點預期,但所有訊息皆能降低信念離散。作者強調結果僅限於近基準的定性外推,遠端情境屬探索性假說,須以真人實驗驗證,不能取代調查或結構模型;其價值在於低成本篩選政策溝通方案、生成可檢驗的機制假說,並區分「移動平均預期」與「協調信念」兩種不同的政策目標。

links.title: Enhancing Low-Resource Language Reasoning via High-Resource Language Feature Transfer

evidence: Table 1 (Section 4): Gemma-2-9B EN->KO MATH500 accuracy 49.20->52.41 against EN ceiling 56.91 (+42% recovery), but recoveries span +2% (MMLU-ProX TH) to +69% (Qwen ES MGSM VI), inconsistent with the abstract's 'recovers 25-33% of the gap across all four (reference, benchmark) settings'.

Section 5.1 and Table 2: specificity and necessity controls - top-k feature steering, size-matched random steering, negative steering vector all underperform the contrastive set, and suppressing C_EN->a during English inference drops accuracy from 56.91 to 46.62-55.16.

Section 5.2 and Table 3: 25 of 28 selected features activate in both English and Korean (e.g., feature 13089 peaks 63.6 on EN 'needs/needed' vs 28.0 on KO), supporting the under-elicitation hypothesis.

Appendix B (Table 4): GlotLID shows steering preserves target-language output, changing per-segment target-language proportion by <1.5 points in 37/40 settings, ruling out language-switching as the accuracy source.
Appendix C (Table 5) and Appendix D (Table 6): layer sweep on MGSM shows gains at all tested layers with layer 20 strongest, and SAE-based steering beats CAA in 11 of 12 settings.

Section 3.2 and Appendix A: the intervention defines alpha>0 as steering strength but no alpha value, feature counts per setting, or code URL is reported anywhere in the document; Limitations section admits single-layer-20 SAE basis and reliance on benchmark correctness signals for feature discovery.

Appendix E (Tables 7-8): pair-specific steering transfers partially to unseen targets (BN 75.6->81.2, TE 74.4->75.6), with reused EN->KO/EN->TH feature sets also improving over baseline but remaining weaker than target-specific extraction.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely matching high-weight preferences: LLMs (Gemma-2-9B-it, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), reasoning/CoT, and mechanistic interpretability via SAEs, with an inference-time residual-steering intervention to close cross-lingual reasoning gaps (Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Swahili). The contrastive selection of features from paired reference-correct/target-incorrect traces is a genuinely new angle within an otherwise established SAE-steering toolbox, so novelty is moderate. Rigor is above average: a well-designed control battery (top-k, random, negative-vector steering, source-side HRL ablation), layer sweep (4/12/20/34/38), CAA comparison (wins 11/12), GlotLID language-consistency check, and unseen-language transfer (Bengali/Telugu). Evidence is weakened by absent significance testing/CIs, feature discovery performed on the evaluation benchmark itself (acknowledged correctness-signal leakage, no held-out split), and an abstract/conclusion claim of '25-33% gap closure' that does not match the reported per-setting recovery range of +2% to +69% in Table 1. Generalizability is bounded to two 7-9B models, one SAE layer, and mostly math benchmarks, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is hampered by a missing steering-strength alpha value and no stated code release, though SAEs, benchmarks, and software versions are public.

primary_link.title: Enhancing Low-Resource Language Reasoning via High-Resource Language Feature Transfer

papers.summary: Large language models exhibit substantial performance variation across languages, even when solving semantically equivalent tasks. Existing analyses often treat this phenomenon as an observational disparity caused by differences in pretraining data, tokenization, or benchmark coverage. We study a complementary hypothesis: high-resource languages (HRLs) may more reliably elicit latent computations useful for task-specific (i.e. mathematical) reasoning, while lower-resource languages (LRLs) may un
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型的推理表現在不同語言間落差顯著:同一道數學題以英文提問常能解出,換成泰語、韓語、越南語或史瓦希里語往往失敗。本文假設:此落差不只是預訓練資料分佈不均,更反映高資源語言較能可靠激發任務所需的潛在計算,低資源語言雖表達相同問題卻活化不足。作者以稀疏自動編碼器(SAE)解析殘差流激活,從「參考語言答對、目標語言答錯」的配對對比集中,以集合差異與排序區間過濾選出與成功推理相關的稀疏特徵,再依兩種語言成功軌跡的平均激活差建構引導向量,於第 20 層殘差流注入,且僅作用於生成 token。在 Gemma-2-9B-it 與 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 上,於 MATH500、MGSM 與 MMLU-ProX 心理學子集,以英文或西班牙文為參考語言,此方法使目標語言縮小 25% 至 33% 的落差,且無需參數更新、翻譯,也不改變輸出語言。部分充分性、功能性必要性與特異性三項測試,加上隨機與 top-k 對照,支持所選特徵確實參與落差機制;特徵分析顯示多數編碼數量、等式等跨語言共通的推理概念,且在低資源語言中激活較弱,呼應「激發不足而非能力缺失」的詮釋。限制包括僅測試兩個模型與三個基準、依賴預訓練 SAE 品質與單一層選擇、特徵篩選使用基準正確性訊號,跨任務遷移與極低資源語言尚待驗證。整體而言,此研究將部分跨語言落差詮釋為機制激發問題,提供翻譯與訓練式方法之外、因果可檢驗的特徵層級介入途徑。

links.title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation

evidence: Section 4.1 / Table 1: Single Judge achieves best average human alignment (RMSE 0.644 Korean Essay, 0.682 SummEval; Spearman 0.504/0.458) vs Consensus-based MAD (RMSE 0.935/0.813; Spearman 0.424/0.409), averaged over six judge models.

Appendix F Table 7: paired-bootstrap tests (10,000 resamples) report p<0.0001 for Single Judge vs Consensus-based MAD and Single Judge vs Strict Role Judge on both tasks, while noting non-significant model-level exceptions (e.g., Gemma3-27B Korean Essay p=0.85) and non-significant strict-role effects on Spearman (p=0.54/0.21).

Appendix E Table 6: per-model results show Qwen3.5-27B Symmetric MAD outperforms Single Judge on both tasks (Essay RMSE 0.864 vs 0.938; SummEval 0.734 vs 0.799), and the text states the aggregate ordering 'reflects a dominant trend rather than a universal rule'.

Appendix G Table 9 (Dominance Analysis): Consensus-based MAD mean score shift is -0.589 (Korean Essay) and -0.454 (SummEval) versus -0.334/-0.335 arithmetic midpoints of Strict-only and Lenient-only shifts, supporting the strict-stance dominance claim beyond simple averaging.

Appendix D Table 5: Score-Masked MAD worsens average RMSE (Korean Essay 0.935 to 1.040; SummEval 0.813 to 0.994) and widens final inter-agent gap (0.176 to 0.385; 0.076 to 0.224), supporting score sharing as coordination signal rather than sole anchoring source.

Limitations section: only one role configuration (strict-lenient), fixed five rounds, unweighted averaging, two domains, and acknowledged SummEval single-judge prompt asymmetry ('strict and consistent evaluator') left unquantified.

Appendix A/B/C: full bilingual system prompts for all conditions, sampling seed 42, dataset sources (NIKL Grading Writing Data 2024; mteb/summeval on HuggingFace), six OpenRouter model identifiers, and temperature 0 are provided; no code repository or release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-evaluation methodology paper on LLM-as-judge and multi-agent debate (MAD), directly matching the LLM, agents, and evaluation preferences; it is not pure CV/robotics/domain application. It delivers a credible negative result: a single judge beats consensus MAD on subjective rubric scoring, with ablations attributing the degradation to asymmetric strict-role prompting rather than interaction or score anchoring. Novelty is moderate-to-good: LLM judge biases are well documented, but the strict-stance dominance finding (consensus shift exceeding the strict/lenient midpoint) and the demonstration that consensus can enforce artificial agreement are fresh contributions. Rigor is solid: controlled ablations (Strict-only, Symmetric MAD, Score-Masked MAD), six judge models across three families, cross-model role swapping, round-wise trajectory analysis, and paired-bootstrap tests; weaknesses include only one role configuration, fixed five rounds, unweighted averaging, a prompt asymmetry between the two single-judge baselines ('strict and consistent evaluator' only in SummEval) that is acknowledged but unquantified, and per-model exceptions (Qwen3.5-27B and partially Gemma3-27B favor Symmetric MAD) that show the aggregate claim is not universal. Evidence is concrete and transparent (specific RMSE/Spearman tables, p<0.0001 for key comparisons, dominance analysis, honest counterexamples), though single-run temperature-0 inference and no CIs for most cells temper strength. Generalizability is limited to two tasks/domains and one role pair; reproducibility benefits from fully published bilingual prompts, seeds, dataset sources, and OpenRouter identifiers, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Beyond Consensus: Downward Bias and Role Asymmetry in Multi-Agent LLM Judges for Subjective Evaluation

papers.summary: Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) has been widely adopted to improve LLM-based evaluation by prompting multiple agents to negotiate and reach a consensus. However, for subjective rubric-based scoring, inter-agent agreement does not guarantee alignment with human judgments. In this paper, we compare a single-judge baseline against a consensus-based MAD protocol on subjective evaluation tasks and design three ablations to isolate the impact of role prompting, multi-round interaction, and explicit score sha
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討以共識為基礎的多代理辯論（Multi-Agent Debate, MAD）在主觀評分上能否提升與人類判斷的一致性。作者比較單一評審基線與由「嚴格」與「寬鬆」評審組成的共識式 MAD，並以三項消融實驗隔離角色提示、多輪互動與分數分享的影響；實驗涵蓋韓國作文評分與 SummEval 摘要評估兩個資料集，採用 GPT-4o-mini、Gemma-3 與 Qwen3.5 等六個模型擔任評審，以 RMSE 與 Spearman 相關係數衡量與人類參考分數的對齊程度。結果顯示，單一評審基線在兩項任務上的平均對齊最佳；共識式 MAD 反而使 RMSE 上升、排序一致性下降。消融分析指出，退化主要源於不對稱的角色提示而非互動本身：嚴格角色引入系統性向下偏誤，且共識分數遠低於獨立嚴格與寬鬆條件的中點，顯示嚴格立場主導辯論，無法靠平均抵銷。移除角色不對稱的 Symmetric MAD 大致恢復基線水準；遮蔽分數則擴大代理間分歧並使對齊更差，顯示分數分享較接近協調訊號而非錨定偏誤來源；跨模型互換角色也無法消除此模式。作者坦承研究採自訂精簡協定、單一角色配置、固定輪數且僅涵蓋兩個領域，推廣性仍待驗證。整體而言，多代理共識可能犧牲真正的人類對齊來換取人工共識，角色設計是主觀評分中 MAD 的關鍵結構性限制，值得評審系統開發者警惕。

links.title: VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs

evidence: Section 3.2: Visual Evidence gates context compatibility with logit-lens evidence mass; Visual Reliance is an image-vs-generated-prefix support ratio using input-embedding similarity for prefix tokens
Table 1 (Section 4): VisER average MSCOCO AUROC 84.89 across LLaVA-1.5-7B/NeXT/InstructBLIP/MiniGPT-4, +3.63 over GLSim; best AUROC on all four models
Table 2: extended models (LLaVA-1.5-13B, InternVL3, Shikra, Qwen2.5-VL) show best average AUROC 81.66, +4.24 over PAS
Figure 3(b) (Section 4.3): VR alone 78.22, VE alone 83.88, combined 85.66 AUROC at alpha=0.4 on LLaVA-1.5-7B, supporting complementarity
Table 5 (Section 4.3): blank-image and patch-shuffle interventions reduce VE/VisER; prefix removal drops VR to 50.00 AUROC, supporting source attribution
Table 3 (Section 4.2): vs POPE on 3000-image MSCOCO subset with 1000 balanced resamples, ACC 78.67 vs 67.77 and F1(F) 79.42 vs 54.75 for LLaVA-1.5-7B
Appendix B Table 6: per-model layers, K, alpha fixed; tau calibrated on a disjoint 100-image split, but selection procedure for alpha/layers is not documented
Section 4 footnote 1: code publicly available at https://github.com/AfsanehEB/VisER
Limitations: restricted to object-existence hallucination on COCO/VOC-style categories, requires white-box access to internal representations, multi-token object sensitivity
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal-LLM reliability work, not pure CV: VisER detects object hallucinations in LVLMs using language-model internals (logit lens over the unembedding matrix, hidden-state similarities), matching Multimodal AI, hallucination/factuality, and Interpretability preferences. Novelty is moderate: the source-confounding framing is a useful lens, but the components assemble existing signals (Internal Confidence's logit-lens probabilities, GLSim's context-compatibility term, and an image-vs-prefix contrast related to PAS), with the prefix support proxied by raw input-embedding similarity (Section 3.2). Rigor is solid: 8 LVLMs, 2 benchmarks, 6-7 tuned-to-fairness baselines, sensitivity analyses for K/alpha/layers, gating and component ablations, decoding-strategy robustness (Appendix D), and counterfactual interventions (Table 5) that support the claimed VE/VR interpretations; however, how per-model alpha and layer indices (Table 6) were selected is not stated, and only 500 sampled images are used for main results. Evidence strength is good with consistent but sometimes modest AUROC gains (e.g., 85.66 vs 84.59 on InstructBLIP MSCOCO, Table 1) and clear separation of grounded/hallucinated gate statistics (Table 10). Generalizability is limited to object-existence hallucination on COCO/VOC categories with white-box access, as candidly stated in Limitations. Reproducibility benefits from per-model hyperparameters, calibration protocol, baseline re-implementations (Appendix A), and a public code link (Section 4 footnote 1), though selection of fixed hyperparameters is underspecified.

primary_link.title: VisER: Visual Evidence and Reliance for Object Hallucination Detection in LVLMs

papers.summary: Object hallucination remains a persistent reliability issue in large vision-language models, where generated object mentions may sound plausible but lack visual grounding. Recent training-free detectors use internal signals such as token likelihood, attention, visual confidence, or image-text similarity to identify hallucinated objects. These signals are useful, but they are often source-confounded. They measure how strongly an object is supported inside the model without distinguishing whether
papers.summary_zh: 大型視覺語言模型（LVLM）在圖像描述時常產生「物件幻覺」，即提及影像中不存在的物件。現有免訓練偵測方法多依賴內部訊號，如 token 機率、注意力或影像文字相似度，但這些訊號存在「來源混淆」問題：難以區分支撐是來自物件特定的視覺證據，還是場景先驗或已生成的文字前綴。本文提出 VisER，一個免訓練的雙面物件級偵測指標：視覺證據（VE）透過對影像 token 施加 logit lens 取得物件特定證據，並以此閘控物件與情境的相容性；視覺依賴（VR）則比較影像衍生支撐與文字前綴支撐，避免前綴延續造成的誤判，最終分數由兩者線性組合。在 MSCOCO 與 Pascal VOC 上，涵蓋 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、InstructBLIP、MiniGPT-4、InternVL3、Qwen2.5-VL 等模型，VisER 的平均 AUROC 與 AUPR 均超越 Entropy、NLL、SVAR、PAS、GLSim 等基線，例如 MSCOCO 平均 AUROC 84.89，較最佳基線 GLSim 提升 3.63 點；對比 POPE 式逐物件提問驗證，準確率與幻覺 F1 皆更高且更省時。消融實驗顯示 VE 與 VR 互補，反事實介入（空白影像、patch 打亂、移除前綴）亦支持兩者分別對應影像證據與前綴依賴。限制在於僅針對物件存在性幻覺，未涵蓋屬性、關係與計數等細粒度錯誤，且需存取模型內部表示，較適合白箱或灰箱情境。整體而言，VisER 提供輕量、免參考的後驗幻覺偵測途徑，有助可靠的多模態生成與後續選擇性棄答或解碼介入。
