links.title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning

evidence: Abstract: 'trajectory geometry can identify critical turns ... increasing task success rates on τ-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%'
Sec 3.2: hidden states taken from 'a fixed intermediate probe layer (layer 22 for Qwen3-14B, layer 42 for Qwen3-32B, and layer 16 for Llama-3.1-8B)' with no layer ablation shown
Sec 4.3: 'Separability is significant for all pairings except the two Airline cases (14B p=0.30, 32B p=0.057)' — honest null results
Sec 4.4: turn alignment addresses the confound that 'a longer trajectory is mechanically more curved and accumulates more variance regardless of correctness'
Sec 4.1 Implementation Details: 'inference for LLMs using vLLM on 8 NVIDIA L40S GPUs and 4 H200 GPUs'; decoding follows official configurations
Sec 6: 'Each configuration is run over 5 trials per task'; threshold sweep '−0.15, −0.20, −0.25 give 0.388, 0.397, 0.363' on Retail/Qwen3-14B

Table 3: Never-think rewards 0.286/0.196/0.347/0.136 vs geometry-conditioned 0.397/0.392(curvature 0.384)/0.442/0.352 — headline mean uses best signal per setting; no significance tests reported for trigger-policy deltas
Sec 6 Applicability: notes limits — 'The threshold matches or beats the trained classifier' but 'A trained trigger is fitted to one model's failure distribution'; no code release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic paper: LLM agents on τ-Bench, multi-turn reasoning control, and hidden-state interpretability, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning, interpretability). Novelty is solid but incremental: hidden-state probing for error/hallucination detection is established (Sec 2.2, ICR Probe is closest prior); the contribution is extending trajectory analysis across turns and repurposing geometry as a training-free online trigger for thinking mode, plus an action-chain decomposition. Rigor is above average: the paper explicitly controls a trajectory-length confound via turn alignment (Sec 4.4), reports honest non-significant results (variance slope on Airline 14B p=0.30, 32B p=0.057), and compares against fixed, action-conditioned, and learned policies (Table 3). Evidence is moderate: headline gains (24.1%→39.6% reward, 11.2% token reduction) are averages over only 4 domain-model settings with 5 trials each, no confidence intervals, and the headline appears to average the best geometry signal per setting (temporal curvature on Retail, variance slope on Airline 14B), a mild selection concern; threshold τκ is swept with only a heuristic claim of transferability. Generalizability is plausible (3 models incl. Llama-3.1-8B, open-ended and tool-grounded tasks) but limited to two τ-Bench domains and one sharded-prompt framework, with acknowledged task-dependence of the signals. Reproducibility is moderate: models, probe layers, hardware, and benchmarks are specified, but no code/artifact release is stated in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning

papers.summary: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals
papers.summary_zh: LLM 代理人在多輪互動中,隨著脈絡持續累積,其內部對任務相關資訊的表示會逐漸漂移,難以區分建設性推理與有害的表示漂移;現有方法多仰賴規劃、反思與記憶等脈絡工程,而推論模型又使用固定的思考強度,無法依回合需求調整。本文將多輪推理形式化為底層 LLM 的隱藏狀態軌跡,以兩個互補的幾何訊號刻畫:時間曲率 κ 衡量相鄰回合位移向量的方向一致性;變異數斜率 β 衡量隱藏狀態分散度的擴張或收縮。隱藏狀態取自固定中間層,並以回合對齊排除軌跡長度的混淆。在 Math、Code、Airline、Retail 四項任務與 Qwen3-14B、Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.1-8B 三個模型上,失敗軌跡呈現顯著的方向反轉與過早收斂;將回合分解為 Read、Write、Respond、Transfer 組成的三動作鏈後,發現可分性取決於動作類型,資訊輸出型鏈(如 Respond×3)最具判別力。應用上,當曲率低於門檻時觸發思考模式,在 τ-Bench 上將平均成功率由 24.1% 提升至 39.6%,token 成本降低 11.2%,免訓練且優於或媲美學習式策略。限制方面,變異數斜率的可分性具任務依賴性,在 Airline 上未達統計顯著;門檻仍需一維掃描校正,且證據限於特定基準與模型規模。整體而言,本研究提供可解釋、免訓練的線上控制訊號,能即時偵測失敗徵兆並自適應分配推理資源,對長程代理系統的可靠部署具重要參考價值。
papers.title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
papers.title_zh: 分歧的幾何:追蹤隱藏狀態軌跡以實現自適應多輪推理

links.title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation

evidence: Abstract: NavMCP couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor; claims SOTA on HM-EQA, MT-HM3D, EXPRESS-Bench, +14.9 pp over episodic interface on HM-EQA, 78.3% success on Unitree Go2

Table 2 (Section 4.2): matched full-system comparison on HM-EQA with same Qwen3.5-397B-A17B agent, episodes, and budget; NavMCP 74.0±0.3 vs FAST-EQA reproduction 63.5±1.4 and ToolEQA reproduction 60.8±0.9

Table 4 (Section 4.4): protocol ablation with fixed agent/executor — episodic interface −14.9, terminal-only observation −5.9, w/o EQA context state −4.6, w/o journey analysis −4.4, single navigation mode −2.0

Section 4.1 and Appendix B: cross-paper Table 1 results are 'contextual only' and excluded from paired significance tests; results are mean±std over three runs with variation from hosted LLM API stochasticity

Appendix G: intent call schema, trajectory record and journey artifact schemas, journey-analysis and final-synthesis prompts, evidence ledger fields, and equivalent-step compensation (Eq. 4-5) that charges NFM rollouts only, not summarizer/perception calls
Section 5 Limitations and Table 6: reliance on a large VLM slows inference; counting is weakest at 65.0% due to cross-view duplication
Appendix F: Qwen3.6-Plus (256K context, hosted API) agent and hosted Qwen-RobotNav 8B executor on uncontrolled hardware; no code or checkpoint release stated
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM/VLM agent-methodology paper (agentic scaffolding, tool calling, persistent memory ledger, context compaction) instantiated on embodied EQA, not pure robotics, so it is in scope and strongly matches the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Reasoning, and Memory preferences. The three-channel intent/observation/memory design addressing an 'episodic interface gap' is a genuine but incremental system contribution over ReAct/ToolEQA/MemGPT-style prior work. Rigor is solid: matched full-system comparison (Table 2), two controlled capability sweeps (Table 3), and per-channel protocol ablations (Table 4), though only three runs, no significance testing, a self-defined step metric that omits summarizer/perception costs, and manually judged real-robot success. Headline SOTA claims partly rest on cross-paper numbers the authors themselves label contextual only; the matched-comparison and ablation evidence is the stronger support. Reproducibility is limited: extensive prompts, schemas, and hyperparameters in Appendices E-G, but no code release and dependence on proprietary hosted Qwen3.6-Plus/Qwen-RobotNav APIs.

primary_link.title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation

papers.summary: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an
papers.summary_zh: 長時程實體代理必須在遠距任務目標間持續推理，並將每個決策落實為可靠的閉迴路行為，但現今基礎模型各自只具備其一：視覺語言模型（VLM）擅長推論缺失資訊與調整高層規劃，卻難以穩定地反覆將決策轉為導航動作；導航基礎模型（NFM）能穩健執行語意目標，卻只會完成有界片段而缺乏持續的任務層級推理。本文提出NavMCP，一個代理式鷹架框架，以VLM作為推理代理、NFM作為執行器，並透過意圖、觀察、記憶三個通道銜接兩者：意圖通道將證據需求轉為語意導航呼叫，觀察通道把完整執行軌跡轉為具來源依據的旅程證據，記憶通道則跨呼叫累積已搜尋區域、負面證據與未解目標，全程不需重新訓練任何基礎模型。作者以具身問答（EQA）驗證此框架，在HM-EQA、MT-HM3D與EXPRESS-Bench三個基準上皆達到最先進表現；在相同代理與執行器條件下，較片段式工具介面高出14.9個百分點。於Unitree Go2實體機器人上更達78.3%成功率，且領先幅度隨任務時程拉長從10分擴大到45分。限制方面，系統依賴大型VLM，推論速度較慢，跨視角重複觀察也會影響計數準確性。此研究證明，將互補的基礎模型鷹架式整合為單一長時程代理，是邁向實體世界智慧代理的有效途徑。
papers.title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
papers.title_zh: 鷹架式整合基礎模型打造實體世界代理，推進長時程導航的疆界

links.title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 22.2% safety improvement over baselines and code availability at github.com/DecayingSeart/CREST

Sec 3.2/Table 1: EOS suppression analysis; Qwen3-8B guidance on Mathstral gives 99.2% EOS suppression, 61.3% burial, GSM8K accuracy 27.7%, with 84.8% of incorrect predictions containing the correct answer
Sec 5.2/Table 2: code insecure rate 0.18 (base) vs 0.14 (CREST) vs 0.17 (Nudging); math 0.92 to 0.96; medical 0.99 preserved; capability deltas at most 0.01
Sec 5.2: states 17.6% relative reduction over the strongest baseline and 22.2% over the base model, showing the abstract's 22.2% headline is vs base-only
Sec 5.1: capability comparison across methods is confounded by backend differences (CREST on HuggingFace generate, baselines on vLLM); base-HF HumanEval 0.228 vs CREST threshold=1.0 at 0.228

Appendix A.3, Tables 3-8: sensitivity to alpha_max, probe length, steered layers, intervention length, guidance model (Llama/Qwen/Gemma all improve over base), and threshold; fixed tau=0.2 collapses HumanEval to 0.05
Appendix A.4/Table 9: CREST 1.3x base latency vs BlendIn 2.8x and Nudging 7.0x; 57 MB alignment cache
Appendix A.5: judge-based scoring sensitivity; medical safety drops 0.99 to 0.96 under trimmed extraction with 24 apparent regressions analyzed (17 leading-clause truncations)
Limitations: setup requires domain-appropriate safe/unsafe prompts, three domains only, indirect capability comparison, and jailbreak robustness explicitly out of scope
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM safety/alignment paper: inference-time alignment of specialized LLMs via cross-family representation steering, touching LLMs, AI safety, alignment, interpretability (safety directions), and LLM-judge evaluation. The problem framing (complementary expertise orthogonality, stop-token interference/answer burial) is well-motivated and quantitatively demonstrated (Sec 3.2, Table 1: 99.2% EOS suppression and 61.3% burial with Qwen3 guidance on Mathstral). Method combines known components (activation steering, Procrustes cross-model mapping, probe-based detection) into a coherent new setting. Rigor is decent with extensive sensitivity analyses (App A.3 Tables 3-8), runtime analysis (App A.4), and an unusually honest judge-sensitivity study (App A.5), but effect sizes are small (code insecure rate 0.18 to 0.14 on n=351), no significance testing, the 'up to 22.2%' headline is versus the base model (17.6% vs strongest baseline, Sec 5.2), hyperparameters are tuned per domain, and capability comparison against token-level baselines is confounded by backend differences the authors themselves acknowledge (Sec 5.1, Limitations). Generalizability is supported across three domains and three guidance families (Table 7) but limited to 4B-9B models and requires domain-specific setup prompts. Reproducibility is aided by a public code link and detailed implementation settings.

primary_link.title: Beyond Token-Level Guidance: Inference-Time Alignment of Specialized LLMs via Cross-Family Representation Steering

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) finetuned for specialized domains represent crucial high-impact applications. Inference-time alignment improves safety degraded from specialization finetuning without requiring substantial computational resources, complementing finetuning-based methods with an easy-to-use, plug-and-play solution. However, existing inference-time methods fail to reliably improve safety without disrupting domain capability. We identify the root cause as complementary expertise orthogon
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討專業化 LLM 的安全對齊問題。模型經領域 fine-tuning 後獲得專業能力卻常犧牲安全對齊;現有 token 層級的推論時期對齊方法在此情境會出現結構性失敗:引導模型缺乏領域專業,其通用續寫偏好會壓制基礎模型的序列結束(EOS)訊號,迫使生成越過正確答案,造成「答案掩埋」(GSM8K 上 61.3% 樣本受影響);基於不確定性的觸發機制也無法攔截模型自信生成的有害內容。作者將根因歸納為「互補專業正交性」:基礎模型具備領域知識但失去安全對齊,引導模型反之。為此提出 CREST,直接在表徵空間運作:先以 Procrustes 對齊將引導模型的安全方向跨家族投影至基礎模型的隱藏表徵,再以探針式威脅偵測計算威脅分數,自適應決定引導強度,僅對少數頂層注入安全方向有限步數,因而保留 EOS 邊界與後續領域生成。實驗涵蓋程式、數學與醫療三領域,以跨家族的 Llama-3.1-8B 為引導模型:不安全率由 0.18 降至 0.14(相對改善 22.2%),數學安全率 0.92 升至 0.96,醫療拒答率維持 0.99;HumanEval 等三項能力基準差距 ≤0.01,延遲僅約 1.3 倍,明顯低於 BlendIn(2.8 倍)與 Nudging(7.0 倍)。限制包括需一次性的安全/不安全提示設定、偵測向量品質取決於領域、僅評估三個領域,且未涵蓋對抗性越獄攻擊。此方法以即插即用、免重訓的方式兼顧安全性與領域效能,對部署專業化模型深具實務價值。

links.title: Attesting Outputs and Delegation Ancestry in Multi-Agent AI Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'all 30 signed-DAG tasks passed complete verification, while a controlled child-key-only claim was rejected; its mean end-to-end latency was 813.1 ms versus 770.8 ms without evidence'
Abstract: 'ancestry-only checks take 24.3–499.2 μs per hop' on an Apple M1 Pro
Sec. I contributions: 'The primitives are standard; the contribution is deployer-side binding and the evidence needed for the two questions'
Sec. VI-B1 / Table VI: child-key compromise — Linked-List/Merkle accept binding to arbitrary parent, Signed-DAG rejects; both-endpoint collusion defeats all designs
Sec. VI-C: 'the current ancestry-only matrix covers three designs, five attack classes (B1–B5), and 1,000 trials per cell; all 15 cells rejected every trial (Wilson 95% upper bound 0.38% per cell)'
Sec. VI-D E11–AWS: 'three t3.small EC2 hosts in distinct availability zones... Issuance averaged 3.651 ms (4.384 ms at p95), and complete verification 5.015 ms (6.642 ms at p95)'
Table VII: Signed-DAG carries 2,096 bytes evidence, 228 bytes more than linked-list, with 11.6 ms child issuance and 16.7 ms complete verification
Sec. VII limitations: 'E12’s loopback services are separate deployer trust domains, not independent organizations... it does not measure public-network latency, TLS/mTLS, OAuth, KMS'
Sec. VIII: artifact 'including current sources, raw results, manifests, and regression commands, is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cscloud-artifacts-6342/'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong topical match to Agents & Tool Use (multi-agent delegation, MCP, A2A, local LLM) and secondary match to AI Safety (threat model, tamper-evidence). Rigor is notably high for a systems-security paper: explicit unified threat model and trust-boundary table (Sec. III), a formal edge-authorization game and proof (Sec. VI-B1), fixed 1,000-trial-per-cell adversary matrices with Wilson bounds, and multi-environment deployments (in-process, process, container, three-AZ AWS). Evidence is quantitative but conformance- and performance-oriented; the paper itself concedes the primitives are standard and the contribution is deployer-side binding plus parent co-signature, limiting novelty. Generalizability is constrained: loopback-only live workflow, single-host client timings, excluded endpoint collusion, open registries, and prompt-injection prevention (Sec. VII). Reproducibility is supported by an anonymous artifact with sources, raw results, and regression commands (Sec. VIII).

primary_link.title: Attesting Outputs and Delegation Ancestry in Multi-Agent AI Systems

papers.summary: Multi-agent applications delegate work across independently operated deployers. After an incident, a verifier must answer two questions: which deployer released the reported bytes, and whether each cross-deployer edge was authorized. Credentials establish who may act, but need not bind them to later output bytes or prove both deployers authorized a dynamically created edge. We present a two-layer attestation design for dynamic delegation without a shared authority, public log, or precommitted wo
papers.summary_zh: 多代理應用常跨越彼此獨立運作的部署方(deployer)委派任務;事故發生後,驗證者必須回答兩個問題:是哪個部署方釋出這些位元組?每條跨部署方的委派邊是否皆經授權?傳統憑證只記錄誰可行動,既未繫結後續輸出位元組,也無法證明雙方都同意動態建立的委派邊。本文提出兩層證明設計:第一層由受信任的部署方執行環境對每筆輸出雜湊並簽署;第二層為淵源證據,記錄每條委派邊的授權。作者在統一威脅模型下比較簽章鏈結串列、Merkle 鏈變體與共同簽署 DAG:前兩者在子部署方金鑰遭入侵後,仍允許攻擊者偽造任意父節點綁定;共同簽署 DAG 因要求父方也簽署完整邊清單而能拒絕。27,000 個固定變異樣本無一被誤接受。在 Apple M1 Pro 上,淵源驗證每跳約 24.3 至 499.2 微秒;含 MCP、A2A 與本地 LLM 的實測流程中,30 個 Signed-DAG 任務全數通過驗證,端對端平均延遲 813.1 毫秒,僅比無證據時多約 5.5%;三可用區 AWS 部署中 1,000 條有效路徑全數驗證成功,簽發平均 3.651 毫秒、完整驗證 5.015 毫秒(不含 TLS/mTLS、KMS 與模型服務延遲)。此設計不預防提示注入或代理遭入侵;註冊機制信任假設、端點共謀、金鑰輪替、跨驗證者重放與串流語意皆在範圍之外。其價值在於提供事後稽核與歸責的密碼學證據,為跨部署多代理系統奠定可驗證的問責基礎。

links.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving

evidence: §5.3: 'For KDA, TP-balanced placement reduces TTFT by 25.4–42.6% and improves input-token throughput by 39.3–68.4%'; channel-wise KDA achieves 2.63–28.04x compression across W_max=16–512.

§5.2 Table 3: at W_max=16 dasc 'exceeds the five-mask Random mean in all 15 reasoning comparisons, with seven remaining significant after Holm correction' on Kimi-KDA; Qwen-GDN shows 'mixed dasc–Random differences'.
§3.4 Table 1(b): median Hs–He Spearman correlation 0.801 (GDN) and 0.856 (KDA) over 1,152 and 640 prefix–layer comparisons, supporting weight-derived horizons as selection signal.
§5.2 Table 2: at W_max=1024 Kimi-KDA RULER average drops to 0.88 at 16k vs dense 0.95, with losses on MK1, MV, CWE, QA-S.

§6 Limitations: 'We evaluate hybrid architectures only; transfer to purely linear-attention or state-space models remains open. All serving experiments use TP8; scaling to larger TP degrees remains untested.'

Appendix C: full evaluation protocol with fixed seeds {42,123,7}, random-mask seeds {1234,2027,3407,4519,5683}, per-rank budget bytes, and 10,000-sample bootstrap with Holm adjustment; §5.1 states implementation in SGLang with TP8, but no public code link is given.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A systems paper on compressing recurrent state checkpoints in hybrid linear-attention LLM serving (Qwen3-Next/GDN, Kimi-Linear/KDA) within SGLang. Preference relevance is solid: it directly serves LLMs and matches Inference & Serving, Long Context & Memory, Scaling & Efficiency, and Transformer Architecture (linear attention/SSM/GDN), but misses the highest-weight agent, reasoning-methodology, and Japanese-NLP clusters, using reasoning benchmarks only as end-task evaluation. Novelty is moderate-to-good: weight-derived retention horizons as an input-independent selection signal, ragged state layout, and TP-balanced placement address a genuinely new axis (state-checkpoint representation) distinct from Marconi admission/eviction and ReplaySSM replay, though the serving-engineering components are incremental. Rigor is strong: controlled zero-state interventions (§3.2), Spearman validation with IQR (Table 1b), count-matched random-mask baselines, matched-HBM budgets, three seeds, bootstrap CIs with Holm correction (Appendix C, Table 5). Evidence is credible and honestly reported (Qwen-GDN shows mixed dasc-vs-Random results; dasc-wr replay cost quantified in Table 8), with headline 2.63x compression, 42.6% TTFT, and 68.4% throughput gains backed by §5.3/Figure 3; some quality deltas at W_max=1024 (Kimi RULER 0.88 vs 0.95) are non-trivial. Generalizability is limited to two hybrid models, TP8, Hopper GPUs, and untested purely-linear/SSM architectures (§6). Reproducibility is aided by unusually detailed protocols, seeds, and mask seeds, but no code repository URL is stated.

primary_link.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving

papers.summary: Hybrid linear-attention architectures have recently scaled to large open-weight models, offering quality competitive with full attention while substantially reducing key/value (KV) cache growth. However, their in-place recurrent-state updates complicate cache management: prefix reuse requires state checkpoints alongside full-attention KV, while storing state checkpoints in full increases memory pressure, leading to more evictions and repeated prefill. By analyzing the decay structure of Gated De
papers.summary_zh: 混合線性注意力架構（如 GDN 與 KDA）雖能減緩 KV cache 的成長，但其遞迴狀態會被原位覆寫，使前綴快取必須定期儲存完整的狀態檢查點，加重 HBM 記憶體壓力並導致更多驅逐與重複 prefill。本文分析 Gated DeltaNet（GDN）與 Kimi Delta Attention（KDA）的衰減結構，發現不同 head 與通道以差異極大的時間尺度保留前綴資訊，作者稱之為保留視界（retention horizon）。據此提出 DASC：僅由模型權重推導各狀態單元的靜態保留視界，挑選長視界單元、略過短視界單元，打包成 ragged 狀態檢查點並在 TP ranks 間平衡分布；重用時可選擇以零填補（dasc-nr），或付出額外計算、以有限後綴重放刷新（dasc-wr），並已實作於 SGLang。實驗顯示：Kimi-KDA 在保守設定下可將 KDA 遞迴狀態檢查點壓縮 2.63 倍，品質仍接近完整快取；在固定記憶體預算下，平均 TTFT 降低 42.6%，輸入吞吐量提升 68.4%；更激進壓縮時，dasc-wr 能以重放計算挽回大部分準確率。Qwen-GDN 呈現類似趨勢，但因衰減以 head 為粒度，增益較小。限制為僅評估混合架構、僅測試 TP8，且 dasc-wr 仍屬近似。整體而言，本研究證明衰減異質性可轉化為與輸入無關的狀態檢查點策略，對長上下文 LLM 服務的記憶體效率具實務價值。

links.title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs

evidence: Abstract: claims consistently lower WikiText2 perplexity than GPTQ, MxMoE, and GEMQ on Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct, Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite in the low-bit regime, with code link to github.com/snu-mllab/Q-Strata

Section 4.2, Table 1: Q-Strata lowest Wiki2 at 2.25/2.00/1.75 bits on all three models (e.g., Mixtral 1.75 bits: 12.14 vs MxMoE 25.20); accuracy exception at DSv2-Lite 2.25 bits where MxMoE leads by 0.3
Section 4.3, Table 2: outer-stage ablation on Mixtral with fixed inner ILP; lazy greedy lowest JSD (107.2/229.6/749.4) and Wiki2 vs Uniform, One-shot ILP, and Ascending greedy
Section 4.3, Table 3: pruning-free direct cell-ILP (~15.4k evaluations, >8x Q-Strata's whole search) within ~4% JSD, indicating inner-stage pruning discards little

Section 4.4, Table 4: with GEMQ's official router fine-tuning applied equally to both allocations, Q-Strata attains lower perplexity in all 18 pairs; rotation effect is model-dependent at extreme bitwidths (Section 4.5/D.5, Table 12)
Section 4.5, Table 5: dense Llama-2-7B; lazy greedy matches/beats AMQ with 1,378 vs 10,474 queries and stays within 0.001 JSD of eager greedy at 51x fewer queries
Appendix D, Table 8: calibration JSD correlates with test perplexity at Spearman rho 0.98 (no rotation) / 0.99 (rotation) vs GEMQ additive proxy 0.42 / 0.28 on identical allocations
Appendix B: shared protocol details (GPTQ, group-128 asymmetric 1-4 bit quantizers, 64/32 calibration sequences for inner/outer stages, context 4096, lm-eval-harness v0.4.5)
Appendix D, Table 14: search cost 23.0-88.7 GPU-hours per model on H100, one-time offline cost; Limitations section concedes outer stage is heavier than proxy-only allocation

Section 1: positions gap that prior MoE MPQ methods either keep per-block budgets uniform (MxMoE, MC-MoE) or rely on additive proxies across blocks (GEMQ); Section 5 notes concurrent ScaleBits overlap
llm_evaluation.rationale: A post-training mixed-precision quantization method for MoE LLMs (Mixtral, Qwen1.5-MoE, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Qwen3-30B-A3B), matching LLM, MoE, quantization/efficiency, and inference-serving preferences, though it is an efficiency/deployment paper rather than a language-methodology contribution. Novelty is moderate: the bi-level split (per-block MCKP proxy caching Pareto frontiers + lazy greedy descent over block budgets optimizing a model-level JSD objective) is a sensible new combination for MoE MPQ, but lazy greedy (Minoux 1978), MCKP, and the block reconstruction proxy are all established, and concurrent ScaleBits overlaps on diminishing-returns greedy allocation (Section 5). Rigor is high: shared quantizer set and protocol across baselines (Section 4.1), outer-stage ablation including a pruning-free direct cell-ILP showing the inner pruning loses little (Table 3), GEMQ compared with its router fine-tuning restored in all 18 (model, budget, rotation) pairs (Table 4), dense-model comparison vs AMQ (Table 5), calibration-objective fidelity via Spearman rho 0.98-0.99 vs GEMQ proxy 0.28-0.42 (Table 8), seed-stability check (Table 11), MMLU/GSM8K with standard errors (Table 9), and honest limitations on search-time cost (Limitations). Evidence supports the headline claim of lowest WikiText2 perplexity at every tested bitwidth (Table 1), with the single accuracy exception disclosed (DSv2-Lite 2.25 bits). Generalizability is decent: demonstrated on four MoE models and as a standalone dense allocator, but only on WikiText2-style calibration and mid-scale models. Reproducibility is aided by a stated GitHub code release and detailed appendices (calibration sizes, grid, eval harness version, GPU-hours), though the link and Gurobi dependency are unverified.

primary_link.title: Q-Strata: Hierarchical Bit Allocation for Mixed-Precision Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts LLMs

papers.summary: Mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) assigns a different bitwidth to each linear layer of a large language model (LLM) to minimize the quantization-induced quality loss under a fixed budget, but Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models contain these layers in every expert of every MoE block, so the allocation space grows far larger than in a dense model. Existing methods either allocate within each block under a uniform per-block budget, or allocate across blocks through an additive proxy, and neither dire
papers.summary_zh: 混合精度量化為各線性層指派不同位元寬度，以在固定預算下最小化品質損失，但Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型每個區塊含多個專家、每個專家有三個線性層，位元配置空間隨專家數暴增。現有方法不是在區塊內使用統一預算，就是以可加性代理指標跨區塊分配，皆無法直接最佳化模型層級目標。本文提出Q-Strata雙層分配器：內層以低成本的區塊重建誤差為代理，用整數線性規劃解多選背包問題，為每個MoE區塊於各預算等級快取Pareto最佳候選配置；外層在組裝後的量化模型上直接最小化JSD目標，以惰性貪婪下降為每個區塊選定一個預算，使搜尋從3LE個位元寬度選擇縮減為L個區塊預算，捕捉加性代理遺漏的區塊間耦合。在Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite及Qwen3-30B-A3B上，Q-Strata於1.75至2.25bits的低位元範圍一致取得最低WikiText2困惑度，零樣本準確率除一項外皆最佳；Mixtral在1.75bits時困惑度較MxMoE減半以上。消融實驗證實增益確實來自外層的直接評估，校準JSD與測試困惑度的Spearman相關性達0.98。限制是外層每步需對組裝模型執行一次前向傳遞，搜尋成本高於純代理方法（每模型約23至89GPU小時），惟屬一次性離線開銷。此法亦可獨立應用於稠密模型，以約7倍更少的查詢次數匹敵AMQ，對MoE模型的低成本部署極具價值。

links.title: Doc-REFRAG: Rethinking Multimodal Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

evidence: Abstract: introduces DocLongRAG (343,474 QA pairs, avg 37.4 retrieved images/question) and Doc-REFRAG with RL-based selector; claims SOTA over eleven baselines on six benchmarks with lower inference latency.
Sec 5.2: evaluation retrieves top-20 images per question with Jina-Embeddings-V4; states top-20 covers 93.4% of gold images (Recall@20), isolating generator quality from retrieval recall.

Table 2 (Sec 5.2): Doc-REFRAG (7B, ~150 tokens/image) averages 57.5% accuracy across ChartQA/SlideVQA/InfoVQA/DUDE/ViDoRe-v2/MMDocIR with TTFT 2.57s and TTIT 0.07s, vs DocOwl2 48.9% and Qwen3-VL 52.3%.
Table 3 (Sec 5.2): RL selector achieves 57.5% average accuracy at 3.7s latency vs ColQwen-based selection 53.6% at 9.3s, random 38.8%, perplexity-based 43.7%.
Table 4 (Sec 5.3): ablations show removing single-image reconstruction drops average accuracy 55.1%->19.7% and replacing curriculum learning yields 24.2%.
Table 5 (Sec 5.3): fine-tuning InternVL3.5, MiniCPM-V-2.6, and DocOwl2 on DocLongRAG improves averages by 3.9, 4.3, and 3.9 points respectively; Doc-REFRAG without DocLongRAG is 48.9% vs 55.1% full.
App. C: human validation of hard-negative relevance with Krippendorff's alpha 0.78; top-3 retrieved images score >=3.94 average relevance, motivating exclusion before negative sampling.
App. G: pseudo-labels from ColQwen similarity achieve 86.4% accuracy, precision 84.1%, recall 80.3%, Cohen's kappa 0.79 against human chunk-relevance labels.

Limitations: fixed chunk size k cannot adapt at inference, RL reward is answer accuracy only (64% of residual errors on dense/complex text per App. L), DocLongRAG is English-only with constructed training noise, and results are from a single training run.

Sec 5.1 and App. K: implementation details (LoRA rank 64, AdamW lr 1e-5 with 4% warmup, GRPO clip 0.2, three stages, 8x RTX 3090, stage-wise trainable parameters) and GitHub resource link support reproducibility.

App. N: 2x2 factorial decomposition attributes +3.9% data gain, +3.1% architecture gain, +2.3% synergy on DUDE/ViDoRe/MMDocIR; App. O shows naive random data pairing drops accuracy to 35.4%, isolating pipeline design.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope language-methodology work, not pure CV: multimodal document RAG coupling a 7B decoder LLM with question-guided visual token compression and a GRPO/PPO-trained chunk-expansion selector, plus efficiency (TTFT/TTIT), long-context multi-image inputs (~37.4 images/question), and RL components that align with RAG & Knowledge, Multimodal AI, Scaling & Efficiency, Inference & Serving, and RL preferences. Novelty is moderate-to-incremental: the compress-and-expand RL selector is a genuine new angle (App. A argues differentiation from heuristic query-conditioned pruning), but the system is assembled from DocOwl2 encoder/decoder, ColQwen pseudo-labels, and existing datasets (Doc-750K, OpenDocVQA). Rigor is strong: six benchmarks, eleven baselines under a unified retrieval setting (top-20 via Jina-Embeddings-V4, Recall@20 93.4%), selector/curriculum/dataset ablations, 2x2 factorial decomposition (App. N), naive-random control (App. O), and human-validated hard negatives and pseudo-labels (App. C/G, Krippendorff alpha 0.78, kappa 0.79). Evidence is extensive and internally consistent, but single-run results without significance testing, batch-size-1 latency on consumer GPUs, and evaluation where only the proposed model is trained on RAG-style data (partially mitigated by fine-tuning three baselines) temper strength. Generalizability is demonstrated via cross-model fine-tuning gains (+3.9/+4.3/+3.9) and reranker transfer, though English-only and document-domain-bound. Reproducibility aided by a public code/data link, full training protocol, hyperparameters, and stage-wise cost breakdown (App. K).

primary_link.title: Doc-REFRAG: Rethinking Multimodal Document Retrieval-Augmented Generation

papers.summary: Real-world knowledge resides in multimodal documents, necessitating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for accurate question answering. However, existing multimodal RAG models are primarily designed for single-image or closed-document settings and exhibit limited accuracy in realistic multi-image scenarios. Moreover, processing numerous retrieved images incurs substantial computational overhead from irrelevant visual tokens. To address these challenges, we introduce DocLongRAG, a large-scale d
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的知識大量存在於含文字、圖表與插圖的多模態文件中，但現有多模態 RAG 模型多針對單張影像或封閉文件設計，在需要跨多張異質、冗餘且互相矛盾影像的真實檢索情境下準確度有限，且大量與問題無關的視覺 token 也造成沉重運算負擔。為此，作者先建構大規模資料集 DocLongRAG，涵蓋約 34.3 萬組問答對與 330 萬張文件影像，每題平均關聯 37.4 張檢索影像，以語意相近的困難負例干擾影像模擬真實 RAG 雜訊，並過濾與情境無關、需線上搜尋、無法回答及涉及倫理疑慮的樣本。接著提出 Doc-REFRAG，採「壓縮—展開」策略：先將每張影像的視覺 token 切成區塊並壓縮為單一嵌入，再由以 GRPO 訓練的輕量 RL 選擇器，依問題相關性動態還原少數關鍵區塊的原始精細 token。訓練分三階段：單影像重建、多影像持續預訓練，以及以答案正確率為獎勵的選擇器強化學習。在六個基準上，Doc-REFRAG 以每張影像約 150 個 token 的設定達到平均準確率 57.5%，超越十一個基線並大幅降低 TTFT 延遲；RL 選擇器亦優於隨機、困惑度與 ColQwen 等策略，且能加速文件重排序。消融實驗證實重建訓練、課程學習與 DocLongRAG 缺一不可，用以微調其他模型也帶來一致增益。限制包括區塊大小於推論時固定、獎勵訊號缺乏區塊級歸因、訓練雜訊為人工建構且僅涵蓋英文。此研究為資源受限環境下的高效多模態文件 RAG 提供了務實可行的解方。

links.title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'an 8B critic trained with TAIScore outperforms both a zero-shot 120B critic and critics trained with outcome-only or critique-only reward signals'; 'Co-evolving the critic and actor further improves performance'
Table 1 (§5.2): TAIScore+co-evolution reaches 76.72±0.14 WritingBench overall vs 72.33 base Qwen3-8B actor, 75.41 gpt-oss-120B critic baseline, 75.63 outcome-gain, 75.18 critique-quality
Table 3 (§5.3): matched TAIScore critique yields ΔWB +2.78 vs +0.97 no-critique, +1.01 generic, +0.55 shuffled — supporting instance-specific critique content as the causal factor
Table 4 (§5.4): critic tailored to target Qwen3-8B gives +3.63 gain vs +2.75 (Qwen3-4B-tailored) and +2.29 (Llama-3.2-3B-tailored), same initialization and budget
Appendix D.1: cross-judge rescore of 800 rollouts with Claude Opus 4.8 shows 89.5% top-1 overlap and 77.9% strict-pairwise agreement with gpt-oss-120B reward judge
Appendix D Table 12: full hyperparameters disclosed (GRPO lr 1e-6, KL 0.02, N=4 critiques; DPO β=0.1, lr 1e-6); judge prompts in Tables 6-9, 11, 13-14
§1 footnote: 'Our implementation can be accessed at https://github.com/jiny1623/taiscore'

Limitations: 'broader evaluation on additional domains... would further clarify the scope'; 'main training experiments also focus on Qwen-family models'; co-evolution uses 'a fixed number of rounds over disjoint data shards'

Related Work: differentiates from Critique-RL (Xi et al., 2025) and CGI (Yang et al., 2025b) by setting (non-verifiable generation) and credit assignment via a judge-based reward over the full critique-guided revision process
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM post-training methodology paper: actor-conditioned critique reward (TAIScore) trained with GRPO plus DPO actor updates in a co-evolving loop, squarely matching LLM, alignment/RLHF, RL, and training preferences. Novelty is moderate: the actor-conditioned framing and targeted credit assignment (validity, adherence, targeted gain, faithfulness) are meaningful refinements over Critique-RL/CGI-style joint critic training, but the components (GRPO, DPO, LLM-as-judge reward) are standard. Rigor is strong: controlled motivating analysis (Table 5), reward ablations (Table 1), critique-content controls (shuffled vs matched: +0.55 vs +2.78, Table 3), actor-matching experiment (Table 4), cross-judge agreement check (D.1), and a small human eval (Table 2). Evidence is weakened by reliance on LLM judges for both reward and evaluation, no significance testing, small human study (50 prompts, 3 annotators), and modest gaps on some metrics (e.g., 75.96 vs 75.63 outcome-gain on WritingBench). Generalizability is limited to two non-verifiable domains and Qwen-family training, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is good: code released (§1 footnote), full hyperparameters (Table 12), and all judge prompts (Appendices A, D).

primary_link.title: Co-Evolving Actor-Conditioned Critics for Non-Verifiable Generation

papers.summary: Natural-language critiques provide supervision beyond scalar rewards for non-verifiable generation, which lacks deterministic verifiers. In critique-guided refinement, a critic gives feedback on an initial response and an actor revises it. However, final revision quality does not reveal whether the critique was actually useful: a capable actor may improve without following the feedback, while valid feedback may fail if the actor cannot execute it. We frame critique as actor-conditioned revision
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討缺乏確定性驗證器的不可驗證生成任務（如創意寫作與深度研究）如何獲得有效監督訊號。作者主張，自然語言評論的價值並非取決於其獨立品質，而是取決於目標行動者能否執行該回饋並改善對應面向；控制實驗顯示，更大的評論家未必帶來更高的遵循度或增益，而同一評論對不同行動者的效果也不相同。為此，論文提出 TAIScore（Targeted Actionable Improvement Score），由 gpt-oss-120B 評審同時觀察指令、初始回應、評論與修訂，依評論有效性、遵循度、針對性增益與指令忠實性四項診斷給出最終分數，作為以 GRPO 訓練評論家的獎勵；再從成功的評論引導修訂建構 DPO 偏好對以更新行動者，並交替兩者形成共同演化迴圈。實驗顯示，8B 評論家勝過零樣本 gpt-oss-120B 評論家，也勝過僅用結果增益或評論品質獎勵的對照方法，將 Qwen3-8B 行動者在 WritingBench 由 72.33 提升至 76.72，HelloBench 與 DeepResearch-Gym 亦呈相同趨勢；人類評估與評論家—行動者配對實驗（與目標行動者匹配的評論家增益最大，達 3.63 分）支持此結論。限制包括僅評估創意寫作與深度研究兩個領域、訓練實驗主要使用 Qwen 系列模型，且共同演化採固定輪數與不相交資料分片，缺乏自適應排程。此研究指出，評論監督應針對特定行動者設計，並隨其能力演進持續調整，對獎勵建模與自我改良流程具重要啟示。

links.title: CHASE: How Content Ecosystems Are Reshaped When Ranking Is the Only Target

evidence: Section 4.1 / Appendix C (Table 3): rank-citation AUC 0.853±0.093 across six domains, three seeds, five evaluation rounds (n=90), supporting ranking as a visibility proxy
Section 4.2 / Table 1: quality-ranking alignment ρ declines R0→R20 in all six domains, from −0.018 (Books) to −0.107 (Web), mean −0.068; no significance tests or seed variance reported
Section 4.3 / Appendix D.1 (Table 4): random-target control Δρ = +.001/+.014/−.036 (Retail/Debate/News) vs CHASE −.047/−.065/−.104, separating ranking-driven adaptation from rewriting alone
Section 4.5 / Appendix G (Table 9): 3,472 rewrites audited, 93.0% pass all integrity checks, fabrication 3.4%, no deterioration over rounds (90.3% earliest vs 96.4% at R15)
Section 4.6 / Appendix H.4: human validation on 60 documents by 3 annotators; Krippendorff's α=0.72, human-LLM Spearman ρ=0.58 (95% CI [0.49,0.66])
Section 3.6: cross-family setup with Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite as ranker, GPT-5.4-mini as rewriter, Claude Haiku 4.5 as independent judge, five seeds, 20 queries per domain sampled from C-SEO Bench

Section 6 (Limitations): admits single model configuration per role, fixed 25-dimensional feature space (declining alignment may partly reflect feature insufficiency), fixed ranker, and 20-round horizon; Section 4.4 frames negative evidentiary-feature associations as non-causal
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric simulation study of population-level Goodhart dynamics in generative-engine ranking: relevant to LLMs, AI safety (reward hacking/Goodhart), LLM-as-judge evaluation, and RAG grounding/citation visibility. The Rank-Discriminate-Rewrite-Evaluate framework extends single-round GEO work (Aggarwal et al. 2024; Wu et al. 2025) to repeated population-level adaptation with a fixed ranker, which is a genuine but incremental novelty over LEMSS and performative prediction. Rigor is strengthened by cross-family model assignment (Section 3.6), no-rewrite and random-target controls (Section 4.3), sensitivity sweeps (Section 4.5/D.2-D.3), a 3,472-rewrite integrity audit (Appendix G), and human validation (Appendix H). Key weaknesses: the core quality-ranking divergence effect is small (mean Δρ −0.068, Section 4.2) and no statistical significance tests or confidence intervals are reported for Δρ; Table 1 omits seed variance; quality rests on an LLM judge validated on only 60 documents by 3 annotators (Appendix H.4); 20 queries per domain are sampled; each role uses a single model configuration and a fixed 25-feature space, acknowledged in Section 6. Generalizability is bounded by the simulated 20-round horizon, myopic non-strategic creators, and C-SEO Bench domains only. Reproducibility is good: code link, full prompts (Appendix F), complete feature definitions (Appendix B), pseudocode (Appendix A), and named models with temperature 0.0.

primary_link.title: CHASE: How Content Ecosystems Are Reshaped When Ranking Is the Only Target

papers.summary: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) is increasingly used to improve content visibility in LLM-based retrieval systems, yet its population-level effects under repeated optimization remain poorly understood. We introduce Content Homogenization under rAnking Signal Exploitation (CHASE), a controlled simulation framework for studying how content ecosystems are reshaped when creators repeatedly adapt documents to an LLM ranking signal. We use ranking as a proxy for source visibility and validate thi
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究生成式引擎最佳化（GEO）在重複進行下的族群層級效應。作者提出 CHASE 受控模擬框架，把 LLM 對候選文件的強制排序視為來源能見度的代理訊號，並迭代執行排序、特徵判別、改寫與評估四個階段，共二十輪，涵蓋零售、電玩遊戲、書籍、網頁、新聞與辯論六個領域。框架以邏輯迴歸判別器辨識與排名成功相關的二十五維特徵，隨機挑選部分落敗文件朝目標特徵改寫，並使用跨模型家族的獨立 LLM 評審評分，輔以人類標註驗證。主要證據顯示：排序與引用高度相關（rank–citation AUC 0.853），支持排序作為能見度代理；但六個領域的品質—排序對齊（Spearman ρ）從 R0 到 R20 全數下降，幅度介於 −0.018 至 −0.107（平均 −0.068），顯示越貼近排名目標特徵的文件，與獨立評判品質的關聯越弱，即「品質—排序發散」。隨機目標對照組證明此發散並非反覆改寫本身造成，而是源自朝排名衍生目標調整；改寫完整性審查的整體合格率為 93.0%，人機評分一致性為 ρ=0.58。生態動態具領域差異，可歸納為結構收斂、訊號不穩定與特徵主導三種型態。研究限制包括僅模擬二十輪、創作者短視且非策略性、排名器固定不變、特徵空間有限，且品質主要依賴 LLM 評審。此研究提醒，即使評分器不變，反覆最佳化也可能侵蝕排名與品質的對齊，對排名系統設計與稽核具重要意義。

links.title: Strong Drafts Need Compact Memories: Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Compressed KV Cache

evidence: Abstract: claims draft-side memory reduction over 70% and speedups up to 2.08x (8B) and 3.33x (70B) at prefixes up to 32K, verified against Table 1 (Ours 4x L3B 2.08x at 32K on Llama3.1-8B; Ours 4x L8B 3.33x at 16K on Llama3.1-70B).

Section 5.3, Table 3: extra peak memory drops from 17.21-18.02 GB to 3.98-5.05 GB and draft latency from 41.34-54.92 ms to 12.39-15.37 ms at 32K under the 70B target, supporting the >70% memory claim.

Section 5.4.3, Table 4: PT+SFT beats PT-only and SFT-only in all settings (e.g., L8B 8x: 5.34 vs 3.87/3.01 Tok./Iter), and Section 5.4.2 Fig. 6 shows copy-weight init dominates random init in loss and gradient norm.

Section 5.1 Metrics & Appendix D: all main experiments use greedy decoding T=0, batch size 1, single 8xH100 node; evaluation restricted to GovReport/QMSum/MultiNews summarization from LongBench-v1 - limits generality of throughput claims.

Limitations: adaptor trained on only 2B tokens at 8K context, only mirrored K/V projections trainable, fixed window/sink/interval; no code or checkpoint availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
Section 2.1: positioning against TriForce, MagicDec, TokenSwift, QuantSpec, LongSpec; the claim that none introduces a learnable compressed state for the draft is the paper's stated novelty axis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on long-context inference efficiency: speculative decoding with a learnable compressed draft-side KV memory (MASW), directly matching high-weight LLM/long-context/inference preferences. Novelty is moderate rather than high: eviction-based (TriForce, MagicDec), quantization-based (QuantSpec), and learnable context-compression (Gist, ICAE, Activation Beacon) exist, and the contribution is their combination plus trainable mirrored projections for the draft side. Rigor is solid: motivating latency/acceptance analysis (Fig. 3), comprehensive baseline comparison across two target scales and four prefix lengths, and four ablations (window size, init, recipe, training context). Evidence is internally consistent but narrow: greedy decoding only (T=0), batch size 1, single 8xH100 node, summarization-only eval (GovReport/QMSum/MultiNews), Llama-family models only, and unexplained non-monotonic baseline anomalies (EAGLE 0.59x at 16K vs 1.05x at 24K on 8B). No code or adaptor checkpoint release is stated, limiting reproducibility despite unusually detailed setup (Appendix D) and hyperparameters (W=S=128, 16-token rollback, 2B-token RedPajama pretraining + LongAlpaca/BookSum SFT).

primary_link.title: Strong Drafts Need Compact Memories: Long-Context Speculative Decoding with Compressed KV Cache

papers.summary: Long-context LLM applications such as document summarization and multi-turn agents require generation from prefixes spanning tens of thousands of tokens, making decoding latency a major bottleneck. Speculative decoding (SD) reduces latency without changing model outputs, but its speedup depends on both accepted draft tokens and draft-step latency: Lightweight drafts are fast but lack the capacity to capture long-range dependencies, whereas strong independent drafts recover acceptance but incur g
papers.summary_zh: 長上下文 LLM 應用如文件摘要與多輪代理，常需在數萬 token 的前綴上生成，解碼延遲成為主要瓶頸。推測性解碼（Speculative Decoding）雖可在不改變輸出下加速，卻面臨兩難：EAGLE 等輕量草稿快速但難以捕捉長距離依賴，接受率隨上下文增長下降；強大獨立草稿雖恢復接受率，每步卻須串流完整 KV 快取，延遲隨前綴長度線性上升。本文提出記憶增強滑動視窗起草（MASW），為獨立草稿模型配備壓縮的草稿端 KV 記憶：保留 sink token 與精確局部視窗，並每隔 r 個 token 透過可訓練的鏡像投影矩陣將歷史壓縮為記憶槽，僅訓練輕量記憶轉接器、凍結草稿主幹。目標驗證器保有完整 KV 快取並執行標準接受／拒絕規則，無損保證不變。實驗以 Llama 3.1-8B 與 70B 為目標模型、前綴長度達 32K，草稿端記憶體減少逾 70%，相較自迴歸解碼分別最高加速 2.08 倍與 3.33 倍，並優於 EAGLE、SWA 與 SnapKV 等基線。消融顯示鏡像投影宜以複製權重初始化，先預訓練再 SFT 的兩階段訓練最佳，且 8K 訓練長度即可外推至更長上下文。限制：轉接器僅以 2B token、8K 上下文訓練，僅訓練 K/V 投影，視窗與槽間距固定，自適應配置留待未來。此設計採連續且僅附加的快取更新，與現有 KV 快取服務系統相容，具部署實用價值。

links.title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving

evidence: Abstract: identifies two obstacles (limited reasoning diversity from rigid symbolic programs, insufficient visual grounding) and proposes MTS, PA training, and CG-MTE; claims up to 8x sampling-cost reduction and public code/data at https://github.com/Jason8Kang/ReTTS-PGPS

Section 4, Table 1: PA training on MTS-All yields Qwen3-VL-8B accuracies of 71.2% (PGPS9K, +12.6 over direct program prediction), 74.5% (Geometry3K), 67.2% (GeoQA), evaluated against general MLLMs, neural solvers (LANS 66.7/72.1), and neural-symbolic solvers (Pi-GPS 61.4/70.6)

Section 5.1, Table 2: data-size-matched control (original programs repeated to 32K) shows removing synthesized traces (w/o PGPS9K-MTS) costs -4.1/-3.9/-3.6 points on 2B/3B/8B, isolating diversity from scale
Section 5.1, Table 4: token-controlled leave-one-out ablation; removing CoT-PAL causes the largest drop (-3.1 on 2B, -3.0 on 3B), indicating complementarity of trace formats

Section 5.2, Table 5: adaptive beam-search SC baselines (rank split 75.2% @ ASN 4.68; pattern split 75.8% @ ASN 12.72) vs CG-MTE 76.0% @ ASN 4.89 on 8B; authors conclude CG-MTE is 'primarily a sample-efficient adaptive inference strategy rather than a method for raising the high-budget accuracy ceiling'
Appendix C.3: human evaluation of 400 randomly sampled traces per CoT format by two annotators with third-annotator adjudication; Table 3 reports CoT-PAL correctness 98.5% vs CoT-Program 93.0%

Appendix D.5, Table 10: error-coupling analysis shows pairwise same-wrong agreement of 34.3-39.8% and all-four identical-wrong of 2.5-4.9%, supporting consensus as empirical early stopping rather than correctness certification

Limitations: method requires formal solution programs and semantic-clause annotations, is confined to 2D plane geometry, and execution-based verification cannot certify faithfulness of natural-language rationales

Appendix B.1: training setup fully specified (Hugging Face TRL SFTTrainer, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, 8x A100 80GB, per-model learning rates, 10 epochs, max sequence length 1024); Appendix A.2.1 reports MTS construction statistics (e.g., 8,017 verified PAL scripts out of 8,021 programs)

Appendix D.2, Table 9: self-consistency scaling on all three benchmarks (PGPS9K 71.2->76.7, Geometry3K 74.5->80.7, GeoQA 67.2->76.1 at SC@40), supporting the claimed TTS reactivation beyond one dataset
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-LLM reasoning paper, not a pure domain application: its core contributions are language-methodology (multi-trace CoT/program synthesis, test-time scaling reactivation, adaptive consensus inference) applied with Qwen-VL and InternVL backbones, so it aligns well with high-weight preferences (CoT/reasoning, multimodal AI, LLMs, scaling efficiency) without hitting the out-of-scope cap. Novelty is moderate: each ingredient (PAL conversion, CoT augmentation, perception-first training, adaptive/self-consistent inference) builds on known work (PAL, LLaVA-CoT/Insight-V, adaptive test-time compute), with the program-seeded heterogeneous trace expansion and consensus-guided ensemble being reasonable but incremental combinations. Rigor is solid: data-size-matched (Table 2) and token-controlled leave-one-out (Table 4) ablations, cross-backbone validation (Appendix C.1), human trace-quality evaluation with adjudication (Appendix C.3), error-coupling analysis (Appendix D.5), and an honest adaptive-beam baseline comparison (Table 5) showing CG-MTE's advantage is mostly sample efficiency, not a higher accuracy ceiling; deductions for absent significance testing/seed variance and a 2-annotator human eval. Evidence strength is good, with consistent numbers across abstract, Table 1, Table 5, and Appendix D (71.2% greedy, 76.7% SC@40, CG-MTE 76.0% @ ASN 4.89 vs 40, ~8x cost reduction), though several key claims rest on figures. Generalizability is limited by the authors' own stated constraints: reliance on formal programs and semantic-clause annotations and confinement to 2D plane geometry (Limitations). Reproducibility is strong: public code/data link, full prompts (Appendix A.2.2), training hyperparameters (Appendix B.1), and dataset statistics (Table 6), with a residual dependency on Gemini-2.5-Flash for trace generation.

primary_link.title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving

papers.summary: Plane geometry problem (PGP) solving has become a critical benchmark for multimodal reasoning because it requires accurate visual perception and precise multi-step symbolic deduction. Although test-time scaling (TTS) has demonstrated remarkable success in general mathematical reasoning, it fails to scale effectively under the symbolic-program paradigm for plane geometry. We identify two key obstacles: limited reasoning diversity induced by rigid symbolic programs and insufficient explicit visual
papers.summary_zh: 平面幾何問題（PGP）求解是多模態推理的重要基準，但 test-time scaling（TTS）在此領域卻難以發揮效益。本文指出兩大障礙：僵化的符號程式限制了推理多樣性，且模型在符號推導前缺乏明確的視覺 grounding，易因誤讀圖形而推導錯誤。為此，作者提出多軌跡合成（MTS），將每個符號程式轉換為可執行的 Python（PAL）腳本與 CoT 增強變體，並透過規則轉換與執行驗證確保正確性；同時引入感知增強（PA）訓練，讓模型先將圖形解析為結構化語意子句再進行推導。推論階段另提出共識引導的多軌跡整合（CG-MTE），在淺層解碼深度檢查跨軌跡共識，僅在意見分歧時才擴充取樣預算。實驗於 PGPS9K、Geometry3K 與 GeoQA 三個基準上微調 Qwen-VL 系列：Qwen3-VL-8B 在 PGPS9K 貪婪解碼達 71.2%，beam search 的 self-consistency（40 個樣本）進一步提升至 76.7%；CG-MTE 平均僅取樣 4.89 次即達 76.0%，相較高預算 self-consistency 最多省下 8 倍取樣成本，並超越通用 MLLM 與專用幾何求解器。限制方面：方法依賴正式解題程式與語意子句等結構化標註；驗證僅限於二維平面幾何；執行驗證無法保證自然語言推理說明的語意忠實性。本研究的價值在於重新啟用 TTS 於幾何求解，顯著改善精度與計算成本的 Pareto 權衡，並公開 MTS-All 資料集與程式碼，對多模態推理的資料建構與高效推論具重要參考意義。
papers.title: Reactivating Test-Time Scaling for Plane Geometry Problem Solving
papers.title_zh: 重新啟用測試時間擴展（Test-Time Scaling）以求解平面幾何問題

links.title: Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents

evidence: §4.2/Table 1: pooled pass rates 0/75 (frontier −art.), 51/75 (frontier +art., 68.0%), 17/75 (mid-tier +art.) across fifteen tasks with exactly five trials per cell and Wilson 95% intervals.

§4.2: perturbed-artefact control on bom-costing — three gated conventions changed to plausible-but-wrong values yield 0% pass rate across five trials vs. 100% with the correct artefact; reported as single-task, single-model control.

§4.3: recitation probe — Qwen recites all gated conventions and passes 100% across 20 two-turn conversations on bom-costing and legal-clause, versus 0% under the full sandboxed agent harness, localising failure to tool use/file discovery/format compliance rather than knowledge.
§3.4 and §5.3: executable per-task leak-audit scripts cover nine of fifteen calibration tasks; static scanning cannot exclude semantic paraphrasing or adversarial leakage.

§3.5: retention screen is a coarse quality-control rule, admits zero-variance cells, and one flipped outcome shifts pass rate by 20 points at n=5; selection makes survivor statistics descriptive, not independent validation.
§5.4: public release covers five retained tasks; aggregate counts and pass matrix cannot be reconstructed from the public subset; evaluation trajectories and reference solutions are not included.
§1/§6: authors explicitly state experiments validate protocol behavior only and do not establish that retained tasks improve post-training; no training experiments are performed (Figure 1 caption).
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope and well-aligned with core preferences: a methodology paper on constructing knowledge-gated, verifiably-checkable tasks for LLM agents (agents/tool-use, LLMs, evaluation, RLVR-adjacent data curation). The core contribution — planting non-derivable private conventions at construction time and exposing artefact access as a byte-identical, leak-audited experimental variable — is a genuine but incremental extension beyond SkillsBench's paired evaluation and benchmark-auditing work. The headline evidence is strong within its narrow scope (0/75 to 51/75 pooled pass rate, §4.2/Table 1), supported by a single-task perturbed-artefact control (0% with wrong conventions, §4.2) and an instructive two-task recitation probe localising harness failures vs. knowledge gaps (§4.3). Rigor is helped by Wilson intervals, fixed-seed outcome-blind sampling, and unusually honest scoping (circularity of the retained set, configuration-relative results, no training-value claim); it is limited by n=5 cells, executable leak audits covering only 9/15 tasks, no statistical test, and boundary-case retention decisions. Generalizability is constrained: two coupled model+harness configurations, one 15-task pool, deterministic verification only (rubric path unexercised). Reproducibility is partial: pinned harness/model versions and a GitHub release of five retained tasks, but closed frontier models, no trajectories or reference solutions, and aggregate statistics not reconstructable from the public subset (§5.4).

primary_link.title: Ignorance or Incompetence? Constructing Knowledge-Gated, Verifiable Tasks for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Professional agent tasks often depend on conventions that are absent from public corpora, yet benchmarks rarely control whether an agent has access to those conventions. We introduce a knowledge-gated task-construction protocol that separates a task instruction from a compact artefact containing private conventions, reference tables, and utility operators. Construction-time provenance, byte-identical task instructions across the provided- and withheld-artefact conditions, leak audits, and execut
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理專業代理任務的一個矛盾：任務常依賴公開語料中不存在的內部慣例，但基準測試鮮少控制代理是否能取得這些知識，而模型自產的合成任務又受制於生成模型自身的能力上限。作者提出知識門控的任務建構協定，將任務指令與一份數 KB 的知識工件（artefact）分離，工件承載私人慣例、參照表與工具運算子，並以建構期溯源、逐位元組一致的指令、洩漏稽核與可執行見證腳本，使對工件的依賴明確且可檢驗。知識門分為植入不可推導私人選擇的「慣例門」，與放置難以手寫演算法的「運算子門」。在十五個校準任務上，Claude Opus 4.8 配置附工件時整體通過率為 68.0%，抽走工件後降為 0%；中階配置（Qwen3.6-Plus，一律附工件）僅 22.7%。在 bom-costing 上，改用數值看似合理但錯誤的工件同樣得到 0%。兩任務的背誦探針（recitation probe）顯示 Qwen 在單輪、無工具設定下能正確複述慣例並 100% 通過，但在完整代理 harness 下為 0%，將失敗定位於工具使用與檔案探索等框架層因素。校準篩選機制保留七項任務；附錄案例顯示僅保留慣例的最小工件（約 1 KB）與完整文件同樣達 100%。限制包括僅十五項任務、每格五次試驗、洩漏稽核只涵蓋九項任務，且本研究未訓練模型，無法證明保留任務能改善後訓練（post-training）。其價值在於把知識存取變成明確、可稽核的實驗變數，為可驗證獎勵（RLVR）的資料策展奠定方法基礎。

links.title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation

evidence: Page 4-6, Section 3 (Approach/Pipeline): defines sentence-level perplexity ranking, K=floor(T/1000) insertion positions, length 500–1,000 word and target-leakage filters, and gradient-free refinement minimizing continuation PPL (Eqs. 1-8).

Page 7, Table 1: PPL reductions — full augmented data 7.28501, original tokens 1.03078, selected continuations 4.23539 (No annotation→Optimized); the paper notes the large full-data gain may partly reflect fluent model-generated annotations.
Page 8, Table 2: mean annotation self-repetition 0.203% vs source 0.615%; annotation-to-source exact 13-gram overlap 0.051%.

Page 9, Table 3: two 680M models with identical architecture/optimizer trained on raw (523B) vs REER-PT (542B) mixtures; BBH and GPQA-Diamond +2.07, MATH +1.50, but MBPP+ −2.65, HumanEval+ −1.83, LiveCodeBench −1.79.

Page 10, Section 6 (Limitations): 680M model and single pre-training recipe; dependence on PPL/annotation model choices; natural-language annotations disrupt code structure, motivating code-specific formats.
Page 6 (Augmented Corpus Construction): 23B source tokens transformed into a 42B-token augmented corpus; no mention of released code, data, or named annotation/PPL models anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pre-training research: offline, perplexity-guided insertion of CoT-style reasoning annotations into raw pre-training corpora, directly matching LLM and reasoning/CoT preferences. The pipeline is clearly specified (sentence-level PPL ranking, inferability filtering, leakage/length constraints, gradient-free refinement) and validated with a controlled from-scratch comparison of two 680M models on matched mixtures plus a corpus-scale data analysis. Novelty is incremental: reasoning-augmented pre-training already exists (Quiet-STaR, TPT, Mining Hidden Thoughts, RLP), and the contribution is an offline, sparse, REER-style refinement variant. Rigor is solid but limited: only one training run per condition with no variance reporting, token counts differ between conditions (523B vs 542B, acknowledged as part of the transformation), no comparison against alternative augmentation baselines (e.g., WRAP, TPT-style trajectories) at equal budget, and PPL evidence is measured by the PPL model rather than the trained checkpoints. Evidence includes concrete quantitative tables (PPL reductions 0.42–7.29; benchmark deltas; 0.051% 13-gram overlap), and the authors honestly report code-benchmark regressions (MBPP+ −2.65) and scale limitations. Generalizability is constrained by the 680M/single-recipe setup and the failure on code documents. Reproducibility suffers from unspecified PPL/annotation models, an unnamed 500B general corpus, and no release statement.

primary_link.title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation

papers.summary: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理語言模型預訓練的資料瓶頸：傳統下個詞元（next-token）預測僅監督接續內容，其背後的隱含推理並未被明確表達。作者提出REER-PT，將逆向工程推理（REER）延伸至原始預訓練資料：先以句子層級困惑度挑出難以預測、但仍可由前文推得的接續句，經可推斷性檢查過濾後，由標註模型產生簡潔的筆記式註解，重建前文與接續內容之間的隱含關聯；再以接續內容的困惑度作為最佳化訊號，離線迭代精煉，並施加長度（500–1,000字）與目標洩漏限制，剔除冗餘或洩漏答案的候選。保留的註解以專用標記插入原文，所有原始詞元維持不變，語料相容於標準訓練目標，無需線上推理推演。研究將約23B原始詞元轉換為42B增強語料：三種評估範圍的困惑度降幅介於0.42至7.29，註解的13-gram與原文完全重疊僅約0.05%。控制實驗訓練兩個680M參數模型，增強語料模型在BBH與GPQA-Diamond各提升2.07個百分點，MATH、DROP、OlympiadBench亦有約1.4至1.5點進步；但MBPP+、HumanEval+、LiveCodeBench等程式基準最多下滑2.65點。作者坦承限制：實驗僅涵蓋680M參數與單一訓練配方，結果依賴困惑度模型與標註模型的選擇，且自然語言註解會干擾程式結構。整體而言，此研究顯示稀疏、困惑度引導的資料增強可在不改變訓練目標下提升知識與推理能力，為推理感知的預訓練資料工程提供可擴充且務實的路徑。

Appendix F Table 5: LLM judge (Llama-3.3-70B) achieves 93.0% agreement with human annotator on 100 reasoning traces

Appendix E.2: 'Qwen3-4B's English-worse effect is significant (p<0.001)... Qwen3-30B, Gemma-4-31B, Krikri-8B, and Alpaca-8B trend in the same English-worse direction but do not reach significance (p between 0.07 and 0.49)'

Contribution footnote 1: 'Our code and data will be available under the Apache 2.0 license' with repository link (availability claimed, not independently verifiable)
Section 4.1 Table 1: capability hierarchy across models/languages (e.g., Gemma-4-31B 61.3% English vs 56.5% Greek; Llama-3.1-8B 23.3% English vs 14.4% Greek)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, mathematical reasoning/CoT, probing/interpretability, benchmarking, prompting), not in any out-of-scope category. Novelty is moderate: first multilingual paired solvable/unsolvable benchmark (French/Greek ReliableMath) and first multilingual Solvability Belief faithfulness analysis, but methodology extends existing English probing work (ReliableMath, Xiros et al.). Rigor is solid: human-validated translations (95-97% agreement, Appendix G), judge validated at 93% on 100 samples (Appendix F), paired bootstrap CIs and z-tests (Appendix E), six models. Evidence strength is tempered because the headline 'less faithful in dominant language' claim is only significant for Qwen3-4B (p<0.001) while other models trend without significance (p=0.07-0.49, Appendix E.2), and probe AUC values appear only in figures. Generalizability is limited to three European languages and math problems, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is decent (Apache 2.0 data/code claim, full prompts in appendices, layer selection in Appendix D) but the repository link is a placeholder and probe hyperparameters are sparse.

Consequently, it remains unclear whether multilingual failures arise from differences in internal Solvability Belief or from language-dependent failures to express it. To address this gap, we introduce the first multilingual benchmark of paired solvable and unsolvable mathema
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型(LLM)偵測數學題目可解與否的能力,能否忠實地跨語言遷移。過往研究僅針對英文,難以判斷多語言情境下的失敗究竟源於模型內部「可解性信念」(Solvability Belief)的差異,還是無法以該語言適當表達。作者將 ReliableMath 基準中的可解題目及其不可解對應版本翻譯成法文與希臘文,建立首個多語言成對基準,並對 Qwen3、Gemma-4、Llama-3.1 及其法文、希臘文特化版本,從行為與內部表徵兩個層面進行分析。他們以隱藏狀態訓練 L1 正規化邏輯迴歸探針預測可解性信念,並以 LLM 評審標註模型文字輸出的可解性判定,據此計算兩者的一致率作為「忠實度」。結果顯示:模型在英文的解題準確率最高,可解性信念在英文的編碼也最清晰,但此信念高度語言無關,合併各語言訓練的通用探針表現不低於單語探針;感知提示可大幅提升拒答率,但語言特化會同時推高真拒答與誤拒答。最關鍵的發現是忠實度出現反轉:Gemma 與 Qwen 在弱勢語言的忠實度反而高於英文,而多語能力最弱的 Llama-3.1-8B 恰好相反。換言之,優勢語言帶來更強的推理能力,卻未必帶來更可信的自我報告。本研究限制在於語言涵蓋範圍有限,作者未來將擴及中文等更多語言,並發展對齊文字判定與內部信念的方法;此結論對多語言情境下的可靠性評估深具參考價值。
papers.title: More Capable, Less Faithful: A Multilingual Analysis of Mathematical (Un)Solvability Detection in LLMs
papers.title_zh: 能力更強、忠實度更低:LLM 數學(不)可解性偵測之多語言分析

links.title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection

evidence: Abstract: 'surpassing full-dataset fine-tuning while using only 25% of the LLaVA-1.5-665K data' and 'DICS reaches 94.52% of the official InternVL3-8B-Instruct performance using less than 25% of its reported training data'; code link https://github.com/cqu-student/DICS

Section 3.1 Eq. 1-3: VIC defined as exponential of token-weighted cross-entropy loss difference between predicting response with and without the image, with POS-based token weights detailed in Appendix A.1
Section 3.2 Eq. 4-6 and Appendix A.3: RIC as inverse prediction of the instruction from the response; DIC = min(VIC, RIC)
Section 5.4 Table 5: ablations show VIC only 101.02%, RIC only 97.60%, Sum 98.61%, Product 98.84%, full DICS 101.40% relative performance at 25% ratio
Section 5.4 Table 6: FPS (101.40%) vs Top-K (100.40%) vs Hierarchical (101.39%) selection strategies for DICS
Appendix C.1 Table 10: 5-run statistics, DICS 46.97±0.04 vs strongest baseline PRISM 45.18±0.05 for Table 1 setting, gaps claimed to exceed standard deviations
Section 5.3 Table 4: on DICS-6M, best result is at 85% sampling ratio (103.10% relative), and 5.1M samples achieve 94.52% of official InternVL3-8B-Instruct (109.08%) trained on 21.7M
Section 5.3 Table 3 / Appendix C.2 Table 11: cross-architecture transfer, LLaVA-1.5-7B selector boosts Qwen2-VL-7B to 101.25% and LLaVA-1.5-13B to 101.79%
Appendix C.3 Table 15: Spearman correlation between DIC quantiles and quality ratings is rho=0.27 (human) and rho=0.20 (VLM judge), p<0.001, described as 'broadly aligned'
Section 6 Limitations: 'our consistency evaluation currently focuses on image-text data, excluding modalities like video or audio'
Appendix C.4 Table 17: DICS total pipeline 14.0h (12.0h selection + 2.0h LoRA training) vs 15.0h full fine-tuning on LLaVA-665K with 8 A100s
Section 5.1: training uses LoRA on 8 A100-40GB for LLaVA-1.5 and full fine-tuning on 32 GPUs for InternVL3; scoring model warmed up on 5% random subset, warm-up checkpoint discarded

Section 2.2: acknowledges recent works on image-text consistency 'rely on expensive external LLMs... or only consider unidirectional alignment', citing Lee and Hwang (2026) arXiv:2602.17186 on visual information gain
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal-LLM data-selection paper (visual instruction tuning for LLaVA-1.5, Qwen2-VL, InternVL3) that is squarely within the multimodal AI / training-optimization / data-curation preference cluster, though it is not a pure-LLM or reasoning paper. Methodologically it extends text-only loss-differential selection (IFD) to multimodal settings via VIC (loss with/without image) and an inverse-prediction RIC combined with min-fusion and adaptive FPS; the paper itself cites closely related visual-information-gain work (Section 2.2, Lee & Hwang 2026), making the contribution an incremental extension rather than a new paradigm. Rigor is strong: 12 benchmarks, 9 baselines, component ablations (Table 5), selection-strategy ablations (Table 6), 5-run statistics (Table 10), controlled-corruption AUC (Table 14), and honest reporting of weak human-judge correlation (rho=0.27 human, 0.20 VLM, Table 15). Evidence supports modest but statistically separated gains (101.40% vs full at 25% data; DICS-6M best at 85% ratio, 103.10%), though headline claims like '94.52% of InternVL3-8B-Instruct' are data-efficiency framing rather than matching the official model. Generalizability is demonstrated across datasets, architectures, ratios, and weak-to-strong selector transfer, but is limited to image-text by the authors' own admission (Limitations). Reproducibility is good (algorithms, prompts, hyperparameters, VLMEvalKit protocol, code link), with the caveat that DICS-6M and trained models are only promised 'in the near future'. Not out-of-scope: it has substantial language-model methodology (loss-based scoring, POS token weighting, prompt-based inverse prediction), so it is not capped.

primary_link.title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection

papers.summary: Visual instruction tuning is crucial for advancing the vision-language alignment and instruction-following capabilities of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, identifying optimal subsets under a fixed ratio constraint from rapidly expanding datasets remains a significant bottleneck. While existing methods largely depend on distribution diversity or heuristic filtering, they often overlook the internal coherence within individual samples. To bridge this gap, we propose Data Intrinsic Consiste
papers.summary_zh: 視覺指令微調資料快速膨脹,在固定預算下為視覺語言模型(VLM)挑選最佳子集合是重要瓶頸。論文提出樣本層級自評分指標「資料內在一致性」(DIC):視覺資訊一致性(VIC)以有無影像時的加權交叉熵損失差異,衡量影像對回應的資訊增益;回應資訊一致性(RIC)採反向預測,評估回應能否協助還原原始指令;取兩者最小值為 DIC 分數,確保影像、指令與回應三方緊密對齊。據此提出 DICS 選樣法,結合 DIC 排名與最遠點取樣(FPS)的自適應策略,依比例兼顧品質與多樣性。實驗顯示,LLaVA-1.5-665K 僅用 25% 資料微調即超越全量訓練,相對效能 101.40%,並在 Vision-FLAN、Qwen2-VL-7B 與 LLaVA-1.5-13B 展現跨資料集與跨架構遷移能力;作者另建立 600 萬筆 DICS-6M 語料,於 InternVL3-8B 以 85% 選樣超越全量基線 3.10%,並以 5.1M 資料(官方為 21.7M)達成官方 InternVL3-8B-Instruct 約 94.52% 效能。消融實驗確認 VIC、RIC、最小值融合與 POS 詞權重皆屬必要;控制性破壞及人類/VLM 評分也支持指標與品質正相關。目前僅涵蓋影像與文字模態,未來擬延伸至影片、音訊,並從剔除轉向主動修復低分樣本。評分僅需推論且成本隨資料規模線性成長,對大規模多模態資料策展深具實用價值。
papers.title: DICS: Exploring Data Intrinsic Consistency for Visual Instruction Selection
papers.title_zh: DICS:探索資料內在一致性以進行視覺指令選擇

links.title: Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs

evidence: Abstract: claims ~89% LLM-judge validity, ~90% exact-match condition accuracy, 99–100% guaranteed-valid JSON at roughly half the per-rule prompt tokens; bridge lift of +24 judge-validity points on GPT-5.3-chat with an ~8-point frontier gap persisting.

Sec 2 Benchmark: '635-rule benchmark spanning seven structural families' that is 'manufactured synthetic data' from programmatically generated templates with injected spelling errors and non-English entity values; Data Availability: 'The evaluation data and the platform's vocabulary are proprietary'.

Sec 5.5 / Appendix D Table 4: paired McNemar on n=635; GPT-5.3-chat Selector+IR beats monolithic by +24.3 points, p<10^-3; Opus gains small/negative on some cells (scorer-strictness on canonical combiner nesting disclosed).

Sec 5.6 / Appendix D Table 5: TOST at pre-specified ±5 margin — GPT-5.3-chat Selector+IR vs GPT-5.2 monolithic Δ+0.8, 90% CI [-2.0,+3.6], p_TOST=0.007; vs Opus 4.6 only near-parity (equivalent at ±7); GPT-4.1 rejected at ±5 (needs ±12), argued as discriminant validity.

Sec 5.2 / Appendix B Table 3: node-set 98.4–99.8% (GPT-5.2) and 99.5–100% (Opus 4.6) vs node-exact markedly lower (GPT-5.3-chat 62.5→82.8 under Selector+IR), supporting the emission-not-interpretation localization without the LLM judge.

Sec 5.1 / Appendix A / Appendix H: judge is Claude Opus 4.6 with self-preference bias bounded three ways; blind author-labeled 100-item verdict-balanced sample shows 91% agreement, combined κ=0.82, with annotator overlap of only 22 items.

Sec 5.7 Table 2: per-rule tokens fall from 21,264 (monolithic) to 11,980 (Selector+IR) on GPT-5.3-chat (0.56×); Appendix G discloses Selector→JSON is more expensive (~1.08–1.12×) and not a clean single-variable ablation.

Sec 5.9 / Appendix E: error taxonomy over 2,348 failing cells — completeness/syntax errors roughly halve (12.6→5.7, 8.3→3.7 per 100) while ordering errors (49.5% of failures) persist, 'externalizing emission converts omission errors into mis-ordering errors'.

Sec 8 / Sec 6 Generality: cross-domain transfer (ETL, agent tool-graphs, CI pipelines) and a similarity-based candidate prefilter are described as planned/untested ('planned similarity-based candidate prefilter'), with no experiments outside the proprietary routing platform.

Appendix D 'Single-run scope': every cell is one temperature-0 generation; intervals capture rule-sampling and scorer uncertainty but not decode or prompt-paraphrase variance — the main residual threat acknowledged by the authors.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM structured-generation paper (not a capped pure domain application: it contributes general NL→structured methodology — an emission-density diagnostic, an IR+deterministic-compiler split, retrieval-based registry selection, and LLM-judge evaluation practices — beyond its contact-center deployment). Preference match is strong: LLMs, reasoning vs non-reasoning models, few-shot prompting, retrieval/registry selection, workflow automation, structured output. Rigor is unusually careful for an industry study: paired McNemar tests on n=635, pre-specified TOST equivalence at ±5 with a demonstrated negative control (GPT-4.1 rejected), Wilson and scenario-clustered CIs, judge-independent Cond% corroboration, and a blind human-agreement check (κ=0.82). Honesty is high: the paper discloses single-run greedy scope, scorer-strictness artifacts, a confounded ablation, and a persistent ~8-point frontier gap. Main deductions: the 635-rule benchmark is manufactured synthetic template data on one proprietary platform with no cross-domain or real-rule validation, so the generalization claims (emission-density lens, target-agnostic compiler) are asserted rather than demonstrated; the IR+compiler pattern is an acknowledged instance of known neuro-symbolic/workflow-generation work, so novelty is moderate; and data, schemas, and prompts are proprietary with no code release, keeping reproducibility low.
topics: non-reasoning vs reasoning model gap bridging
LLM-as-judge evaluation and TOST equivalence testing

primary_link.title: Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs

papers.summary: This paper addresses the problem of translating natural-language routing rules written by business administrators into executable workflow graphs for enterprise contact centers. Each target is a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of conditional actions with parallel branches, hit-first fallback chains, and per-branch Boolean predicates, encoded in the JSON dialect of a commercial routing platform. We show that neuro-symbolic decomposition enables lower-cost, non-reasoning large language models to gene
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討企業客服中心的實際需求：將管理師以自然語言撰寫的路由規則，自動轉譯為可執行的工作流程圖——含條件述詞、平行分支與 hit-first 後備鏈的 JSON 有向無環圖（DAG）。作者診斷出純 LLM 失敗的根源是「輸出密度瓶頸」：模型幾乎總能讀懂規則並選對動作節點，但隨著一次必須輸出的相依節點增多，屬性值與布林結構便開始遺漏或錯接。對應的解方是架構性而非擴大模型：LLM 先以學習式選取器挑出所需 registry 條目，再把規則改寫成精簡的中間表示（IR，採 YAML 降低結構語法負擔），最後由決定性編譯器展開為保證合法的 JSON。在 635 條合成規則基準上，系統達到約 89% LLM 評審效度、約 90% 精確條件吻合率、99–100% JSON 合法性，token 成本約為單體式提示（monolithic prompt）的一半。最關鍵的「鴻溝橋接」結果：GPT-5.3-chat 套用此架構後評審效度提升 24.3 分，並於 ±5 分邊界的 TOST 等價檢定下統計上追平 GPT-5.2 的單體提示品質、接近 Opus 4.6；但推理模型同樣採用此法時，約 8 分的前沿差距仍存在。限制包括：最弱的 GPT-4.1 無法橋接；DAG 邊序錯誤佔失敗近半且幾乎未改善；recurring-timer 家族約四成規則仍失準；基準為專有合成資料，且每格僅單次貪婪解碼。本文示範平價非推理模型在架構設計得當時，可達生產等級的結構化生成品質。
papers.title: Generating Workflow DAGs from Natural Language with Non-Reasoning LLMs
papers.title_zh: 以非推理型 LLM 從自然語言生成工作流程 DAG

links.title: Local-to-Global Sentence-Level Graph Reranking for Scientific Synthesis

evidence: Abstract: proposes LoG-Reranker, a local-to-global sentence-level graph reranking framework for scientific synthesis with role-aware local scoring and sentence-graph global refinement.
Section 4 (Baselines): compares against nine baselines in four families (Cross-Encoder, LLM-Based, Fine-Grained, Graph-Based) using the same OS-8B generator and top-10 input setting.
Table 1: LoG-Reranker achieves the best result in 14 of 15 task-metric reranking comparisons, e.g., MAP 67.85 vs 66.49 (CoRank) on SciFact and 30.46 vs 29.15 (SentGraph) on Scholar-Multi.
Table 2: LoG-Reranker obtains the best task-specific generation score and citation F1 on all seven benchmarks, e.g., Rub-Acc 62.44 and Cite 39.42 on Scholar-CS.
Table 3 (Ablation): w/o Local causes the largest degradation (coverage -0.360 average), w/o Global reduces organization by 0.344 on average; w/o Structured underperforms in all 12 comparisons.
Table 10 (Efficiency): 152.5M parameters, 2.426s latency, 3.21GB memory; 2.6x faster than ChainRAG and 40.2x faster than SentGraph with 3387.3 unique relation pairs vs 2085.9/780.6.
Appendix C (Random Seeds): three seeds 13/42/2027; reranking metric std 0.09-0.47, generation Rub-Score std at most 0.011, indicating robustness.

Appendix B: training supervision is generated via Qwen3-Max API annotation (2,138,904 retained sentences, 256,896 passages) with UniFAR role distributions; manual quality check (Table 7) covers only 30 instances and 45 role samples.

Appendix D (Input Length): LoG uses 3173 input tokens on ScholarQA-CS vs ~6600-6800 for passage-level baselines while achieving the best Rub-Acc and citation scores; RECOMP/EXIT show very short inputs hurt quality.

Limitation signal: no code or data release statement appears anywhere in the document, and cross-passage edge construction depends on a pretrained UniFAR facet model, constraining out-of-domain generalization.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Solid, in-scope RAG/reranking paper for LLM-based scientific synthesis. Preference relevance is strong for RAG & Knowledge and NLP, moderate for LLMs (LLMs are used as annotator Qwen3-Max and generator OS-8B, but the contribution is a 152.5M reranker, not an LLM method; no match for Japanese, reasoning, or agent preferences). Novelty is incremental: it combines sentence-level reranking (EXIT/DSLR line), graph-based reranking (SentGraph/ChainRAG line), and role/facet typing (UniFAR) into a new local-to-global framework; the typed role-transition edges and intent-role compatibility are new details but not a fundamental advance. Rigor is high: 9 baselines in 4 families (Section 4), controlled generator, reranking and generation metrics, component-wise ablations (Table 3) plus 10 detailed ablations (Table 12), hyperparameter sensitivity (Table 9), and 3-seed variance (Appendix C). Evidence is consistent and non-trivial: best in 14/15 reranking comparisons (Table 1), best generation score and citation F1 on all seven tasks (Table 2), better quality with ~half the input tokens of passage baselines (Table 11). Concerns: supervision labels are Qwen3-Max pseudo-labels with small-sample manual validation (30 instances, Table 7), potential train/eval proximity between OpenScholar training data and ScholarQABench is not explicitly discussed, LLM-judge (Prometheus) metrics dominate generation evaluation, gains are modest in absolute terms, and no code/data release is stated; dependence on the pretrained UniFAR scientific role model (Appendix B) limits transfer beyond scientific text.

primary_link.title: Local-to-Global Sentence-Level Graph Reranking for Scientific Synthesis

papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented scientific synthesis aims to answer complex research questions by integrating information from multiple papers into comprehensive and well-grounded responses. Since the generator can only synthesize the information selected and organized by the reranker, the quality of the generated synthesis depends critically on the reranked results. However, most rerankers operate at the passage level, which leaves key methodological, empirical, and comparative information buried in long a
papers.summary_zh: 本論文處理檢索增強(RAG)科學合成中的重排序瓶頸:多數 reranker 只在段落層級挑選文件,方法、實證與比較等關鍵細節易埋沒於冗長扁平的上下文,且查詢—候選獨立評分忽略候選間的互補、脈絡與對比關係,削弱生成答案的紮實度與覆蓋度。作者提出 LoG-Reranker,以局部到全域的句子級圖重排序因應:局部階段以角色感知方式預測查詢意圖與句子功能(背景、方法、結果),結合上下文表徵計算細粒度相關分數;全域階段建構句子圖,以段落內角色型相鄰邊與跨段落同角色相似邊進行關係感知的圖注意力編碼,精修整體排序;最後將高分句子連同其鄰居組成結構化上下文交給生成器。訓練資料取自 OpenScholar 的 25,915 個 QA 實例,由 Qwen3-Max 標註句子與段落排名,並以 UniFAR 補充角色分布。在 ScholarQABench 上,本模型於 15 項重排序比較中 14 項最佳,並在七個生成任務全面取得最高任務指標與 citation F1;其輸入長度少於段落級基準,僅 152.5M 參數、每查詢約 2.4 秒,比 ChainRAG 快約 2.6 倍。限制包括 QASA 的 nDCG 略遜於最佳基準、監督訊號依賴 LLM 偽標籤,效能亦受相似度門檻與鄰居數等圖建構超參數影響。整體而言,此工作顯示句子級、關係感知的重排序能為文獻回顧與研究探索提供更可信、更全面的合成品質。
