links.title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark

evidence: Section 6.1 / Table 4: on the same 398 dense-retrieval rows, Qwen3.5-2B's measured fine-tuning gain is +50.0% under exact-line parsing but +3.0% under constrained A/B/C/D logit scoring, and the two methods reverse the Gemma-4-E2B comparison (+10.1% vs −2.5%).

Section 6.2 / Table 2: five of six reference models gain 14.7–19.3% strict-consistency accuracy when the governing provision is supplied among four same-act distractors; Section 6.2/Table 12 shows accuracy falls 8.0–15.3% when that provision is withheld.

Section 6.4 / Table 11: difference-in-differences estimates for increased reliance on supplied law after fine-tuning range −1.8% to +5.1% with every 95% CI including zero, supporting the paper's null claim.

Section 5 'Statistical analysis': 10,000 question-grouped bootstrap intervals and two-sided exact McNemar tests with Holm correction across 12 tests per model; Table 13 reports counts behind all cells at or below 5% to expose limited precision.

Appendix J 'Reproducibility': anonymous repository with corpus, per-item outputs, frozen retrieval bundle, contract and prompt SHA-256 digests identical across all eight checkpoint executions, and reproduce.py running 21 bundled analyses in about one minute without GPU.

Limitations section: benchmark is 199 questions from two examination years in one jurisdiction; five-candidate training remains untested; contamination cannot be ruled out; English translations had no legal-expert review (Appendix H/I audit is model-based with planted-error sensitivity checks).
Section 3.2 / Table 1: 150-item supplied-law control drafted by GPT-5.6-Luna, author-checked with 20 items removed, and two independent legally trained reviewers confirmed every retained answer key.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A carefully executed LLM evaluation-methodology paper on bilingual Bangladesh legal QA that credibly separates scorer, retrieval, and model-context-use effects. It matches the LLM (2.5) and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8) preferences well, and RAG/Prompting/Training partially, but misses the highest-weight Japanese LLM & NLP (2.5) and Agents (2.5) preferences entirely, and its legal-domain testbed keeps it from pure core-method status, so relevance stays mid-range. Novelty is moderate: CircularEval and option-ID scoring are adopted unchanged; the supplied-law control with provision withholding and the fine-tuning difference-in-differences framing are the genuinely new pieces. Rigor is exceptional: a hash-frozen pre-specified contract, three LoRA seeds per model, exact McNemar with Holm correction, item-clustered bootstrap, sparse-cell reporting, planted-error translation audit, and contamination checks. Evidence strongly supports the scoped claims, including the honest null that fine-tuning does not increase provision reliance (all control DiD CIs include zero), though only 199 independent items in one jurisdiction limit power and external validity. The measurement lesson generalizes; the specific empirical findings are deliberately bounded. Reproducibility is excellent (anonymous repo, per-item outputs, manifests, one-command re-analysis).

primary_link.title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark

papers.summary: Fine-tuning can improve legal question-answering accuracy without improving how models use law supplied in context. We study this distinction in bilingual Bangladeshi legal QA, where observed errors can arise from answer scoring, retrieval, or failure to use relevant law. We construct a hierarchy-preserving statutory corpus, 2,165 reviewed bilingual fine-tuning examples, and a 150-item supplied-law control. We evaluate six instruction-tuned models: Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.2-3B, Qwen3.5-0.8B, Qwen3
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討:fine-tuning 提升法律選擇題準確率,是否代表模型更會使用脈絡中提供的法條?作者指出錯誤可能來自三個環節——評分方式誤讀答案、檢索漏掉相關條文、模型未使用已在眼前的條文——混同將高估微調的法律適應效果。團隊建構保留階層結構的孟加拉成文法語料、2,165 筆經審核的雙語微調範例,以及 150 題保證關鍵法條在場的對照題組;以 Llama-3.2-1B/3B、Qwen3.5-0.8B/2B/4B、Gemma-4-E2B 六個模型各訓三個 LoRA adapter,結合受限選項字母評分(直接讀 A/B/C/D logits)、須在四種選項順序皆答對的嚴格一致性,以及受控移除關鍵法條。結果:在 398 筆 Bar Council 試題上,逐行解析器宣稱 Qwen3.5-2B adapter 進步 50.0%,改用選項評分僅剩 3.0%;Gemma-4-E2B 的比較更在兩種評分法下方向相反。當關鍵法條保證在場時,六個模型中五個提升 14.7%–19.3%;移除該條文使準確率下降 8.0%–15.3%,顯示模型確實依賴它;但差異中的差異估計顯示微調未增加這種依賴。限制:僅涵蓋單一司法管轄區 199 題;訓練供一條、評估供五條的轉移未經直接測試;無法排除預訓練資料污染;英文翻譯未經法律專家審查。其價值在示範可遷移的測量流程:宣稱法律適應之前,應先分離評分器、檢索器與模型本身的失誤。
papers.title: Do Small Models Use the Law You Give Them? Measuring Context Use on a Bilingual Bangladesh Legal Benchmark
papers.title_zh: 小模型會使用你給它的法律嗎?在雙語孟加拉法律基準上衡量脈絡使用

links.title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents

llm_evaluation.rationale: A position/framework paper on LLM-based persistent agent architecture. Topic relevance is very high: Sections 1 and 4 define an architecture for language agents (perception, control plane, lifecycle task packages), Section 4.3 specifies an action space (sensing, dispatching, instantiation, reasoning, retrieval, updating, grounding), and Sections 4.4-4.5 cover task-level decision-making in the style of ReAct/Tree of Thoughts plus memory and self-improvement of agent harnesses and source code — directly matching high-weight agent, LLM, reasoning, and memory preferences. Novelty is moderate: Section 1 introduces the 'agents in the small vs. agents in the large' framing and the episodic vs. lifecycle task distinction (Section 3.3), but Section 2 explicitly builds on DeRemer & Kron (1976), Hayes-Roth (1995) active perception, and Section 7 acknowledges CoALA, AIOS, and autonomic computing as close precedents, so the contribution is a synthesis rather than a new mechanism. Rigor is limited by the absence of any empirical, formal, or simulation-based validation: Section 5 is a purely illustrative hypothetical case study and Table 1 (Section 5.2) is a qualitative comparison of Plan-and-Act, A-MEM, PaLM-E, ContextAgent, and Pera; there is no limitations section and no implementation. Evidence strength is weak: the only quantitative-sounding claims (Section 1, 'effective task horizons remain much shorter... progress often plateaus') cite external work (Starace et al. 2025; Kwa et al. 2026) rather than presenting results, and no quantitative results, baselines, or ablations exist anywhere in the document. Generalizability is comparatively strong: the framework is architecture-level and Section 5.2/Table 1 retrospectively organizes systems across computer-use, memory-augmented, embodied, and proactive agent classes, and Section 6 spans sensing, signal representation, context learning, proactivity, lifecycle control, self-improvement, and evaluation. Reproducibility is low: there is no code, artifact, or availability statement; only the conceptual description (e.g., lifecycle task package elements in Section 4.2) could guide reimplementation. Overall ~0.68.

primary_link.title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents

papers.summary: Cognitive language agents have achieved substantial progress by equipping language models with memory, tools, and decision-making procedures, enabling agents to reason and act in interactive environments. Existing frameworks largely cast these agents as systems for solving user-specified, bounded tasks. An increasingly important goal is for language agents to provide persistent assistance in long-lived settings where user needs, context, and service procedures persist and change, and to remain u
papers.summary_zh: 這篇立場論文探討語言代理從解決單一任務走向長期持續服務的架構轉變。作者指出，現有認知型語言代理皆圍繞使用者指定的有限任務設計，屬於「小型代理」；但在需求、脈絡與服務程序長期演變的環境中，代理必須持續感知變化並主動調適，才能提供持久協助，然而目前缺乏刻劃此類代理的理論框架。論文借鑑軟體工程從「小型程式設計」到「大型程式設計」的歷史轉變，以及Hayes-Roth的主動感知概念，提出Pera架構：以感知元件持續擷取來自環境、任務執行與內部脈絡的訊號，控制平面則解讀訊號並形成「生命週期任務」套件，用以檢視脈絡、修訂程序或預備新興需求。Pera區分追求明確成果的片段式任務與維護未來服務的生命週期任務，並以共用運算叢集上模型開發工作負載的個案研究，比較Plan-and-Act、A-MEM、PaLM-E與ContextAgent等系統，說明僅有記憶或外部感知仍不足以維持跨任務的服務狀態。論文據此整理近年相關研究並提出可行方向，包括調適性感知、訊號表示、脈絡學習、主動性校準、生命週期控制與安全的自我改進等。本文屬概念性架構，未提供實證評估，訊號解讀與感測強度選擇等挑戰仍有待解決，但它為「大型代理」研究提供了統一的組織視角與發展藍圖。
papers.title: Agents in the Large: Perception-Centered Architecture for Persistent Agents
papers.title_zh: 大型代理：以感知為中心的持久性代理架構

links.title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering

evidence: Abstract: 'Hi-Q reaches 52.3 EM and 64.0 F1 averaged over the three benchmarks, ahead of the iterative retrieval baseline IRCoT by 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1' under full-corpus retrieval.
Section 4.1: 1,000 validation questions per dataset over complete corpora (139,416 to 5,233,235 passages); 'paired question-level bootstrap... using 10,000 resamples and 95% percentile intervals.'
Section 4.2: 'Every improvement over IRCoT and PropRAG is significant... 19 of the 22 EM and F1 tests at p<10^-4'; smallest margin (3.2 F1) reaches p=0.0033.
Section 4.4 Table 6: w/o dependency-aware decomposition drops average EM/F1 from 57.9/69.3 to 47.1/56.0; always-decompose trigger drops to 57.3/68.5 but only on 'N=100 sampled queries'.

Section 4.3: 'we manually analyze 100 randomly sampled a=⊥ triggers on MuSiQue', giving 10% false-trigger rate; FRR=11% on 100 normal queries and FAR=2% on 50 adversarial unanswerable queries (Table 5).
Appendix D: Adaptive-RAG routes '959 of the 1,000 questions... to multi-step retrieval' and the always-multi-step constant control outscores it (27.3 vs 26.4 EM on MuSiQue-full).
Appendix I: closed-book GPT-4o-mini control scores 13.1 EM / 21.7 F1 on MuSiQue; strict evidence-grounded variant matches Hi-Q (47.6 vs 47.5 EM), supporting that gains come from evidence acquisition.
Section 4.5 Table 8: cost-matched Hi-Q uses 2.93 LLM calls and 4.8s latency vs IRCoT's 2.92 calls and 6.4s, with a 10.4 EM / 11.6 F1 macro-averaged improvement (paired bootstrap, all p≤0.0036).

Appendix N Limitations: 'Our experiments establish performance on English, Wikipedia-derived, passage-based short-answer multi-hop QA'; cyclic or jointly-optimized dependencies are 'outside what the current state representation models'.

Appendix O provides full prompt templates for all operators (resolution, decomposition, verifier, refinement, synthesis); Abstract lists project page https://hi-q-project.github.io/ but no explicit code/data release statement appears in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/RAG/multi-hop reasoning paper squarely within preferred topics (RAG & knowledge, reasoning/decomposition, LLM readers, agentic retrieval baselines). Methodology is a competent combination of known ingredients (iterative retrieval, query decomposition, self-verification) but the evidence-conditioned stop/expand control with a cost-threshold derivation and explicit contrast against query-only routing (Adaptive-RAG) is a genuinely useful reframing. Rigor is unusually strong: two retrieval regimes, bootstrap significance (19/22 tests p<1e-4), component ablations, reader and embedder substitutions, cost-matched comparison, learned-controller and constant-policy controls, closed-book and strict-grounding controls. Evidence is solid though some key diagnostics rest on small author-annotated samples (100 triggers, 50 adversarial) and the always-decompose ablation uses only 100 queries; PropRAG is missing on HotpotQA-full. Generalizability is limited to English Wikipedia short-answer multi-hop QA, which the authors candidly acknowledge. Reproducibility is decent (Algorithm 1, full prompts, hyperparameters, project page) but no explicit code/data release is stated and results depend on API models.

primary_link.title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering

papers.summary: A central bottleneck in multi-hop Question Answering (QA) is that the granularity at which a question is expressed often differs from the granularity at which corpus evidence is retrievable. Existing methods address this mismatch by imposing fixed graph structures over the corpus, by iteratively reformulating the query, or by executing a generated program over it, but these strategies do not explicitly decide when a query unit is already supported by evidence and when it should be refined. We fo
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討多跳問答(multi-hop QA)的核心瓶頸:問題的表達粒度常與語料庫中證據可被檢索的粒度不一致,使得單次檢索、Graph RAG 與疊代式檢索各自失靈。作者提出 Hi-Q,一個以證據為條件的階層式查詢精煉框架:在每個查詢節點上,解析運算子先檢驗檢索證據是否足以回答該查詢,已解決的節點即終止;未解決的節點才由二元分解運算子展開,先解決前置子查詢再處理依賴分支,並由語意覆蓋驗證器確認分割未遺漏或偏移原意。查詢樹的拓撲由語料庫支持訊號決定,而非固定分解模板或預建圖形,且無需全語料庫建圖。在 MuSiQue、HotpotQA 與 2WikiMultiHopQA 的全語料庫檢索設定下,Hi-Q 平均達 52.3 EM 與 64.0 F1,領先 IRCoT 15.1 EM / 18.2 F1,並在 MuSiQue-full 上超越 PropRAG 11.5 EM / 12.0 F1;在受控設定中亦以 57.9 EM / 69.3 F1 領先。診斷顯示未解決訊號的誤觸發率約 10%,消融實驗證明階層式分解、依賴感知與觸發策略各具貢獻;在與 IRCoT 成本相當的設定下,Hi-Q 更省且更準。限制方面,評估僅涵蓋英文維基百科短答型任務,依賴結構需為可逐支解決的無環形式,系統亦仰賴 LLM 模組的可靠性,且二元訊號無法表達部分或衝突證據。本文的意義在於把查詢粒度視為可控變數,說明多跳檢索的關鍵不在於抓取更多文件,而在於找到每個推理步驟可被檢索且可被回答的粒度。
papers.title: Hi-Q: Hierarchical Evidence-guided Query Refinement for Multi-Hop Question Answering
papers.title_zh: Hi-Q:針對多跳問答(Multi-Hop QA)的階層式證據引導查詢精煉框架

links.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs

evidence: Abstract and Sec. 1: propose cross-temperature bipartite semantic agreement; low-T anchors vs high-T probes with NLI entailment weights
Sec. 7.3 / Appendix A.2 Table 3: AvgSqSim is 'numerically identical to BiG-SURE' and aggregation choice 'carries little value'; Top-1/Top-2 spectral variants nearly identical
Table 2: SURE best average AUROC in 6/7 groups, e.g., Trivia-QA 0.753±0.017 vs Deg 0.722±0.007; OK-VQA 0.752±0.014 vs SNNE 0.735±0.016; SciQ-fr is the exception (LexSim 0.608 vs SURE 0.590)
Sec. 5.2: fixed M=3, N=10, T_L=0.1, T_H=1.0 across all models/tasks; probes from 5 augmentations x2 samples; image perturbations (blur, ±10° rotation, Gaussian noise)
Appendix A.4 Table 5: baselines rerun with N=13; SURE retains advantage (e.g., Trivia-QA avg 0.753 vs Deg 0.725)
Sec. 9 Limitations: consistency-based overconfidence on consistent wrong answers, textual-only similarity ignores image grounding, QA-only scope, small-scale human validation
Sec. 7.5: Gemini-2.5-Flash judge agrees with 10-annotator consensus on 90-95% (κ 0.80-0.90) on 20 samples/language; rephrase equivalence 20/20 in en and ja
Project/GitHub links given (iiscleap/BiG-SURE); entailment backends are public HF models (deberta-large-mnli, mDeBERTa-v3-base-xnli) and prompts in Appendix A.6
llm_evaluation.rationale: Black-box uncertainty/abstention estimation for LLMs and VLMs is squarely relevant to LLM methodology, hallucination/reliability, safety-evaluation, and multimodal preferences (Japanese appears only as one of four SciQ languages, so the Japanese-LLM preference is marginal). The cross-temperature anchor-probe idea is a genuine but incremental departure from fixed-temperature semantic-entropy methods, and the paper itself concedes the 'spectral' score is numerically identical to a mean-squared-similarity strawman and that 'the specific aggregation method used in SURE carries little value' (Sec. 7.3), trimming novelty. Rigor is solid: 7 baselines, 11 models, 5 seeds with std, matched-inference-budget rerun (Appendix A.4), augmentation/temperature/sample ablations, small-scale human checks of the LLM judge and rephrases (Sec. 7.5). Evidence is credible with consistent but modest AUROC gains (e.g., Trivia-QA 0.753 vs 0.722; OK-VQA 0.752 vs 0.735). Limitations (consistent-but-wrong overconfidence, NLI-backend dependence, QA-only scope) are candidly documented. Public code, fixed hyperparameters, named NLI backends, and full prompts support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs

papers.summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constr
papers.summary_zh: 在金融、法律與醫療等安全關鍵場景，大型語言模型（LLM）與視覺語言模型（VLM）的幻覺與誤判恐造成重大損失，可靠的不確定性估計遂成部署關鍵，尤其在無法存取內部狀態與 logits 的黑箱情境下更為困難。本文提出 BiG-SURE，一種基於跨溫度語意一致性的黑箱估計方法：以低溫取樣回應作為穩定錨點（anchors），以高溫取樣與語意等價輸入轉換（如問題改寫、輕度影像擾動）所得回應作為探針（probes），利用 NLI 蘊含機率建構錨點—探針二部圖，以鄰接矩陣的正規化平方頻譜能量作為信心分數，其補數即為不確定性。此分數無需監督、不需語意分群，並具備語意同一性、分離性與單調性等理論性質。實驗涵蓋 Trivia-QA、SVAMP 文字問答、四語 SciQ 多語問答與 OK-VQA 多模態問答，共十一個模型；BiG-SURE 在七個資料組中六項取得最佳平均棄答 AUROC，如 Trivia-QA 達 0.753、SVAMP 達 0.877，優於 DSE、圖論基線、KLE、SNNE 等方法，且在同等推論預算下仍領先。消融顯示輸入增廣與跨溫度比較為主要增益來源。限制包括依賴 NLI 相似度後端、無法偵測一致但錯誤的答案、未檢視影像 grounding，且人類驗證規模有限。整體而言，本法簡單、可解釋且免微調，適合安全關鍵應用的可靠性感知部署。
papers.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
papers.title_zh: BiG-SURE：運用跨溫度二部圖估計 LLM 之語意不確定性與可靠性

links.title: LLM-based Hardware Development with Hierarchical IRs and End-to-End Multi-Agent Workflow

evidence: Abstract: claims pass@5 of 95.5% on Verilog-Eval, 'surpasses current state-of-the-art LLM generation frameworks'
Sec 4.1 / Table 2: with GPT-5, ours 149/156 vs native GPT-5 146/156 and MAGE-with-GPT-5 146/156; a +3 improvement on single-module tasks
Sec 4.2 / Table 4: case study results ROME 0/7, MAGE 1/7, ours 7/7 with GPT-5 and GPT-5.4; 5/7 with Sonnet, 6/7 with Opus
Sec 4.2 / Table 5: sub-module pass rates 29/29 (ours) vs 19/29 (MAGE) and 16/29 (ROME); authors state 'We manually created golden testbenches' only for validation
Sec 4.3.1 / Table 6: ablations direct generate-k 1/7, direct repair-k 2/7, w/o Op. Spec. 2/7, w/o Arch. Sketch 5/7, full 7/7, with framework budget 22 calls/$1.22 vs relaxed 25/$1.30
Sec 4.3.2 / Table 7: multi-agent debug loop 29/29 sub-modules and 7/7 top-modules vs vanilla loop 26/29 and 4/7 (GPT-5, max 10 iterations)
Sec 4: evaluation models are API IDs 'gpt-5-2025-08-07', 'gpt-5.4', 'claude-sonnet-4-6', 'claude-opus-4-6'; synthesis via Synopsys Design Compiler with GlobalFoundries 22FDX 22nm library
Sec 4.2 / Table 3: case averages ~800s, ~82K tokens, ~780 LOC, ~1.4M cells vs Verilog-Eval maximum 10s / 1.5K tokens / 65 LOC / 5.4K cells
Sec 6 / Conclusion: no code, dataset, prompt, or artifact release is stated anywhere in the paper
Sec 4.1: on Verilog-Eval the framework 'omits' the Architectural Sketch and disables testbench generation and the debug loop, so benchmark gains reflect only the Operational Specification IR
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agentic LLM workflow paper (multi-agent planning, structured IRs, iterative multi-agent debug) applied to RTL/Verilog code generation, so it matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming) and is not in any excluded category. Rigor is above average: comparisons against ROME and MAGE re-run with the same LLM, budget-matched direct-generation/repair baselines (22 calls/$1.22 vs relaxed 25/$1.30), IR-removal ablations, and a debug-loop ablation (Sec 4.3). However, the headline case study is small (7 designs, 29 sub-modules), designed by the authors themselves, which risks alignment with the method; the standard Verilog-Eval gain is marginal (+3/156 over native GPT-5, Sec 4.1) with key framework components disabled there; no statistical significance testing; and verification ultimately relies on author-written golden testbenches. Evidence is mostly self-generated benchmarks plus synthesis statistics (Table 3: ~800s, ~82K tokens, ~1.4M cells average). Generalizability is limited to hardware/RTL, though the IR + decomposition recipe could transfer to other structured code domains. Reproducibility is weak: no code, prompts, or case-study release is mentioned, and evaluation depends on proprietary Synopsys/GF22FDX tooling and unverifiable future-dated model identifiers (gpt-5.4, claude-opus-4-6, Sec 4), undermining external verification.

primary_link.title: LLM-based Hardware Development with Hierarchical IRs and End-to-End Multi-Agent Workflow

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in software development, but their use in complex hardware design remains limited. This gap stems from both the scarcity of public hardware training data and the fundamentally different methodologies used in hardware design. In particular, applying LLMs to hardware requires more than direct RTL generation: the model must understand module boundaries, inter-module connections, and verification requirements. In this paper, we present an LLM-based
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）難以勝任複雜硬體設計的問題：公開硬體訓練資料稀缺，且硬體開發方法與軟體截然不同，直接生成多模組系統的 RTL 幾乎不可行。作者提出結合階層式中間表示（IR）與端對端多代理工作流程的框架。第一個 IR「Architectural Sketch」以 JSON 描述模組層級、實例與訊號連接；第二個 IR「Operational Specification」逐模組列舉操作、控制訊號、輸入輸出模式與功能語意，並搭配自動產生的軟體參考函數構建測試平台。生成階段採由下而上策略，先逐一驗證子模組再整合頂層；除錯採多代理迴圈，由不同代理挑選內部訊號、擷取波形、診斷根因並修正 RTL，同時維護除錯歷史以避免重蹈覆轍。結果顯示框架在 Verilog-Eval 達 pass@5 95.5%（149/156），優於原生 GPT-5 與 MAGE；於自建七個複雜個案（Beamformer、OFDM、CNN 加速器、RISC-V 處理器等）與 29 個子模組全數通過，而 ROME 僅 0/7、MAGE 僅 1/7。消融實驗證實兩個 IR 與多代理除錯各有貢獻：移除 Operational Specification 後僅剩 2/7，改用傳統自我反思除錯則頂層僅 4/7。限制包括個案平均約 780 行 RTL、合成後約 140 萬個電路單元，仍屬中小型設計，結果依賴特定頂級模型，PPA 最佳化尚未納入迴圈。此工作顯示結構化抽象與自動驗證可讓 LLM 邁向真實的端對端晶片設計。
papers.title: LLM-based Hardware Development with Hierarchical IRs and End-to-End Multi-Agent Workflow
papers.title_zh: 基於 LLM 的硬體開發：階層式中間表示與端對端多代理工作流程

links.title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs

evidence: Section 4.2, Tables 1-2: PAC attains the best curriculum average in both settings (e.g., 0.302 multi-level Qwen2.5-3B; 0.517/0.600 multi-domain 7B/32B), with reported gains of 13.1%/8.5% over SEC and 6.2%/1.9% over DUMP, mean ± std over three seeds but no significance tests.

Appendix C.2, Table 6 vs Section 4.3: 'Ours w/o prog' per-task scores (0.535, 0.387, 0.135, 0.214, 0.851) are identical to SEC's row in Table 2, its reported average 0.502 conflicts with the text's 9.5% improvement over w/o prog (which implies 0.472), indicating a data/reporting inconsistency.

Section 3.2-3.3 and Appendix A: utility is motivated by a first-order Taylor factorization (Eq. 3-4); Appendix A's theorem uses a '≲' bound and 'slowly varying' gradient-norm assumptions, so the advantage-as-learnability proxy is heuristic, not proven.

Appendix B.2, B.3, B.5, Table 3: full implementation detail (8 GPUs, B=256, G=8, mini-batch 64, T_cold=50, W=16, δ²=0.02, dataset splits and verifier types) supports reimplementation, but no code or dataset release is mentioned anywhere.

Limitations section: validation restricted to outcome-level verifiable rewards, task-level arms (3-9 arms), and backbones up to 32B; instruction following, dialogue, multilingual, safety, and prompt-level allocation are explicitly untested.

Section 4.3 and Appendix B.5: component ablations (w/o adv 3.0%, w/o prog 9.5%, w/o ts 4.2%) and history-window sweep W∈{4,16,32,64,128,256} (peak at W=16, 0.302) support the design, though ablations run only on one setting/model size.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on multi-task GRPO post-training with an online curriculum, strongly aligned with LLM/reasoning/RL preferences and not a pure domain application. Design is solid: two settings, three backbone sizes (3B/7B/32B), four baselines, three ablations, window sensitivity, and a mechanistic curriculum-dynamics analysis. Novelty is incremental: Thompson Sampling bandit task allocation and learning-progress signals are established (Matiisen 2020; Graves 2017; SEC Chen 2025; DUMP Wang 2025); the delta is the multiplicative fusion of advantage-derived learnability with normalized reward-slope progress plus variance inflation, and the motivating theory (Appendix A) is a loose '≲' bound under smoothness assumptions rather than a real guarantee. Evidence is weakened by an internal inconsistency: in Appendix C Table 6 the 'Ours w/o prog' per-task numbers (0.535/0.387/0.135/0.214/0.851) exactly duplicate SEC's row in Table 2 while its reported average (0.502) contradicts Section 4.3's 9.5% improvement claim, which implies 0.472; several margins are small (1.9% over DUMP at 32B vs avg std ±0.011-0.014) with three seeds and no significance testing. Hyperparameters are fully specified (B=256, G=8, T_cold=50, W=16, δ²=0.02, Algorithm 1, Table 3) but no code/data release is stated. Authors correctly limit scope to verifiable rewards, 3-9 arms, and reasoning/code/logic tasks.

primary_link.title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs

papers.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) is used to improve the reasoning abilities of LLMs, while training data span heterogeneous tasks. However, most RL post-training pipelines rely on fixed or manually designed task mixtures, even though task usefulness changes as training progresses. Online curriculum methods often define learnability by update magnitude, ignoring whether the update translates into reward gains, which can misallocate rollout budget toward tasks with large but ineffective updates. We pro
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對大型語言模型之多任務強化學習（RL）後訓練，研究如何在訓練過程中線上分配有限的 rollout 預算於異質任務。既有做法多依賴固定任務混合，或僅以優勢大小衡量任務可學性，忽略更新能否真正轉化為獎勵提升，導致資源誤投於更新大但報酬停滯的任務。作者提出 PAC（進度增強優勢課程），融合兩種訊號：由群組正規化優勢幅度估計的可學性，以及在歷史視窗內對任務平均獎勵進行線性迴歸所得的進度斜率；兩者相乘構成任務效用，再交由貝葉斯湯普森抽樣（Thompson Sampling）控制器維護各任務的高斯後驗，逐樣本抽樣組成批次，並以變異數膨脹維持探索與應對非平穩性，訓練初期另設均勻取樣的冷啟動階段。實驗涵蓋多層級推理（Countdown、Zebra、ARC）與多領域推理（數學、程式碼、K&K 邏輯謎題），使用 Qwen2.5-3B/7B/32B 驗證。結果顯示 PAC 以更少 rollout 步數即可達到最強基線水準，樣本效率提升約 1.2 至 1.6 倍，最終平均分數亦優於 SEC 與 DUMP 等基線；消融實驗指出獎勵進度訊號貢獻最大。限制包括：方法依賴結果級可驗證獎勵，稀疏或高雜訊獎勵需更穩健的趨勢估計；課程粒度限於任務層級；實證範圍以 32B 以下模型與至多九個任務臂為限。此研究證明有效的課程配置應同時追蹤更新潛力與獎勵轉換，對降低 RL 後訓練成本具實務價值。
papers.title: PAC: Progress-Augmented Advantage Curriculum for Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning of LLMs
papers.title_zh: PAC：適用於大型語言模型多任務強化學習的進度增強優勢課程

links.title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.3: three-stage framework fine-tunes an LLM (Qwen3-8B per Appendix C) and applies GRPO with composite trajectory rewards (hit rate, recall, category, diversity) to align generated styles with downstream sequence quality
Table 1 (Section 5.2): SemPOI-RL HR 0.0219 (Foursquare) / 0.0273 (Yelp) vs strongest baseline SPOT-Trip 0.0190 / 0.0248; text admits absolute exact-POI HR remains low for every method
Appendix F.1 (Table 8): 3-seed mean±std with paired t-tests, significant p<0.05 vs SPOT-Trip on HR, RR, ED, DTW on both datasets
Section 5.3 and Table 6: ablations w/o SFT (HR 0.0070 Foursquare), w/o SPAM, w/o RL all underperform the full model
Appendix E Table 7: w/o DIV slightly improves HR (0.0225 vs 0.0219 Foursquare; 0.0279 vs 0.0273 Yelp), partially contradicting the diversity-reward rationale in Section 4.3
Section 3 Problem Statement and Limitations: destination region and POI catalog occur in training data; no zero-shot evaluation on unseen cities; prototypes remain latent and only category-mediated
Appendix C: full training details (LoRA r=16, alpha=32, lr 2e-5 SFT / 5e-5 RL, four A100 GPUs); code claimed at https://github.com/Wind-Flipped/SemPOI-RL; prompt templates in Appendix H
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM-alignment paper (SFT + GRPO on Qwen3-8B with LoRA) that treats natural-language travel style as a trainable, reward-aligned interface for structured POI sequence generation. LLM methodology (RL alignment, prompting templates, interpretability of attention/prototypes) is central, so it does not fall under the explicit out-of-scope domains, though the target task is domain recommendation with low absolute HR (~0.02-0.03) and gains over the strongest baseline (SPOT-Trip) are modest. Novelty is moderate: a sensible alignment protocol combining known parts (MAE, prototype attention, GRPO) rather than a new architecture or algorithm. Rigor is above average: 10 baselines, ablations, hyperparameter sensitivity, 3-seed paired t-tests (p<0.05), efficiency analysis, and honest limitations (fixed catalogs, no zero-shot unseen cities). Evidence supports the main claims but effect sizes are small; the DIV reward slightly hurts HR (Table 7: 0.0225 w/o DIV vs 0.0219 default on Foursquare), and RM=1.0 is largely a byproduct of hard-constrained decoding, neither fully dissected. Generalizability is limited to one task, two datasets, and one backbone, with destination catalogs seen in training. Reproducibility is strong: code link, full hyperparameters (Appendix C), data protocol (Appendix A, Table 3), and prompt templates (Appendix H).

primary_link.title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong semantic reasoning and open-ended generation abilities, but aligning these abilities with structured sequential generation remains challenging. This challenge is particularly evident in out-of-town (OOT) POI sequence generation, where a model must infer transferable travel intent from a user's hometown behaviors, adapt to cross-city interest drift, and generate a coherent destination trajectory under structural constraints. Existing approaches either r
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討異地（out-of-town）POI 序列推薦的難題：模型必須從使用者在故鄉的打卡軌跡推論可遷移的旅行意圖，再為陌生城市生成結構完整的目的地行程，同時應對興趣漂移與結構約束。作者提出三階段框架 SemPOI-RL：第一階段以 supervised fine-tuning 訓練 LLM（Qwen3-8B），以自然語言推論目的地導向的旅行風格；第二階段設計 Semantic POI Alignment Module（SPAM），將風格嵌入分解成多個原型，並注入風格條件化的 masked autoencoder（MAE），逐位置對齊語意與軌跡生成；第三階段以 GRPO 強化學習，結合命中率、召回率、類別一致性與多樣性獎勵，使風格文字直接對齊下游序列品質。在 Foursquare 與 Yelp 兩個真實資料集上，SemPOI-RL 優於七種傳統方法與三種 LLM 基線，命中率較最強的非 LLM 基線約提升 15% 與 10%，類別匹配、編輯距離與 DTW 亦領先；消融實驗顯示移除 SFT 影響最大，多種子檢定與文字相似度分析支持其穩定性與可解釋性。限制包括：原型僅能透過 POI 類別間接解讀、評測設定假定已知起訖點與行程長度、目的地目錄固定而非零樣本泛化到未見城市，且多階段流程成本較高、絕對命中率仍偏低。此研究的價值在於將自然語言旅行風格視為可訓練且受強化學習對齊的介面，為 LLM 語意推理與結構化序列生成的銜接提供透明且可驗證的作法。
papers.title: SemPOI-RL: Aligning LLM Semantic Reasoning for Interpretable Out-of-Town POI Sequential Generation

links.title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents

evidence: Results, 'Performance of frontier agents in a single-round test': Claude median r=0.774 across five replicates vs best human strategy mean r=0.763; GPT r=0.655 and Gemini r=0.680 with neither exceeding the best human reference.
Results, 'Performance in single-round testing with prior knowledge': medians improved to r=0.781 (Claude), 0.760 (GPT), 0.751 (Gemini) after seeing the 14 human strategy descriptions and scores.

Methods, 'Agent configuration and regimes': 30 one-shot runs (three models x two conditions x five replicates); long-horizon testing limited to Claude Opus 4.7 'because of computational cost and throughput' (four 30-round runs).
Methods, 'CodonBox implementation': 'For each world, we ran Claude Opus 4.7 once, for 500 design rounds' - eight worlds, n=1 run per world, no replicates for the rule-discovery claims.

Results, 'Dry oracles with invented rules': rule discovery was 'assessed from the agent's stated hypotheses'; for the English-word cipher 'none of the three framings led the agent to consider that pairs of characters might encode letters'.
Discussion: notebook evaluation was done by human inspection, while 'this evaluation step can be automated by using independent AI judges' is proposed but not implemented or validated.

Methods, 'In silico MPRA oracle': Malinois damp oracle (776,474 training sequences) sealed from agents, with 'analysis of all session logs reveals that the agents studied here successfully obeyed these instructions'; Table 1 lists 14 hidden evaluation sets (5 empirical, 9 Malinois-labeled) with chromosome-level holdout.

Data and code availability: all sandbox code released at https://github.com/asr2210/science-sandbox; supplementary includes verbatim agent instructions, strategies.md baseline tables, and downstream-model training hyperparameters (Adam lr 3.27e-3, batch 512, up to 200 epochs).
llm_evaluation.rationale: The paper centrally evaluates frontier LLM agents (Claude Opus 4.7 in Claude Code, GPT-5.5 in Codex, Gemini 3.5 Flash in Gemini CLI) in closed-loop scientific experimentation, matching top-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use, Reasoning, LLMs, Evaluation) rather than being a pure biology application - the biology is the testbed, the object of study is agent scientific reasoning. The wet/damp/dry oracle taxonomy and invented-rule dry oracles (e.g., Fibonacci positions, English-word cipher) are a genuinely fresh way to separate score optimization from rule understanding. Rigor is solid for the one-shot regime (30 runs, 14 human baseline strategies x 5 seeds, 14 hidden eval sets with chromosome holdout, sealed oracles verified via session logs), but the headline claims about reasoning collapse rest on Claude-only long-horizon runs, a single run per CodonBox world, and subjective human reading of lab notebooks; the proposed AI-judge automation is not implemented. Quantitative one-shot results are concrete and well-reported; qualitative rule-discovery findings are anecdotal. Framework generality is asserted (BroadBox) but demonstrated only in two biology-adjacent settings. Code, agent instructions, and full hyperparameters are released, aiding reproducibility despite reliance on proprietary, non-deterministic frontier models.

primary_link.title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents

papers.summary: Scientific progress depends not only on finding solutions, but on learning the rules that explain why they work and using that understanding to design better experiments. We introduce science sandboxes, a framework for studying this capability in AI agents through repeated cycles of experimentation, feedback, and hypothesis revision. Science sandboxes invite an agent to query the natural world in different ways, ranging from "wet" physical experiments, to "damp" predictive models trained on empi
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出「科學沙盒」框架，衡量 AI 代理的科學能力：不只是能否最佳化指標，而是能否透過反覆實驗、回饋與假說修正，歸納出系統背後的規則。沙盒以濕式（實體實驗）、damp（以實證資料訓練的預測模型）與乾式（人為發明規則）三種神諭提供回饋，並據此建立兩個生物學沙盒。MPRAbox 要求代理從近乎無限的調節 DNA 序列空間中，挑選 5 萬條最有資訊價值的序列庫以訓練序列到活性模型，由隱藏神諭回報 14 個隱藏測試集的 Pearson 相關係數；CodonBox 則建構人為發明的遺傳世界，代理須從適應度分數推導隱藏的密碼子規則。單輪實驗中，Claude Opus 4.7 中位數達 r=0.774，超過最佳人類策略的 r=0.763，GPT-5.5 與 Gemini 3.5 Flash 較弱，但獲得人類策略成效的先驗資訊後明顯改善；30 輪長期實驗中，Claude 能依回饋修正假說、隔離單一變因，全部超越人類基準。然而面對乾式神諭（如英文單字密碼、費氏數列位置等人造規則），代理雖能拉高分數，卻幾乎無法推得真正的規則；CodonBox 最難的世界（6 字母、4 字元密碼子）亦未能復原通用映射，顯示其依賴熟悉生物先驗，遇到位置性、數學性邏輯便失效。限制包括濕式實驗昂貴、damp 模型繼承資料偏誤、乾式規則缺乏真實物理複雜度，且受測模型有限。科學沙盒將「最佳化分數」與「理解系統」區分開來，為測量並擴展 AI 的科學能力提供可控途徑。
papers.title: Science sandboxes measure the scientific capability of AI agents
papers.title_zh: 科學沙盒衡量 AI 代理的科學能力

Section 5, Evaluation: '100 randomly selected instances per domain were evaluated' with blind manual annotation; no significance tests or annotator agreement reported

Section 7.4, Tables 4-5: triplet-level filtering reduces generated triplets (e.g., ReAct FT 8B 3.32→2.79) and raises ReAct FT 8B accuracy from 62.5% to 70%

Section 7.2, Table 3: fashion trajectories grow 5,492→11,073 over 5 iterations; training stopped after the 6th iteration degraded performance; Prometheus score analysis restricted to fashion validation

Appendix A: baseline, ReAct, and Prometheus evaluation prompts provided; no code, model, or data availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong preference match: ReAct-style LLM agent combining reasoning trajectories, tool use, ICL prompting, LoRA fine-tuning, and LLM-as-judge filtering on a task-oriented dialogue benchmark — clearly in scope, not a pure domain application. However, the methodology is a competent assembly of known components (STaR-like trajectory harvesting, Prometheus-2 rejection filtering, iterative self-training) applied to TOD; the paper itself cites prior ReAct-for-TOD work [4], capping novelty. Rigor is reasonable but uneven: single dataset (SIMMC 2.1), only 100 manually evaluated instances per domain with no significance testing or inter-annotator agreement, SOTA baselines deliberately excluded (Section 5 Baselines), and several analyses (scene complexity, generalization) rely on Prometheus as a metric despite the authors demonstrating its bias. The headline 8B-beats-70B claim rests on a 5-7 point margin on small manual samples. Honest limitations section; prompts are published in the appendix, but no code/data release is stated and key training hyperparameters are missing.

primary_link.title: Learning to Reason and Use Tools through Unsupervised Fine-Tuning in Task-Oriented Dialog Systems

papers.summary: Current dialogue systems struggle with dynamic information retrieval, often leading to hallucinations and lower response accuracy. We address this by adapting the ReAct framework for Task-Oriented Dialogue, enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to access external knowledge and produce factual responses. Mainly, we propose an unsupervised fine-tuning pipeline that harvests reasoning trajectories via in-context learning inference. High-quality samples are filtered using an LLM-based judge to const
papers.summary_zh: 任務導向對話系統中的 LLM 常因只依賴訓練時習得的靜態知識而產生幻覺，無法動態擷取完成任務所需的即時資訊。本文將 ReAct 框架（思考—行動—觀察的迭代迴圈）調整至對話場景，設計 Look[]、Search[query] 與 Finish[answer] 等工具，讓模型主動查詢場景中物件的 metadata。作者進一步提出完全不需人工標註的非監督式 fine-tuning 流程：先以 Llama 3.3 70B 透過 in-context learning 生成推理軌跡，再以開源評審模型 Prometheus 2 依 Likert 量表篩選滿分樣本，接著用 LoRA（rank 32）微調 Llama 3.1 8B，並迭代執行自我改進迴圈，讓持續進步的 checkpoint 生成更優質的訓練資料。在 SIMMC 2.1 資料集的人工評估中，微調後的 8B 模型於時尚領域達 67%、家具領域達 82%，超越 70B 的 ICL 系統（60%/80%），也優於 All-in-context 與 Blind 兩種基線。分析顯示五輪自我改進使 Prometheus 驗證分數由 2.77 升至 3.67；在物件眾多的複雜場景中，ReAct 系統的效能衰退明顯小於 All-in-context 基線；過濾低品質的三元組能同時提升效能與推論效率；跨領域泛化亦優於 BART 基線。研究限制包括僅在 SIMMC 2.1 上實驗、只使用文字 metadata 而未納入視覺輸入，且評估主要仰賴少量人工標註，缺乏可規模化的自動評量方法。此研究證明小型模型可透過自動化資料策展與迭代自我改進，以較低的推論成本達到甚至超越大型模型的表現，對實際部署極具價值。

links.title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models

evidence: Abstract: paper positions itself as a survey/SoK that 'systematizes recent progress in tree-search-based reasoning' with a Unified Design Space and 'standardized compute-reporting abstraction'.

Introduction (Contributions): 'Our goal is not to introduce new algorithms or benchmarks, but to consolidate existing methods under a shared conceptual and reporting framework'; cites prior survey Wei et al. 2025b (arXiv:2510.09988) on the same topic, indicating incremental consolidation.

Section 3.7 (When Search Is Unwarranted / Configuration Trade-offs): claims 'MCTS-based methods routinely report substantial gains (e.g., 10-40%) over greedy decoding' and 'allocating roughly 20-30% of inference compute to evaluation yields robust gains' with no supporting citations for the latter.

Limitation section: states experiments were 'conducted on commonly used benchmarks and controlled settings' under 'a fixed set of experimental assumptions', which conflicts with the paper's survey-only scope and suggests template mismatch.

Appendix G.1 (Logical Implication): 'a strictly fair, compute-normalized comparison of existing literature is currently infeasible' and Figure 7 caveat admits re-computing data points 'under a unified FLOPs standard is impossible' — honest but weakens evidence strength of cross-method claims.

Appendix E.5.2 and E.5.4: paragraphs on alignment and multimodal self-improvement open with citation blocks of largely unrelated works (e.g., recommendation graph pre-training, KERGNNs graph kernels, spoken conversational QA), indicating citation padding.

Section 5 / Appendix G.2 (SCRP): proposes Standardized Compute-Reporting Protocol with budget vector B=(C_policy, C_eval, C_verify, T_wall) and FLOPs proxy C≈2PT, a concrete, reusable reporting contribution.

Appendix H (Tables 6-8): detailed side-by-side comparison of node representations, evaluation functions, backpropagation rules, and reward-model training across ~20 methods, supporting reproducible verification of the synthesis.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A SoK survey on tree-search/MCTS-based reasoning for LLMs sits squarely in high-weight preference areas (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, test-time scaling, agents, RAG, code, RL-vs-search reward design), so topic relevance is near-maximal. However, it is explicitly a consolidation ('Our goal is not to introduce new algorithms or benchmarks', Introduction), apparently extending the authors' own earlier survey (Wei et al. 2025b cited in Introduction), limiting novelty to the unified formalism, taxonomy tables, and the SCRP compute-reporting protocol. Rigor and evidence are mixed: the taxonomy and unified notation (Sections 3.2-3.4, Appendix H) are careful, and the paper honestly concedes compute-normalized comparison is infeasible (Appendix G.1); but key empirical claims lack sources (Section 3.7 asserts '10-40%' gains and that 'allocating roughly 20-30% of inference compute to evaluation yields robust gains' without citations), the Limitation section inconsistently refers to original 'experiments under a fixed set of experimental assumptions' that do not exist in this survey, and appendices show citation padding (e.g., E.5.2 opens with unrelated works on recommendation, graph kernels, and spoken QA; E.5.4 cites a block of spoken-QA papers for multimodal VLM work) plus duplicate bibliographic entries. Generalizability of the framework across math, code, RAG, and agentic domains is good; reproducibility is moderate since the protocol and comparison tables are verifiable against cited works but no artifacts accompany the synthesis.

primary_link.title: When LLM Meets Tree Search: A Systematic View of Inference as Search in Large Language Models

While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) exposes intermediate steps, common instantiations rely on single-trajectory decoding, limiting recovery from early errors and exploration. This survey systematizes recent progr
papers.summary_zh: 隨著預訓練擴展法則趨於飽和，測試時運算擴展（Test-Time Scaling, TTS）成為在固定模型上提升推理表現的關鍵方向。本文為一篇知識系統化（SoK）綜述，主張將推論視為在部分推理狀態空間中的搜尋，而非單軌解碼。文中追溯由無資訊搜尋（BFS、DFS）到蒙地卡羅樹搜尋（MCTS）的演進，說明取樣式控制如何支援探索與利用的原則性權衡。為整合零碎文獻，作者提出統一設計空間，涵蓋搜尋拓撲（軌跡型、狀態—動作型、終端狀態型節點）、評估訊號（過程獎勵 PRM 與結果獎勵 ORM）與控制動態（選擇、擴展、回傳更新），並釐清搜尋獎勵作為短暫的外部指引，與強化學習獎勵永久改寫模型參數的本質差異。論文另提出標準化運算報告協定（SCRP），將推論成本分解為策略生成、節點評估、外部驗證與實際時間，促成跨研究可比較的運算—準確度分析。實務上，作者歸納任務導向建議：數學與邏輯採軌跡型節點搭配 PRM 與平均回傳；程式碼生成利用執行回饋與最大值回傳；檢索增強與代理規劃各有專屬設定。文中亦指出搜尋適用界線：終端驗證可靠時效益最佳（如數學與程式，增益可達 10–40%），獎勵模型偏誤可能引發反向擴展，簡單任務則易過度思考而浪費運算。限制在於作者未於統一運算預算下重新實驗，回顧性比較仍受驗證成本與硬體差異不透明所限。本文的價值在於為樹搜尋推理提供共用詞彙、分類框架與報告標準，並點出將搜尋軌跡蒸餾回模型的自我改進為未來關鍵方向。

§4.2 RQ3 Table 3: latency/token breakdown vs GJAR with GPT-4o mini for both; online latency cut >99%, total latency reduction 62-79% (Fig. 3 break-even at 22-35% query workload).
§C.2 Table 7: gold-path F1 only 0.38-0.61; oracle join beats PEARL on MMQA (61.68 vs 58.84 R@2) and BIRD, showing discovery headroom; +50%/+100% noise corruption degrades monotonically.

Abstract/§4.1/Appendix F/B: GitHub code link, λ_div=0.1, K=⌊|C|/2⌋, temperature 0.7, ten sampled rows, Algorithm 1 pseudocode, and full prompt templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Training-free multi-hop table retrieval framework that front-loads LLM reasoning into offline indexing (join-path discovery, LLM-generated instructional queries, vertical partitioning) and uses only dense retrieval at query time. Strong preference fit to RAG & Knowledge (dense retrieval, embeddings, grounding for RAG pipelines per §1) and meaningful LLM usage (Llama 3.3 70B / GPT-4o mini / Qwen 2.5 7B query generation, §4.1, Table 10), plus multi-hop reasoning context and prompting templates (Appendix F); it is not an LLM-behavior or Japanese-NLP paper, so preference_relevance is moderate-high rather than top. Evaluation is notably rigorous for an IR paper: three multi-hop benchmarks plus FeTaQA single-hop (§4.1, Appendix E), baselines reproduced from public code, corpus-expansion controls (Random-view/Random-query, §4.3), a Slot R@k adjusted metric explicitly guarding against joined-entry recall inflation (§C.1.1, Tables 2/5), join-path quality analysis with oracle and noise corruption (§C.2, Table 7), query duplication checks (Table 8), same-backbone controlled comparison (Table 9), and detailed latency/token/storage/incremental-indexing accounting (Table 3, D.3-D.4). Honest reporting of BIRD degradations (Table 1 ▼9.33% 2-hop R@2; Table 5 ▼14.80% Slot R@2) with analysis in D.2 strengthens credibility. Deductions: no significance testing, post-hoc dataset-size arguments for BIRD losses, oracle join outperforms PEARL on MMQA/BIRD (Table 7a) indicating headroom, evaluation confined to academic benchmarks with join paths capped at length 3 (Limitations), and the abstract's 'consistently outperforms' slightly overstates the mixed BIRD results. Novelty rests on the specific combination of join-path-aware offline query generation and vertical partitioning (claimed first, §1), plausible but incremental over offline augmentation baselines like CORE-T and CGPT. Code, hyperparameters, algorithm pseudocode, and full prompt templates support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: PEARL: Front-Loading Relational Chains for Multi-Hop Table Retrieval

papers.summary: While large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities in tabular reasoning, retrieving relevant tables remains challenging due to the fragmented and relational structure of real-world data. Existing work typically relies on whole table representations that overlook cross-table semantics induced by join relationships. We propose PEARL, a training-free framework that shifts the paradigm toward vertical partitioning-based sub-table encoding. PEARL augments the retrieval corpus offline b
papers.summary_zh: 真實世界的表格資料常分散於多張資料表中，使用者的查詢往往需要跨越多張以 join 關係連結的表格才能回答。現有表格檢索方法多將整張表格壓縮成單一向量，無關欄位的語意雜訊會掩蓋潛在的跨表關聯；改用查詢時分解或迭代推理則造成高昂的 LLM 推論成本。PEARL 是一個免訓練的多跳表格檢索框架，核心思維是「前置化」：把反覆出現的線上推理負擔移轉到固定的離線索引階段。離線時，系統透過結構模式、欄位相似度與值域重疊等訊號探索明確（如外鍵）與隱含的 join 路徑，再以 LLM 針對每條路徑生成具鑑別力的合成查詢，並依查詢相關欄位進行垂直分割，產生子表（sub-entry）與合併（joined entry）兩類索引單元；線上階段僅以標準密集檢索器比對預先計算的向量，完全不需要 LLM 推論。實驗在 SPIDER、MMQA、BIRD 三個基準顯示，PEARL 於 3-hop 查詢的 R@2 最高提升 30.05%，Recall@k 平均超越最強基準 5.84%，線上延遲降低逾 99%，總延遲最多縮減 79%，token 消耗平均減少 4.1 倍；消融實驗證明效益來自 join 感知的垂直分割，而非單純擴充語料庫，且對不同 LLM 後端具穩健性。限制包括 join 路徑長度上限為 3、評估僅限學術基準、索引規模約為整表檢索的 2.4 倍，且在小型資料集 BIRD 上因統計先驗較強而略遜於部分基準。此設計對資料湖與 RAG 場景中的表格檢索深具實務價值。

links.title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines

evidence: Abstract and Section 1: 'an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models' with five operation areas (load, record, attribute, intervene, evaluate) and GitHub/PyPI/doc links (footnotes 1-3).

Section 5.1 and Table 1: IOI reproduction recovers name mover heads (three strongest: L9H9, L9H6, L10H0) and negative movers (L10H7, L11H10), but 'The S-inhibition result therefore holds for two of the three tested name mover heads' (L9H9 28.9%, L10H0 22.8%, L9H6 raised by 4.9%).

Section 5.2 and Figure 3: truth-direction normalized indirect effect 0.88/0.98 (Murano) vs 0.85/0.97 (Marks and Tegmark 2024); 'the largest difference across the 24 corresponding pairs of values is 10.53 percentage points' for probe accuracy.

Section 5: 'The case studies do not evaluate user completion time, error rates, runtime, memory use, model coverage, the benefit of the Node representation by itself, or the effort required to add a new method.'
Section 5.3: SAE feature steering 'at strength 2000, all four collapse into repetitions of California or Sacramento... they do not show coherent control of topic'; case study 'is not a reproduction'.

Appendix Table 2: capability comparison 'based on the cited publications and public documentation, checked in August 2026', recording documented interface coverage 'rather than implementation quality, usability, or performance'.

Limitations: backend 'depends on nnterp and nnsight', one-GPU default, per-operation architecture support limits, 'fixed prompt sets, data splits, corruption schemes, and intervention settings' with 'no systematic test of sensitivity'.
Appendix Figures 4-6: code snippets with statement counts (17 vs 35 for head sweep, 10 vs 14 for mass mean, 13 vs 24 for SAE workflow), explicitly noted as not measuring usability or reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope systems paper: an open-source orchestration framework for mechanistic interpretability of LLMs (GPT-2, LLaMA-2-13B, Gemma 2 2B), squarely matching the LLM and interpretability preferences and transformer internals work, though it does not touch the highest-weighted agent/Japanese/reasoning/code preferences. Novelty is moderate: it composes and standardizes existing libraries (TransformerLens, nnsight, sae-lens, nnterp) rather than introducing new scientific methods; the step/artifact contract and canonical Node addressing are the main design contributions. Rigor is limited but honest: evaluation is two reproductions plus one non-reproduction case study, with no user study, runtime, or error-rate evaluation, and the framework comparison is documentation-based (Table 2, checked August 2026); the paper transparently reports partial failures (S-inhibition holds for 2 of 3 heads; probe grid differs by up to 10.53 points; SAE steering at strength 2000 collapses generation, explicitly 'not coherent control'). Evidence for 'Murano can express these workflows and recover selected findings' is concrete and quantitative (Table 1: 0.88/0.98 vs 0.85/0.97; head rankings recovered), but code-line-count comparisons (17 vs 35 statements) are weak proxies and fixed prompt sets with no sensitivity analysis cap evidentiary strength. Generalizability is bounded by nnterp/nnsight-backed Hugging Face coverage and per-operation architecture support; agents explicitly remain future work. Reproducibility is strong for a tooling paper: public GitHub, PyPI package (murano-interp), hosted docs, and notebooks. Overall a credible, well-scoped resource contribution of moderate scientific depth.

These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano r
papers.summary_zh: Murano 是一套開源框架,用於設計、執行與重現針對大型語言模型的機制可解釋性(mechanistic interpretability)實驗。此類研究通常結合模型載入、激活記錄、歸因、介入與評估等操作,但現有工具函式庫各自只涵蓋部分流程,研究者跨函式庫工作時須自行轉換輸出格式並對應不同的元件命名。Murano 將五類操作封裝為可組合的 Step,步驟間透過共用的 Results 容器以具名產物交換結果,並以標準化的 Node 位址表示層、注意力頭、投影與 token 位置等模型內部元件,底層整合 nnterp、nnsight、sae-lens 與 scikit-learn。作者以兩項重現實驗與一個 SAE 案例展示框架:在 GPT-2 的間接受詞識別(IOI)研究中,重現出三個 name mover heads 與兩個 negative mover heads,但 S-inhibition 查詢介入結果僅在三者中的兩個成立;在 LLaMA-2-13B 真值方向研究中,重現的 mass mean 介入效果與原研究最多相差 0.03,惟探針準確率最大差異達 10.53 個百分點;SAE 特徵導引案例顯示過大的固定添加量會使生成崩壞為重複詞彙。限制包括管線僅能循序執行、依賴特定後端、各操作對模型與 Node 格式支援不一,且案例研究未評估可用性、重現成本或執行效能。此框架降低了跨領域研究者進行可解釋性實驗的門檻,有助於建立一致、可重現的研究工作流程。

links.title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization

evidence: Abstract: proposes fine-tuning-based Stratified Consistency Distillation with entropy-stratified selection (majority voting / LLM-as-a-Judge / abstention) and claims experiments on 'multiple policy-driven reasoning benchmarks'.
Section 4.1 (Datasets): only states 'We evaluate our method on NL2SMT FOLIO dataset' — no second benchmark is defined, contradicting the abstract's claim of multiple benchmarks.
Table 4 caption: 'Ablation study of stratified consistency distillation on the Customer Service dataset' — this dataset is never described anywhere in the paper.
Table 1 / Section 4.2: SCD achieves Pass@10 of 55.208% vs Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 21.875%, Qwen3-14B 42.708%, and vanilla distillation 50.347% on FOLIO.

Section 3.1: extends semantic entropy (Farquhar et al., 2024) via 'check_smt_equivalence' clustering with Z3 (unsat indicates equivalence) to compute symbolic semantic entropy over equivalence classes.
Section 4.1 (Training Strategy): LoRA fine-tuning with learning rate 5e-5, batch size 32, LoRA rank 32, scaling factor α=64 on Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
Table 3: cluster-based selection analysis shows Top@2 approaches the Pass@10 oracle (SCD: 30.556 vs 31.481), supporting the stratification motivation.

Section 4.3 (Latency), Table 2: fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B P50 latency 4.040s vs Claude Sonnet 3.7 16.680s (~4.1×), while the Introduction/abstract claims '5×–20× lower inference cost' without supporting measurement.

Appendix A: full translation-generation prompt with few-shot example and declarations provided, aiding reproducibility; however, no code or data release is mentioned and training-set size/statistics are unreported.

Preliminary section: describes synthetic dataset pipeline from policy documents (extract semantic context → generate Q&A → translate to SMT-LIB) as a stated contribution, but no direct quantitative evaluation of this pipeline appears in the reported tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology paper: entropy-stratified consistency distillation from a frontier teacher (Claude Sonnet 3.7) into Qwen2.5-7B via LoRA for NL→SMT-LIB autoformalization, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning, distillation/efficiency, agents/tool-use via Z3 verification). Novelty is moderate: it adapts known components—semantic entropy (Farquhar et al. 2024), self-consistency/majority voting, LLM-as-judge, distillation—into a new symbolic-equivalence setting (Z3 clustering, Egglog anti-unification scoring), which is a sensible but incremental combination. Rigor is undermined by serious internal inconsistencies: the abstract claims evaluation on 'multiple policy-driven reasoning benchmarks' yet Section 4.1 defines only the FOLIO dataset, and the Table 4 ablation cites an undefined 'Customer Service dataset'; eval scale appears small (~96 FOLIO examples inferred from percentages), with no significance testing and no external autoformalization baselines. Evidence strength is limited by these gaps plus an unsupported '5×–20×' cost claim (latency table shows ~4.1× at P50). Generalizability is plausible for structured-output distillation but demonstrated narrowly. Reproducibility benefits from full hyperparameters (LoRA rank 32, α 64, LR 5e-5) and an appendix prompt, but there is no code/data release and key dataset statistics are missing.

primary_link.title: Stratified Consistency Distillation for Natural Language Formalization

papers.summary: Neurosymbolic reasoning has shown promising success in addressing complex reasoning tasks by combining large language models (LLMs) and symbolic solvers. While this approach shows promise, a fundamental challenge remains: improving the accuracy of translations from natural language to logical formulas. Current methods predominantly rely on prompt engineering, which is difficult to scale across different domains and input formats. Drawing inspiration from the success of fine-tuning in other model
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否將自然語言準確翻譯為可供 Z3 等符號求解器驗證的 SMT-LIB 邏輯公式，以確保高風險應用中聊天機器人回答的邏輯健全性。現有方法多依賴提示工程，而前沿模型參數龐大、推論成本高且多為閉源，難以透過 fine-tuning 再提升。作者提出分層一致性蒸餾（Stratified Consistency Distillation, SCD）：先由教師模型 Claude Sonnet 3.7 對每個輸入取樣多個翻譯，以 Z3 檢驗邏輯等價性進行叢集並計算符號語義熵；再依熵值分層選取偽標籤——低熵採多數決投票、中熵由 LLM-as-a-Judge 於前兩大叢集間裁決、高熵則統一化或棄用——最後以 LoRA fine-tune 學生模型 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct。論文另設計自政策文件自動產生自然語言與 SMT-LIB 配對資料的合成管線，並提出以 anti-unification 為基礎的連續邏輯相似度指標。在 FOLIO 資料集上，SCD 的 Pass@10 達 55.208%，優於 vanilla distillation 的 50.347% 與 Qwen3-14B 的 42.708%；微調後模型的 P50 延遲僅 4.040 秒，約為教師模型 16.680 秒的四分之一。消融實驗顯示低熵樣本提供較強的監督訊號，分層策略整體表現最佳。其限制在於成效依賴教師模型品質與等價性檢查的可靠度、高熵樣本常被棄用，且主要評估集中於 FOLIO。整體而言，此工作為低成本、可驗證的 LLM 自動形式化提供了可擴充的蒸餾路徑。

llm_evaluation.rationale: A diagnostic evaluation of multimodal LLMs (Qwen2.5/3-Omni, Gemini 3 Flash Preview) on spoken sarcasm detection across English and Mandarin, with acoustic error diagnosis and causal PSOLA prosodic manipulation. It is not 'pure audio' since language methodology (zero-shot prompting, transcript conditioning, chain-of-thought trace analysis) is central, so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap does not apply. Relevance is moderate: it engages LLM/multimodal/evaluation/interpretability preferences but not the highest-weighted clusters (agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM, RAG). Novelty is solid: prior work (Li et al. 2025, cited in §1) benchmarked modality-conditioned performance but did not perform acoustic error profiling or causal intervention; the FP/Control/TP framework, out-of-sample manipulation, reverse manipulation, and cross-model transfer are genuine contributions. Rigor is strong: five modality conditions, 5-fold repeated evaluation (Table 4), Mann-Whitney U/Cohen's d with cross-split validation (§4), ASR-verified lexical suppression of the 300 Hz filter (§2.4), naturalness controls via CER/DNSMOS (Appendix F), and bidirectional causal evidence (Appendix I). Evidence is generally well-quantified but slightly dented by an internal tension: the abstract claims audio does not improve true positive detection while §3.2 reports FN reductions of 7.5-9.7% under Bimodal, and English FP-Control effect sizes are modest (d≈0.22-0.27, §5.2/Appendix H). Generalizability is constrained by performative TV speech in both corpora (acknowledged in Limitations) and only two main open models plus one closed model. Reproducibility is decent: open models, public datasets, prompt templates (Appendix A), full feature list (Appendix D), manipulation targets (Appendix E), and implementation stack (§2.6), though no explicit code release is stated and the Gemini transfer arm cannot be fully reproduced.

We address this through sarcasm detection, evaluating Qwen2.5-Omni and Qwen3-Omni on Mandarin Chinese and English under five modality conditions that decompose the contributions of lexical content, vocal semantics, and prosodic structure. Adding audio systematically inflates fals
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討多模態大型語言模型(MLLM)在語音諷刺偵測中,是否真正運用韻律線索進行語用推論,或僅依賴表層聲學刻板印象。研究以中文 MSCD(電視脫口秀)與英文 MUStARD++(情境喜劇)語料,零樣本評估 Qwen2.5-Omni 與 Qwen3-Omni,設計五種模態條件拆解詞彙內容、語音語義與韻律結構的貢獻,並以 Praat 擷取 66 項聲學特徵,建立兩種語言的諷刺聲學基準,進而診斷模型錯誤並進行因果驗證。主要發現:加入音訊會系統性推高假陽性,卻不提升真陽性偵測;假陽性樣本在聲學特徵空間其實更接近非諷刺對照組,但模型的音訊編碼器卻將其表徵為兩類之間的模糊區域。模型錯誤集中於「音高偏高、停頓不規則」的表達性韻律刻板印象,與真實諷刺特徵相悖——中文諷刺重視音高輪廓複雜度與總時長,英文則呈現較低 F0 與較高能量。僅以 PSOLA 操弄音高與停頓兩個維度,即誘發最高 60% 的假陽性率;反向操弄亦可部分矯正錯誤。同一操弄模板未經修改套用於 Gemini 3 Flash Preview 仍重現效應,顯示此捷徑跨越模型家族。限制方面,兩語料皆為表演性電視語音,未必推及日常自發對話;編碼器與多模態融合階段的機制定位仍待釐清。本研究顯示,真正的副語言理解需將韻律表徵與語言特定語用線索對齊,並凸顯診斷式評估相對整體指標的價值。
papers.title: When Models Hear What They Expect: Diagnosing Prosodic Heuristics in Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
papers.title_zh: 當模型聽見它們所期待的:診斷多模態諷刺偵測中的韻律捷思

links.title: Context Staircase: Signature-Aligned Dynamics of Token Embeddings under Small Initialization

evidence: Abstract: claims 'Context Staircase' — embeddings learn low-order statistic signatures before high-order ones, with gradient-flow explanation for feed-forward and self-attention architectures
Section 3.3/3.4: initialization scale N(0, d^{-2γ}) with small-initialization regime γ>1/2; informal propositions state low-order dominance at start and highest-order dominance late

Section 4.4, Proposition 1: ratio of order-m to order-0 signature contributions is O(d^{-mγ})=o(1) at initialization; Proposition 2: late-stage all orders share scale s_U(t)s_E(t)^{K-1} with highest order largest when K≫L
Section 4.7/Figure 5: activation-order sweep shows modular-addition is unlearnable when activation order K < sequence length L, with collapsed embeddings
Section 5, Theorem 5: embedding gradient under attention decomposes into value/key/query paths, each an attention-score-weighted (ψ) position-specific signature (φ)

Section 6.1: 0.7B decoder-only Transformer trained on 36B tokens; Figure 7A shows next-token-signature correlation ρ_next peaks early then decays; Figure 7B rank-one first-order-signature probe evaluated on held-out tokens; Figure 7C layer-wise attention-path correlation

Section 7.1/Figure 8: fixed first-order signature embeddings converge faster than trainable embeddings; attention-only model attains signature-aligned geometry yet fails the task, showing structure is not sufficient
Section 7.1/Figure 9: with N=20, learning slowdown (thousands of epochs) exactly for M=4,5,10,20 where zero-order signatures are identical across tokens
Section 7.3/Figure 11: next-token signatures computed from the 36B-token corpus show numeric ordering, weekday cyclic structure, and semantic category clustering via PCA
Appendix A.4: LM details — 24 layers, hidden 1024, 16 heads, RoPE, vocab 60,416, RMSNorm/SwiGLU, Megatron-LM, AdamW, bilingual Chinese–English 36B-token corpus; no code-release statement found
llm_evaluation.rationale: A theory-driven paper on token-embedding training dynamics in language models: it introduces a hierarchy of token-conditioned 'probability signatures' and shows, via gradient-flow analysis under small initialization, that embeddings first align with low-order (token-label) statistics and progressively absorb higher-order context statistics ('Context Staircase'). It is squarely relevant to core LLM science (token embeddings, Transformer/attention dynamics, initialization, mechanistic understanding) but does not touch the highest-weighted applied preferences (Japanese LLM/NLP, agents, reasoning methods); the reasoning link is only via prior-work association with small initialization. Novelty is solid: the signature-order decomposition (Theorem 1/2) and attention-modulated variant (Theorem 5) extend the authors' own small-initialization/condensation research line (Yao et al. 2025; Zhang et al. 2024/2025) rather than appearing from nowhere. Rigor is good: assumptions are explicit (polynomial activation approximation, softmax linearization), propositions proved in Appendix B, and controlled falsification-style tests are included (activation-order sweep in Sec 4.7/Fig 5 shows no learning when K<L; modulus sweep in Sec 7.1/Fig 9 shows learning slowdown exactly when M|N makes zero-order signatures uninformative). Evidence is largely correlational (similarity-matrix correlations) but strengthened by intervention experiments (fixed signature embeddings accelerate learning, Fig 8D) and a real 0.7B LM run on 36B tokens (Sec 6.1, Fig 7) verifying next-token-signature peak then decay and layer-wise attention-signature correlation. Generalizability is moderate: main analysis restricted to small initialization (γ>1/2), exchangeable contexts for the FFN case, controlled arithmetic tasks, and one bilingual 0.7B model; late-stage claims rely on regime assumptions (Prop 2). Reproducibility is decent: Appendix A gives architectures, epochs, dataset constructions, LM training details (Megatron-LM, AdamW, corpus composition), though no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Context Staircase: Signature-Aligned Dynamics of Token Embeddings under Small Initialization

papers.summary: Token embeddings are the basic representational units that connect discrete tokens with continuous computation in language models. Although modern language models learn embeddings from random initialization through gradient-based training, the dynamical mechanism by which meaningful embedding structures emerge remains unclear. In this work, we identify that the evolving embedding structures are closely related to token-conditioned label and contextual distributions, which we formalize as probabi
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究語言模型中 token 嵌入自隨機初始化出發，於訓練過程如何逐步形成有意義的統計結構。作者定義以 token 為條件的機率「簽名」（probability signatures），刻劃 token、標籤與上下文 token 間的聯合分佈，並提出「情境階梯」（Context Staircase）現象：早期嵌入幾何貼近零階標籤簽名（token 與標籤的關係），訓練後期才逐步納入涉及更多上下文的高階簽名，呈現由簡入繁的隱式偏誤。理論上，論文在多項式活化近似下分解嵌入的梯度流，證明各階簽名明確進入嵌入更新；小初始化會壓抑高階貢獻，解釋早期的零階對齊，而後期各可及階數達到相同主導尺度，其中最高階貢獻最大；對 self-attention 架構，簽名項為位置相依且受注意力分數調控。實證上，加法、乘法、模加法等控制任務顯示嵌入幾何與簽名幾何高度相關，並以傅立葉頻率分析解釋不同隨機種子產生相異嵌入幾何的現象；在 0.7B 參數、36B token 的真實語言模型訓練中，早期嵌入幾何追蹤 next-token 簽名，注意力路徑表徵對應注意力加權簽名。作者亦證明簽名對齊結構可加速學習、簽名階層決定任務學習的起始時機，且語料簽名本身已具語意組織（數字排序、星期循環、類別聚類）。限制包括主要理論假設上下文可交換、以多項式近似活化函數，且低階簽名缺乏鑑別資訊時，小初始化可能延後學習。此研究連結嵌入幾何與可解讀的動態機制，揭示了資料統計與架構如何共同塑造表徵空間。
papers.title: Context Staircase: Signature-Aligned Dynamics of Token Embeddings under Small Initialization
papers.title_zh: 情境階梯（Context Staircase）：小初始化下 token 嵌入的簽名對齊動態

links.title: TuringLLM: Efficiently Scaling Foundation Models Toward Physical AI

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 3: GSM8K 4-shot EM is 74.53 (Turing-20B-A2B) vs 90.07 (Qwen3-8B Base), and ARC-C 90.17 vs 91.53, weakening the abstract's 'overall general capability exceeding Qwen3-8B Base' claim.
Section 4.1: 'Qwen3.5 base models may activate an explicit thinking process during evaluation, resulting in substantially longer generations' — disclosed confound in Table 4 comparisons.

Section 5.1: controlled ablation trains a 10B MoE (~1.6B active) for ~100B tokens with only the routing mechanism differing; Table 7 shows Quantile Routing wins 7 of 8 benchmarks (e.g., ARC-C 27.12 vs 23.73) and Figure 6 shows lower MaxVio.

Section 5.2, Table 8: capacity-constrained (CF=1.25) RL variant regresses on MMLU 76.34 vs 79.03 and GSM8K 88.93 vs 90.22 relative to dropless, while improving BBH 66.02 vs 65.13 and GPQA 34.34 vs 31.31.

Section 4.3 / Appendix B, Eq. (10): model-level prefill latency is estimated by summing representative per-layer measurements, not measured end-to-end; protocol (H800, FP16, batch 1, torch.compile, do_bench) is documented.
Section 3.1: 'We do not disclose the exact mixture ratios of individual data sources'; no release of weights, code, or in-house data is stated anywhere in the paper, limiting reproducibility.
Section 3.3, Table 2: native 128K context via 4K→32K→128K continued pretraining; 256K/512K RULER results (81.31/77.38, Table 6) are training-free YaRN extrapolation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM foundation-model report (MoE architecture, routing, pretraining, long context, latency), squarely within high-weight LLM/efficiency/long-context preferences; the physical-AI framing is motivation, not a domain-only application. Novelty is limited: Quantile Routing (Su 2025), Lightning Attention, YaRN, and MTP are adopted rather than invented, with the deployment-time capacity-constrained prefill being the main new twist. Evaluation protocol is relatively rigorous (unified OpenCompass generation-based setup, controlled routing ablation at matched budget), but headline claims are overstated: Table 3 shows Turing trailing Qwen3-8B on GSM8K (74.53 vs 90.07), BBH, MMLU-Pro, ARC-C, and C-Eval, and 'approaching Qwen3.5-9B' is generous given Table 4; comparisons to Qwen3.5 with possible thinking-mode activation are acknowledged confounds. Model-level latency is estimated by layer aggregation (Eq. 10) rather than end-to-end measurement, and ablations are only ~100B tokens. No code or weight release is claimed and data mixture ratios are withheld, hurting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: TuringLLM: Efficiently Scaling Foundation Models Toward Physical AI

papers.summary: We present Turing-20B-A2B, a 20B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts language model that activates approximately 2B parameters per token, designed for long-context and latency-sensitive physical AI applications. The model adopts Quantile Routing in a dynamic top-k configuration, enabling token-adaptive expert allocation while maintaining balanced expert utilization and a controlled average compute budget. During deployment, we further apply capacity-constrained routing to prompt prefill for more regula
papers.summary_zh: 小鵬汽車（XPeng）團隊提出 Turing-20B-A2B，一款總參數 20B、每個 token 平均僅啟用約 2B 參數的混合專家（MoE）語言基礎模型，針對自動駕駛與具身智慧等 Physical AI 應用對長上下文與低延遲推論的需求。方法上，模型採動態 top-k 的 Quantile Routing，經由專家門檻的分位數追蹤，讓不同 token 依難度啟用不等的專家數（平均約 8 個），同時維持負載均衡與平均計算預算；注意力採 20 層 Lightning Attention 搭配 4 層完整注意力的 5:1 混合架構；預訓練遵循知識基礎、能力強化、品質退火三階段課程（約 22 天、512 張 H800），再將原生上下文由 4K 擴至 128K，並以 YaRN 免訓練外推至 512K；部署時對 prompt prefill 施加容量約束（capacity factor 1.25）以規律化專家執行。證據方面：基礎模型整體表現超越 Qwen3-8B Base、逼近 Qwen3.5-9B Base；消融實驗顯示 Quantile Routing 在 8 個基準中的 7 個優於 Loss-Free Routing，且專家負載更穩定；RULER 長上下文評測在 64K 與 128K 仍達 90.00 與 84.87；prefill 延遲相較 Qwen3 基線在 32K 至 128K 加速約 1.2 倍至 2.2 倍，Turing MoE 較 dropless top-k MoE 平均快 1.53 倍。限制：目前僅驗證基礎模型，後訓練仍在探索；容量約束使 MMLU、GSM8K 等部分基準小幅下滑。此工作展示在緊湊啟用參數預算下兼顧能力、長上下文擴展與部署效率的實用 MoE 擴展配方，可支援 VLA 2.0 自動駕駛、智慧座艙與 XPeng Iron 機器人等延遲敏感的 Physical AI 應用。

links.title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus

evidence: Section 7.1, Table 4: Claude Sonnet 4.6 stance agreement κ=0.711 with human consensus labels, exceeding majority (0.000), DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot (0.269), TF-IDF+LogReg (0.419), and comparable to human-human agreement (0.644).

Section 7.3, Table 8: 54% of Against-speeches (n=570) contain sexism vs 21% of For-speeches (n=2,167); For-stance sexist speeches are 81% benevolent-only while Against-speeches split roughly evenly across hostile-only, benevolent-only, and both.
Appendix J, Table 14: on human-consensus labels only, 76.7% of Against vs 37.5% of For speeches contain sexism (Fisher's exact p<0.001), replicating the LLM-based pattern independently of the judge.
Appendix D, Table 9: cross-model validation with GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, and DeepSeek V3 under identical prompts yields stance κ of .533-.711 and hostile-sexism κ of .416-.639 against human labels.
Appendix H, Table 13: 3% gender-label noise induction across 1,000 iterations keeps the gender-stance gap statistically significant in 1,000/1,000 runs (mean χ²=68.99).

Section 11 (Limitations): single primary LLM judge, sexism recall 0.43-0.46, keyword retrieval may miss relevant speeches with divergent vocabulary, and detection difficulty may differ between hostile and benevolent sexism.

Section 5 and Appendix G, Table 12: validation set is 300 speeches labeled by two annotators (~40 hours each); sexism inter-annotator κ is low (0.270-0.338), and the rare 'Both' stance class has F1 of only 0.22 (Table 3).

Section 1 footnote 1 and Conclusion footnote 2: dataset and reproducible code released at github.com/Social-Insights-Lab/Two-Centuries-of-Sexism; full classification prompts with JSON schemas provided in Appendix C.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An applied computational social science study that uses LLMs-as-judges (Claude Sonnet 4.6 primary; GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash, DeepSeek V3 for cross-model checks) to classify stance and Ambivalent Sexism Inventory categories over 200 years of Hansard speeches. It is squarely on-topic for an LLM/NLP curator (LLM-judge validation, prompting with structured JSON output, text classification, gender-bias analysis), but it contributes no new language-model methodology; the LLM is a measurement instrument for a sociological claim, so preference relevance is moderate rather than high. Rigor is a strength: a 300-speech human validation set (Section 5), baselines including DeBERTa-v3 zero-shot and TF-IDF+LogReg (Table 4, Claude κ=0.711 vs 0.269/0.419), sentiment-confound (Appendix E), gender-era confound via logistic regression (Appendix F), 1,000-iteration label-noise robustness (Appendix H), speaker-level aggregation (Appendix L), and an honest LLM-free reanalysis (Appendix J). Evidence for the headline stance result is strong; the sexism-rate result (54% vs 21%, Table 8) rests on a judge with low recall (0.43-0.46) and low inter-annotator sexism κ (0.270-0.338, Appendix G), though the pattern replicates on human-only labels (76.7% vs 37.5%, Table 14). Novelty is decent (first large-scale ASI analysis of parliamentary discourse plus a 6.7M-speech gender-matched dataset release) but methodologically conventional; generalizability claims to other debate corpora are plausible yet untested. Prompts (Appendix C), code, and data are released, supporting reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus

papers.summary: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this pa
papers.summary_zh: 本文以計算方法分析英國國會兩百年（1803-2005）關於女性參政權的辯論，探討支持與反對陣營是否採用不同型態的性別歧視論述。研究團隊釋出附有後設資料的 Hansard 語料庫版本，涵蓋約 670 萬篇演說，在下議院達成 89% 的性別比對覆蓋率；再以兩層關鍵字檢索取得 6,531 篇相關演說，運用 Claude Sonnet 4.6 等大型語言模型，依 Glick 與 Fiske 的矛盾性別歧視量表分類立場（支持、反對、混合、無關）與敵意型、善意型性別歧視。模型在 300 篇人工標註驗證集上與人類共識標籤的 Cohen's κ 為 0.711，接近兩位標註者彼此的一致程度；跨模型（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Flash、DeepSeek V3）比對與情感混淆分析亦支持結果穩健。主要發現：反對女性參政的演說有 54% 含性別歧視內容，支持方僅 21%；反對方混合敵意與善意歧視，支持方則壓倒性屬善意型，即以讚美框限女性角色；女性議員 93% 支持女性政治權利，男性議員為 70%，控制年代因素後性別仍是顯著預測因子。限制包括僅分析下議院、關鍵字檢索可能遺漏相關演說、模型召回率偏低使歧視比例恐被低估、二元性別分類過於簡化，以及歷史語料標註本身的主觀性。本研究為矛盾性別歧視理論提供大規模自然語料證據，顯示對立陣營不只是結論相左，而是推理性質相異，並示範 LLM 作為評審在大規模歷史文本分析的價值。

papers.title_zh: 英國國會兩百年的性別歧視：以計算方法分析 Hansard 語料庫中的女性政治代表性

links.title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark

evidence: Abstract: introduces MIOH, 'a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark' spanning four tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position), three reasoning patterns, and three adversarial pressures.
Sec. 3.4 Benchmark Statistics: 'The final benchmark comprises 3,484 questions across 11,732 images, balanced across tasks, reasoning patterns, and difficulty levels.'
Appendix A.4.4: 'Each question underwent independent review by three annotators'; ~26,000 generated questions reduced to ~20,000 verified, then stratified sampled.
Sec. 4.1: overall average accuracy 36.1% across 29 models; Gemini-2.5 Pro 64.4% and GPT-5 63.1% lead; best open models Qwen2-VL-7B (49.1%) and MiniCPM-V-2.6 (48.5%).
Sec. 4.6 ablation: 'single-image processing substantially outperforms simultaneous multi-image analysis, consistently across all models and scales', supporting the integration-stage failure claim.
Sec. 4.4: Existence drops from 62.4% easy to 30.0% under 8-image NI pressure; Position falls 46.9% to 35.2% under Hard Negatives (Table 2).

Sec. 4: 'the decoding temperature is set to 0 for all experiments. All experiments were conducted on four NVIDIA A6000 GPUs'; no code, data, or benchmark release statement appears anywhere in the document.

Related Work: positions MIOH against MIHBench [27], which 'focuses mainly on binary existence questions and varies only the number of images', establishing the incremental-but-finer-grained novelty claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope multimodal LLM evaluation work (MLLM hallucination diagnosis), not pure computer vision: it evaluates GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro, Qwen2.5-VL, LLaVA, InternVL3.5 and other LLM-based models on language-posed questions. Relevance rests on Multimodal AI, hallucination/factuality (RAG & Knowledge), and Red Teaming & Evaluation preferences; it is not about core LLM language methodology, so relevance is solid rather than maximal. Novelty is moderate: multi-image hallucination is already probed by MIHBench, and the contribution is a systematic taxonomy (4 tasks x 3 reasoning patterns x 3 adversarial pressures, 26 question types) rather than a new capability. Rigor is above average: 3-annotator majority-vote validation of ~26,000 generated questions (Appendix A.4.4), stratified balanced sampling to 3,484 questions/11,732 images, temperature-0 decoding, and a controlled ablation (comprehensive vs. decomposed single-image evaluation, Sec. 4.6) that cleanly isolates integration-stage failure. Evidence is strong for its central claims (36.1% overall accuracy, selection reasoning hardest at 34.2%, NI pressure collapses Existence to 30.0%, no model-size-robustness correlation), though no confidence intervals or significance tests are reported and CLIP-based filtering could inject label noise. Generalizability is limited by COCO/PACO/SVG object-centric natural-image coverage. Reproducibility is weakened by the absence of any benchmark/code/data release statement; only construction methodology and hardware (4x A6000) are documented.
