However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger h
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLM）已能同時處理多張影像，但物件幻覺問題依然嚴重：模型會生成看似合理卻與視覺輸入不符的物件描述。既有幻覺評測多針對單一影像且偏重二元問題，通用多影像基準又缺乏可控變因，難以診斷幻覺成因。本文提出 MIOH，首個系統性評估多影像物件幻覺的細粒度基準：涵蓋存在、計數、屬性、位置四類物件任務，結合綜合、比較、選擇三種推理模式，共 26 種題型，並施加三種對抗壓力——影像數量規模、知覺難度（小型或遮蔽物件）與情境偏誤（共現先驗誤導）。題目由 COCO-ReM、PACO、SVG 產生，經三位標註者驗證後保留 3,484 道題目與 11,732 張影像。評測 29 個模型的整體平均準確率僅 36.1%；Gemini-2.5 Pro（64.4%）與 GPT-5（63.1%）領先但仍遠未臻完美；計數任務最弱（25.4%），選擇型推理最為困難；影像數增至 8 張時，存在任務表現銳減逾五成。研究亦發現基線準確率高的開源模型在對抗條件下未必穩健，且將同一內容拆解為單影像問答的表現顯著優於多影像綜合問答，顯示幻覺不僅源自知覺失誤，更源於跨影像資訊整合階段的崩壞。限制方面，計數基線接近隨機水準形成地板效應，且資料集標註噪音使部分題目需大量過濾。此基準為診斷與改善多模態系統可靠性提供了精細工具。
radar.title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
radar.title_zh: MIOH：細粒度多影像物件幻覺基準測試

links.title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code

evidence: Abstract/Section 3.2: WebWorld-27B reaches 52.7 on HTMLBench-400 and 85.5 on MiniAppBench-Val, improving Raw-27B by 5.3 and 14.9 points; Table 1 caption states each SFT cell is a single seed-42 run.

Section 3.3, Table 2: acceptance-rule ablation at 9B — NoCertificate +0.4, No preserve +1.5, VLM-only +3.5, Score gate +3.6, full WebWorld +4.8 over Raw-9B; NoCertificate TC pass drops 3.1 below Raw (31.0 vs 34.1).

Appendix A.1: five non-overlap conditions (item, prompt-template, test-case, probe, repair-skill disjointness) audited because HTMLBench-400 shares infrastructure ancestry with HTMLCure from overlapping authors (Wu et al., 2026b).

Appendix C: backbone Qwen3.5 4B/9B/27B, AdamW LR 2e-5, batch 128, seq 16,384, 3 epochs, 64-128 H100s; exact package versions and runner commit 'released with the code artifact' (planned release); the VLM used for critique/skills is never named.
Appendix D: 'roughly 60K' re-executed candidates, 24,350 refused, 42,860 certified pool, 32,800 SFT subsample — the counts are not arithmetically consistent (60K - 24,350 = 35,650 ≠ 42,860).

Limitations: method restricted to single-file interactive HTML; perceptual defects (aesthetics, accessibility) have no executable certificate and fall back to the VLM proxy; frontier model scores in Section 3.2 are 'benchmark context rather than a controlled model comparison'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong fit to agentic/code preferences: an autonomous VLM critique-repair loop for web code where browser re-execution certifies transitions used as SFT supervision for Qwen3.5 backbones (Agents & Tool Use, Code & Programming, Training & Optimization). Core insight—use the browser as an executable oracle/world model to split hypothesis from proof—is a useful reframing of execution-based verification and self-refinement rather than a fundamentally new technique; contract/certificate/ratchet packaging is moderately novel. Design is rigorous: matched-recipe Raw-vs-WebWorld SFT at 4B/9B/27B (Table 1), acceptance-rule ablations isolating the certificate gate (Table 2/3: NoCertificate +0.4 vs full +4.8), fixed-budget depth diagnostic (Table 4), and a five-condition leakage audit (A.1). Deductions: every cell is a single seed-42 run with no variance; the primary benchmark (HTMLBench-400) comes from concurrent HTMLCure work with heavily overlapping authors, and frontier comparisons (Kimi-K2.6, GPT-5.4) are acknowledged as context, not controlled; Appendix D counts are internally inconsistent (~60K re-executed minus 24,350 refusals cannot yield the 42,860 certified pool). Effects are large and behavior-focused (TC/Functionality/MiniApp gains, not visual polish), supporting the mechanism claim. Generalizability is limited to single-file interactive HTML with the browser as faithful oracle; perceptual defects revert to the VLM judge (Limitations). Reproducibility is decent (full optimizer/hardware config, pinned runner commit, planned code/data release) but the pipeline VLM used for critiques is never named, and key benchmarks are concurrent/unreleased.

primary_link.title: WebWorld: The Browser as a World Model for Self-Improving Web Code

radar.summary: VLM-driven self-improvement of web code has a structural flaw: the model that proposes the repair is the model that judges it, and visual plausibility under that judge is a poor proxy for whether the page actually works. What the loop is missing is a counterparty the VLM cannot fool, and the browser already is that counterparty: a deterministic, executable simulator of how an HTML artifact behaves under user actions, and in everything but name a world model for web code. We present WebWorld, the
radar.summary_zh: VLM驅動的網頁程式碼自我改進存在結構性缺陷：提出修復的模型同時擔任評審者，僅憑截圖判斷頁面好壞，無法保證頁面在實際互動下真正可用。本文提出WebWorld，把瀏覽器視為現成的世界模型——瀏覽器本身就是確定、可執行的模擬器，能在使用者操作下重放網頁行為，成為VLM無法欺騙的對手。方法包含三個環節：規劃器將VLM的批評編譯成具型別的互動合約（目標謂詞、重放動作與保留集合）；瀏覽器重新執行候選修復，唯有在達成目標進度且保留所有先前已驗證能力時，才核發接受憑證；取得憑證的狀態轉移累積為品質棘輪，成為唯一的SFT匯出監督資料。在相同骨幹與訓練配方下，WebWorld-27B於HTMLBench-400較Raw-27B提升5.3分，MiniAppBench-Val提升14.9分，達到Kimi-K2.6與GPT-5.4等前沿系統在互動式HTML生成上的水準。9B等規模消融顯示瀏覽器憑證正是增益來源：移除憑證後增益僅剩0.4分，TC通過率甚至低於Raw；深度診斷顯示深度≥5的5,000筆樣本即可逼近完整32,800筆語料的效果。限制方面，方法目前僅針對單檔互動HTML，多檔或框架情境會引入部署變數；美學、品牌識別與無障礙等純感知缺陷缺乏可執行憑證，仍須依賴VLM代理判斷。此研究的價值在於將假設與證明分離：VLM提出假設，瀏覽器核發證明，使監督資料無須額外訓練世界模型即可可靠取得。

links.title: Textual Acoustic Grounding for Generalizable LLM-Based Deepfake Voice Detection

evidence: Abstract: claims 'over 16.2% absolute improvement in Macro-F1' over ALLM baselines and 'All models reported in this work are publicly available', but no repository URL for the released models appears in the text (footnote links cover only pretrained encoders).

Section V-B vs Table I: prose states Wav2Vec2 FR+LoRA-16 achieves 'LA19 F1: 99.44% ... ITW (54.95%) ... ML (69.78%)', but Table I row reports 96.84/33.15/56.21; prose for EAT FT+Frozen cites '(ITW: 54.20%; ML: 69.91%)' vs Table I values 27.12/57.62; codec ML F1 quoted as 65.83/65.59 vs Table I 33.68/38.70.

Section VI-B and Table III: openSMILE injection improves Whisper FT + Qwen-0.5B LoRA-16 ML F1 from 68.18% to 91.17% (+22.99%) and frozen-LLM average F1 from 91.09% to 93.54% (+2.45%); these values are internally consistent between prose and Table III.

Section V-C and Table II: frozen LLM outperforms LoRA across alpha in {16,64,256} and scales 0.5B/3B/7B for both encoders; scaling frozen Whisper FT from 0.5B to 7B slightly degrades average F1 (91.09% -> 90.58%), supporting the no-scaling-benefit claim.

Section IV: single training corpus (ASVspoof 2019 LA, 25,380 utterances), four evaluation benchmarks (LA19, LA21, ITW 31,779 trials, MLAAD v9 ~298,000 utterances), metrics Accuracy/Macro-F1 rather than the field-standard EER.
Section III-C: openSMILE eGeMAPSv2 (88 features) serialized to ~1500 text tokens; claim that token overhead is 'negligible... adds minimal latency' is asserted without measurement.

Section VII/Table IV: best configuration (Whisper FT + Qwen-0.5B LoRA-16 + OS) reaches 87.53% ITW / 91.17% ML vs ALLM4ADD 68.34/77.87 and ICLAD 77.80/59.30; the abstract's 16.2% figure does not match any single computed margin.
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric methodology (Qwen2.5 0.5B-7B backbones, LoRA, structured cross-modal prompting) applied to audio deepfake detection; not 'pure audio' since language-model methodology (prompting, frozen-vs-tuned LLM tradeoffs) is the core contribution, but the audio-forensics task is peripheral to core LLM/NLP interests. The openSMILE-as-text-prompt idea is genuinely novel for ALLM-based detection and the frozen-LLM finding is informative. However, Section V-B prose contains multiple numeric values that contradict Table I (e.g., Wav2Vec2 FR LA19 99.44/ITW 54.95 vs table 96.84/33.15; EAT FT+Frozen ITW 54.20/ML 69.91 vs table 27.12/57.62; codec ML 65.83/65.59 vs table 33.68/38.70), the headline '16.2%' improvement is not directly traceable to Table IV, no seeds/significance tests are reported, the 'all models publicly available' claim lacks a repository URL, and the 'negligible latency' claim for ~1500 added tokens is unmeasured. Directional conclusions (encoder FT drives OOD gains, frozen LLM competitive, openSMILE injection helps) are supported by internally consistent Table II/III data.

primary_link.title: Textual Acoustic Grounding for Generalizable LLM-Based Deepfake Voice Detection

radar.summary: Deepfake voice detection suffers from poor generalization across unseen domains. While Audio Large Language Models (ALLMs) show promise, the modality gap between continuous audio embeddings which capture the subtle acoustic details necessary for deepfake detection and the semantic space of LLMs remains a critical, underexplored bottleneck. We address this by benchmarking diverse audio encoders integrated with Qwen LLMs (0.5B to 7B parameters). First, we demonstrate that fine-tuning the LLM alone
radar.summary_zh: 深偽語音偵測最大的挑戰在於跨領域泛化:模型遇到訓練時未見過的偽造演算法或錄音環境時,效能往往大幅下滑。本文聚焦 Audio LLM(ALLM)架構中,連續音訊嵌入與 LLM 語意空間之間的模態落差。作者以 Qwen2.5-Instruct(0.5B 至 7B)為骨幹,系統性比較 Whisper、Wav2Vec2、EAT 與神經語音編解碼器(DAC、SpeechTokenizer)等音訊編碼器,並測試凍結、加權聚合與 fine-tuning 三種整合策略。關鍵發現:fine-tuning 音訊編碼器才是域外泛化的主要驅動力;單獨以 LoRA 微調 LLM 反而可能造成域外退化,凍結的 instruct LLM 是更穩健且省運算資源的基線。其次,作者提出跨模態提示策略,將 openSMILE eGeMAPSv2 的 88 項聲學特徵(如平均基頻、共振峰頻率)序列化為結構化文字,連同音訊嵌入一併輸入 LLM。此文字化扎根不僅強化凍結基線(平均 F1 由 91.09% 升至 93.54%),也使 LoRA 微調轉為有效:Whisper 搭配 LoRA-16 時,MLAAD 之 F1 從 68.18% 躍升至 91.17%。最終系統在域外 ITW 與 MLAAD 基準上,Macro-F1 較既有 ALLM 基線高出逾 16.2%,總參數量僅約 1.1B。限制包括:增益取決於編碼器預訓練目標(Whisper 受益大於 Wav2Vec2),原生多模態的 Qwen2.5-Omni 僅小幅改善,文字提示約增加 1500 個 token,且訓練僅使用 ASVspoof 2019 LA。整體而言,本研究為可解釋、推理導向的音訊鑑識提供了高效且泛化的新路徑。
radar.title: Textual Acoustic Grounding for Generalizable LLM-Based Deepfake Voice Detection
radar.title_zh: 以文字聲學扎根實現可泛化的 LLM 深偽語音偵測

links.title: Convergence rates for the RMSprop optimizer with full control of the hyperparameters

evidence: Abstract: main result bounds the expectation of the stopped objective by an exponentially decaying initialization term plus a stochastic approximation remainder of order γ_n and a memory error of order (1-β)^2, with constants uniformly controlled over step sizes, β, and ε∈[0,1], covering ε=0.

Section 1.2, Theorem 1.1 / Eq. (12): non-asymptotic bound holds for every gradient step n with all error constants explicitly specified; Remark 7.2 provides explicit C0, C1 (Eqs. (206), (208), (210)).

Section 1.4: authors state Theorem 1.1 is the first RMSprop result for SOPs with error constants uniformly controlled w.r.t. β and ε, motivating that ε-dependent constants would be ~10^16 at the PyTorch default ε=10^-8 and thus unusable.

Sections 4 and 6: key technical innovations are post-startup inverse moment bounds for the second moment process (Lemmas 4.4-4.5) and exponentially small pre-startup probabilities (Proposition 6.3), combined into a single recursion in Theorem 7.1 (Section 7).
Section 1.6: authors disclose that GPT 5.5 and GPT 5.6 were substantially employed to formulate and work out statements and proofs in LaTeX, with authors taking full responsibility.

Sections 1.2, 7, and 8: limitations — estimate restricted to the event {τ≥n} where the process stays in a measurable set V, and requires local PL inequality (Eq. (10)), L∞-bounded innovations (Eq. (9)), and (c,q)-regularity (Definition 4.1); applicability illustrated analytically via linear least squares (Theorem 1.2), risk-sensitive exponential tilting (Example 8.4), and compactly supported nonlinear regression (Proposition 8.5).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Pure optimizer-theory paper: proves RMSprop convergence rates for stochastic optimization with error constants uniformly bounded in the decay parameter β and regularization ε, including the unregularized regime ε=0. Strong fit to the Training & Optimization preference (RMSprop, Adam, learning rates, gradients) and motivated by practical PyTorch defaults, but it contains no LLM, language, or agent methodology, capping preference relevance. Novelty is real: the claimed first hyperparameter-uniform result rests on a new inverse-moment-bounds plus early/late-coordinate-decomposition proof mechanism. Rigor and evidence are solid for a theory paper (complete self-contained proofs, fully explicit constants in Remark 7.2, analytic verification on least squares, risk-sensitive tilting, and nonlinear regression), though no numerical experiments exist, LLM-assisted proof drafting is disclosed, and results are confined to stopped processes under a local PL inequality, L∞-bounded innovations, and a (c,q)-regularity condition, limiting generalizability to practical nonconvex deep learning.

primary_link.title: Convergence rates for the RMSprop optimizer with full control of the hyperparameters

radar.summary: Popular adaptive stochastic gradient descent (SGD) methods to train artificial intelligence (AI) systems include the RMSprop, the Adam, and the AdamW optimizers, where the adaptivity parts in Adam and AdamW basically just coincide with RMSprop. Such adaptive methods involve several hyperparameters including the regularization parameter $ε$ (which ensures that one does not divide by 0 and is often chosen to be very close to zero such as $10^{-8}$ in PyTorch by default) and the second moment decay
radar.summary_zh: 本文針對訓練人工智慧系統時廣泛採用的自適應隨機梯度下降法 RMSprop，建立對超參數完全可控的非漸近收斂速率。雖然相關理論文獻眾多，但誤差常數在正則化參數 ε 趨近零（PyTorch 預設為 10⁻⁸）與二階矩衰減參數 β 趨近一的關鍵區域是否仍一致有界，即使對凸隨機最佳化問題也長期懸而未決。作者在局部 Polyak–Łojasiewicz 不等式、創新項一致有界與 (c,q) 非退化假設下，證明在過程未離開集合 V 的事件上，目標函數期望值可由三項之和控制：隨訓練時間指數衰減的初始項、階數為 γ_n 的隨機近似餘項（此速率已知最佳），以及階數為 (1−β)² 的記憶誤差；誤差常數對所有容許的步長序列、β∈[1/2,1) 與 ε∈[0,1] 一致有界，涵蓋完全無正則化 ε=0 的情形，且從第一步起對每個梯度更新皆成立、常數均可明確寫出。技術上的關鍵創新是對第二矩過程建立逆動差上界：引入座標啟動時間，將分析拆解為啟動後的逆動差估計與啟動前機率呈指數小的部分，構成新的證明架構。作者並將結論應用於線性最小平方法（不要求 AᵀA 可逆）、風險敏感指數傾斜與緊緻支撐非線性迴歸等範例。限制包括誤差界僅在過程停留於 V 內時有效、需局部平滑與非退化條件，且因最佳化器內在誤差，(1−β)² 項一般無法改進。此結果使誤差分析在實務預設超參數區間真正可用。

radar.title_zh: RMSprop 最佳化器在超參數完全控制下的收斂速率

links.title: SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning

evidence: Abstract: claims SimCRAFT-7B 'significantly outperforms open-weights LLMs and rivals advanced closed-source models and specialized RS agents'
Section 4.4, Table 1: SimCRAFT-Qwen2.5-7B reports PSR 83.2, TSA 93.5, AEM 79.6, Hal.Rate 0.5 on SimRS-14k test split; GPT-5 reports 83.8 PSR
Section 4.6, Table 3: zero-fine-tuning ThinkGeo results show SimCRAFT 58.3 PSR vs GPT-4 61.8, Hal.Rate 3.9 vs 2.3
Section 4.5, Table 2: KnowFlow-Bench zero-shot PSR 79.4; cross-benchmark drop -3.8% vs vanilla SFT -10.8%
Section 4.1: PKB and KnowFlow-Bench both derive from CangLing-KnowFlow; ThinkGeo (486 tasks, independent provenance) added to rule out shared-provenance effects
Section 4.7: CRAFT yields +9.6% to +11.6% PSR over vanilla SFT across Qwen-2.5-7B, Llama-3-8B, Mistral-7B; Qwen3-8B reaches 84.7% PSR
Section 4.7, Table 4: perturbation sweep peaks at epsilon=0.15 (PSR 83.2) and degrades below unperturbed baseline at 0.50 (76.9)
Section 3.4.3: Mock Execution Engine applies schema, dependency, and compatibility checks; 16,200 candidates, 13.6% rejection, 14,003 retained; 2800 human-inspected with 99.5% pass

Limitations: Mock Execution Engine does not invoke GDAL/SNAP/GEE on real imagery; PSR/TSA/AEM do not measure downstream product correctness; cross-domain transfer requires domain-specific reconstruction
Section 4.1: LoRA r=64, alpha=128, dropout 0.05, AdamW lr 2e-5, 3 epochs, 8x A800; footnote 1 claims code at github.com/WangHrYii/SimCRAFT
Appendix D and Appendix E: describe six synthesis agents and a frozen dual-encoder retriever but never specify which underlying LLM powers the agents or which encoder model is used
llm_evaluation.rationale: An LLM agent-training paper instantiated in remote sensing, not a pure domain application: the central contributions are methodological (RAFT-style retrieval-augmented fine-tuning extended to multi-step tool planning with two noise perturbations, plus a constraint-validated multi-agent trajectory synthesis pipeline), so the 0.20 out-of-scope cap does not apply. Topic fit is strong for Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RAG, and Training preferences, but the remote sensing domain itself matches no listed preference and cross-domain transfer is explicitly scoped out (Limitations), tempering relevance. Rigor is comparatively strong: backbone x paradigm ablations across three 7B backbones plus Qwen3-8B (Section 4.7), perturbation sweep with a non-monotonic peak (Table 4), novice-ratio ablation, bootstrap CIs (Appendix F), and two external benchmarks. Evidence strength is limited by the headline claim of rivaling GPT-5/Gemini-3-Flash resting on a held-out split of the authors' own synthetic SimRS-14k distribution, where in-distribution training confounds comparison; on the independent ThinkGeo benchmark the gap to GPT-4 narrows to 58.3 vs 61.8 PSR (Table 3), and KnowFlow-Bench shares provenance with the PKB (acknowledged in Section 4.1). Internal numbers are consistent (16,200 - 2,197 = 14,003; 13.6% rejection; 2787/2800 human passes; ablation sums match). Reproducibility is decent (code link, LoRA/optimizer hyperparameters, full 36-tool schemas in Appendix B) but the LLM powering the six synthesis agents and the identity of the frozen dual-encoder retriever are never specified, and seed-task release is unclear. Novelty is moderate: RAFT adaptation and verify-then-filter synthesis extend known patterns (RAFT, RA-DIT, APIGen, ToolACE) to multi-step planning with clarification dialogues and dependency/compatibility checks.

primary_link.title: SimCRAFT: Distilling Remote Sensing Agents via Synthetic Trajectories and Contextual Retrieval-Augmented Fine-Tuning

radar.summary: The unprecedented surge in Earth observation data volume and diversity has exposed a critical bottleneck for traditional manual workflows, catalyzing the emergence of Remote Sensing (RS) Agents. However, the practical deployment of these advanced agents is severely hindered by their heavy reliance on large-scale general-purpose LLMs, which lack deep domain expertise and impose prohibitive infrastructure demands. To resolve this, we propose SimCRAFT, a model-agnostic framework that distills sophi
radar.summary_zh: 遙測代理人可將自然語言查詢轉為多步驟工具呼叫序列,但現有系統依賴 GPT-4 級閉源大型語言模型,運算成本高、網路連線受限且隱私風險大,難以部署於衛星或無人機等邊緣環境。本文提出 SimCRAFT,一個與模型無關的兩階段框架,將遙測工作流程規劃能力蒸餾至 7B 級開源模型。第一階段為多代理資料合成:結合雙模式使用者模擬(專家模式與需追問釐清的新手模式)、規劃/執行/反思/摘要四代理協作,以及 Mock Execution Engine 對綱要、相依性與感測器相容性的三重驗證,由 162 個種子任務擴展出含 14,003 條軌跡的 SimRS-14k 語料。第二階段提出情境式檢索增強微調(CRAFT):訓練時從程序知識庫檢索標準作業程序作為脈絡,並施加無關情境注入與參數變異兩種擾動,迫使模型從含噪脈絡萃取可遷移的程序結構而非機械複製。結果顯示,SimCRAFT-Qwen2.5-7B 在 SimRS-14k 測試集達 83.2% 規劃成功率與 0.5% 幻覺率,媲美 GPT-5 等閉源模型;在 KnowFlow-Bench 零微調達 79.4%,於獨立來源的 ThinkGeo 基準達 58.3%,接近 GPT-4。消融實驗證實 CRAFT 較一般 SFT 提升 9.6 至 11.6 個百分點,且跨三種 7B 骨幹結論一致。限制方面,模擬執行引擎未在真實影像上驗證下游產品正確性,工具集亦限於遙測領域。此研究證明,經約束驗證的合成資料搭配情境去噪訓練,可讓體積小約百倍的開源模型比擬閉源前沿模型,利於資源受限情境下的邊緣部署。

links.title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance

evidence: Abstract: 'Across 36 synthetic authorization attacks, a direct-agent baseline accepted 36 attack effects, a transparent prompt-policy baseline accepted 20, and AIS accepted none; all configurations accepted 8/8 admissible fixtures.'
Section 3.4: 'This evaluation isolates architecture mechanics; it does not call a live language model or estimate an empirical attack probability.'

Section 8.5: 'the executable prototype is a deterministic, author-implemented architecture-mechanism test. It contains no live model, production key, concurrency, economic optimization, compromised control plane, key theft, collusion, or implementation vulnerability.'

Section 2.3: 'AIS does not claim that mediation, least privilege, or capabilities are new; its novelty is their integration with the FAI and an accounting-grade evidence chain for probabilistic agents.'

Section 6.1: 'The raw sample contains 1,700 address-transaction rows... The EIP-3009 candidate rule retained 1,193 transactions.' with explicit caveat that values 'describe a non-random latest-activity sample and are not population estimates.'
Section 3.4: 'The v2 code, machine-readable fixtures, event records, results, summary, and protocol are preserved separately from v1 in the replication directory.'

Section 7.3: 'The experiment does not show that every prompt control will have a 55.6% failure rate, nor that every AIS implementation will achieve zero failures. The rates are conditional on transparent baseline definitions and fixed fixtures.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: A design-science paper proposing Authority-Inference Separation (AIS): a deterministic control plane that grants LLM agents temporary, single-use execution authority over a typed Financial Action Intent, evaluated with a 48-fixture prototype and a descriptive Base/x402 ledger test. Preference relevance is solid for the high-weight Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety interests (agentic finance, agent identity, prompt injection, agent hijacking defenses, business workflows), but weak for LLM methodology itself: the harness explicitly calls no live model, so no LLM capability is measured. Novelty is moderate and honestly bounded by the authors: reference monitors, capabilities, nonces, and least privilege are classic; the contribution is their integration with an FAI and an accounting-grade evidence chain plus an encodable/attestable/human taxonomy. Rigor within its self-imposed scope is decent (formal invariants, fixed denominators, three transparent configurations, bounded claims), but attacks are author-synthetic, not drawn from established benchmarks like AgentDojo, and exact 0%/100% outcomes are structurally guaranteed rather than discovered. Evidence strength is limited: results demonstrate architecture mechanics in the harness, and the ledger sample is a non-random latest-activity snapshot explicitly not usable for adoption inference. Generalizability is plausible across four finance domains and rails but untested with real models, concurrency, or adaptive adversaries. Reproducibility is moderately supported by a deterministic prototype and a claimed replication directory, though no public repository link is provided.

primary_link.title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance

radar.summary: AI agents can select tools, counterparties, and transaction parameters, yet inference should not itself confer authority to execute a financial action. This study develops and evaluates Authority-Inference Separation (AIS), an intent-centered architecture for bounded agentic finance. AIS treats a financial action intent as the control object: a machine-generated proposal can receive temporary executable authority only after an independent deterministic control plane validates registered agent id
radar.summary_zh: 本論文處理AI代理在金融場景中可自行選擇工具與交易參數,但推論能力不應等同執行權限的核心問題。作者提出「權限—推論分離」(Authority–Inference Separation, AIS)架構:代理產生的金融行動意圖(FAI)須先經獨立的確定性控制平面驗證,包括持久代理識別、具名的當責負責人、授權與風險胃納脈絡、政策版本、狀態與精確經濟語義,方能取得短期單次使用的可執行權限,並以確定性原因代碼記錄准駁;模型自身的解釋僅供診斷,不具授權效力。區塊鏈則負責執行已授予權限的操作表示並留存可攜帶的結算證據。方法採設計科學流程,結合需求追溯、跨四個金融領域的實例化、BIS與MAS官方案例、48個可執行測試範例,以及Base公鏈上1,700筆x402相關交易的公開帳本觀察。結果顯示:36個合成授權攻擊中,直接代理基線全數接受、提示政策基線接受20個,AIS則全部拒絕;8個合規案例全數獲准執行,重播與替換攻擊亦全數攔截,13個定義的證據欄位完整填列。限制在於:原型不含真實模型與生產環境,基準定義影響確切比率,公鏈樣本非隨機,且政策正當性、模型適任性與法律問責仍屬鏈外與人類職責。本研究的價值在於劃出「可編碼、可見證、仍須人類」的治理邊界:帳本能使已授予的權限可執行、可稽核,卻無法使其正當。
radar.title: Authority-Inference Separation in Agentic Finance: First-Line Control, Blockchain Enforcement, and Replayable Assurance
radar.title_zh: 代理式金融中的權限—推論分離:第一線控制、區塊鏈執行與可重播保證

links.title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention

evidence: Section 3.2, Table 1: learned-gate notebook reaches 81.9%/80.2% at train length L=512 and 81.1% zero-shot at L=2048 (two seeds) vs trunk-only 3.8%/0.0% and a parameter-matched attention head 100%/0.0%.

Section 4.1, Table 2: algebraic unlearning drops the erased fact to 4.3%/3.1% (chance 3.8%) while retained facts remain ~84% at both lengths, with a memory-only counterfactual confirming removal from the store.

Section 7, Table 3: WikiText-103 ladder 8→512 MB shows monotonic extra repeat gain +0.064→+0.156 bits/byte at 8× length with a two-seed error bar (±0.008) at the top rung and zero-to-negative overall cost.

Section 5.4 and Section 9: the attention twin posts +0.83–1.04 repeat gain on natural text and generalizes zero-shot, honestly scoping the notebook's claim to exact one-shot recall at O(L); limitations admit all results are 0.2–3.4M params, ≤512 MB data, single head baseline.
Section 6: word-level negative result — extra repeat gain ≤+0.13 with flat gate selectivity (β=0.16) — showing the method is absorbed outside its byte-level habitat.

Appendix A/B: full hyperparameter recipe card, seeds 42/43, and a 19-experiment pre-registered registry ('JSON reports accompany the scripts'), though no explicit public repository or code release URL is stated.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An architecture/language-modeling paper (in scope) on a 25K-param HRR associative memory ('notebook') attached to an attention-free byte trunk, targeting length-invariant one-shot recall. It aligns with medium-weight preferences (Long Context & Memory, Transformer Architecture via SSM/linear-attention family, NLP, scaling) but misses the highest-weight ones (LLM, agents, reasoning, Japanese LLM) since models are only 0.2-3.4M params on WikiText. Novelty is solid: fixed content keys, local write gate, self-gating read, and write-triggered forgetting are a new combination, though the VSA/HRR algebra and memory-module lineage (NTM/DNC, fast weights, Memorizing Transformers, Titans) are classical, and unlearning-by-subtraction follows directly from linear superposition. Rigor is unusually strong for a solo effort: ten pre-registered rounds, oracle gates, counterfactual read-outs, documented harness bug, honest negative results (word-level absorption, attention generalizes on natural-text repetition), budget-matched arms. Evidence is internally consistent with tables and two seeds at headline points, but rests on a synthetic needle task, a single-head attention baseline, self-reported pre-registration, and no empirical comparison to modern memory baselines. Generalizability is limited: tested only on the authors' own reverb trunk, fails at word level, untested on Mamba/RWKV despite the framing, and small scale. Reproducibility is aided by a full hyperparameter recipe card and experiment registry, but no public code URL is stated.

primary_link.title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention

radar.summary: Recurrent, attention-free sequence models share a structural weakness: a fading state cannot perform exact recall of something seen once, far in the past. We add to the Kathleen trunk a second memory layer -- a "notebook": a fixed-key holographic (HRR) associative store with a learned local write gate, a self-gating raw read, and write-triggered forgetting -- 25K parameters that attach to the logits of any trunk. (1) Mechanism: on a controlled needle-in-haystack task the notebook reaches 80-82%
radar.summary_zh: 問題:無 Attention 的序列模型(狀態空間模型、線性注意力變體與 Kathleen 位元組級模型)以會衰減的狀態換取 O(L) 成本,卻無法精確回憶遙遠過去僅見過一次的內容;Transformer 靠二次方成本解決,但違背此類模型的初衷。方法:在主幹上加掛約 25K 參數的「notebook」記憶模組——固定隨機內容鍵構成的全像(HRR)關聯記憶體,位址只依內容不依位置,結構上即長度不變;僅看 16 位元組局部視窗的學習式寫入閘門;以取回向量幅值自我閘控的原始讀出;以及與寫入量(而非時間)掛鉤的寫入觸發遺忘。證據:大海撈針測試中,notebook 於 4 倍訓練長度達 80–82% 單次回憶(兩個 seed),未訓練的記憶體本身在 512/2048/4096 皆約 90%;參數匹配的 attention head 在訓練長度內 100%、超出即 0%。論文以十輪預註冊實驗隔離三處長度洩漏(閘門視野過窄、ℓ2 正規化放大雜訊、主幹 logits 漂移),皆以結構修正。因記憶體為線性疊加,一次減法可將單一事實擦至隨機水準且不傷其他事實;反事實擦除提供 100% 逐位元組溯源。真實文字上重複罕見詞增益 +0.15–0.27 bits/byte,隨距離增長且總成本為零;WikiText-103 階梯上增益隨資料單調上升。限制:規模僅 0.2–3.4M 參數;attention 對照僅單頭,且其在自然文字重複任務上仍較強;無標記情境的顯著性偵測僅半解;詞級模型會吸收此記憶;遺忘機制犧牲部分近距增益。意義:以常數狀態與 O(L) 成本達成精確回憶,並提供梯度訓練權重做不到的「可保證遺忘」與逐位元組溯源,對資料刪除義務(如 GDPR)與可稽核 AI 具啟示。
radar.title: Kathleen Remembers: Length-Invariant One-Shot Recall Without Attention
radar.title_zh: Kathleen 會記得:不靠 Attention 的長度不變單次回憶

links.title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry

evidence: Section 5.2 / Table 2: CE-GRPO averages 76.04 across nine benchmarks, beating native Qwen3-VL-8B by 8.09, Code-CoT SFT by 6.49, and trajectory-level GRPO by 3.43, improving on the backbone on all nine benchmarks.
Section 5.3 / Table 5: selector ablation shows structure-only reaches 74.26 vs 72.48 random, structure+entropy 76.04 with lowest unclosed rate 4.73%; entropy alone adds only 0.35 over random.
Appendix C.2 / Table 14: offline validation on 300 problems shows structural selection raises Crit.@2 from 0.222 to 0.289 (30.2% relative) and |ΔR| from 0.327 to 0.409.
Section 6 / Fig. 4: CE-GRPO margin over trajectory GRPO grows 3.77 points per additional event (r=0.866, p=0.0016, n=9), significant under leave-one-benchmark-out (p≤0.028).

Appendix B.1 and A.2: answer equivalence judged by Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview and Gemini-2.5-Pro, while SFT traces are synthesized by Gemini-3.1-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Pro; judge–synthesis dependence is unmitigated beyond 'condition-blind' judging in Table 4.

Table 12 / Section B.2: all post-training baselines share the Code-CoT SFT checkpoint, but DPO and GPO use LoRA while others use full updates, and SRPO/CFPO/GRPO-MA are adaptations whose fidelity to originals is unverifiable.
Conclusion: broad applicability to structured-reasoning tasks is claimed, but experiments are limited to geometry benchmarks with a typed-event protocol; no cross-task or second-backbone results.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A reasoning-methodology paper (structured Code-CoT plus event-localized GRPO credit assignment) on multimodal geometry, so it falls inside scope rather than pure CV. Strong alignment with Reasoning & CoT, RL/alignment, and code-based reasoning preferences, though not with Japanese LLM topics. The representation-optimization co-design (typed events as both inference units and branch points for shared-prefix counterfactual groups) is a genuine but incremental advance over VinePPO/SPO/GPO/CFPO-style fine-grained credit assignment. Rigor is solid: nine benchmarks, eight adapted baselines from a shared SFT checkpoint, selector ablation, closed-only re-scoring, offline selector validation, and an event-count correlation (r=0.866, p=0.0016 on n=9, so p-value looks slightly optimistic but leave-one-out tests are reported). Evidence is weakened by a single backbone, single-run results with best-checkpoint selection, adapted (re-implemented) competing methods, and proprietary Gemini/DeepSeek models used for both trace synthesis and answer judging, creating possible favoritism toward the Code-CoT format. Gains over SFT (6.49) vs GRPO (3.43) show part of the improvement is distillation rather than the RL mechanism. Generalizability is asserted ('broadly applicable to reasoning tasks with explicit intermediate structure') but tested only on geometry, and the method requires task-specific event protocols. Reproducibility is moderate: a GitHub link, full hyperparameters (Table 12), and dataset details are given, but the SFT pipeline depends on closed frontier models whose outputs are not reproducible.

primary_link.title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry

radar.summary: Multimodal geometry reasoning requires VLMs to extract precise visual relations and preserve them through multi-step deduction. Existing free-form traces obscure the decisions that determine the answer, and trajectory-level reinforcement learning distributes a single terminal signal across the entire response. We introduce credit-addressable reasoning, in which the semantic units exposed during inference also define where learning compares alternatives and assigns credit. We instantiate this pri
radar.summary_zh: 多模態幾何推理要求視覺語言模型（VLM）精確解讀圖形關係，並在多步演繹中保持一致；然而自由形式的推理鏈會隱藏決定答案的關鍵決策，軌跡級強化學習也只能將單一終端獎勵平攤到整個回應。本文提出「信用可定址推理」，主張推論時暴露的語義單元應同時定義學習中比較與分配信用的位置，並包含兩項設計：Code-CoT 保留原始圖形，將視覺關係表示為可逐行定址、可執行的 Matplotlib 感知程式碼，並把推理組織成 reference、auxiliary、coordinate 與 think 等型別化事件；CE-GRPO 則以結構先驗與型別正規化熵選出候選事件，固定影像、問題與完整前綴後取樣多條完整後續，將終端結果差異轉換為事件局部優勢。在九個幾何基準上，CE-GRPO 平均準確率達 76.04，分別超越 Qwen3-VL-8B 原生模型 8.09 分與軌跡級 GRPO 3.43 分，並在全部九項基準勝過基礎模型；僅計有效終止回應時仍保有 3.91 分優勢。離線分析顯示結構選擇器找出改變結果事件的機率比隨機選擇高約 30%，且中間事件越多優勢越大，每增加一個事件平均多 3.77 分。限制方面，動機研究未區分感知與程式碼轉譯的錯誤來源，無資訊量的選擇僅浪費運算，框架亦僅適用於有明確中間結構的任務。整體而言，本研究示範推理表示與信用分配協同設計，對長鏈、高依賴多模態推理極具價值。

links.title: The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce

evidence: Abstract: 'DRR reaches accuracy parity with the strongest confidence-based router while achieving more than 60% reasoning-token cost savings.'

Table 1 (Section 4.2): DRR 82.8 [80.8, 84.8] accuracy at 21.7% human review with 66.2% reasoning-token savings vs MaxConf 82.0 [80.0, 84.0] at 20.0% review with 55.2% savings; N=1,405 with 95% bootstrap CIs.

Section 4.1 Models: 'Both automated annotators use Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite'; Direct runs with thinking disabled, Reasoning with dynamic thinking enabled; OpenCLIP ViT-L/14 features with shared MLP trunk.
Section 4.2: methods without human routing 'top out at 79.1% accuracy with Oracle, below the thresholded methods that can route examples to human review.'
Table 3 (Section 4.4): rule-level joint failures concentrate in subjective rules (D1 17.4%, E1 16.7%) while objective rules show 0.0% joint failure.

Limitations: evaluation on 'a specific production e-commerce annotation workflow'; 'We do not evaluate label efficiency across training-label budgets'; human review 'treated as ground truth' despite possible disagreement.

Appendix A.4/A.5: derivation of the MVOR > lambda*DeltaC threshold rule (Proposition 1) and budget-response/mirror-ascent properties of the log-space dual update (Propositions 2-3), with explicit disclaimer that global convergence is not claimed for the non-convex router.
Appendix A.6: full system instruction and JSON output prompt provided; no code or dataset availability statement appears anywhere in the document.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An applied LLM-routing paper squarely within preferred topics: it addresses when to spend test-time reasoning compute (Reasoning & CoT, LLM preferences), combines model routing with learning-to-defer so human escalation doubles as cold-start label acquisition, and reports cost-aware inference results. The core method (differentially supervised success-probability heads, MVOR = difference of success probabilities, cost-adjusted threshold rule, log-space dual update) is a sensible but largely assembly of existing ingredients (routing à la BEST-Route/ThinkSwitcher, selective prediction/learning-to-defer), with the main novelty being the three-way joint routing + label-acquisition framing and rule-level diagnostics. Rigor is solid for an industry paper: constrained optimization formalized, component-isolating baselines (MVOR-only, Ambiguity-only, Oracle, MaxConf), bootstrap CIs, honest 'parity not superiority' framing, and explicit limitations. Evidence is limited to one proprietary e-commerce task with a single model pair (Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite with thinking toggled), no public benchmark, no significance test for the 82.8 vs 82.0 comparison, and DRR realizing 21.7% review vs MaxConf's 20.0%, a mild confound; the headline savings claim (66.2% vs 55.2%) is well-supported by Table 1. Generalizability is constrained by the single domain and conjunctive rule task, as the authors concede. Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, proprietary production data and commercial models, though prompts (A.6), rules (A.1), and implementation sketch (A.3) are provided and several hyperparameters/thresholds are unspecified. Not a pure domain-application paper since the routing methodology is language-model-centric, but the single-task production evaluation caps the overall score.

primary_link.title: The Differential Reasoning Router: Operationalizing Cost-Aware LLM Annotation in E-commerce

radar.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used to annotate structured product data in e-commerce, but early deployment often begins as a cold-start problem: only limited pre-launch labels are available, the value of expensive reasoning is unknown, and human review is needed before the system can be trusted at scale. This challenge is especially common in rule-based annotation workflows, where each item must satisfy multiple business rules and both model errors and ambiguous rule boundaries a
radar.summary_zh: 電商平台常以大型語言模型（LLM）標註結構化商品資料，但上線初期面臨冷啟動難題：人工標籤稀少、昂貴推理模型的效益未知，規模化前仍需人工審核把關。本文提出差異化推理路由器（Differential Reasoning Router, DRR），在直接模型（M_d）、推理模型（M_r）與人工審核三者間做成本感知的決策。DRR 分別在樣本層級與規則層級估計兩模型的成功機率，並計算「推理邊際價值」（MVOR）與雙重失敗的模糊性分數：簡單案例交由直接模型，推理留給預期能改善決策的案例，可能雙雙失敗或規則不一致者轉人工。訓練時以拉格朗日乘數控制推理預算；人工審核的標籤回饋至提示工程、supervised fine-tuning、校準與規則修正，形成改善迴路。在真實電商的主圖資格驗證任務（11 條規則、9,358 筆標註）上，DRR 達 82.8% 準確率，與最強基線 MaxConf（82.0%）相當，但在 21.7% 人工複審率下省下 66.2% 推理 token 成本（MaxConf 為 55.2%）。規則層級診斷顯示雙重失敗集中於主觀規則（如產品是否為視覺焦點），可指引規則修訂與真值蒐集。限制包括：僅在單一生產流程驗證、未評估不同訓練標籤預算下的效率，且假設人工標註即為真值。此研究將冷啟動 LLM 標註轉化為兼顧成本、準確率與人力的明確營運策略，對產業部署極具參考價值。

links.title: HF-SID: High-Fidelity Semantic IDs for Generative Retrieval in Location-Based Services

evidence: §4.1 Baselines: 'all baselines are re-implemented under the same configuration as HF-SID: codebook depth L=3, per-layer codebook size N_c=4096 on AMap-L and N_c=512 on AMap-S' with seven SID methods listed
§4.1 Implementation: backbone 'initialized from Qwen3-0.6B', downstream next-POI task uses 'Qwen3-4B with full-parameter supervised fine-tuning (SFT)', beam width 300, 64 A100 GPUs
§4.2 Table 2: HF-SID reaches Avg.Dist 0.25 km and Hit@200 81.24% vs strongest baseline GeoGR 0.49 km / 77.58% on AMap-L
§4.3 Ablation: 'w/o Geo' drops Hit@200 from 81.24% to 68.34% (−15.88%); 'w/o All' returns to plain RQ-KMeans at 54.47%, 'the entire gap to the baseline is attributable to the representation alone'

§2 Related Work: dedicated scalar encoders '(Jin et al., 2026)' previously 'evaluated on reasoning tasks rather than identifier construction', indicating the numerical encoder is adapted rather than invented
§4.5 Public datasets: only Geo-CPT is applied; 'Avg.Dist. drops from 6.96 km to 3.99 km on NYC (−42.7%)' versus −95.9% on AMap-L, showing weaker transfer
§4.6 Table 6: averaged online A/B gains 'PV_CVR rises by 6.74% and UV_CVR by 6.03%' over a production geography-aware system
§4.1 Datasets: 'AMap-S is a publicly released subset from the same platform'; AMap-L is built from proprietary anonymized interaction logs and not released
llm_evaluation.rationale: LLM-centric generative retrieval methodology (Qwen3 backbone, numerical encoders fused into the LLM, two-stage CPT, residual contrastive learning) applied to POI recommendation in LBS. It contains genuine language-model representation methodology rather than being a pure domain application, so it is not capped, but the target task (recommender systems / map search) is peripheral to the core preference areas (LLM, reasoning, RAG, agents), keeping preference relevance moderate. Novelty is incremental: the numerical encoder is adapted from GeoNum (§2), Cartesian coordinate transformation and contrastive SID refinement are known ideas, recombined with type embeddings and a last-layer-only contrastive design. Rigor is solid: seven baselines re-implemented under identical SID config (§4.1), leave-one-out ablations that remove representation not information (§4.3), NMI and attribute-dispersion analyses (§4.4), public-dataset validation (§4.5), and a one-week online A/B over three scenarios (§4.6). Evidence is quantitatively detailed and internally consistent (Table 2: 0.25 km Avg.Dist, 81.24% Hit@200; Table 3: w/o Geo −15.88%), but the headline dataset AMap-L is proprietary, ablations run only on AMap-L, and no significance testing or variance reporting is given. Generalizability is tempered by public-dataset gains being weaker and limited to Geo-CPT (§4.5: −42.7% vs −95.9%). Reproducibility is partial: AMap-S is released and hyperparameters are specified (§4.1), but AMap-L, CPT data, and code availability are unstated, and the pipeline requires 64 A100s.

primary_link.title: HF-SID: High-Fidelity Semantic IDs for Generative Retrieval in Location-Based Services

radar.summary: Generative retrieval has attracted increasing attention in Location-Based Services (LBS), where each Point-of-Interest (POI) is represented as a Semantic ID (SID). As the SID is the only channel through which POI information reaches the generative model, whatever it fails to preserve is irrecoverable at decoding time, and LBS retrieval is especially sensitive to the fine-grained differences that existing SIDs blur. Specifically, (1) LLMs embed continuous coordinates discontinuously, so their num
radar.summary_zh: 在生成式檢索中，Semantic ID（SID）是 POI 資訊抵達生成模型的唯一通道，凡表示階段未能保留的資訊，解碼時便永久無法挽回。本文指出現有 POI 導向的 SID 方法介入太晚：LLM 將座標切碎為數字子詞元造成編碼不連續、數值屬性量級懸殊使相同差距意義迥異、短文字無法表達「購物/消費電子」這類階層歸屬，導致地理、數值與結構保真度在量化前即已流失。HF-SID 主張在寫入離散碼之前於表示層修復：將經緯度轉為連續的三維笛卡兒座標；以極座標分解把每個數值編成單一連續單元，經凍結的 Numerical Encoder 映射，並加上 Type Embedding 使各屬性類型擁有獨立子空間；透過 Geo-CPT 與 Num-CPT 兩階段持續預訓練對齊 LLM；再將 Structure-based Contrastive Learning 僅施加於第三層量化前的殘差，分離共用粗標籤但細粒度不同的鄰近 POI。這些機制豐富表示而非加長識別碼，SID 維持 3 個 token。在 AMap-L 上，SID 內部平均地理距離降低 95.9%，Hit@200 較最強基線 GeoGR 提升 3.66 個百分點至 81.24%；線上 A/B 測試 PV_CVR 與 UV_CVR 分別成長 6.74% 與 6.03%。限制方面：公開資料集 NYC、TKY 缺少動態數值屬性與細粒度標籤，僅能驗證 Geo-CPT，相對改善幅度較小（-42.7%）；方法高度依賴工業級屬性，A/B 測試僅涵蓋一週與三種場景。作者並釋出 AMap-S 資料集，證明表示保真度而非碼簿設計才是生成式檢索成效的關鍵。

links.title: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence

evidence: Abstract and §1 Contributions: OLIVE fuses explicit behavioral and implicit fixation-locked EEG evidence to adapt a frozen VLM, reporting 96.8% guidance convergence in 28.3 s and Pareto-domination of TPT/TDA/olive-base baselines.
§3.4 and Appendix C: online EM with reliability parameters (α, β, ν+, ν−), prevalence anchoring, and ordered projection; Propositions C.1/C.2 with proof sketches (App. C.4).
§4.3.1: OLIVE-IE 96.8% (92/95 rounds, 5 seeds) vs olive-base-E 86.3%/59.9 s and TPT-E 29.5 s/68.4%; TDA-E shows ranking without calibrated belief (zero belief convergence).
§5.4.2 and §6.3.2: within-session throughput gains Δ=+0.031 kills/s (p=.003) in US2 and Δ=+0.070 (p=.001) in US3; §6.3.1 guidance reconvergence 14.7 s faster (p=.008).
§5.2 acknowledges Oracle cue density is not matched across conditions; §7 Limitations admits modest per-condition n (8–14), exploratory framing for US2/US3, and untested prevalence drift.

Data and code availability: GitHub (ApocalyVec/olive) and HuggingFace dataset (olive-frp) released, but Appendix E decoder note states the physio decoder architecture is withheld pending separate publication; only per-fixation probabilities are released.
Appendix E.9: portable-EEG form-factor results are explicitly simulation-based plausibility checks, not hardware measurements, showing appropriate evidential hedging.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An HCI/BCI paper (XR assistive agent) whose ML core is online EM adaptation of a frozen CLIP VLM via virtual prompt tuning, framed as a human-contingent test-time adaptation of a foundation model. It partially matches the profile (AI agent, foundation model, VLM/prompt tuning, TTA baselines TPT/TDA) but contains no LLM, reasoning, RAG, Japanese-NLP, code, or safety substance, so preference relevance is modest though not in the enumerated out-of-scope categories. Methodologically novel fusion of Dawid-Skene-style reliability estimation with frozen-VLM adaptation; three user studies (N=57/46/45) with ablations (E/I/IE, olive-base), formal propositions, and honest limitations (exploratory between-subjects n=8-14, unmatched Oracle cue density, fixed prevalence anchor, decoder weights withheld). Code and dataset are released. Overall a rigorous, well-evidenced, but domain-adjacent paper.
topics: Online EM / learning from noisy annotators
Prompt tuning of frozen foundation models

primary_link.title: Augmenting Human Performance with an XR Agent Learning from Online Behavior and BCI Evidence

radar.summary: We present OLIVE, a framework for adapting a foundation model to provide real-time assistance in temporally demanding, high-stakes, and dynamic tasks. We show that passive EEG, fused online with behavioral evidence, can meaningfully extend the number of targets users detect and engage beyond their unaided action bandwidth. OLIVE learns from both explicit behavioral signals (the targets the user shoots down in an XR first-person shooter game) and implicit physiological signals (fixation-locked EE
radar.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出 OLIVE 框架，針對注意力成為瓶頸的高風險任務（如空中交通管制、放射判讀），讓凍結的視覺—語言模型（CLIP）在任務中即時適應個別使用者。OLIVE 融合兩類證據：明確的行為訊號（XR 射擊遊戲中的開槍）與隱含的生理訊號（注視鎖定 EEG），透過線上期望最大化（EM）演算法同時估計各來源可靠度，並只微調虛擬提示，無需人工標記或離線重訓練。三項使用者研究以 XR 遊戲 SpaceShooter 進行：US1（N=57）顯示 OLIVE-IE 在 28.3 秒內達成 96.8% 引導收斂率，在收斂率與速度上 Pareto 支配 TPT、TDA 等基線，且不受認知過載或低品質 EEG 影響；US2（N=46）即時部署中，OLIVE-IE 操作者的每秒確認擊殺數顯著提升（Δ=+0.031，p=.003），且與射擊技術無關；US3（N=45）在目標無預警切換時，OLIVE-IE 的新目標擊殺提升最大（Δ=+0.070，p=.001），引導重新收斂比僅用行為證據的版本快 14.7 秒（p=.008）。限制：US2/US3 屬探索性，各條件僅 8–14 人；固定流行率錨定 π 未驗證漂移情境；瞳孔訊號因 XR 亮度干擾遭排除；且為受控代理任務而非真實場域。核心啟示：AI 應透過展現與操作者意圖的一致性贏得信任，而非仰賴預設配置，這為被動神經副駕系統開啟了設計空間。

links.title: Tail-Replay: Escaping the Curse of Linear Attention in Prefix Caching for Hybrid LLMs

evidence: Abstract: 'retains 92.8–99.9% of full-prefill quality on LongBench and RULER' with 5–10% replay budget and '9.1–14.3×' TTFT speedup at 32K
§2 Related work: Marconi 'focuses on which recurrent states to retain' and Sparse Prefix Caching 'focuses on where to place checkpoints'; Tail-Replay differs by omitting recurrent-state checkpoints

§3 Method: caches FA KV plus per-token FA output hiddens; on cache hit replays tail of k=⌈rm⌉ tokens from zero-initialized state per linear-attention group; tail-FFN skip and transfer/replay overlap optimizations
§4 Experiment: three Gated DeltaNet-based models (OLMo-Hybrid-7B, Qwen3.5-4B, Qwen3.6-27B) on NVIDIA H100, PyTorch 2.9.1; TTFT averaged over 20 timed repetitions
Table 1: quality retention spans 92.8% (OLMo-Hybrid-7B LongBench r=5%) to 99.9% (several RULER cells); zero-only baseline isolates reconstruction benefit
Table 2: speedups 9.82×, 9.12×, 14.32× at ~32K matched prefixes for OVL+skip at 5% replay; 10% replay increases TTFT at 32K where replay dominates
Table 3 (Appendix A): per-cell results cover only 5 LongBench tasks and 4 RULER tasks at 8K/16K–64K; no comparison against Marconi, Sparse Prefix Caching, or LinearKV reported anywhere in the paper
No code/data release, no storage-overhead measurement for cached FA output hiddens, and no variance/statistical reporting found in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM systems paper on prefix caching for hybrid (full-attention + linear-attention) models, matching LLM serving, long-context, and inference-efficiency preferences; not a domain-application or out-of-scope area. The core idea—exploiting gated linear attention's decay so a short tail replay reconstructs recurrent states, eliminating checkpoint-constrained reuse boundaries—is a genuine, cleanly motivated advance over Marconi and Sparse Prefix Caching, though adjacent to LinearKV and incremental in scope. Rigor is moderate: three models, two budgets, a zero-state ablation baseline, and per-cell results (Appendix A) are provided, but there is no head-to-head comparison against checkpoint-based systems, no realistic multi-turn trace showing the practical hit-rate benefit of unconstrained boundaries, no variance reporting, and unexplained non-monotonicity (e.g., Qwen3.5-4B LongBench 98.9% at r=5% vs 98.1% at r=10%). Evidence is internally consistent (Table 1 percentages match Table 3 cells; abstract speedups match Table 2) but self-reported, limited to subsets of LongBench/RULER, one TTFT workload, and no storage-overhead quantification for cached FA hiddens. Generalizability is limited to Gated DeltaNet-style decayed linear attention and a bespoke PyTorch setup rather than an integrated serving system. No code release is claimed. Calibrated weighted score ~0.61.

primary_link.title: Tail-Replay: Escaping the Curse of Linear Attention in Prefix Caching for Hybrid LLMs

radar.summary: Hybrid large language models interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce the cost of long-context inference. This structure complicates prefix caching: full-attention key-value caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing hybrid prefix caching methods address this mismatch by storing recurrent-state checkpoints. As a result, token-level matches are directly u
radar.summary_zh: 混合式大型語言模型交錯全注意力(FA)層與線性注意力層以降低長上下文推論成本,卻使前綴快取變得棘手:FA 的 KV 快取以 token 為索引、可於任意邊界重用,線性注意力層則將已處理前綴摘要成遞迴狀態,推進後無法回溯,形成「線性注意力的詛咒」。既有系統(如 Marconi)仰賴儲存遞迴狀態檢查點,重用邊界因此受限於檢查點位置。Tail-Replay 的核心洞見是:Gated DeltaNet 等線性注意力可視為對前綴的結構化有損壓縮,閘控更新會逐步衰減早期輸入,故只重播匹配前綴的近期短尾段即可良好近似其遞迴狀態。系統只快取精確的 FA KV 與 FA 輸出隱藏狀態、不存檢查點;命中快取時由零初始化狀態逐組重播尾部,重建各線性注意力組狀態,重用邊界遂由共享 token 決定;尾端 FFN 跳過與 KV 傳輸/重播重疊兩項最佳化再壓低開銷。在三個 GDN 混合模型(OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B)上,5–10% 重播預算於 LongBench 與 RULER 保留 92.8–99.9% 的完整 prefill 品質,32K 前綴的 TTFT 加速達 9.1–14.3 倍,重疊傳輸再省 18–42%。限制包括僅驗證 GDN 類機制、部分任務(如 qasper)品質下滑較明顯,且 10% 預算在 32K 時重播成為主要成本。此工作讓混合模型首次能不受檢查點束縛地與前綴快取協同部署,對多輪對話、RAG 與代理等重複前綴工作負載的服務效率極具價值。

links.title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training

evidence: Section 3.1: BonCorpus pipeline reduces 21.7M articles by nearly a third to 14.6M articles / 8.5B tokens via filtering, fastText LID, and MinHash LSH + Levenshtein deduplication.

Table 1 (Section 4.2): eight data mixtures ablated on Ministral 3 3B; BonCorpus-only (B) degrades average BonEval to 36.98 vs base 39.73, while BCES reaches 41.48, supporting the experience-replay claim.
Section 5.2: mean relative Euclidean parameter distance of 0.08 (LoRA) vs 0.18 (FFT) is offered as a hypothesis for why instruct vectors help only LoRA-adapted models.

Table 3 (Section 5.4): BonLM 8B LoRA+IV averages 46.02 on BonEval vs base 41.59; generative Headline improves 18.35→29.76 while discriminative Topic/Entity slightly degrade, matching the stated pattern.
Table 2 (Section 5.3): BonLM FFT averages 45.86 on Swedish EuroEval vs base 58.73, evidencing the targeted-evaluation argument that existing benchmarks miss in-domain gains.

Limitations section: proprietary data, code, and models cannot be released; single model family; unknown overlap with base-model pre-training data; automatic metrics only — directly limiting reproducibility and generalizability.
Appendix C / Table 4: full hyperparameters (AdamW, lr 5e-5, seq length 16,384, global batch 64, 6,500 GPU-hours on H200) are disclosed, partially offsetting the non-release of artifacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodologically substantive LLM adaptation study (continued pre-training of Ministral 3 3B/8B to Swedish journalism) with strong alignment to LLM, NLP, training/optimization, data-curation, and evaluation preferences, but no relevance to Japanese-specific LLM work, reasoning, agents, code, safety, or alignment, which caps its weighted preference fit. Contributions are real but incremental: experience replay (Section 3.3), LoRA vs FFT (Section 2.2, citing known trade-offs), and instruct vectors (Section 2.3) are established techniques; the novel elements are the BonEval benchmark, the finding that IV helps LoRA-CPT but hurts FFT-CPT, and the demonstration that EuroEval masks in-domain gains. Rigor is solid: 8 mixtures ablated at 3B scale (Table 1), recipe transferred to 8B (Table 3), 10 evaluation runs with 95% CIs (Tables 12-13), multiple baselines, and supplementary tasks validating BonEval. Evidence supports the claims quantitatively (e.g., BCES 41.48 vs base 39.73; BonLM LoRA+IV 46.02 vs base 41.59 on BonEval; FFT EuroEval drop to 45.86 vs base 58.73). Generalizability is limited to one model family, language, and domain, as the authors concede; reproducibility is poor because data, code, and models cannot be released for business/legal reasons (Limitations section). Not a pure domain-application paper since it contributes corpus curation, training recipes, and benchmark methodology.

primary_link.title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training

radar.summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct
radar.summary_zh: 大型語言模型在通用任務上能力漸強,但在新聞學等冷門領域與瑞典語等研究較少的語言上效益仍然有限。本文由Linköping大學與Bonnier News合作,以持續預訓練將大型語言模型調適至瑞典語新聞工作。研究團隊從2,170萬篇新聞文章出發,經格式標準化、規則過濾與精確及模糊去重,建成約1,460萬篇、85億詞元的BonCorpus語料;並將編輯內容轉化為標題產生、導言撰寫、摘要、主題分類、關鍵實體識別與常識測驗六項任務,構成新基準BonEval。實驗採用Ministral 3的3B與8B基礎模型,比較完整fine-tuning、LoRA與LLaMA Pro,並測試各混入10%程式碼、英語或瑞典語回放資料。結果顯示,唯有搭配經驗回放,持續預訓練才有正向效益,最佳混合為BCES;生成任務與事實知識(尤其測驗)一致提升,鑑別式任務則略為退步;8B模型以LoRA加instruct向量平均46.02分最佳。值得注意的是,通用基準EuroEval反而顯示退步,未能捕捉領域內的進步,凸顯針對性評估的必要。限制包括資料、程式碼與模型因商業及法律因素無法公開、僅測試單一模型家族,且僅仰賴自動評估。此研究證明持續預訓練是出版商開發並掌控編輯工具的可行途徑,也為其他語言與領域的模型專門化提供藍圖。

links.title: CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework

evidence: Sec. 5, Table 1: CM2 improves accuracy across four backbones (llava-onevision-7b 23.53 to 50.68; GPT4.1-mini 41.63 to 55.20); Sec. 5.1 concedes the margin 'narrowing to 0.90pp on the strongest backbone GPT4.1-mini'; no significance testing or variance estimates appear anywhere.
Sec. 5.2, Table 2: per-module ablations on three backbones; smallest drops are ~1.1-1.8pp (e.g., w/o RDF: 46.83 to 45.02 on Qwen2.5-VL-7B), within noise for n=442.
Sec. 4 'Hybrid Construction Pipeline': the 3,715-entry KB_rag is built by retrieving materials from expert-provided seeds; no leakage control between retrieval KB and the 442 test items is stated.

Secs. 3.6-3.7: gate weights and final answer selection are scored by the backbone VLM itself (1-10 scales), and RDF applies threshold 's-bar < tau = 0.6' to an average of 1-10 scores, an apparent scale inconsistency; no validation of self-scores against human judgment.
Sec. 5.3, Fig. 3: on the Conflict Subset (~54% of test samples) CM2 reaches 50.0%/53.4% vs CoT-SC 40.4%/46.2% and Agent Debate 38.8%/44.5%; Consensus Subset analysis also reported.

Document-wide: no code, dataset-release, or availability statement; Fig. 4 caption admits 'Reasoning texts are human-edited summaries, not verbatim model outputs'; the Qwen2.5-VL-7B (SFT) row in Table 1 lacks all baseline comparisons.

Secs. 3.4-3.5: hyperparameters are specified (alpha=0.5, top-K=5, r=5, T_max=3, tau_g=0.7, FAISS over CLIP + sentence-transformer similarities), aiding reproducibility, but actual prompt texts and web-search API details are omitted.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong alignment with top-weight preferences: multi-agent framework with web-search tool use (Agents & Tool Use), explicit comparison to CoT/Self-Refine/CoT-SC/Agent Debate (Reasoning), a central RAG module, and MLLM backbones (LLMs, Multimodal). However, the contribution is largely an assembly of established techniques (RAG, gated fusion, self-refinement, debate) applied to a self-constructed 442-sample cultural benchmark. Numbers are internally consistent with n=442 and per-module ablations exist, but there are no significance tests/error bars, the margin on the strongest backbone is only 0.90pp, possible KB-to-test leakage is unaddressed, gate/refinement scoring by the same backbone VLM introduces self-evaluation circularity, and no code or data release is mentioned.

primary_link.title: CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework

Their horizontal, interdisciplinary cultural reasoning, however, remains underexplored.We propose CM2, a multi-agent framework grounded in the cognitive pathway of human cultural interpretation. CM2 integrates multimodal perception, retrieval-augmented generation, networked reasoning, gated fusion, and r
radar.summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型(MLLM)在STEM領域擅長逐步演繹的「垂直推理」,但文化理解任務需跨學科整合異質證據並處理多重詮釋的歧義,屬於「水平推理」,現有模型常過度相信表面視覺線索,或生成看似合理卻缺乏依據的敘述。本文提出CM2,一個以人類美感認知路徑為本的五模組多代理人框架:多模態感知(MP)擷取風格線索;檢索增強生成(RAG)啟動文化先例;網路化推理(NR)透過網路搜尋進行外部驗證;閘控融合(GFS)以相關性加權仲裁跨模態衝突;獎勵驅動回饋(RDF)依文化準則迭代修正輸出。作者另建構CM2D資料集,含442題專家驗證測試樣本與3,715筆檢索條目,涵蓋四大類十三細類,並以反事實篩選確保題目需跨模態推理方能作答。實驗顯示,CM2在Qwen2.5-VL、llava-onevision-7b與GPT4.1-mini等骨幹上皆穩定超越CoT、Self-Refine、CoT-SC與Agent Debate,如llava-onevision-7b由23.53%倍增至50.68%;消融實驗證實各模組皆有貢獻,而在佔多數的證據衝突子集上,閘控融合較CoT高出18.3至26.1個百分點。限制在於:最強骨幹GPT4.1-mini上領先幅度縮小至0.90個百分點,測試集規模有限,整體準確率仍未過半。本研究證明,顯式的證據整合與衝突仲裁,而非單純擴大模型規模,才是提升人文社會科學推理能力的關鍵。
radar.title: CM2: Multimodal Cultural Reasoning via an Integrated Multi-Agent Framework
radar.title_zh: CM2:透過整合式多代理人框架進行多模態文化推理

links.title: FABO: Agent-Guided Discovery of Joint Breakpoint Optimization for Timing-Driven Routing Trees

evidence: Abstract: reports FABO reduces average FLUTE-normalized wirelength at every setting with peak same-epsilon reductions of 0.83% overall and 2.66% for nets with at least 30 pins; code released at github.com/DevinShang/routing-FABO.

Sec. III: describes eight Hypothesis Agents, a Critic, three parallel Programmer-Verifier chains, a fixed Evaluator, and an SSOT, but nowhere names the underlying LLM, its prompts, or the number/cost of search rounds.
Sec. IV-B/IV-C/IV-E: Lemma 1 (feasible intervals form a contiguous suffix), Theorem 1 (minimum initial breakpoint set), and Theorem 2 (feasibility of realized candidate) are stated with proofs.
Sec. V-B: at epsilon=0.1125 mean FLUTE-normalized wirelength is 1.0312 for SALT vs 1.0227 for FABO; FABO has lower mean beta without increasing mean alpha or gamma at all 20 tolerances.
Sec. V-C: maximum reductions across the 20 tolerances are 0.31% (3-9 pins), 1.70% (10-19), 2.15% (20-29), 2.66% (30+ pins), with 3-9-pin nets at 69.9% of the benchmark.
Sec. V-D mechanism test: at epsilon=0.1125 and rho=50%, SALT mean shared-trunk fraction 48.74% vs FABO 49.38%; FABO reduction is 1.38%/0.80%/0.12% in low/mid/high-sharing terciles.

Sec. V-E: full FABO takes 10.66x all-net SALT runtime at epsilon=0.1125 (SALT 62.43 s, +602.83 s, prediction 0.872 s); depth-4 96-tree XGBoost with 22 features and eight-fold leave-one-design-out; at b=1.3 FABO-FAST recovers 99.0-100% of nets with at least 25% gain.
Sec. IV-G concedes the minimum cover does not guarantee minimum wirelength and that candidate ranking, connector construction, support-tree choice, and postprocessing remain heuristics.

Sec. V-A footnote 1: released benchmark has 1.29M nets with at least three pins versus 2.38M nontrivial nets reported in the SALT paper; authors note the discrepancy and compare under the same released files and evaluator.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An EDA routing-tree algorithms paper framed around LLM multi-agent discovery. The technical core (FABO: interval-based joint breakpoint optimization over SALT) is well specified, proved (Lemmas 1-2, Theorems 1-2), and evaluated at scale (1.29M ICCAD15 nets, 20 tolerances, fanout stratification, shared-trunk mechanism test, leave-one-design-out predictor for FABO-FAST), with honest limitation and benchmark-discrepancy notes and released code. However, the headline agent framework is never evaluated as a method: no ablation vs. a serial agent, no round/cost statistics, and no LLM model, prompts, or framework hyperparameters are disclosed, so the claim that the multi-agent loop discovered FABO is unverifiable; average wirelength gains are modest (0.83% overall, 2.66% on 30+ pin nets) and confined to one formulation. Moderately relevant to agent/LLM program-search preferences, but the language-methodology content is one section and the artifact is domain-specific.

primary_link.title: FABO: Agent-Guided Discovery of Joint Breakpoint Optimization for Timing-Driven Routing Trees

radar.summary: The topology of a routing tree determines how a multi-pin net branches and shares physical wire, directly affecting wirelength, congestion, capacitance, and delay. We study a central early-stage routing problem: minimizing wirelength while bounding the root-to-sink path stretch for every sink. SALT is the state-of-the-art constructive algorithm for this problem. We ask whether language-model-guided search can discover a constructive algorithm that improves on SALT. To make this search reliable,
radar.summary_zh: 本文探討早期繞線的核心問題:在限制每個 sink 的根點至 sink 路徑長度不超過 (1+ε) 倍曼哈頓距離的前提下,最小化多接腳網路繞線樹的總線長,SALT 是此問題最先進的建構式演算法。作者建置多代理程式探索框架:八個隔離的假設代理並行提出結構性機制,Critic 檢驗假設並產生規格,三組 Programmer–Verifier 鏈平行實作與獨立驗證,固定 Evaluator 檢查完整繞線樹,並以 SSOT 記錄已驗證證據。透過此框架發現 SALT 的結構性瓶頸:其逐一修復超額路徑,從不為共享根部線段的多條路徑聯合決定分岔位置,導致過早分裂並重複繞線。據此提出 FABO,將每條路徑的合法斷點表示為連續區間,於區間重疊處選擇共享斷點,以「全有全無」的邊釋放會計估算增益,同時保證每個 sink 的路徑預算。在 129 萬個 ICCAD15 網路、SALT 的 20 組伸展容差設定下,FABO 於每個設定皆降低平均 FLUTE 正規化線長,峰值降幅為整體 0.83%、至少 30 接腳網路 2.66%,且增益隨 fanout 增加而擴大,其樹保留更多共享主幹線段。完整 FABO 在 ε=0.1125 約需 10.66 倍 SALT 執行時間;FABO-FAST 以 XGBoost 預測器挑選高增益網路,在 1.3 倍執行時間內即涵蓋絕大多數高增益個案。理論上,區間可行性、最小初始斷點集與候選樹預算可行性均有證明,惟候選排序與連接器建構仍屬啟發式;此結果展示語言模型引導搜尋能發現並驗證實用的 EDA 演算法改良。
radar.title: FABO: Agent-Guided Discovery of Joint Breakpoint Optimization for Timing-Driven Routing Trees
radar.title_zh: FABO:代理程式引導之時序驅動繞線樹聯合斷點最佳化探索

links.title: DiffPDE: Masked Diffusion Language Models as PDE Solver

evidence: Abstract: proposes DiffPDE using discrete diffusion LMs with localized re-masking and infilling for targeted code repair, plus Iterative Debugging GRPO (ID-GRPO) with intermediate rewards.

Section 5.3: 'all LLM-based methods share identical candidate budgets (N=32), debugging limits (k=3), prompts, and execution environments, with the repair mechanism being the sole differentiating factor.'
Section 5.5, Table 6 ablation: full DiffPDE reaches avg nRMSE 0.23 and Pass@32 0.52 vs. 0.37 without intermediate rewards and 0.38 without dynamic buffer.
Section 5.6, Table 7: same-checkpoint localized infilling cuts per-attempt latency from 64.85 s to 0.748 s (~86x) with Pass@32 0.5063 vs. 0.4938 for full regeneration.
Section 5.5 and Tables 1-2: DiffPDE discloses weak Darcy results (nRMSE 1.0, Pass@32 0.09) and a React-Diff Pass@32 drop to 0.28, described as trade-offs.

Section 5.4: implementation builds on Dream-Coder-7B, ~1K SFT trajectories, 60 RL steps, 8x A800, ~350 GPU-hours; Appendix Tables 10-12 give full hyperparameters and Appendix D gives prompt templates.
Limitations: 'A limited subset of failures requires global structural revisions and remains beyond the scope of the current localized infilling framework.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: An in-scope LLM-methodology paper: fine-tunes a masked diffusion LM (Dream-Coder-7B) with SFT plus a custom GRPO variant (ID-GRPO) for execution-feedback-driven code repair, applied to PDE solver synthesis on PDEBench. It aligns well with high-weight preferences on LLMs and Code & Programming, moderately with RL/alignment (GRPO, reward design), agents (generate-execute-debug loop), and reasoning (CoT planning path), but has zero connection to Japanese LLM/NLP and only partial coverage of other high-weight areas. Novelty is moderate-to-good: localized re-masking/infilling for debugging with a bidirectional dLLM, multi-round RL trajectories with dense intermediate rewards, and a dynamic infilling buffer are a coherent new combination, though dLLM code generation and infilling-based repair have prior art. Rigor is mixed: fair shared-budget comparison protocol and useful ablations (Table 6; Table 7 same-checkpoint full-regen vs. infill) strengthen the case, but same-scale AR baselines lack the task-specific fine-tuning DiffPDE receives, best-of-32 nRMSE reports peak rather than mean performance, only 5 PDE families with 100 test instances each are used, and no variance/significance estimates are provided. Evidence is solid within the document (quantitative tables, 86x repair speedup, failure-locality stats, case study) and weaknesses like Darcy (nRMSE 1.0, Pass@32 0.09) are disclosed rather than hidden. Generalizability is limited by the deterministic traceback-anchored localization, the narrow PDEBench subset, and the admitted inability to handle global structural failures. Reproducibility is above average: repository link claimed, detailed hyperparameter/prompt/split/hardware documentation (Tables 10-12, Appendix D), though repo contents cannot be verified from the text.

primary_link.title: DiffPDE: Masked Diffusion Language Models as PDE Solver

radar.summary: Existing approaches for synthesizing Partial Differential Equation (PDE) solvers predominantly rely on autoregressive models, yet their global left-to-right decoding incurs substantial redundancy when addressing inherently localized bugs. In this work, we challenge this inefficient paradigm and propose DiffPDE, a framework leveraging discrete diffusion language models for targeted code repair. By introducing a localized re-masking and infilling strategy, DiffPDE regenerates only erroneous region
radar.summary_zh: 現有以大型語言模型合成偏微分方程（PDE）數值求解器的方法多採用自迴歸（AR）架構，修正局部錯誤時仍須由左至右重生成整段程式碼，冗餘運算可觀。本文提出 DiffPDE，改用離散擴散語言模型（dLLM），透過「局部重新遮罩與填補」策略，僅平行重建疑似錯誤區段，並以周遭正確程式碼為雙向條件，契合錯誤稀疏分布的特性。針對需多次修復的耦合錯誤，作者提出 Iterative Debugging GRPO（ID-GRPO），結合任務分配與動態緩衝機制，以中間獎勵提供稠密回饋，支援單一軌跡內的多輪除錯訓練。模型以 Dream-Coder-7B 為基礎，先經監督式微調（SFT）與強化學習（RL）訓練。在 PDEBench 五個 PDE 家族上，DiffPDE-7B 的最佳候選誤差（nRMSE）可與 GPT-5.2 等大型模型抗衡，並大幅優於同規模 AR 基線，例如 Burgers 誤差降至 9.7×10⁻⁴；在可壓縮 Navier–Stokes 的 Pass@32 達 0.78，超越 Claude-Sonnet-4.6。效率上，每次填補修復不到一秒，較 AR 全量重生成加速約 30 至 100 倍，端對端平均最壞成本降至 55.5 秒。消融實驗確認 SFT、中間獎勵與動態緩衝各有貢獻，且 76.8% 的初始失敗屬局部錯誤。限制：從零生成仍較 AR 緩慢，約 5.4% 的全域結構性錯誤與 2D Darcy Flow 尚待解決。此研究展現 dLLM 在科學程式生成與互動式除錯的潛力。
radar.title: DiffPDE: Masked Diffusion Language Models as PDE Solver
radar.title_zh: DiffPDE：以遮罩擴散語言模型作為 PDE 求解器

links.title: Bridge: Automatically Mining Ecosystem-Scale API Update Mappings and Client Update Instances

evidence: Section 4.2.2, Table 4: Bridge achieves 91.6% precision / 88.7% recall / 90.1% F1 for Java (305 TP, 28 FP, 39 FN) and 90.1% / 64.0% / 74.9% for Python (155 TP, 17 FP, 87 FN) on a ground truth of 638 Java and 609 manually annotated API call change records.
Section 4.1: two-author annotation with Cohen's kappa of 0.92 over 2,283 Java and 1,988 API call pairs; ground truth contains 344 Java and 242 genuine instances.
Section 4.3.2, Table 5: Phase 4 ablation raises Java precision from 51.3% to 91.6% and Python precision from 46.8% to 90.1% at the cost of recall (95.3%->88.7% Java, 90.9%->64.0% Python).

Section 4.5.2, Table 7 and Figure 8: best LLM replacement recommendation is GPT-5.4 with 37.1% Java FQN and 44.4% Python FQN accuracy; accuracy rises from ~15.4-23.9% on single-instance mappings to ~48.5-79.4% on mappings with >100 instances; context input does not consistently help.
Section 5.2 Threats to Validity: ground truth sampled from Phase 3 records so RQ1 recall is not end-to-end; pinned versions, same-commit assumption, and Java/Python-only support limit coverage.
Section 1 (end) / Section 6: implementation and mined dataset publicly available at https://github.com/ROCK-SE/Bridge; mining depends on World of Code V3 (4.7B commits, 19.6B blobs, Section 2.4).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A mining-software-repositories / dataset-construction paper (API update mappings, version transitions, client update instances via World of Code), not an LLM methodology paper. Topic fit is moderate: it falls under Code & Programming and Data & Datasets, and its LLM content (RQ4) is only an application study evaluating four existing LLMs on replacement API recommendation (best 37.1% Java / 44.4% Python FQN accuracy, Section 4.5.2 Table 7), with no new language-model technique. Research quality is strong: manually annotated ground truth with Cohen's kappa 0.92 (Section 4.1), internally consistent precision/recall numbers (91.6/88.7 Java, 90.1/64.0 Python, Section 4.2.2 Table 4), threshold and weight sensitivity with grouped 5-fold cross-validation, a Phase 4 ablation showing +40.3/+43.3 precision points (Section 4.3.2 Table 5), detailed FP/FN error analysis, and McNemar + Holm statistics for the LLM study. Limitations are candidly stated (Section 5.2: recall is not end-to-end, ground truth sampled from Phase 3 outputs, pinned versions and Java/Python only, language-specific reimplementations needed). Novelty is incremental: a client-driven inversion of existing library-driven dataset workflows plus scale (381,661 Java / 277,259 Python instances; Section 4.4 Table 6), built from known parsing, similarity matching, and validation techniques. Code and dataset publicly released (https://github.com/ROCK-SE/Bridge), but reproducibility depends on WoC V3 infrastructure access.

primary_link.title: Bridge: Automatically Mining Ecosystem-Scale API Update Mappings and Client Update Instances

radar.summary: Library updates often require adapting client code to API changes. API update mappings that identify relations between legacy and replacement APIs, version transitions that these mappings apply, and client update instances that capture concrete API call changes are essential for developing and evaluating automated library update techniques. Existing library evolution datasets capture only subsets of this information and typically cover few third-party libraries. In this paper, we present Bridge,
radar.summary_zh: 函式庫更新雖能取得安全性修補與新功能，但常需調整用戶端程式碼以因應 API 變動。現有函式庫演化資料集僅涵蓋部分資訊，且多只涉及少數第三方函式庫，難以同時提供 API 更新映射、版本轉換與用戶端更新實例。本文提出 Bridge，一個以用戶端為驅動的自動化框架，建構於 World of Code（WoC）基礎設施之上：先從用戶端相依性更新提交中挖掘候選更新實例，再以函式庫端證據（API 存在性、移除或棄用標記）驗證，最後歸納出 API 更新映射，使每個保留的映射皆立基於至少一個真實用戶端實例。在手動標註的真值資料集上，Java 達到 91.6% 精確率與 88.7% 召回率，Python 為 90.1% 與 64.0%；函式庫端驗證使兩種語言的精確率分別提升逾 40 個百分點。套用至 WoC V3 後，共挖掘 381,661 個 Java 與 277,259 個 Python 更新實例，對應 2,557 與 999 個函式庫的 18,900 與 4,456 個映射，並呈現明顯長尾分布。作者進一步評估四種大型語言模型於替換 API 建議任務，最佳準確率僅達 Java 37.1% 與 Python 44.4%，且對低頻長尾映射的表現明顯較差。限制方面，框架僅支援固定版本約束、假設相依性更新與程式碼調整發生於同一提交，且目前僅涵蓋 Java 與 Python。此資料集連結「替換什麼、跨哪些版本、用戶端如何改」，對發展與評估自動化函式庫更新技術極具價值。
radar.title: Bridge: Automatically Mining Ecosystem-Scale API Update Mappings and Client Update Instances
radar.title_zh: Bridge：自動挖掘生態系規模的 API 更新映射與用戶端更新實例

links.title: LangBP: Language-Guided Reasoning and Acting for Joint Bidding and Pricing

evidence: Abstract: 'Experiments on AuctionNet show that LangBP outperforms strong baselines, and online A/B tests further demonstrate business gains in real-world deployment' — domain is online advertising, but the method is LLM policy optimization.

Section 1: identifies two claimed gaps — prior language-guided methods 'condition actions on language strategies without modeling the corresponding state changes' and give 'imbalanced policy updates across effects'.
Section 4.2, Eq. (7)-(10): S-DT predicts target states from instruction and history, then recovers actions via a frozen inverse model; language affects action 'only through this target state'.
Section 4.4, Eq. (14): EGPO assigns equal outer weight per active effect group, dividing within groups; only the instruction policy is updated while S-DT/CEV stay frozen.
Section 4.3: CEV trained on matched historical pairs with residualized utilities via DML-style folding; paper states S 'remains an observational, non-causal ranking score'.
Section 5.2/Table 1: LangBP highest Score in all ten settings; 4.2%–6.5% over JD-BP on AuctionNet and ~2.0%–3.3% over strongest baselines on AuctionNet-Sparse.
Section 5.3/Table 2: five ablations (SFT Only 20.0–46.8 up to LangBP 21.8–51.1); target-state mediation beats Direct Action by 4.1%–6.6%.
Section 5.4/Figure 4: CEV pairwise accuracy 85.7% vs 72.6% Relative-Q and 58.2% under support-preserving context permutation, with bootstrap CIs in Appendix D.1 (4,231 validation pairs).
Section 5.5/Table 3: A/B gains +2.59% Ad Click, +3.34% Ad Value, +1.83pp Achievement; no significance tests or intervals reported for these online metrics.

Section 5.1 'Joint trajectory construction': joint training data built by augmenting the simulator with a PID pricing controller and rerunning delivery — evaluation data is self-constructed; 'data-construction code and constructed training data will be released upon publication' is a promise only.
Appendix B: GPT-5.5 teacher and Qwen-3.5-0.8B student, full hyperparameters (learning rates, batch sizes, thresholds in Table 5), two NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
Appendix C: matched-seed LangBP-minus-w/o-Effect-Grouping differences 'positive for all five seeds at every budget ratio'.
Appendix A/Table 4: LangBP w/o Pricing (20.8–49.5) vs full LangBP (21.8–51.1) isolates the pricing lever as ~1–1.6 Score points.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A domain application (online-advertising auto-bidding) whose central contribution is nonetheless genuine LLM methodology: an instruction policy trained with a GRPO-style, effect-grouped PPO objective (EGPO), a language-conditioned Decision Transformer with target-state planning and inverse dynamics (S-DT), and a RankNet-style context-effect verifier. This keeps it above the pure-domain cap, but all evaluation is confined to AuctionNet variants plus one proprietary A/B test, with no evidence the EGPO/CEV machinery transfers beyond bidding, so preference relevance and generalizability are moderate. Novelty is incremental: S-DT combines DePO-style state planning (Liu et al. 2022) with SemBid/LBM-style language conditioning, and EGPO modifies GRPO's within-context weighting. Rigor and evidence are strong: formal formulation, five ablations, five-run means with std, matched-seed paired differences positive on all seeds (Appendix C), advertiser-cluster bootstrap CIs for CEV accuracy (85.7% vs 58.2% under permutation), threshold sensitivity checks, and honest caveats that CEV is observational and non-causal. Weaknesses: joint training data is self-constructed by augmenting the simulator with a PID pricing controller, the A/B test reports no significance tests or confidence intervals (Table 3), and code/data are only promised ('will be released upon publication'). Dependence on a proprietary GPT-5.5 teacher further limits reproducibility.

primary_link.title: LangBP: Language-Guided Reasoning and Acting for Joint Bidding and Pricing

radar.summary: Auto-bidding is a long-horizon sequential decision problem for maximizing conversion value under budget and key performance indicator (KPI) constraints. Recent work extends this task from bidding alone to joint bidding and pricing, where a policy controls bidding decisions and pricing corrections. Existing methods mainly rely on numerical trajectory modeling, which offers limited support for interpreting campaign context and expressing high-level strategies. Large language models (LLMs) can comp
radar.summary_zh: 本文處理線上廣告自動競價在預算與KPI約束下極大化轉換價值的長時序決策問題,並將控制範圍由單純出價延伸至出價與事後定價修正的聯合決策,以分工兼顧未來價值與歷史偏差的修補。既有語言引導方法有兩項限制:一是僅以語言策略條件化動作,未明確建模對應的狀態變化,難以區分策略理解與動作生成的錯誤;二是不同指令可能產生相似執行效果,導致策略更新權重失衡。作者提出階層式框架LangBP:高層指令政策以GPT-5.5為教師、Qwen-3.5-0.8B為學生,由廣告活動脈絡產生含策略說明、出價方向與定價強度的結構化指令;低層執行器S-DT依指令與軌跡歷史預測目標狀態,再以逆動力學還原聯合動作。EGPO將相似效果的候選指令分組,由CEV在行為支援區域內學習情境相依的觀察式偏好,並對各活躍效果組給予等量外層權重。在AuctionNet與AuctionNet-Sparse的十種預算設定中,LangBP全面超越JD-BP、LBM、SemBid等基線約2.0%至6.5%;消融實驗證實目標狀態中介、CEV與效果分組各有貢獻。七天線上A/B測試顯示廣告價值提升3.34%、點擊提升2.59%、ROI達標率提升1.83個百分點。限制在於CEV僅依賴行為支援區域內的觀察式證據,分佈偏移下的線上回饋仍待探索。本工作示範語言推理與連續控制的結合能帶來可驗證的商業效益。

evidence: Section 4.1/Table 1: LLM scoring limited to 100 held-out customers per dataset (3,599 Instacart pairs, 1,214 DC pairs) due to inference cost.
Table 2 (Section 5.1): on Instacart GPT-4o achieves NDCG@5 0.6568 vs XGBoost 0.6962 and personal-frequency 0.6297; LLM trails supervised rankers but beats the heuristic on most metrics.

Section 5.2/Table 3: GPT-4o norm-prompt improves over base GPT-4o on all 18 masking metrics on proprietary data but only 8 of 18 on DC, and exceeds the cross-family attribution baseline on 10/18 Instacart vs 4/18 proprietary metrics.
Table 4 (Section 5.2): groundedness audit of 3,599 Instacart explanations reports group precision 0.951, recall 0.740, numeric consistency 0.996.

Section 6 (Limitations): median-replacement masking may be unnatural for binary/categorical features, no user study of explanation usefulness, only 100 customers per dataset, and no code or data availability statement anywhere in the paper.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A workshop paper from Walmart that studies LLMs (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Pro) in two roles: standalone repurchase scorers and generators of feature rationales evaluated via a cross-model feature-masking protocol against TreeSHAP/integrated-gradients baselines. It is genuinely LLM-centric rather than a pure domain application: prompting/evidence-card representation, rationale selection, and text-to-evidence groundedness are the object of study, so it earns solid preference relevance (LLM weight 2.5, interpretability 1.8, prompting 1.5), though the e-commerce recommendation setting and lack of reasoning-methodology depth cap it. Novelty is moderate: adapting rationale-faithfulness/masking evaluation (ERASER-style) to tabular recommendation with cross-model validation is a reasonable, somewhat incremental contribution. Rigor is decent for a workshop paper with clear RQs, three datasets, multiple baselines and a prompt ablation, but weakened by very small LLM eval sets (100 users per dataset, Sec. 4.1), no significance testing, and median-replacement masking issues that the authors themselves flag in Sec. 6. Evidence strength is fair: quantitative tables support the claims (Table 2 shows LLM NDCG@5 0.6568 vs XGBoost 0.6962 on Instacart; Table 3 shows dataset-dependent masking gaps), but the groundedness audit methodology (Table 4) is under-specified and no error bars are given. Generalizability is limited by acknowledged dataset-dependence, two LLM families, and a proprietary dataset. Reproducibility is weak: no code/data release, a proprietary dataset, and API-model versioning, though the prompt template and 28-feature list are provided in Appendix A.

primary_link.title: Beyond Ranking Accuracy: Evaluating LLM-Cited Feature Rationales for Next Basket Repurchase Recommendation

radar.summary: Next-basket repurchase recommendation is commonly formulated as a ranking task: given a customer's purchase history, the system ranks previously purchased items that may be needed again. In production settings, however, ranking accuracy is only one component of recommendation quality. Customers may also benefit from concise evidence about why an item is recommended now. Large language models (LLMs) offer a potential way to surface such evidence through feature-based, human-readable rationales gr
radar.summary_zh: 下次購物籃回購推薦通常只以排名準確度衡量，但顧客也需要了解商品為何此刻被推薦。本文探討現成 LLM 能否勝任兩種角色：作為結構化行為特徵的評分器，以及引用可解釋特徵作為理由的產生器。作者建立涵蓋購買節奏、頻率、新近度、使用者行為與商品熱門度的 28 項特徵，渲染成證據卡提供給 LLM，並在 Instacart、Dunnhumby DC 與私有零售資料集各抽樣 100 位顧客實驗。結果顯示 LLM 評分始終落後 XGBoost 與 vanilla NN 等監督式排名器；GPT-4o 僅在 Instacart 上超越個人頻率基準，norm-prompt 變體也未能改善排名。理由品質方面，作者以跨模型特徵遮蔽協定，比較 LLM 引用特徵與 TreeSHAP、integrated gradients 等歸因方法造成的排名退化，發現改善效果依資料集而異（私有資料集 18 項指標全數改善，Instacart 僅 7 項），且鮮少超越跨家族歸因基準；文字對證據的核對則顯示高理由群組精確度 0.951 與數值一致性 0.996。限制包括遮蔽法無法確立因果或忠實性、每資料集樣本僅 100 位顧客、自動化核對僅限 Instacart，且只涵蓋兩種 LLM 與兩種排名器家族。整體而言，本文支持混合式設計：由監督式模型負責排名，特徵層級評估驗證證據，LLM 則將證據轉譯為簡潔的顧客導向解釋，理由品質應與排名準確度分開評估。
